85.instruction: Starting at a doorway looking into a dinning room that has a table and some chairs. Step in front of that door way, it should be opened. Where you should be standing the window to your right and the doorway is in front of you and you are done.

101.instruction: You're facing towards the floor, turn slightly towards your left, and go straight, to the right you'll find brown color table, go straight, you'll find brown color chair, go few steps forward, on the floor near the pillar you'll find your destination.

102.instruction: You're facing towards an open wooden entrance, and towards your left you can see a wooden railing, walk a few steps forward, and from underneath the stairs, enter the open entrance towards your right, now you can see few sofa's onto your right side, now slightly turn to your left, and walk a few steps forward and stand facing towards the wooden closed door and a black pot in front of you and that is your final destination.

118.instruction: Right now you're facing towards an arch. Now turn right and cross the chairs which are in front of you. There is a carpet in front of you, move towards the carpet and stand on it. Now slightly turn right, there is an open door in front of you, move towards the door and enter in to the bathroom, there is a window to your left and a toilet basin and sink platform to your right and it is your end point.

119.instruction: You are facing towards an open arch. Turn right and walk straightly behind the bar chairs till you find an open arch in front of you. Walk through the open arch. Slightly turn right and walk straightly towards the open door. Walk through the open door and enter into the room. Now you are in the washroom. There are two glass windows on your left side and a commode on your right side. That will be the end point.

257.instruction: Present you are facing diagonally towards the wall and there is an open door in your front. Exit the room. Take left from the door, move straight towards the other open door and that is your final destination.

258.instruction: You are facing towards the wall turn slightly left and exit the room, turn left and go near the door which is open, now your in front of the door, this would be your end point.

263.instruction: Right now you're facing towards a sink. Turn slightly towards your left and exit the room. Move forward till you reach a closed door in front of you. Walk towards the staircase and stand on the second step and that is the end point.

274.instruction: You are on the steps, slightly take left, climb the steps and move forward, turn right, you can find stairs, climb up the stairs completely, turn left, move forward, take left, walk straight, now you are facing towards the wall, turn left, you can find an open door, enter into the room, at the entrance of the room you can find your destination.

275.instruction: You are on the staircase facing towards the opposite side, take a slight left turn and move forward, and go straight near the door, take a slight right turn and go straight, take a right turn and go upstairs, take a slight right turn and go upstairs, take a slight left turn and go upstairs, turn around and go upstairs, take a slight left turn and go upstairs, and move forward, take a left turn and go straight near the wall, and take a slight left turn and move forward near the door, take a slight left turn and go straight towards the wall, take a slight left turn and enter into the room through the door. This is the endpoint.

333.instruction: We'll start by seeing some white ropes in front of us. We are going to turn to the right and see that there is a large doorway that leads to a hallway and another room. So, let's walk to this doorway, and this will be your destination.

340.instruction: Facing a grey couch in front of a wooden table. Head across the room into an open double door. Head down the hallway past the weigh couch on the Persian rug. Enter the kitchen and head past the breakfast table, taking a right. Head towards the kitchen island and you've arrived.

383.instruction: Now you are facing towards the white coloured curtain, turn towards your right and move forward and take immediate right turn and move out of the door, now move straight by passing through the curtains on your right side and the bed on your left side and move out of the open door, now move forward here you can see the white coloured clock on your left side. Now move forward through the open arch and take immediate left and go up the stairs not completely and walk till you find the second rose frame              on the right side of the wall and stop on the stair that would be your end point beside the second light on the stair.

384.instruction: You're facing to the curtains. Turn around, walk towards the mirror. Turn right, walk out of the room. You have the bed in front of you, walk straight and exit the room. Continue straight into the passage, where you can see stairs on your left. Walk to the stairs. Go up the stairs and stop right below the candle holder. It is your destination.

385.instruction: Facing the front door, just to the left is a mirror. Walk towards the mirror that's just above the table with a plant on it. Once you've reached the mirror, stay to the left and walk towards the downstairs. Don't go down the stairs, instead, veer to the right and go straight through the open doorway, keeping the railing of the stairs going down to the left, to the right is several paintings stacked right next to each other. You'll see a sink above some white cabinets, also below some white cabinets. Once you've stepped once in the room, turn back around, directly across from you should be another room with two, with an open, with two open doors and some pictures that are visible on the wall on the right. Jump into that room. That room looks like a classroom. On the left is a chalkboard with the word 'ART' above it. On the ground in front of you, a circular carpet with two stools on it, walk and stand next to the stool that is closest to the chalkboard and once you've done that, you're finished.

419.instruction: You are facing towards the chair turn right and walk straight, left you can find an entrance enter into it, turn right and walk straight till you reach a window in front, then turn left and walk few steps ahead you can find a washroom at the left side, enter into it you can find your destination in the middle in front of mirror.

420.instruction: You are facing towards the white chair. Turn to your left where you can find a sofa and a table. Move towards the sofa, walking straight and onto your left, you will find an entrance. Enter through it and take right. You will find another door which is opened. Enter through the door and there will be a microwave oven on your left and an open door in front of you. Pass through that door and go straight. You will find an another open door. Enter through that door and walk straight through the cupboards. You will find another open door in front of you. Pass through it and take immediate left. Again, take left. You will find an open door onto your left side. Enter through that door. Now, you are in the washroom. That will be your end point in front of the washbasin and mirror and toilet on your right side.

421.instruction: We're facing towards a staircase, take a few steps further, turn slightly to the left and go downstairs, once you land, turn towards the right... You're now facing towards a dining table with beige chairs, walk towards the back of the chair that's right in front of you... And exit towards the doorway that's in front of you... You're now facing towards a kitchen, walk towards the counter that's on the right, the one with the sink... Once you're facing it, turn towards the right slightly, and walk past the walkway that's between the counter and the cabinets... You're now facing towards another living room, turn towards the left, on your right there's a white couch, a very long white couch and on the left there's a round table with four chairs, and behind the chair that's on the right, there's a doorway that leads us to the exterior part of the house... Walk towards the corner of the white couch and the wall... Once you're facing the switch, and on the right side there's a painting, and on the left you're facing towards a glass door, you have reached your destination.

554.instruction: Right now, you're facing toward the potted plant. Turn right and  move forward until you reach a staircase on the right. Now, slightly turn right and get down the stairs. Now, enter into the room and stand at a point, where you can see a shower room on the right and a sink platform on the left and that is the end point.

555.instruction: You're facing towards the plant, turn to your right, you can see an open door, exit the open door, at your right you can see stairs, get down the stairs. Turn right and again turn right, move forward, slightly turn to your right, you can see an open arch. Go inside the arch, you can see an open door, go inside the open door and stand near the commode this is your end point.

556.instruction: Exit the closet to the foot of the bed. Turn right and exit the bedroom. Exit the bedroom and turn left and you'll stop at the next doorway on the left, it's a bathroom, you can see a bath. To the right now is just the railing, you're done.

589.instruction: You are facing towards a wooden table. Slightly turn left and move towards the couch. Now you are standing behind the couch facing towards the fire place. Turn left and walk straightly behind the bar chairs till you find a wooden table in front of you. Slightly turn left and walk through the open door. Now walk straightly towards the another open door and enter into the room. There is a dining table on your left side. Now walk straightly towards the couch. There is a tea-poi on your left side and a TV on your right side. That will be the end point.

590.instruction: You're facing a open space and beside you, it's a kitchen area and when you go straight, you will see the chairs and on your right side you will see the couch. Now you can see a grey sofa in front of you and a small rack above which you can see a TV, go straight. You can see two windows, go near the right window, it is your end point.

678.instruction: You're standing in a bedroom. On the left corner, you'll see there's an exit. Exit the bedroom and slight right. You'll see there is a room with a light on, slightly to your right. Walk into that room. You'll see it's a bathroom. Walk towards the sink. To your right is the bathtub. To the left, you'll see the shower and the toilet. In front of you is the sink. And you're done.

836.instruction: You're facing towards the table, now turn to your left, move forward, you can see stairs, climb up the stairs, go straight and turn to your right, you can see stairs, climb up the stairs, at your left you can see a bedroom, go inside the bedroom and stop near the lamp.

837.instruction: Now you are standing facing towards the blue chair and brown table, take slight left turn and move towards the table, on the table you can see the fruits bowl, take slight left turn and move towards the steps, climb-up the steps and move forward till you get the right turn where you can see the stair case, climb-up entire stairs, now you are standing in-front of the two open doors, take left turn you can see the open door and white bed, enter into that room and move forward and stand beside the white table at the corner, that is your final destination.

881.instruction: Now you are standing in the middle of bed and door turn right and you will find door entrance take an exit from the door and walk towards the stair case from there walk towards the wall that is your destination.

882.instruction: Right now you are facing towards the open door, turn slightly left and go straight, now move out through the open door and go straight, walk through the narrow path and in the middle of the empty room is your end point.

892.instruction: Exit the sauna. Take a right through the blue beads over the doorway. Once you're through the doorway, take the first left just in front of the chair on the left. Walk around the table, keeping it to the left of you and walk all the way to the opposite side so you're facing the door you came in and you're on the other side of the stone table. You're done.

904.instruction: You are standing in a washroom, exit the washroom, turn right, walk straight in the narrow path, in-front of you you can see a platform, walk to the platform, turn left, walk straight, to right you can see an open entrance, walk to the open entrance. In-front of you you can see a stand and  a lamp on it, walk to the lamp, slightly turn left, walk little bit forward and stand in-front of the table with a flower vase on it, that's your end point.

905.instruction: Currently facing towards a wall, turn slightly right and exit through the door, Now turn towards your right and enter the open arch and pass through the other open arch. Now you can see a kitchen counter table, move towards it, turn to your left, you can see a hallway of open arches, move towards it, turn to your right and enter the first room on the right. Can see a dining table with some chairs, take a slight left and move towards the other side of the dining table, now you are near a lamp . Turn to your left and stand near the entrance of the open arch, that is your end point.

914.instruction: Right now you're facing towards a wall and a curtain. Now turn right and move towards the mirror which is in front of you. Now again turn right and exit the room. There is an open door in front of you, move towards the door and exit the bedroom. You can see an arch in front of you, move towards the arch and slightly turn left and move forward in to the room which is in round shape. There is an arch in front of you, pass through the arch and stand in front of the arch which is to your left. Now turn left and enter in to the room and stand in front of the dining table and it is your end point.

915.instruction: You are facing towards a brown coloured table, turn to your right and move forward, now turn right and exit through the open door. Turn slightly left and move forward. You can see an open arch which has a portrait on its wall, enter through it. Move forward and enter the first open arch on your left and move forward towards the dining table. You are now standing facing towards a table with many chairs and this is your end point.

985.instruction: Move forward from the place you are standing and exit the room, slightly turn to your left, you can find an opening which is to the right of the staircase, go near the opening, you are facing towards the wall right now, slightly turn to your left and move a bit forward, to your left you can find an opening, go near the opening, slightly turn to your left and move forward, to your left you can find an opened door, move towards the opened door, slightly turn to your left and stand infront of the commode, that would be your end point.

986.instruction: You are beside the cupboards with a study lamp and a telephone. Move towards your right, you will find an arch. Go through that arch and take left. Move forward and you will find an another arch on your left side. Go through that arch. Move forward and take left. Pass through the window on your left side. Pass through the photo frame on your left side and you will find an open door on your left. Enter through that door. Now, you will enter into the washroom and that will be your destination point in front of the wash basin and the mirror.

1011.instruction: You find yourself in a narrow zone, facing towards the wall which has a violin and a lamp on it. Turn right and enter the room, now you find yourself facing the wooden cabinets and two washing machines to your right. This is your final point.

1012.instruction: You're facing towards an open entrance now turn around and towards your left you can see an open wooden door, enter the door and you're now in front of the wooden racks and towards your right, you can see a washing machine and that is your final destination.

1124.instruction: Right now you are standing in between of the two walls turn right and walk straight and enter into the arch in front you can find the wooden cupboard and a flower pot on it take left, walk completely straight towards the two chairs and a round table take right from the two chairs and move towards the sofa which is present in the front under the television now take slight right and move near the fireplace in between of the fireplace and a plant is the end point.

1125.instruction: You are standing facing towards the portrait on the wall. Slightly turn right and walk two steps ahead. You will see an arch on your right side. Enter into the arch and walk straight. You will be passing through some paintings on both the sides. You are now facing towards a white vase. Turn left and keep walking straight on the path beside the stove. You will find an open arch and two brown chairs in front of you. Turn right and keep walking straight inside the living room. Slightly turn towards your right you will see a big pot and two giraffes. Stop near the white pot. You have reached your point.

1183.instruction: You begin looking at some shelving units, one of which has a globe and an hourglass on it. Turn to your left until you see the arched wooden entryway. Go ahead out of that into a circular atrium of sorts and turn to the left, taking the hallway immediately to the left of the one that you're exiting. Down that hall you should see another, smaller, circular atrium. You're going to cut directly across it to the door just beside the mirror, and once you are through there you are going to continue straight through the bedroom into the open archway on the left. That is a door actually, it was just hard to see the door from further away. You should step into a closet, a walk-in closet with a window on the other end of it to the one you're entering, just step up to that window, right above the little cabinet drawers thing, and once you're standing looking out of that window, you're done.

1220.instruction: You will start by standing in between the shelves and the counter with the sink. Look straight towards the kitchen. The hallway. Keep walking forward, standing in between the sink and the stove. Take another step forward and you will see a hallway on your left and on your right you will see the dining table. An open area where you can go outside and the living room. Walk towards the open area right on the right side corner of the dining table. Once you're there look to your right and you will see the grey carpet and the single grey chair on the left of the living room. Walk towards the front of the grey chair. Once you're there, walk towards the front of the TV and once you're at the front of the TV then you're done.

1234.instruction: For your start point you are at a doorway facing a room that has red printed carpet and a fire place across the room with a picture over the mantel. On either side of the of the fire place there are book selves or cases. Turn to your right and exit this room you now enter into a vintage study room you will see a table in front of you that has a lamp and a statue to the foot or the legs of the table. Turn to the left and move forward behind that table until you reach what it looks like, it could be a fire place to your left with a portrait above it of a man. Once you are in front of that fireplace you have reached your end point.

1237.instruction: You are facing towards the wall slightly turn left, and exit the room then again turn to your left. Move two steps forward and enter into the room which is two your left side, go and stand beside the bath tub.

1238.instruction: Right now your facing towards the wall turn slightly left and move forward, exit through the door. Then turn left and move forward again turn left, and enter into the restroom go and stand in front of the mirror which is in opposite to you, and that will be your final destination point.

1239.instruction: Right now, you're facing towards the couch. Slightly turn right and move forward, where you will be facing towards a fridge. Now, slightly turn right and move forwards until you reach a narrow window in front of you. Now, turn left and move forward towards the stove and that is the end point.

1240.instruction: You're facing towards sofas, now slightly turn to your right, move forward, turn to your right, you can see a dining table, pass through the dining table and then turn to your left. Stand near the stove this is your end point.

1265.instruction: You are facing towards a white wall, slightly turn left and walk towards the table. Now turn left and walk towards the open door opposite to you, now walk towards the table. You are now in between the table on your left and a book shelf on your right. You have reached your destination.

1266.instruction: You are in a walkway, facing towards the wall with a wall painting attached to it. Take a slight left turn. Walk forward, towards the table. From there take a left turn. We will find a entrance into a room. Go straight towards the book shelf filled with books. And here is your destination in front of it.

1274.instruction: We're facing towards a small picture that's attached to the wall, turn slightly to the right, and enter the hallway that's in front of you, turn to the left, take five steps further... On your right there are a few glass doors and on the left there's a living room, walk towards the living room, turn slightly to the left... On the right there are four chairs and a beautiful coffee table in the middle, on the left there's a console table with a vase with flowers on top, walk past the console table towards the back of the chair that's in front of you... We're now facing towards a lamp, and on the right there's a marble console table with decorations on top, and that's your destination.

1375.instruction: You are standing facing towards the sofa. Turn right and exit the room through the open entrance in the front. Slightly turn right. There is a big clock towards your left side. Walk straight till you reach the open entrance towards your left side. Turn left and enter into the open entrance. Slightly turn left and stand in front of the closed door. You have reached your point.

1376.instruction: Right now you are facing towards the sofa turn slightly right and move forward towards the clock on the wall. Then turn right and move forward then turn slightly left and move forward towards the frame on the wall on the left side. Then turn left and you can see an open entrance enter through it now you are standing near the door which is closed, you have reached you're destination point.

1426.instruction: You begin facing a brick wall on a staircase, go up, keep going up the staircase, once you get to the top, turn to your left, you will see  bunch of windows, go towards the windows, and then turn to your left again, you will see the same windows, or doors, you will see the same doors with windows behind a bunch of couches, go towards them and then take one last step into the corner behind the couch in front of you, next to the lamp, you are done.

1468.instruction: Right now, from the place turn left and exit the room. Turn left and move towards the closed door. Slightly turn right and walk through the path beside the closed door. Take a few steps and stop facing the closed door, on your left you see the stairs, this is the endpoint.

1498.instruction: you will start by standing beside the mirror. Turn left jump over the table in front of you towards the opening in the middle with a red carpet. Once you've done that, turn left walk towards the opening on the left and take a step forward walking past the staircase on your right. Now turn left once again and take two steps towards the left side of the couch inside this room. Now turn right and make your way towards the other doorway on the other side of the room and exit the room. You will see a fireplace on the left take a step forward towards the window and you're done.

1505.instruction: Directly in front of you, you will see a wall light, a wall shelf with flowers and a couple of other items. Directly to the left of that there are glass doors.Walk towards your left. You will see black chairs, do not pass the black chairs up, take your first left before that. Your in what looks to be a kitchen area. Directly to the left of you, you will see glasses in a cabinet.Where the cabinet ends you will see on the counter, two  orange bowls. You will need to go over the counter, between the two bowls on your right and where the cabinet ends on your left. Once you go over the counter you will see an orange couch, a glass table and chairs to your right. To the left of that there's an open area with many chairs and a table. Walk in to that room, as you pass the table up on your right you will be looking at a candle holder, you will see mirrors behind it. Walk in between the table on your right and the shelf. Directly in front of you you will lights on the wall and a plant, walk towards this plant directly in front of you. To the left of you there will be an open window to the side of this open window is a curtain with flowers. Stop directly beside the curtain tn your left of the window.

1522.instruction: Right now you're facing towards a wall. Now turn behind, there are steps in front of you, move towards the steps and turn left. There is an open door to your left, move towards the door and enter in to the room. Now turn left, there are two windows in front of you, move towards the window which is to your left and stand in front of it. Now you are facing towards a window and a sculpture and it is your end point.

1523.instruction: You are now facing towards the wall. Turn around and move towards the stairs. Turn around and move towards the open door, move forward to the mat. Turn slightly left and move towards the window, which is in front of you now, and this is your endpoint.

1600.instruction: You're looking at a white door walk to the right down this hallway. And walk past the stairs and turn left and walk up about the second stair and you're done.

1623.instruction: Facing the desk, with the picture above it, exit the doorway to the right of the desk. Walk through the doorway and then through the next doorway. You're now in a room, directly in front of you is a fireplace with a very intricately designed mantle, turn back around 180 degrees, facing the room you just came from, turn to the left and walk up the stairs. Walk straight through the doorway at the first landing of the stairs. It's a bathroom. Turn to the right and enter the shower. Once you're standing inside the shower, you're done.

1683.instruction: Slightly turn to your right, you can find a staircase, go near the staircase and stand on the eighth step, that would be your end point.

1684.instruction: "Okay, you can see the stair case on the left side. Turn slightly right, and move forward, you can see the another stair case in front of you. Now slightly move forward and go up the stair case until, you see the gold leaves hanging on the wall on the left side. Now, you have reached your destination."

1801.instruction: You are standing near a window turn slight right and, now you should be facing two lamps on a cupboard , walk near that cupboard and or desk and their should be a dining table and two chairs on your right and an open door just beside the desk. Go near the open door and walk outside from this open door into a black carpet, as soon as you are standing on the carpet turn right and go and stand near the first step of the stair case. now as you are near the staircase turn right and go back inside the room which has an old carpet and turn left their should be a fire place and a painting on it and their should be some statues and rug on the floor, go near the women statues and you are done.

1871.instruction: You're standing in front of a white chair and a fireplace. On your left there's an armchair on top of a cowhide carpet. Walk towards the corner of the carpet in front of you on the living room, and keep walking straight past the wooden table on your left and the grey sofa on your right, you'll keep walking towards the kitchen island in the center of the kitchen, and once you're standing in the left corner of that kitchen island you will look left. Now you'll have the oven and an arched doorway in front of you. Walk towards that arched doorway and turn left, you'll walk past the door on your left and into the next door ahead of you, which is a bathroom. Walk into the bathroom and stand in front of the mirror. That's your spot.

1886.instruction: You are facing the shelf, turn left, walk straight. Right in the front you have an arch, enter into it by passing through the potted plant. Slightly turn right and walk straight in the passage. Walk straight until you find the counter tops in the left. Turn right, walk straight. Enter the second room which is in the left. Move a step forward, you are facing the sink and in the right you have the commode. This is the end point.

1887.instruction: You are facing towards the cupboards in front of you, turn left, there is an arch in front of you, go straight and exit the arch, slightly turn left, go straight, there is another arch in front of you, go straight, now you are standing beside the flower pot, turn right, go straight, on the left side there is a table, go straight near the table, turn right, go straight, slightly turn left, go straight, there is a washroom on the left side, slightly turn left, go straight and enter the washroom, stand in front of the mirror, stop there, this is your final destination.

1943.instruction: You are facing towards an opened door, slightly turn left and exit the room through the opened door which is infront of you, now you are facing towards the wall, turn right and move towards the staircase, turn right and move forward, now you are at the entrance of a room, move a bit forward, where to the right, you can find a table with two chairs, that would be your end point.

1944.instruction: You are facing towards the table, turn slight left and move towards the door which is near the table lamp. Now move out of this room. Turn right and move towards the staircase. Turn right you can see an open door, enter into the room. Now move towards the table which is opposite to you. Now you are facing towards the table, the position you are standing is your final destination.

1961.instruction: Okay, now you are at the entrance of a room. Turn to your left and in front of you there is a narrow arch shape entrance, walk straight through the narrow arch shape entrance. Now you are standing next to a sink platform, which is on the left. Turn to your right and move towards the table, which is in front of you. Now in front of you there is a stove, go straight towards that stove and turn to your left. Now move forward till the end of the table. Now slightly turn to your right and move forward, now you are in the corridor. Walk all the way straight through the corridor, until you reach a flower vase, which is on the right side. Turn to your left and in front of you there is an open entrance, walk all the way straight through that opened entrance passing the staircase on the right side. There is a white open door on your left side. Now move towards the cabinet which is in front of you. Turn right and climb the steps. Now you are facing towards the wall and the closed white door. There is a staircase on your left side. That will be the end point.

4069.instruction: You are in a laundry room facing towards the washing machines, turn around and go to the door, from there take a slight left and come out of the room, and go straight to the door which is in the front side, from there come out of the room and go straight to the dresser, and take a right turn and go upstairs to the door in the front side. This is the endpoint.

4070.instruction: You begin staring into a corner between a set of windows and a bench seat, and a door with glass panels in it. Turn around to your right. You should see a gray couch and a kind of untreated looking wooden coffee table. Move between those two towards the open double doors, and then, before you go into those double doors, turn to your left and move towards the grill. The indoor grill. From in front of the grill, turn to your right and continue into the small room with the microwave and toaster ovens, and then pass them by, continuing through the open door in front of you and the open door in front of that open door, and then down the hallway through one last open door, into a hallway with an arched- or, with a... An? With an arched window just in front of you. Once you hit the arched window, it's pretty high up on the wall, turn to the left and continue down the hallway into the first door on your left, which is a bathroom, which you will go into and stand in front of the toilet. Once you are in front of the toilet, you are done.

4099.instruction: You begin in a bathroom, turn to your right and exit the bathroom, going to the left in the study, go behind the chair on the right, you should be standing next to the bookshelf, look to your left and you will see a set of french doors with 2 curtains on each side, stand in front of these french doors and you're done.

4147.instruction: Right now you are facing towards a closed door. Turn to your left and go into the corridor. Walk forward till you reach the platform. At this point take a slight right turn and enter the carpet, you will find a washbasin towards your right. Go forward and enter the arch. Now you will find a round table in front of you, turn slightly toward left and go outside the room. Now turn slightly towards left and enter the room, which is in front of you. At this point you will find a dining table towards your left. Now take a left turn and go forward towards the first arch, which is behind the dining table. Here you have reached your destination in front of a door and there is a mirror and a table towards your left.

4148.instruction: You're facing the door, turn towards your left, and go straight till the end, enter the room, and go straight, to the left you'll find brown color table, go straight, and enter the room, then turn left, and exit the room, go straight, again you'll enter in to the room, you'll find brown color table, and chairs, from there turn left, at the end of the room, backside of the brown color table, and in front of the entrance to next room you'll find your destination.

4173.instruction: You are facing towards a couch, slightly turn right and go forward, slightly turn left and go forward, slightly turn right and go forward towards the white cabinet, here facing towards the wall which is having four portraits you have reached the destination.

4174.instruction: Now you are facing to the black couch,move a bit right and move forward,on your left there is a kitchen table with two chairs move towards it,if you look right there is a white colour cabinet,move towards the cabinet and stop.

4252.instruction: You're standing near the fireplace. Turn right and exit the room. Move forward towards the staircase where the staircase is directed to the downside. Stand on the first step of the staircase. This would be your end point.

4253.instruction: You are in center of a hall. Move little forward, take a right turn at the entrance of the door. Move towards the wall. Take a right turn from the stairs. On the second step of the staircase which is along the downwards, you will find your destination.

4266.instruction: You are standing in front of a cupboard filled with books. Turn to your right side, you can see an arch. Enter into that arch. After entering into the arch, turn to your left side. You can see a staircase and an arch beside it. Enter into that arch, stand under that arch. You have reached your destination.

4267.instruction: Turn right from the place you are standing and exit the room, slightly turn to your left, enter into the opening which is left to the staircase, stand in the middle of the opening, that would be your end point.

4278.instruction: You are standing near the open doors and facing towards the dinning table, turn right and move forward. Slightly turn right and move towards the open door which is to your right. Turn right and move towards the open door which is opposite to you. Now you are standing near the open doors, move forward. Slightly turn right and take few more steps ahead. Now you can see a bed to your left and you can see 2 chairs on your right. The position you are standing is your final destination.

4279.instruction: Now, you are facing towards the open entrance. Turn around and move towards the open brown door on your right side. Enter through it and walk straight towards the open door. Pass through it and move forward. Now, take slight right and that will be your end point where you are facing two chairs and a table in front of you.

4294.instruction: You are looking out over some railing in the upstairs of a house. You are going to turn to your left and go straight towards the room where you can just barely see the foot of a bed.  And you are just going to step into that room and stop.  On the left of you will be the foot of the bed of the first bed and on your right will be wood railing.  You are done.

4318.instruction: Begin in front of a window. Turn slightly right. Pass through the 2 Corinthian columns towards the rad couch. Head to the right of it and you'll see a small radiator. Once you reach it you're done.

4322.instruction: You're standing in a bathroom walk forward past the sinks on the right. And enter into the bedroom and take a step towards the open door on the right. And walk through it. And walk through the archway directly in front of you. Take a step into the left of this circular room and you'll see an archway that's made of wood to the left. Step through it. And take two step in this room. And hop over the brown armchair that's to the right. And you'll be looking through the window you can see a patio with a pool table and you're done.

4344.instruction: You are standing near exercise machines turn right and exit through the open door on your right. you are not exiting you entered a washroom in front of you, exit the washroom and enter a room which has a shelf with books, turn right crossing the machines on the table on your left and you are done.

4375.instruction: You are facing a door and a massage bed.  You are going to take 1 step into this room and then you are going to turn around.  And you are going to turn into the 2nd door on your left it looks like.  You will see a massage bed in front of you slightly to the right.  You are going to move forward in this room going around the head of the massage bed in front of you.  And you are going to head towards the sink with the wood cabinet and you'll be standing right in front of the wood cabinet and on your left of you is almost going to be the threshold of the door into the shower area and you are done.

4383.instruction: You are now facing towards the window, turn around and move towards the open door, which is in front of you. Now turn right and exit the room through the open door, you are now facing towards the open door, move forward through the open door. You are now facing towards another open entrance, where on your left, you can find the staircase. Turn left and get down two stairs and turn to your extreme left and move towards the open door, which is in front of you. You are now facing towards the statue on the table, which is on the left side, now turn slightly right and move towards the couch, beside the lamp. Move forward, you are now facing towards the wall, which is your end point.

4384.instruction: You are facing towards a window, turn around and move forward towards the open door. Now turn to your left and exit the room through the door. And you can see an open door right in front of you, enter through it. Turn to your left, you can see a staicase, get down three steps and turn around. There is an open door right in front of you, enter through it. Take a slight right and move forward towards the sofa and move forward. You are now facing towards a wooden wall and on your right side you have a white coloured lamp and this is your end point.

4406.instruction: Now you are at the entrance of the gym room, turn left towards the equipment and go straight near the large equipment which is in front of you, turn right and go straight near the washroom, go near the toilet seat which is in front of you, turn left and exit the washroom, turn right, go near the refrigerator which is front of you, turn right and walk few steps, now you are in between the two entrance of the room, towards your right there is a cupboard on it there is a flower vase and a telephone, this would be your final destination.

4407.instruction: Now you are facing towards the sofa set, turn around and move forward here you can see gym equipments in the room, now take right turn and enter into the open door here you can see toilet seat and washbasin in front of you, from there take left turn and enter into the open door and take immediate right turn and move forward. Now turn your right and take little steps here you can see the small wooden desk and a flower pot and telephone which is placed on the desk, here you reach your final destination opposite to the desk.

4522.instruction: Turn around from the place you are standing. You will find an open door. Now go and stand in front of the open door. That will be your final destination.

4523.instruction: You are standing on the stairs facing towards the staircase railing, turn to your left there is an open door, move towards the open door, the entrance of the room is your end point.

4543.instruction: You are facing towards the cupboards. Turn left and walk towards the open door. Turn right and exit the room. Walk a few steps ahead till you reach an open brown door towards your right side. Turn right and enter into the room. Stand beside the door. You have reached your point.

4544.instruction: Now you are facing towards the closed door, turn slightly your left and move forward, now turn right and move out through the open door here you can see carpet in front of you. Now, turn first right and enter through the open door and in front of the door is your final destination.

4587.instruction: Right now you are facing towards a wall, there is a table in front of you. Turn around and go outside the bathroom, at this point there is a bathtub in front of you. Turn slightly towards left and exit the room and now turn slightly towards left and go forward. At this point there is a door in front of you and a bedroom to your left. Here you have reached your destination.

4588.instruction: You are facing towards the wall in the wall in the washroom turn left you can find an open door, exit the room and move little forward towards the bathing tub, and take left move forward you can find an open door in front and an entrance at the left side, the position now you are standing is your destination.

4624.instruction: You are standing inside a study room or office, turn on your left near the heater and the window, and as soon as you are near the heater on the rug facing the book shelf turn right and exit through the grey open door on the left side near the stairs, go near the stairs and as soon as you are near the stairs do not go up go down, just take few steps don't go all the way down, just take few steps and turn around, and now go back in the room which is in front of you with the table and the statue of a person. once you are inside this room go near the fireplace and you are done.

4643.instruction: Begin facing a fire place. Turn left and you'll see a living room area with a pinkish arm chair. Head towards it. Head past it to the dining area. Head to the right side of the rug in the dining area and you'll see 2 arched doorways. Head through the one on your left. You'll be facing a hall way. Head left down the hall and this will lead you into a kitchen area . Head past the ovens and he kitchen island into a family room area with a fire place. Head past the fire place and head into the next room. Another dining room with a fire place. In h left had corner of the room you'll see some flower on top of a small hall stand. Head towards it and you're done.

4683.instruction: Okay, now you are in the living room with a couch and a teapoy in front of you. Now turn behind and slightly turn left and exit the room through the open entrance, which is in front of you. Now you are standing at the entrance of a room and facing towards two white chairs and a teapoy. Now turn left and move a bit forward. Now slightly turn right and move towards the couch, which is on the right side. Now slightly turn right and go straight towards the wide open entrance, which is in front of you. Now you are standing at the entrance of the dining room, turn right and exit the room through the arch shape open entrance, which is in front of you. Now slightly turn right and walk all the way straight through the narrow arch shape open entrance, until you reach in front of another arch shape open entrance. Now slightly turn left and move towards the corner of the room. Now you are in a room with a shelf case on your left side and this is the end point.

4684.instruction: You can find yourself facing towards the sofa set. Turn around and walk near to the glass door, which is open and enter the next room. Now turn slightly left and walk near to the sofa set and walk straight. Now walk near to the dining table. Slightly turn right and enter the arch, which is in front of the flower vase. Turn slightly right and walk through the passage. And you can find a circular open door in front of you just beside the closed door. Walk into the room and walk straight near to the books and stand in front of it, where towards your left you will find the telephone, and towards your right you can find books. This is the final endpoint. You have reached the destination.

4773.instruction: Our starting point walk pass the hallway and turn right towards another hallway... On the left there's a small bench and on the right there's a basket... And there are painting on both sides of the wall, walk pass the bench... In font of you there's a cabinet, walk towards the cabinet, let and enter the kitchen that's in front of you... On your left there's a long counter and on the right there's a stove, walk pass the counter, and walk towards the living room that's in front of you. Once you've passed the living room, turn towards the right and enter the other living room that’s in front of you. On the right there's a long beige sofa with pillows on top, and in front of the sofa there's a coffee table a plant on top, and there's a white rug on the floor, walk towards the edge of the rug next in front of the coffee table, ad then walk towards the middle of the rug, and walk towards the fireplace that's in front of you... Turn slightly to your right, and your destination is between a plant.... I mean, is between a vase with plants and the fireplace.

4787.instruction: "Now you are facing towards the sofa turn right slightly move forward towards TV. Then after again move right go straight you can find stairs get down the stairs and turn right you can see another sofa sets walk in between those sofa sets cross the sofa sets. Then you can see snooker table back side of it there is another sofa stand in between snooker table and sofa your destination has been arrived."

4788.instruction: Now you are facing towards a sofa. Turn right. Go in between t.v and the wall which has a horse painting on it. Turnaround. Get down the stairs. Go through the open door. Turn slightly right. Go near the table with two chairs. Turn right. Go near the brown sofa. Turn right. Go near the brown chair with a small table. Turn left. Go towards the closed door. Turn right. Move forward near the chair. Turn slightly left. Go in between the snooker pool and a small table. You have reached your destination.

4792.instruction: You are facing towards the pillar  take a slight right walk straight you will see two pillars stand under it.

4793.instruction: Right now you are standing in front of the glass window turn right and move towards the  middle of the room right in between of the two round pillar on the red mat is the end point.

4883.instruction: You are standing on some stairs.  You are going to continue moving forward up these stairs.  Once at the top you are going to turn to your left.  And you are going to see directly in front of you some double doors that are wide open.  You are going to go thru those doors.  And you will see there is a desk area in this room.  You are going to hop over the desk so you are landing right in front the closed black doors.  Once you are in front of those closed black doors with the head of the desk behind you you are done.

4887.instruction: You are facing towards the mirror, turn around and move towards the staircase. Move towards the another staircase which is in front of you. Now completely get down of the staircase. Turn right and move towards the closed door. Now you are facing towards the wall, turn right there is a narrow path, move in the path till you face a wall. Now you are facing towards the wall, turn right you can see an open entrance opposite to you, move towards that entrance. Now enter into the room. Move towards the 2 chairs which are in front of you. Now you are standing near the 2 chairs and facing towards the wall, the position you are standing is your final destination.

4888.instruction: Okay, so you are in the living room, facing towards the flower vase. Turn around and walk straight. Take a slight left turn from the staircase. Walk straight, there is a staircase which goes down. Get down through those stairs. Take a slight right turn and walk straight through the path. Take a right turn and enter into the room which is right in the opposite. Walk straight, stand between two chairs and opposite to the vase. This is the end point.

4932.instruction: Turn right, move towards the dining table. Turn around, move towards the stairs. Climb the stairs. Continue straight till the brown colored wooden door. Turn right, move towards the coffee table. Move towards the blinds that is right side of the televesion. It is you're destination.

4933.instruction: "Okay now, you are facing towards the kitchen. Turn slightly right, and move froward, you can see the dining table in front of you. Now turn around, you can see the stair case in front of you. Now go up through that stair case, and move forward until, you reach the closed door in front of you. Now turn right, and move forward, you can see the television in front of you. Now slightly turn right, and move forward, you can see the window in front of you, and there is a television on the left side. Now, you have reached your destination."

5007.instruction: Your are standing in the passage facing the door. Turn towards your left, where you can find a bathroom which has a red carpet, a sink and lot of photo frames to the left side wall. Enter into the bathroom and stop near the sink which is your final destination.

5008.instruction: You are facing an opened door, turn left and get into the washroom passing through the opened door, here just beside the sink you have reached the destination.

5061.instruction: Right now facing towards the metal sheets. Now turn behind and move towards the garden which is in front of you. Now turn right and move forward in the walkway, there are three steps to your right. Now turn right and climb up the steps and move forward towards the open door which is in front of you. Now slightly turn right and enter in to the room. Now turn right and move towards the dining table which is in front of you and stand facing towards it and it is your end point.

5062.instruction: Turn right from the place you are standing and move forward, turn right and move a bit forward, slightly turn to your right, you can find a half opened sliding door infront of you, move towards the sliding door and enter into the house, now you are facing towards the tv, slightly turn to your right and move a bit forward, to your left you can find a dining table, that would be your end point.

5192.instruction: Now you are facing towards a staircase, turn to your left and move forward, there is an open entrance in-front of you, walk through it and slightly turn to your right, walk through the path and move forward, you can see another open entrance in-front of you, walk through it and turn to your right, now move forward, there is a blue color and white colored stands in-front of you, go near that and stand, that's your end point.

5193.instruction: You are facing towards the steps turn slightly left you can see the open door, walk trough the open door and take right and move little bit forward, you will pass through the dinning table on your left walk through the another exit, and take the first right where you can see the ribbons closed a chair take right in front there is two stands move near the stands and that is your end point.

5201.instruction: You are going to start inside a massage room. Take the door that you have in front to exit that room. Walk all the way down and pass the double door that is opened in front of you. Once you are facing the pool, turn right, and take one step to be in front of the single chair on your right, no, two chairs on your right. Once you are there, next to the pool and the two chairs, you are done.

5266.instruction: For start point you will begin in a living room, you will will need to hop over the tan colored coffee table that is in front of you. And make a left turn taking one step forward and make a sharp right. You will go this short narrow hall straight ahead and move forward to wards the study area that is in front of you and make another right turn through this hall. You will see an open door straight ahead of you that leads into a bedroom. And look to your left you will see an open doorway that leads into  bathroom take one step through the door and turn around and go through the bedroom that was originally in front of you it will now be to your left. Make your way taking one step towards the bed to you left. Make a left turn so that the bed will now be to your right. And straight in front of that shelving unit that is in front in the corner odf the wall and you are done.

5267.instruction: You are facing a corner of some wood cabinets.  You are going to turn to your right and you are going to exit this room.  You are going to make a left and you are going to go into the entrance on your left.  You are going to move forward  walking thru the middle of this circular room and you are going to go into the room in front of you with the archway.  You are going to move forward into this room passing the side of the bed on your right.  And you are going to go into the open archway in front of you.  You will see it is a walk-in closet.  And you are going to stop right in the threshold of this closet and you are done.

5313.instruction: You begin looking out a wooden door with glass panels. Turn completely around and move through the dark arched entryway, behind the tan couch you can see in front of you. Once there, turn right, you should see a dining table with many chairs around it. Move towards the far end of that dining table. Once you are there, continue along the wall with the double doors in it, into the hallway. You should proceed through an outdoor area. Keep going. Once you re-enter the indoors you should see a circular table to your left, and an archway to your right. Two of them, in fact, but you will be going into the nearest of the two. Once you're through that archway, continue forward into the kitchen area, between the counter and the island. Keep going until you're right in front of the double ovens. Once you're in front of the double ovens, you're done.

5317.instruction: You're facing the brown table, turn towards your right, and go straight, to the right you'll find cream sofas, go straight till the end, again to the right you'll find living area, to the left you'll find kitchen, from there turn left, then turn right, and enter the room, to the left you'll find wash basin, go straight, and stop near the glass door, in front of the glass door, you'll find your destination.

5318.instruction: You are facing towards the wooden table which has decorative items on it. Turn right and walk straightly in the hallway till you find bar stools on your left side. Slightly turn left and move towards the white cabinets. Turn left and move towards the closed door. Slightly turn right and walk through the open door which is in front of you. Now walk straightly towards the closed glass door and stand in front of it. That will be the end point.

5360.instruction: Right now you are facing towards a portrait which is hanged on a wall. Make a slight right turn and move forward in front you can see a gym equipment and again make a slight right turn, in front you can see a entrance door just exit the room and move forward. On you are right side you can see a toilet commode and in front you can see a open door. Just enter into that room and make a slight right turn in front you can see a fridge stand in front of the fridge. Here we reached our destination.

5361.instruction: You are in a gym area facing towards the window, slightly move right and go straight near the gym equipment, from there take right and go straight towards the washroom, enter into the washroom and go straight towards the toilet set, from there take left and enter into the room, opposite to you there is a book rack, turn right and go straight near the refrigerator, this would be your final destination.

5363.instruction: You are facing towards the window, turn slightly to your left and move a bit forward, turn right and get down the steps, you can find two rooms in front of you, enter into the room which is on your left side, you can see a table with a lamp on it, slightly turn to your left and move towards the opened door, slightly turn to your left and stand infront of the opened door, that would be your end point.

5364.instruction: Right now you are facing towards a edge of a wall, slightly turn left and get down the stairs and turn around and get down the stairs completely. And enter into an open door in front of you, you have a table in front of  you and a book shelf on your right. Turn left, and you have an open door on your left. Enter into that door, it's an empty room and you have a fireplace on your right. And you have an open door on your left, move forward towards the door and this is your final point.

5378.instruction: We're facing towards a Victorian style bed which is covered with a red sheet, and above there's bed there's red curtain, turn around... You're now standing in a red carpet, and in front of you there's a doorway leading that leads us towards the next room, walk past that doorway and enter the room that's in front... On your right there are beautiful vases and on the left there's a round table with a decoration on top, walk past this walk way, in front of you there's another doorway, on your right there's a painting of a lady on a red dress and on the left there a paining of a lady in a white dress, continue walking forward and pass the doorway. Once you pass the doorway, you'll be facing to towards a chandelier, on your left there's a huge vase, sorry, that's on the left, and on the left there are chairs, and you have reached your destination.

5387.instruction: This is the starting point and you're facing towards a wooden door. Turn around. Walk towards the staircase. Get down the staircase and stand on the first stair from the bottom. This is the end point.

5388.instruction: You are facing towards the closed door and there is an umbrella in front of you, turn around, go straight, there are stairs in front of you, get down the stairs and stand on the last step before you reach the floor, stop there, this is your final destination.

5396.instruction: You are facing towards the corner of a room, turn around and go forward just in front of the entrance of this room, turn right and exit the room, turn left and go forward towards the stairs, turn left and go forward by climbing up those two steps passing through the opened brown door, go forward towards the opened brown door which is straight in front of you by climbing up those steps, turn around go forward towards the second entrance which is on to your left, go forward enter the room, here just beside a small bed and a wall you have reached the destination.

5397.instruction: From your starting point turn backward and move forward then turn right and exit the room and enter into the swimming area turn left and move forward near to the stair-case take left and move forward and climb up the steps completely. Enter into the opposite room and turn towards right entirely now enter into the second room which is on your left side move forward and stand near the bed that will be your final destination.

5467.instruction: You are facing towards the wall and the commode. Turn left and exit the washroom by passing through the open door. Now you are facing towards the white railings. Turn left and move forward. Slightly turn right and move towards the open room. Now walk straightly and enter into the open room. Now you are in the bedroom. Slightly turn right and move towards the glass window. There is a bed on your left side. Turn right and walk through the open door. Now you are facing towards an open door. There are white empty shelves on either side of you. Walk straightly through the open door and enter into the washroom. There is a commode on your left side. Turn right and move towards the wall. Now you are in the shower room facing towards the wall. That will be the end point.

5468.instruction: Right now we are standing infront of the toilet seat slightly take left infront you can see the open door move forward and take left in the front you can see the open door on the right slightly take right and enter into the room in the room you can see the bed and the two chairs at left side, take right and move forward on the right you can see the open door take right and move forward infront you can see the washroom enter into it move little forward on the left you can  see the mirror take right and move forward now you are facing towards the wall, and this would be your final destination.

5637.instruction: You are standing inside a washroom near a tub, turn left and exit through the opening in front of you, you should be standing in a hall way one on your right one on your left and two doors in front of you, walk towards the door on the left and you are done.

5693.instruction: You're standing in the kitchen of a house facing a fireplace, you'll have to walk towards the fireplace that's in the living room and stand right before a beige couch and you're going to have the stools to your left, three of them. You're going to walk to the right side of the, between the stools and the sofa couch towards an arch that leads to another room, and you'll go an enter that other room. In this other room there's a table on the right side, and a painting on the right wall, there are windows right in front of you and a table with four chairs, and on the left side there is an open door that leads to the patio of the house, and on the left you're going to have a window, to the right side the open door that leads to the patio and in front of you there's going to be another door that leads to a room with chairs and a carpet or a rug on the floor and seems to lead all the way back to the fireplace. So, your're going to enter the house again and cross that dining room leaving the table to your left and the windows to your right side, and continue in the direction of the fireplace until you reach a sofa on your left side, an armchair is going to be in front of you, an orange armchair is going to be right in front of you. To your right side you will be looking at a different room with sliding window panel doors. You are going to walk to those open doors window panel thing, and now you'll be looking at a pool table in front of you, and to the right side you will see another couch and a coffee table and a rug on the floor or a mat. So you are going to walk towards that mat on the right side and stand on top of it. And as you can see now, you have a TV on your right side, the little couch to the left, the coffee table and the mat, and in front of you there's another window, get close to that window and look out the garden and you are there.

5719.instruction: You're facing towards a wooden wall. Behind you, walk straight towards the dining table. Walk behind the table move forward and turn right. Enter into the room move a step forward turn left and walk all the way to the narrow path. Now, you are at the fire place room. You've a carpet on the floor beside the carpet is your destination.

5720.instruction: You're now facing the edge of an entrance. Turn around and walk straight towards the wooden table with chairs on your left side. From there, turn right and exit the room. From here, turn left and walk straight and stop when you see a sofa set on your left side and that is your end point.

5781.instruction: You're standing on the second floor living room. If you turn around, you'll see a flight of steps. Walk down the flight of steps. Take an immediate right. In front of you you will see a fridge and a hallway.  Walk towards that. Walk towards the left side of the fridge and you will see steps towards the door. Take a step on that small staircase once you are there you're done.

7572.instruction: You begin facing a set of doors, turn to your right, you will see an opened door, take one step to exit the room you are currently in, take another step out into the hallway, you will see a dresser in front of you with a mirror on top of it, to the right of that dresser, there is a archway, take 2 steps to go through that archway, you will see a bedroom with a fireplace, take 2 steps forward, entering the bedroom, and then take 4 steps to go through the archway that's to the left of the fireplace in front of you, you will pass the fireplace on your right and a very tall mirror on your left, once you are in the archway, you will see a white rug on the floor and a opened door, take 2 steps to go through the opened door, moving along the banister, take a step onto the very big red rug, and then take another step forward, following the railing, you will see a white circular rug, take a step onto that and then take a step forward, towards the staircase and take a couple steps to go down the staircase, once you're almost at the bottom of the staircase, take one last step to get to the bottom of the staircase, you should be standing on the last step, you are done.

7694.instruction: You are facing towards a white wall, slightly turn left and enter into the room, walk towards the black chair opposite to you, turn right and walk towards the white glass door. You are now at the entrance of a room full of books, walk towards the pile of books on your left, slightly turn left, you are now facing towards the second frame on the wall with the pile of books on your right. You have reached your destination.

7695.instruction: You are facing towards the open door. Turn slightly left and move forward. Pass over the mat and move towards the fridge and you are now facing towards the wall. Turn slightly left sorry right and move forward and stop at the books where in there are paintings at the left and some books at the right and these books are on the floor, and this would be your end point.

7724.instruction: You're looking through glass doors turn to the left and walk to the right of this couch and walk to the left of this pillar towards the white table. And take one more step forward turn right and enter this living room. And walk past the TV towards the gray couch on the left. And turn right and take a step in between the brown table and island. And turn left and take a step towards the stairs on the left. And turn to the right and walk towards the sink at the end of the kitchen. And once you're standing in front of this dish washer you're done.

7848.instruction: You are facing towards a couch, turn slightly right and move forward. There is a table with some chairs on your right side and there is a kitchen counter on your left, move forward. You can see an open arch in front of you, move forward. Take a slight left and enter through the open entrance that is just beside the portrait and move forward. You are now standing facing towards a glass door and on your left side you have a sink and this is your end point.

7849.instruction: You are facing towards the black couch. Slightly turn right and walk straightly towards the open entrance. Now you are facing towards the wall which has a painting attached to it. Slightly turn left and enter into the open room. Now you are standing at the entrance of a room facing towards the closed glass door. There is a washbasin on your left side. That will be the end point.

7891.instruction: You are facing towards the door, turn slight right and take few steps ahead. You are facing towards the wall, turn left and move forward. Now you are standing next to the second chair, which is your final destination.

7892.instruction: Go straight towards the flower vase, turn left and take the few steps and stop behind the second black chair on the left side and the closed glass door on the right side. This is the endpoint.

7903.instruction: Look around you are in between of an island and a big tall closet and a refrigerator beside it. Walk near the refrigerator by moving forward turn left from the refrigerator. Now you are facing a lounge in front of you and on your left their is a dinning table with black chairs. Walk near the TV and the sofa which has a yellow throw on it. Now move forward and just outside the patio door. When you step outside the patio door you have to turn left and walk near the arm chairs which has grey cushions on it. Walk across the sofa and the white patio chair by moving a little on your right. Now as you come across a sofa on your left which has stripped cushions on it and a black cushion in between them. Behind the sofa their is a kitchen counter with a barbecue in the middle and a refrigerator at the bottom. Go near the refrigerator and  stop near it this is where your destination ends.

7972.instruction: You're looking at two double doors going outside, if you turn to the left you'll see a brown table a mirror on the right side of the hallway, walk past these and walk past the large archway on your right. And walk past this pottery and painting. And you'll two archways on your right, walk towards the one further away on the left and walk down this archway you'll see four pictures on the right side of the wall and one on the left. And then walk through the next archway. And walk to the rug in this room, and in this room you'll see another archway on the left. Walk through it. And then walk so you're standing next to this towel rack and you've reached the end.

8014.instruction: You are facing towards a dining table, take a few steps ahead till you reach a staircase, turn left and climb the stairs. You have now entered a bedroom, walk towards the backside of the white door in the bedroom. Now walk in the path between the wooden railing and the brown cabinet till you reach another bedroom. Turn left, there is an open door, walk towards it, enter the washroom, take a few steps ahead, you are now facing towards a shower room with a glass door. You have reached your destination.

8015.instruction: You are standing beside the staircase, walk all the way up steps take an instant right, walk forward on your left you can see two beds turn slightly left and enter into the washroom, stand beside the shower glass door is your end point.

8025.instruction: We are facing a room with a table with a white tablecloth. Turn and exit this room taking a step out of the room, to the left of the stairs. With the stairs on your left, go forward into the next room and now go forward into the laundry room. Taking a step to the left of the washer. From here take a step and stop when you are in front of the washer and dryer.

8034.instruction: We will start facing a door with ropes on the left and the right. A bust of a man on the right, and some paintings, and two red chairs to the left. You will go through the doorway, and once on the other side, we will be facing a red carpet that leads into two rooms. You want to hang a slight left, where there will be a laquer side table, and some ornate vases on the ground as well as a mirror. You're going to walk through the intricately carved doorway. And once there, we will be going through a main hall with red chairs on the right, as well as a statue of a cherub and a man on the left. There's also many other paintings and a chandelier. Continue forward until you come to the doorway with the portrait of a man on the right, and a portrait of a woman on the left. And we will come to a stop, right here without crossing into the entryway of the next room with a fireplace to the left and a red couch on the right.

8035.instruction: Slide little left, walk straight along the narrow path on the red mat, now enter into the open door and walk straight towards the brown cupboard, slide little right and walk towards the another open door, exit the room and walk straight towards the white colored rope which is tied to the red colored stand, you have reached your destination.

8036.instruction: You are facing towards the corner of the chair, turn to your left side move forward. You can see an open door enter into that room, walk straight until you reach the brown cub board and beside that you will see a open door, enter into that room take a slight left move forward and stand near the railing.

8083.instruction: You are facing towards a window with a curtain, turn to your right and move forward towards the open door and exit through it. Turn slightly to your left and move forward. Now turn slightly right and you can see an open door, move forward, turn slightly right and enter through it. Move forward and stop just before the entrance of another open door and this is your destination.

8084.instruction: You are facing the curtains. Turn right and walk straight. There is an open door, exit the room. Move a little forward, walk straight. Turn right and walk on the carpet. Stand at the entrance of the next room, close to the open door. This is the end point.

8128.instruction: Right now you are in a room move forward. On you are left side you can see a dinning table, on you are right side you can see a stove in front you can see a open door. Just turn to you are right and exit the room and make a slight left in front you can see a stair case. Just climb the steps in front you can see a wall beside the closed door stand near the wall. Here we reached our destination.

8129.instruction: You are in dining hall, move forward, again move forward the right side of the door, turn right move towards the satires, go up the satires, move forward and stand in front the wall beside the closed door.

8130.instruction: You are facing towards an opened door, move towards the opened door, turn right and go up the stairs, now you are facing towards the wall, slightly turn left, you can find a closed door, move a bit forward towards the closed door, now you are facing towards the pillar, that would be your end point.

8131.instruction: "Okay now, you are facing towards the wall. Turn slightly right, and move forward, you can see the open door in front of you. Now turn right, you can see the stair case in front of you. Now go up through that stair case, and slightly turn left, and move forward, you can see the pillar in front of you. Now, you have reached your destination."

8135.instruction: You are facing towards a table, turn slightly right and move forward on the red carpet passing through the open door which is right in front of you. Keep moving forward until you reach another open door and on your right side you have a white coloured statue and this is your end point.

8136.instruction: Slightly turn to your right and move forward, you can find an opened door infront of you, go through the opened door and move forward, you can find an another opened door infront of you, stand infront of the opened door where to the left you can find a table, where there is a clock on it and to the right you can find two chairs, that would be your end point.

8145.instruction: You in a long narrow hallway looking at a closed door. You want to turn all the way around facing the other end of the hallway which has some stairs going down facing toward the window with some blue staining around the border. As you go down the stairs, you will be outside. Once you pass the mat outside at the bottom of the stairs you will see a white column on your left. At that column you will take a direct right into the room with a dark door.  You only want to take a few steps into the room, and this room has pink and green tile on the floor. It is a bathroom. You want to have the toilet to your right or you are right in front of it. You are at your destination.

8168.instruction: Look around your starting point will be from a washroom. You have to exit the washroom by moving forward. After moving forward and exiting the washroom you have to walk through the closet which has white cabinets both side on your right and your left. Cross the walk across the closets and enter  a room. Now moving slightly on your left while exiting the closet you will find your self in a  bedroom which has two sofa's grey in color and while standing near these sofa's you have to turn your self slightly on your right and came across a point wher you stop your self and you will be facing a window a small window which is open and from this window you can see outside it has blinds. from this point you have another window which has blinds on it and they are close. This will be your stopping point.

8187.instruction: Starting in the corner of a room, there is a door opened directly ahead of you. Step to that door that is opened. Once there step into the room, and to the left corner you see a lamp with orange shading over it. Step in front of that lamp and you are done.

8248.instruction: You are facing the corner of a room, turn behind and exit the room passing through the opened door, slightly turn right and go forward towards the opened white door of the washroom which is just beside the closed white door, here at the entrance you have reached the destination.

8249.instruction: You are facing towards the racks, turn around, exit the room and walk towards the white carpet.
