You have reached your destination.

8293.instruction: From the place your standing turn left and move forward then turn slightly left and move forward. Then turn right and move towards the glass window then turn slightly right and move forward again turn slightly right and move forward behind the sofa. Keep moving in a forward direction and turn right then move forward cross the table then turn slightly left and move forward towards the red lamp. Then turn slightly left and move one step forward you have reached your destination point.

8294.instruction: Right now there is a glass door on your right. Take a left turn and go forward. There is a railing on your left, take a slight left turn at the end of the railing by crossing a wooden chair, go forward and you will find a dining table on your right and a kitchen platform to your left. Go forward and take a slight right turn from crossing the dining table. Take a right turn and go forward by crossing the stairs and the pillar, go forward till you reach to the side of a pool table, right now there is a couch in front of you, take a slight right turn and go forward by crossing the sofa on your right. Take a left turn and here we are at the destination and there is a staircase behind you.

8321.instruction: You will start by facing the window. Turn around and take one step forward. In front of you there is an arched opening. Continue to walk straight. Turn right and take 2 steps towards the stove. Now turn left and take one step. Turn to your right and you will see a large hallway. Walk down this hallway. Taking two steps. In front of you you will see a flower pot in the corner. To the right of that you will see a large opening. Walk inside this opening. You will see the living room on your left and the dining table on your right. Take one step in between those. Take another step towards the dining table. Once you are in between the living area and the dining table on your right, then you're done.

8335.instruction: You are facing an open wood door.  You are going to exit that door and into a hallway and make a left.  Continue down the hallway.  You will come to an intersection in the hallway and you are going to make a left.  You will be passing a piano on your left and windows on your right.  You are going to take it all the way down and make another left.  You are going to continue down the hallway passing wood doors on your left and a bedroom area on your right.  You will see a a bathroom with a large white bathtub in front of you.  You are going to veer to the right of that bathtub. And on your right you will see a wood door that is open and right past that room you will see another open area with a small stool right in front of the entrance way.  You are going to turn into that room.  And you will enter this room.  There will be a toilet on your left and a small little black stand in the corner.  Standing right near the door you are done.

8461.instruction: Your few steps away from the entrance, facing towards the pillar, turn slightly left and go straight near the another door, towards your left, enter in to the room, walk through the walkway and enter in to the corridor, from there turn left and go near the door which is open, now you are at the entrance of the room, in front of you there is a dinning table, this would be your final destination.

8462.instruction: You're facing towards the door, move forward, exit the door, go straight, exit the door, turn to your left, go near the open door and stop.

8523.instruction: You are facing towards the window, turn left and move towards the cupboard. Turn slight right and move forward. Turn slight left and move towards the open door. You are standing at the entrance of the door, which is your final destination.

8524.instruction: This is the starting point and you're facing towards a window. Turn left. Walk towards the drawer in front of you. Turn slightly right. Walk forward. Walk towards the open door on your left. You're standing near the open door. This is the end point.

8550.instruction: You are facing towards the wall. Turn around and slightly turn right and walk straightly till you find an open sliding door in front of you. Slightly turn left and walk through the sliding door. Now straightly in the hallway by passing the dining table on your right side till you find an open door in front of you. Walk through the open door. Now walk straightly till you find an another open door in front of you. Walk straightly towards the open arch which is on your right side by passing through the open door. Now you are standing at the entrance of a living room. There are three bar chairs on your right side. Turn around and slightly turn right and walk straightly towards the open door. Now you are standing in front of an open door. There is a round dining table on your right side. That will be the end point.

8551.instruction: Okay,turn around, there is a snooker table in the living room and you find the table and the chairs.Take right from the  door in the middle of the living room ,you will also find the another living space , where you find sofas moving forward from the left side of the living space there is path from the dinning hall, which will lead you to the other room , on the path, the very left side of that there is a pool and the view of the outside with some plants.Moving forward there is a room with some antique wall posters placed on the walls and the table with some chairs and a flower vase with candler hanging on to the ceiling.

8629.instruction: Right now you're facing towards a wall. Now slightly turn right and move forward towards the staircase which is in front of you, climb up the stairs and move a bit forward. There is an open door to your left, which is beside the staircase, move towards the door and turn left. Now enter in to the room and slightly turn right, there is a fire place in front of you, which is under a portrait, move forward and stand in front of the fire place and it will be your end point.

8630.instruction: You are facing towards a wall, slightly turn right and go forward and climb up those steps, slightly turn left and go forward towards the entrance which is beside the stairs, slightly turn left and enter the room passing through the opened door, slightly turn right and go forward towards the fire place, here in front of the fire place you have reached the destination.

8634.instruction: Right now you are standing in front of the fireplace beside the sofa, turn left and move towards the red sofa on the white mat go near to the tea table in the front and take slight right from the tea table in the front you can see an another open arch enter into the open arch now move towards the wooden chair in the front now take slight left move towards the portrait on the wall walk straight towards the table with a flower pot and a lamp on it and turn left from it move towards the wooden chairs which are in row go straight behind the chairs now turn slight right, you can see two pots just beside to the two pots you can find the staircase which is going towards down get down from the staircase you can find the table with an statue turn right from it you can find few more steps get down from the steps in front of the bottle like structure on the second step is the end point.

8635.instruction: You will be finding a sofa left side go straight you will be finding a table with pot, go straight from there you will be finding curtains right side just move straight from there and enter into another room, you will be finding another room with a sofa and two chairs and go little forward you will be finding a photo on the wall at the left side just go little forward, you will be finding a small desk with a flower pot just turn left and enter into a room its a dining room, just go straight till the end of the dining room you will be finding a photo on the wall and a chair right side just move little forward you will be finding a two pots right side and a photo on the wall and there you will be finding a staircase, just go down through the staircase, you will be finding a small table with a toy in the staircase, just turn right and go down towards the staircase at the last fourth step of staircase is your destination.

8646.instruction: Look around, you're currently standing in front of the entrance to a white room. Turn a hundred and eighty degrees and walk down along the red carpet, passing the first brown doors on each side to enter the bedroom. Veer towards your right, passing the red bed to your left, and once you're at the other side of this room, standing at the two brown doors on each side at the entrance, you're done.

8711.instruction: You are going to start facing an opening, facing some file cabinets. Walk towards the file cabinets and turn to the left. Take the door that is opened on you right and take one more step to be in front of that cabinet that has the color painting on top. Once you are there, facing that painting, you are done.

8721.instruction: You start out facing a wall in a bedroom right next to a doorway that leads out to a hallway and the top of a stairway landing. Go out that doorway toward the stairway railing. We are now standing at the corner of the stairway railing and we want to turn right. There is a doorway in the corner and through that doorway you can see a bed with a white bedspread and a gray throw on top of it. Go through that doorway and into that room with the white bed. Once inside the doorway, we want to walk between the wall and the foot of the bed toward another open doorway that we can see ahead of us. That doorway leads into a closet that has some shelves and a couple of items sitting on a shelf. Walk into that closet and stand directly in front of the shelf with the items on it and this is where we will end.

8835.instruction: For your start point you are facing a curtains and gold urn. Turn to the right so that you see the dining table and move to the right side of the dinning table. And exit the dining room through the open doorway straight ahead of you. Continue moving forward you will approach a kitchen island with several chairs to your left.Pass those chairs and you will see to the left there is an archway, straight ahead there's another archway and there's also another archway to the right that has stairs leading down. Move to the right archway with the stair leading down but do not go down the stairs however turn to your right you will see two pots with a picture hanging above it. Move around the pots and turn to the left around the corner. You should see a living room to the left there is a large table that has a mirror above it and a floral arrangement on that table. And straight ahead of you you will see that there is a standing lamp. Move past the table to your left and straight forward to that standing lamp. Once you are in front of that lamp you have reached your end point.

8873.instruction: You are staring at a wall. Turn around to your right until you see a wine colored sofa and a photo on the wall beyond that or a painting. Step in front of the sofa, look left and you'll see a white door head to that door. Look across the hallway directly and step into the next room to the corner of that table. At the table turn left walk to the white that is open that is further from you. There are two one near and further. At that door turn left and look into the hallway, step onto the rug that is just past the stairwell landing, turn left again. You will see a large stone tablet with hieroglyphs on it and a double door at the end of the hallway. Stand in  front of the double doors and stop.

8893.instruction: you are in a kitchen. turn left and walk toward the blue painting on the wall next to the oven. when you are next to the painting pouring tea face the living room youll see an entry room on the right. go thru. face the door and take one step to it. turn left and you will see the thermostat/alarm system. take one step and youll see microwave and sink walk to the next door way. youll see a grill. turn left and youll see the green couch. face the fire place take one step to the animal rug. one step to the gray chair and brown chair behind the brown chair. one step to the windows.

9037.instruction: You're currently standing in front of a green plant. Turn a hundred-and-eighty degrees. Take three steps forward down the hallway, until you're at the entrance to a swimming pool area. Take one step forward down the marble staircase in front of you. Turn around, and face right. Take a step forward. Now, you see a shelf with several white towels in it to your right. Take another step forward in front of you, until the brown open door with the silver handle on it is right in front of you. Now, turn around and face right. Take one step forward to this room. Now, you're standing directly in front of this marble table with stripe towels on it. Now, turn around and face right. Take one step forward. Once you see a white sink attached to a blue marble wall in front of you, slightly to your right, you're done.

9041.instruction: You're starting in a little kitchenette area, facing a bowl of fruit. Turn around, leave this area and walk toward the living room. Walk between the brown couch on your right and a framed photo on the wall on your left. You will go through the first door on the left. This is a hallway. Take two steps toward the large, brown vases in the corner. Take a left and walk to the end of this hallway, toward the bench. Go up the stairs to your left. Once you're at the top of the stairs, turn left and walk to the right of the stair railing by the abstract, rectangular, cluster artwork on your right. Walk into the hallway with the open door that goes into a bathroom. Then turn right and walk into what looks like a craft room. There's a circular rug on the floor. Step onto that rug. Then in the right corner, there is a rack that has fabric hanging on it. Walk up to that rack and you're done.

9096.instruction: You are in front of the black table. Turn around and take right. You will find two open doors. Take the right opened door. Enter into that door. Once you step out of that room, take left. You will find another door on your right side. Enter into that door. Go straight and turn right towards the pillar way. Move forward, there will be an animal statue on your left side. Cross that statue and move forward and then stop. That will be your destination point in front of the big windows and cupboards and photo frame on your left and then stop.

9097.instruction: You are facing towards a fire place, turn right and go forward towards the opened white door which is on the right, go forward towards the wall and exit this room through the opened door, turn left and go towards the room through which you can see a red couch, passing through the entrance go forward towards the fire place, turn right and go forward towards the left side of the glass window,  here on the left side of the glass window you have reached the destination.

9109.instruction: You begin facing a set of doors and a patio, turn around to your left, you will see, you will see an archway, next to the archway there will be some light switches and a white, and 2 white tables with 4 picture frames above them, take one step towards the light switches, then turn to your left, and a take between the black couch and the kitchen counter, looking forward, you should see a hallway, take 3 steps to go down the hallway, right before the corridor that has the main door at the end, turn to your right and you will see another hallway with a picture to the right, it will have a bunch of letters on it, take one step forward and turn into the hallway on the right, the very first door on the right, take 3 steps to go forward, you will pass the kitchen, take one more step forward, so that the kitchen is behind you and you are done.

9127.instruction: You are facing towards the empty cupboards, turn back and exit the room, now you are facing towards the bed, that would be your end point.

9128.instruction: You are facing towards an empty rack, turn around, walk towards the bed. You have reached your destination.

9184.instruction: You are facing a large mirror.  You are going to turn to your right and head towards the tall bookcase.  Once next to the bookcase you are going to head to the open door where you see stairs.  You are going to head thru that doorway.  And you are going to go up the stairs.  And continue up.  And you are going to stop on the 4th step from the stop.  And if you look up right next to you on the wall will be some animal heads mounted and you are done.

9215.instruction: You are facing a window with curtains. Turn around and now you are facing bed which has blue cushions and blue comforter set on it. Go across the bed and exit the bedroom.You will cross the glass closets on your left as you exit the room and step outside and turn left. When you turn left now you are  facing a living room and a kitchen. kitchen is on your right and after that is the living room. And on your left their is a dining table which black and white very stylish chairs go near them and fro their turn right a slight right and move towards the living room area in front of you just near the sofa grey sofa and carpet. Step on the carpet and you are done.

9260.instruction: You are standing beside the bed, where you can see two beds on your right side, and facing towards the open door.Walk straight until you see a bed on your right side, passing through the wooden railing on your left side. Turn to your left, move towards the wooden railing. Turn around, get down the stairs completely. Turn slight right, move towards the closed glass door. Turn around, walk straight towards centre table, which is on your left side. You are standing beside the wooden cabinet, and facing towards the single chair. Which is your final destination.

9261.instruction: Slightly take left and move forward along the railing, till you find a bed at the right side, take left, turn around you can find stairs towards down, climb down the stairs, and take right, move forward towards the window, turn around and walk straight towards the sofa, beside the sofa chair in front of brown cupboard you can find your destination.

9287.instruction: You are standing on the steps facing towards the closed door. Turn around and get down the steps. Walk a few steps ahead. You are now standing facing towards an open white door in front of you. Enter into the room. Walk a few steps ahead till you reach the closed white door in front of you. Stand in front of the closed door. You have reached your point.

9288.instruction: Turn around get down on the stairs, then walk straight towards the red color mat and walk straight completely till you reach the white color door where you will see the brown color chest on your right side. Stand in front of the brown color chest and you will reach your destination.

9301.instruction: You are facing towards a chair, slightly turn left and walk towards the basket, take few steps ahead, turn around and walk towards the pool table, slightly turn left and walk towards the glass window, now walk in the path between the pool table and the glass window. You are now facing towards a wooden wall with three frames, you have reached your destination.

9302.instruction: Now you are in front of the brown color sofa, from there take a left turn start moving straight near to the brown color glass door, here take an about turn, walk straight and turn a bit to your left and start moving straight near to the glass window which is on to your left side. From here turn a bit right and start walking straight until you see white frames in front of you.

9320.instruction: You are facing towards the white shelves slightly turn right, walk in that narrow path you can see table and a chairs go near to the chair. There take a right turn you can see open door, walk through that door you can see wall frames on the wall, go near to that then walk in that near path till you see a wall which has one switch, there tale a left turn and stand at the entrance.

9321.instruction: You are now facing towards the marble table. Turn slightly right and move forward and walk behind the circular table which has four white chairs. Turn slightly right and move forward and enter into the straight open path, where in you are now beside the steps. Walk beside the steps and the wall hanging to your right. Move forward, where in you are facing towards the wall which has wall hanging on it. Turn slightly left and stop facing towards the sink and there is a switch to your right, and this is your end point.

9496.instruction: Now you are standing in-front of a staircase, climb the staircase and take left, you can see an open door to your left, enter into the room through an open door, go near the bed and stand, that's your end point.

Once you're behind that white chair, you will see that there is a gym ignore the gym, look at the hallway to the right, take one step to go down the hallway, take another step, you will see that there are some wooden cupboards, take a step into that room with the wooden cupboards, you are now in a kitchen, turn to your left and you will see the ovens and a island to the right, follow the path with the ovens to your left and the island to your right, you will see the refrigerator, keep going straight, the refrigerator should pass by your right, take another step, you will be in a hallway, ignore the hallway, keep going straight until you are in a, you are in a room with towels hanging from a wooden table, 2 refrigerator on the right, and some kitchen utensils on the table, look to the left, you will see a, you will see a bunch of doors, take one step towards the doors, you should now be standing on the corner of the table, next to the red mixer with the door in front of you, and a picture of a cross right behind you, you are done.

13161.instruction: You are facing a living room.  You will see in the far corner a TV on a wood table.  You are going to head towards the TV.  Once you are at the TV with the white horse figure up against the wall you are going to turn to your right and you are going to see some steps going down.  You are going to take those steps down.  You are going to take them all the way down. You will now be entering an office area.  You are going to veer to your right.  You will see off to the right a living room area.  You are going to head towards the sofa with lots of pillows on it.  There will be a coffee table in front of the sofa, you are going to hop over the coffee table so the sofa is on your left and the fireplace is on your right.  Once you have hopped over you will be next to a footrest that will be at the bottom of a chair.  You are now going to hop to your left heading towards the glass paneled wood doors. You will pass a wood column on your right as you do this.  Once you are in front of the wood glass paneled doors you are going to move forward towards the wood column in front of you, the seating area will be on your left and the doors on your right.  You are going to see some wood steps going up.  Standing next to the wood column you are going to hop up these steps.  And once you make the first leap onto the steps you are going to stop and you are done.

13180.instruction: You are going to start facing the corner of a room with a desk. You are going to turn around completely. Take one step to the right of that plant in the corner. Turn to the right, and exit that room towards the left. Take one step to be in front of the big vases in the corner of the staircase. Turn left, take one step towards the chair that is on the left side of the front door, turn slightly to the right and take one step to... towards the coffee table with the red flowers on top. Turn right and take one step towards the dining room table. Take the door that is on the left side of the mirror. Turn to the right right in front of the coffee machine on the left side. You should have the sink on your left. Keep walking straight until you get to the fireplace in front of you. Now, turn slightly to the left and you are going to take one big step towards the plant that we can see in the corner on the left side of that fireplace. Once you are there, you should be looking at the plant in the corner, a lamp on your left, and two chairs with a coffee table in the middle that has a coffee and some flowers. That is your destination.

13237.instruction: Turn right from the place you are standing, move forward, to the left you can find a clock on the wall, a pink curtain, two flower vases and a glass structure where instructions are printed, stand in between the first flower vase and the glass structure, that would be your end point.

13238.instruction: Slightly move towards your right from the place where you are standing, you can see an open door, enter into it and walk forward on the red carpet, stand in between the two poles, which is to your right and left, that's your end point.

13249.instruction: You are standing on a carpet, go straight ahead exit this room and turn left, go on your immediate left through the archway. Once you are in the middle of the foyer turn left, and you should be standing in the narrow hall way with a rug on the floor and windows with curtains on your right. Take first right and now you should be standing at the door of the washroom you are done.

13334.instruction: We begin facing 2 single grey chairs, 1 with a turquoise pillow. Let's go to the left of those chairs and exit that room, where you see a couple people standing outside of it. People have now disappeared, we are standing in front of a stairway.  Let's head down that stairway, all the way down to the bottom. We will make a u-turn, heading to our left down another hallway. We will go down 3 stairs, backup. We will stand at the top of those 3 stairs where we have reached our destination. So looking down you see a thermostat to our right and the rest of the home in front of us.

13371.instruction: You are facing towards the bed right now, go near the bed, turn right and exit the bedroom, move forward and enter into the room which is infront of you, you can find two bed infront of you, slightly turn to your right and move forward towards the chair, turn right and move forward, stand infront of the cupboard which is to your right, that would be your end point.

13372.instruction: Right now you are standing in a wooden room beside the door which has a bed. Move forward towards the bed, turn right and exit the room. You will enter into a washroom with a commode, walk towards the commode and exit the bathroom as well. You will enter into a room with another bed and also a chair in it. Walk towards the chair and turn right. You will find a brown carpet, walk towards the carpet, take a few steps forward and then you will reach the endpoint beside the cupboard.

13374.instruction: You are standing in a narrow passage, to the left you can see an entrance, walk to the entrance, turn left, walk straight until you reach, a black shelf on your right. Turn left, in-front of you there are two open doors, walk to the left side open door. Enter the room, now you are in a bedroom, to the left you have an bed, in-front of you there is a black chair, stand beside the black chair, facing towards the window, that's your end point.

13462.instruction: You begin looking towards a table and stairs. Skirt around the right side of that table and go ahead up those wooden stairs. You're going to go all the way up and once you are at the top of the stairs you make an immediate turn to the left. Move to the end of the little wooden section of walkway and then take a step forward underneath the stairs in front of you, then you're gonna turn around nearly all the way, to the right. Move to the left side of the wooden strut just in front of you, towards the double doors on the other side, and then turn around fully to your left, or almost fully to your left, Move to the left side of the small cushy coffee table type ottoman... It's like a huge ottoman that they are using as a coffee table by putting a tray on top of it. It looks honestly like stains waiting to happen but, y'know, whatever. Once you are standing on the opposite side of that ottoman to the brown couch and the two brown chairs, and kind of next to a kind of wooden chair with a kind of floral pattern on it, you are done.

13469.instruction: You are facing towards a white shelf, turn left and go forward towards the bed passing through the opened door, slightly turn left and go forward towards the opened white door, slightly turn left and go forward towards the edge of the railing passing through the opened door, slightly turn right and go forward towards the bed passing through the entrance, slightly turn left and go forward towards the lamp which is beside the bed, here facing the wall just beside the bed you have reached the destination.

13470.instruction: Right now you are in a small room facing the shelves. Turn slightly to your left. You see a bed in front of you. Go straight near the bed. From the bed take a left and you see a door in-front of you. Walk near the door, exit the room and turn right. To your right you see a bed with a grey shawl on it in a room. Enter that room which is to your right. You see a white wall in front of you with a small table, a clock and a wall on it. Go near the table and stop.

13496.instruction: You begin facing a bedroom, turn to your left, take a step out the narrow arched door, take another step out into the hallway and then turn left, take one step forward and then turn left and take the last step into this empty closet, you are done.

13633.instruction: Enter into the room which is infront of you, turn left and move a bit forward, turn left and get down the stairs, turn right and move a bit forward, turn right and move towards the closed door which is infront of you, slightly turn to your right and move a bit forward, now you are standing infront of a staircase, that would be your end point.

13634.instruction: You are facing a wall slightly turn left and exit the door, there is a bedroom walk straight to the bed and turn left, walk straight and turn left you can find a staircase walk down the staircase and turn right, you can find a sofa in front go near to the sofa and turn right, walk straight till you reach a black lamp in front at the door, turn right you can find your destination at the staircase and in front of a wheel kind of object.

13641.instruction: We are facing a window with green painting. Turn to our right and walk to the front of the bookcase  ahead of us. Take a right. Walk straight out the door at the end of the room.  Now we are going to walk across the hall and up the stairs. Once you reach the top of the landing of the stairs, take a left in front of the statue on our left. This takes us to a bedroom ahead of us. Walk to the end of the bed in front of the dark chest and go around the bed to the left passing the picture of the soldier with a rifle. At the window with the cross in it, take a left and walk to the night stand with a lamp. The bed will be on your left with the white covering and the flowery quilt. You are at your destination.

13689.instruction: You begin in a room with a mirror on the right and a brown, tall cabinet directly in front of you. Just to the left of the cabinet, you're going to see a door to another room. Walk through that door, and you're going to enter a room with a white carpet with a combination of gray, green, black and orange patterns on it and a dresser in front of you to the right. And if you turn to the left, you're going to see a set of closed doors just beyond the carpet. Walk up to these closed doors and you are done.

13779.instruction: Okay right now you are facing the glass window. Turn to your right and walk straight and enter into the second door to your right and walk straight to the open door till you reach a barbecue grill to your right. Then turn to your left and you enter into the seating area. Walk straight towards the table to the right. Now turn around and you see a open door to your right. Walk straight towards the open door. Now you see a table to your right with a frame to the wall sorry you see a table to your left with a frame to the wall and sofa to your right. Walk towards the sofa and turn to your right slightly and walk towards the sofa which is in front of the glass window. This is the end point.

13780.instruction: You are facing towards the glass window. Turn right and walk straightly in the passage till you reach near to the second open room which is on your right side. Slightly turn right and move towards the open room. Turn right and now you are facing towards an open door. Walk through the open door. Now walk straightly in the passage by passing through the open door till you find a washbasin on your right side. Slightly turn left and move towards the couch. Slightly turn left and move towards the fireplace. Turn left and walk through the open door. Now you are facing towards the wooden bench which has a book and a small flower vase on it. Slightly turn right and move towards the couch. Slightly turn right and move towards the glass window. Now you are facing towards the glass window and the couch. That will be the end point.

13824.instruction: Now you are in a washroom and facing towards mirror. Turnaround. Move forward to the chair. Turn slightly right. Move forward to the bed. Turn right. Move forward to the open door. Turn right. Move forward to the wall. Turn left. Move forward by passing through the table on the left. Turn left. You will see an open door. Go into the open door which has a steel stand and hangers on it. You have reached your destination.

13825.instruction: Okay right now you are facing towards the wash basin. Turn around and you see a chair in front of you. Walk straight towards the chair. Now turn slightly right and walk straight towards the bed. Now turn to your right and you see one open door in front of you. Walk towards the door. Now turn right and go straight. Exit the room. Now you see picture frames in front of you on the wall. Turn to your left and walk straight till you reach the photo frames to your left side. Now turn little left and you see a door which is open in front of you. Enter into that room and stop. That is the end point.

13859.instruction: You are facing a wall with many pictures on it.  You are going to turn to your left and go towards the brown rug on the floor.  Once on the brown rug facing white doors on a closet you are going to make a right and enter that room. Once you enter this room you will be on a red and blue rug.  You are going to make a left into the doorway.  You have now entered another room.  You will see a couch to your right and there will be a large rug on the floor and if you look forward you will see 3 pictures on the wall and a small table with a statue of a man on it. Go towards that table with the statue and stop in front of it.  Facing that wall with the pictures and the statue on the table turn to your left and you will see a doorway. You are going to go thru that doorway.  You are going to see stairs to your right and to your left you will see steps going down.  You are going to take those steps down.  Continue taking them all the way down. And when you get about half way on the steps going down you will see to your right there will be a beige hieroglyphics picture on the wall. And to your left will just be a cement wall.  You are going to stop right there  when you are right next to the hieroglyphics picture on the wall.

13863.instruction: You're now facing an open entrance. Turn around and take a step ahead towards the entrance on your right side, and that is your end point.

13864.instruction: You are standing in a room, facing towards the open door, turn back. To the right you can see another open door, walk to the open door, now stand at the entrance of the door, that's your end point.

13878.instruction: You are standing in a open room, facing towards the closed door, slightly turn left, in-front of you there are lockers, walk to the lockers, turn left, in-front of you there is an open door, walk to the open door, exit the room, turn right, walk straight, to the left you have a staircase, walk to the staircase, climb the stairs completely. In-front of you there is a chair, turn left, in-front of you there is a narrow path, walk straight in the narrow path, passing through the glass doors on your right, walk straight until you reach the table with a pot on it, turn left, to the left there is an open door, walk to the open door, turn left, stand at the entrance of the open door, that's your end point.

13879.instruction: You are facing towards the wall, slightly take left and move forward towards the cabinets, now slightly take left and move towards the open door and exit the room through the open door, now turn to your right and move towards the stairs go all the way up through the stairs, after going up turn to your left and move forward, walk through out the passage till you find a table in front of you with a white clay pot on it,now turn to your left and move forward you are facing towards the entrance of the room, now turn to your left and enter into the room the entrance of the room is your end point.

13904.instruction: Now you are in the bed room, from there take an about turn and start working straight through the narrow corridor, At the end of the corridor, you will find a way to your left side. Here take a left turn and start walking straight, at the end of the corridor you will find a big brown color glass door to your right side and also a wall with frame on it.

13905.instruction: Right now you are standing in the bedroom turn right, you can see the open wooden door exit the bedroom through it go straight and turn left you can see pots towards you are left hand side and the glass door towards you are right hand side walk straight  through it till you reach the second wooden table towards you are left and a portrait above it right in front of the table is the end point.

13936.instruction: You are facing towards the dining table right now, go near the dining table, turn right, you can find a cabinet to your right, go in between the cabinet and the dining table, slightly turn left, you can find a glass window behind the dining table chair, stand in between the glass window and the dining table chair, that would be your end point.

13937.instruction: Right now you are in front of the table, now go near the table, and turn right, you will find window with curtains, now go and stand in front of the window, that will be your final destination.

13941.instruction: Make your way out of this marbled room. Take a left once facing the pool and walk towards the black top counter. Go up the two sets of stairs. You will see two open doors on the right and one in the front. Go to the one in the middle, the one closest to the front door or the that is in front of you and stop at its entrance. You will see a potted   flower and some stairs leading to the upper level.

13978.instruction: There is a floor lamp directly in front of you. To the left of the lamp is a pillar with a taxidermy mount. Walk past the taxidermy mount on your right into the room in front of you. You will see a large burgundy couch nestled between two windows. Walk towards the couch passing the pictures to the left of you on the wall. Walk towards the floor lamp that is left of the couch stopping about a foot and a half before the right edge of the couch. To the left of you there are multiple pictures. To the right of you is a fire place.

13985.instruction: Right now you're facing towards a window. Now slightly turn left and move towards the open door which is in front of you. Now exit the room and turn behind, move towards the second arch which is to your right and slightly turn right. There is a fireplace in front of you, move towards the fireplace. You can see an open door in front of you, move towards the open door and turn left, enter in to the room and move towards the table which is in front of you. Now slightly turn left, there is a closed glass door in front of you, move towards the door and stand in front of it and it is your end point.

13986.instruction: You are facing towards the window, turn left and move out of this room. Now move forward. Turn around and move towards the last arch. Turn slight right and move towards the fire place. Now move towards the open door. Turn left and move towards the table which is in front of you. Turn slight left and move towards the white chair. Now move towards the windows which is in front of you. Now you are facing towards the windows and to your left there is a white chair, which is your final destination.

14014.instruction: You are standing near a window, turn right now their is a pool table on your right and straight ahead their is a couch, walk near the beige couch hope over it and reach the look alike couch with brown foot rest on the left the take step on the floor and turn right their is a pillar on your right and another sitting area after you move forward and take few steps straight ahead and take few steps towards the railing of the staircase staying on the right side of it near the chairs on the opposite side of of it then their is a console table on your left and a kitchen area and a console table on your left, turn right now the dining table should be on your right and the kitchen area should be on your left,proceed straight ahead staying in middle of them then reach the other end of the table and the head chair and turn right then move straight ahead towards the glass doors on your left and the sitting area with beige sofas on your right, once you are near them you are done.

14082.instruction: Okay so once you start you will be looking at a door just on the left side and above you there will be a painting. You will turn to the right 180 degrees, and in the corner you will see a radiator and a bookshelf, so you are going to go to that corner there. Once you are in that corner, you will turn to the right and you will see a door, and just past the door there is a set of stairs. You are going to walk to the door. Once you are at the door you will see two sets of stairs, one going up which is on the right side and on the left side there is a set of stairs going down. You are going to go to the left side where the stairs are going down and stand at the top of those stairs. Once you are at the top there you are going to turn around, and you should see another room, it has a statue just on the left or a couch just off to the right. You are going to take a step into that room just onto that first carpet. Once you are in that spot you will see a giant square red carpet right in the middle of the room. you are going to go to the left corner at the back just to the left of that couch. Once you are standing there you will look to your right and you will see on the right side of the room there is a door that is open. You will go to that back right corner where the door is open. Once you are standing by that door, you will turn to the right and you will see a carpet as well. There is a blue portion, a white portion, and a blue portion at the bottom, you are going to go in between the two blue portions onto that white stripe there. You will see a radiator in front of you just below the window, so we are going to go stand over there. Once you are at the radiator with the window above you, you should be done.

14105.instruction: We are facing a wall. Turn to our right walking to the wood floor. Take a left where you will see some stairs ahead of you. Turn left when you get to the stairs. Go down a few steps toward the bathroom ahead of you. Stop in front of the white toilet. You have arrived.

14115.instruction: You are facing what looks to be a reflection in a mirror of a living room. As you turn around to your right, you see that living room, it has two couches with pillows on it. Walk down the hallway where you can see the outside area. As you walk down the hallway, to the left of you there will be a breakfast bar, to the right of you, you will see a blue couch. Continue walking. As you pass the couch up, walk towards the long table with the chairs to the left of you. Stay on the right side of the table, Continue to walk towards the window. Once you reach this area you will stop. Here you have a view outside. There's a patio area, a lawn, trees and shrubs.

14148.instruction: You are standing in a gym, in front of you there is a red wall with a portrait of an athlete Olympian. Turn to the right you will now be standing in front of a glass doorway move forward into the hallway turning to the right. Once you are in the hallway move to the right towards the staircase.

14164.instruction: You're now facing the wooden sofa. Turn left and you will find the stairs. Climb up the stairs completely and then, turn slightly left. You will find sofa set with centre table. Go near the centre table and stand in between the centre table and the wooden cabinet on your left side, you will reach your destination.

14165.instruction: You are facing the couch, turn left, walk straight. There are stairs in the front, climb those. Once you completely climb the stairs walk straight, turn left from the pillar. Move a step forward and walk straight. In the left you have shelves and in the right you have the dining table. Turn around and walk straight by passing through the lamp. Stand in front of the couch unit where you have the closet behind you. This is the end point

14173.instruction: We start off looking at some portraits. Turn to your left. Take one step over that rug. And to your right you will see a door with a circular portrait on it. Next to the door you see the corner of a rug. Take a step onto the corner of that rug and stop you are done.

14193.instruction: Facing the table with two candles on it, turn to the right. You'll have two doors that are wide open, one to the left and one to the right, take the one to the right. You'll step out. You'll have the stairs to the right, turn to the left you'll see a brown door that's closed, looks like a front door and then to the right of that you'll have an open doorway where you can see a red couch, walk in through the doorway. You'll see an extravagant fireplace. There are two ram heads on the ground, walk between the two of them just to the right of the fireplace. Stop, turn to your right you'll see a white statue in front of the window. Walk and stand beside, right beside, the statue on the left. Stare out the window, you're done.

14194.instruction: This is the starting point and you're facing the glass door. Turn around. Walk towards the open glass door. Turn right. Walk towards the arm chair in front of you. Turn around. Walk towards the portraits in front of you. You're facing a wall with four portraits. This is the end point.

14195.instruction: You are facing towards a door, turn around and move forward. On your right, you can find a living area. Turn towards your right and keep moving forward. In front, you can find a sofa chair. Walk towards that sofa chair and turn around. In front, you can find a black color dining table, which is on you right side. Walk beside that dining table and go near the wall in front of you, which has some photo frames hanging on it. Go near that wall and stand there. You reached your destination.

14202.instruction: You are now standing beside the closed door, facing towards the kitchen area, turn around and move towards the billiards table, you are now facing towards the billiards table, turn slight right and move towards the chair near the cupboard, you are now facing towards the cupboard. Now turn right and move towards the small table, which has a glass jar on it, here you can find the fireplace on your left, now move forward  passing through the small table, you are now facing towards the grey color cupboard, now turn left and move towards the wooden cabinet near the window. You are now facing towards the window, turn left and move towards the open door, you are now facing towards the portraits on the wall, turn left and climb the stairs till you reach to the top, you are now facing towards the television. Turn around and move towards the wooden cabinet, you are now standing in between the wooden cabinet on your left, which has helmets and shoes on it and on your right there is a table with chair, turn slightly left and move one step forward, you are now facing towards the sculpture, which is your end point.

14203.instruction: This is the starting point and you're facing towards a dining table. Turn around. Walk towards the snooker table in front of you. Turn right. Walk towards the coffee table in front of you. Now walk towards the arm chair on your left. Turn slightly left and walk towards the drawer behind the arm chair. Turn left. Walk towards the staircase. Climb up the staircase completely. Turn around. Walk towards the table in front of you. Take a step forward and stop. You're standing beside a rocking chair. This is the end point.

14257.instruction: You are now standing in between the two kitchen counter-tops, facing towards the cabinets. Turn right and move towards the living area, passing through the open entrance, you are now facing towards the sofa, turn slightly left and move in between the sofa and the small side table, you are now facing towards the glass door, which is your endpoint.

14258.instruction: This is the starting point and you're in a kitchen area. Turn around. Walk towards the couch. Walk towards the glass window beside the couch. Now you're standing in front of a glass window and behind you there's a couch. This is the end point.

14365.instruction: You begin facing an archway, turn to your right and go through the open door, continue going forward through the creaked open door, through the next archway, once you get to the end of this hallway, you will see a grill to your right, turn to your left and you will see a fireplace, go towards that, next to the fireplace, there is a white chair that's sitting next to some windows, stand in front of the window that's in the middle, once you're looking out that window and the white chair is to your left and the beige armed chair is behind you, you are done.

14466.instruction: Okay,turn around from the living room move forward to the right side you will find the entrance which will lead you to the dinning room where you find a dinning table with some chairs and on to the very corner of the dinning room, take right there is a path which will lead you to the space where you find a snooker table and there is a window and that is the final end.

14467.instruction: Right now, you're facing towards the couch. Turn behind and move forward, where you will be facing towards a closed door. Now, slightly turn right and move forward until you reach a wooden cupboard in front of you. Now, slightly turn right and move forward. Now, slightly turn right and move forward, where you can see a stove on the left. Continue to move forward until you reach a soccer table in front of you and that is the end point.

14500.instruction: Exit the closet. At the foot of the bed turn right and exit the bedroom. When you exit the bedroom turn left. Walk down the hall, keeping the railing on your right. Keep the railing on your right and turn right and head down the stairs. Once you're at the bottom of the stairs, you'll see the left there'll be a door in the distance with window slits, walk towards that door. At that door, turn right and go stand next to the side of the right most couch, you're done.

14538.instruction: You begin facing a door, turn to your left, take 4 steps to go down the hallway, once you're almost at the end of the hallway, turn to your right, you will see another hallway, going down through a door that's creaked open, take 5 steps to go down this hallway, take another step through the opened door, once you're at the end of the hallway, there will be an oven to your right, take a step to the left, into the living room, you will see a dining table with 4 white rectangular shaped chairs, take a step towards those, once you're standing right next to the dining table, facing it, you are done.

14600.instruction: You are facing towards the entrance of house, slightly take right and go all the way down through the stairs, slightly take right and move forward you will be facing towards the white sofa, now turn to your right and move forward, you will be near the dinning table now slightly take right, go behind the chairs it is your end point.

14601.instruction: You are now standing on the staircase, facing towards a closed door, turn slightly right and get down the steps. Turn slightly right and you can see a couch, move forward towards the couch. Now turn around, you can see a table with white chairs, move forward towards the table. Turn slightly right and move forward. You are now facing towards an open entrance. There is a table with white chairs on left and on your right you have a potted plant and this is your end point.

14610.instruction: You're currently standing right in front of a fireplace. Turn around, so you're facing the glass coffee table with the white roses on top of it. Hop over the glass coffee table and towards the glass coffee table with the green plant on it. Take a step forward to the left side of the brown sofa in front of you. Take a step forward towards the dining room. Walk towards the left side of the brown dining table, towards the brown double doors leading outside. Keep walking straight, stepping a little bit outside and through the double doors leading to a room with a round table, with a white flower on top of it. Take a step forward, passing the round table to the left, until you're in an open archway looking into a living room with a white fireplace in it. It's completely new this time. Take a few steps forward, passing the white sofa on your left. Turn around, face right. Walk down the hallway, passing the kitchen counter on your right. Take a step forward, passing the white archway and leaving the kitchen. Keep walking down the hallway, until you see a white-potted plant to the right of you. Turn around, slightly to the left. You'll be looking into a circular hallway. Take two steps to the left, passing the circular floor on the right side of you, with a brown chair to the left. Once you're right in front of the brown-closed door, directly to the left, you see a brown nightstand with a red ornament on top of it, you're done.

14678.instruction: You begin in a very white home, on top of a very small staircase. Turn completely around behind you, and you should see a larger staircase on your right, and a hall continuing forward to a door that is oddly striped with windows, that go horizontal. Approach the aberrant striped door. Get right up on that thing. Then turn right. You should see a living area with two couches across a small black coffee table from each other, flanking a television with two vases next to it. You want to approach the couch on the left, moving between it and the small black coffee table. Once you're there, approach the television, getting between it and the coffee table. Once you're between the TV and the coffee table, you're done.

14699.instruction: You're looking at a TV. To your right, there is a dark sectional. Walk behind the sectional and continue through, down the hall.
