16702.instruction: You will start facing a bunch of books on a bookshelf, turn slightly to the right and you will see a open door, take one step towards the open door. Turn a little to the left, and you will see that outside of the open door there is a hallway and there will be a ladder in front of you, take one step towards the ladder. Turn to the right, there will be a staircase with a bunch of animals hanging above it, take one step towards the staircase, right now you should be standing right before the stairs, on a carpet, next to a statue of Jesus? Take one step to go down the stairs, take another step, right now you should be right before the second set of stairs, take one step to go down those stairs, take another step, right now you should be on a carpet, and in front of you there should be 2 rooms, turn to the left, there will be a very bright room with a bright red carpet and green walls and a green door and a fireplace, take one step into that room, turn slightly to the left, there will be a bookshelf in the corner, take one step towards the bookshelf, right now you should be standing in front of the bookshelf, next to the window, if you're there, you are done.

16703.instruction: You will start by standing inside a living room. Take a step towards the opening and exit this room. Continue to walk straight. Now turn left and continue to walk down the hallway. Turn left once again and walk up the stairs. Once you've reached the top of the stairs turn left take a step on the left and walk inside the open french double doors. Stand beside the large plant inside this room and you're done.

16725.instruction: You will start out in a doorway. You can see some stairs outside. To the right of them there is a dresser under a window. Take one step toward the dresser and then head up those stairs, going all the way to the top. When you reach the next floor, turn to your left slightly. You will see some stairs going up to another floor. Just to the right of that, there is a floor to ceiling wooden pillar, and then just to the right of that, there is a gray rug on the floor that has a lot of furniture on it. Take one step just to the right of that wooden pillar onto the gray carpet. Then take another step along the edge of that gray carpet between the wooden buffet table on your left and the armchairs on your right so you're walking toward the floor to ceiling windows in front of you. Then turn slightly to your left and you will see the bottom of those stairs coming down and another wooden pillar that goes from floor to ceiling. In between those you will see the stove in a kitchen and you want to take one final step just to the right of that stove, just to the left of the wooden pillar. When you get there, there will be a copper statue sculpture thing just to the right of the stove and when you are standing next to that, you are done.

16737.instruction: Right now you are in a bathroom where you will find a commode and bottles. There is a door, you have to enter the door. Through that door you will enter the room, in which there is a.. there are two beds and there is a chair. You can see a wooden fence type structure, you have to go till there. There is a passage, on the right you will find cupboard type structures, you have to continue straight till you reach the end point. Now you have to take left. By taking left, you will find stairs. You have to walk down the stairs till you reach the floor, where you will find a kitchen. In the kitchen you will see a dining table with chairs and stove. You have to walk till the stove and you have to take a left. This is your destination.

16738.instruction: Get out from the bathroom through the door,take right from here, go through the wall, go straight,go down to the stairs, take left from the stairs, go near the dining table and take left and you reached the point.

16812.instruction: You are near the door step, turn around and you can see a interior swimming pool, keep moving forward and in front you can find two steps, climb up those steps and stand beside a mat which has a pole to your left and swimming pool to your right. You reached your destination.

16813.instruction: You're standing at the entrance of the door, Turn behind, move forward and step on to the swimming pool. Go stand near the pool. This would be your end point.

16836.instruction: Now you're facing the table, slightly turn right and move towards the sofa. Now you are facing the lamp, turn right and exit the room through an open entrance. Turn left and climb up the stairs completely, now you are facing an open door. Turn left, move towards the wall and enter the first room opposite of the railing on the left side and stand in front of the tower behind the bathtub. This is the endpoint.

16837.instruction: You are facing a teapoy with a flower vase. Slightly turn right and move towards the couch. There is a lamp in the opposite. Slightly turn left and exit the room. Take a left turn and walk straight. There are stairs, climb up. Slightly turn left and climb up the stairs. Towards your right there is a closed door and in the opposite there is an open door. Take a left turn, move forward. Take the immediate right turn into the washroom. Walk straight and stand front of the towel. This is the end point.

16839.instruction: "Now you are facing towards the mirror,turn right, you can see a door, exit from it, walk forward and take left, you can see another open door, exit it and walk forward, until unless you see black chairs, towards the black chair, take right and walk inside, there is a oven, go and stand in front of it."

16840.instruction: Behind the desk in wash room go straight and come to the bed room in front a bed go straight and exit the room.There is so many picture on the wall in corridor.Move forward and turn right side there is a dinning table in front of another table.

16856.instruction: You begin looking out a window, turn to your left, go towards the stools at the kitchen, and then turn to your right and go towards the sink in the kitchen, then turn to your left, keeping the island to your left, go forward through the doorway, passing the oven and microwave on your right, you will enter a dining area, continue going forward, once you enter the second living space, go towards the chair with orange pillows and then turn to your left, and go up the staircase, at the top, turn to your left and go through the doorway that's, the first doorway on your left, it will have a bed with a green throw on it, take a step towards the orange and blue blanket on the bed, once you're standing on the rug, you are done.

16869.instruction: You are standing on the staircase facing towards the closed white door. Turn around and walk all the way to the top of the stairs. Now turn right and enter the open room. You are now in the bedroom. Turn left and walk towards the cabinet which has a lamp and a clock on it. Turn left and enter the open room. Slightly turn right and walk towards the open door. Now you are standing near the commode. Turn around to your left and walk towards the open door. Now you are at the entrance of a washroom. Slightly turn right and walk through the glass door. Now you are inside the shower room. That will be the end point.

16870.instruction: You are on the stairs right now, go up the stairs, take right, you can find a bed, enter into the bedroom, turn to your left, you can find a lamp beside the bed, move forward, now you are infront of the lamp, turn to your left, you can find an opened door to your right, enter into that room, you are facing towards the window right now, slightly turn to your left, you can find an opened door to your right, enter into that room, slightly turn to your right, you can find a transparent glass, get inside the bathing area, that would be your end point.

16871.instruction: You begin facing a window, turn around, you will see that you are in a bedroom, to your right there are 2 doors, a bathroom and a closet, take one last step into the closet, once you're in the threshold, you are done.

16908.instruction: We're facing some armchairs and a couch. Let's turn to our right and go straight. And go down the stairs. On this floor we should be able to see a white open door. Go through the open door. We are in a bathroom and we can stop here.

16928.instruction: You are facing a mirror.  You are going to turn to your left.  You are going to exit this area and go up the steps in front of you.  Once up the steps you are going to move slightly forward and you will see a staircase on your left.  You are going to head up those stairs.  You are going to take the stairs all the way to the top.  And you are going to enter the room right in front of you.  You will see 2 chairs in the corner.  You are going to step into this room and you are going to hop over the corner of the foot of the bed heading towards the wall with blinds.  And once you have hopped over the bed and you have landed with the bed on your right and the long blinds on the wall on your left you are done.

16948.instruction: Right now you are in a room take left to exit the door and now take right to exit another door and now take left and move little bit forward where you will find a kitchen area on your right and a dining table on your left, now take left and move forward where you find a white cupboard on your left and a dining table on your right and now you can see a glass window in front of you move towards the glass window and this is your final destination.

16949.instruction: Turn left and exit the room. Now, turn right and move forward. Now, you can see a portrait on the right side. Turn left and take a few steps. From here, turn left and walk towards the window and that is the end point.

16992.instruction: You are facing towards the wall take about turn, move forward you are standing beside the red sofa. You can see a open white door in front of you go out of the room, enter into the door which is in front of you, then take left turn. You can see one more open door go out of the room then take a left turn move forward walk straight to the closed door and stand.

16993.instruction: You are facing towards the wall, turn right and move towards the open door, now turn right, move forward and enter the room, which has a table in it, from here turn left and move towards the open door, now turn left and stand in front of the stairs, now turn left, move forward in the narrow space, and reach the closed door, now you are standing in front of the closed door, this is your end point.

17006.instruction: You are at the door of the dining hall facing towards the dresser and wooden wall, take a left turn and move forward to the dining table near there is a small table, in the front there is a cabinet. You are near the dining table. This Is the end point.

17007.instruction: You are at the door of a dining hall, turn towards your left and keep moving forward. You can find a dining table, which is on your slight right. Go near that dining table and you reached your destination.

17147.instruction: Now, you are facing towards the wall. Turn slight left and walk straight. Now, turn to your right where you can see an open white door. Pass through it and walk straight. Now, turn slight right towards the open door which is towards your right side. Enter through that door and that will be your end point at the entrance of the room facing the bed in front of you.

17148.instruction: You're facing towards the wall, move forward and turn to your right, go straight, you can see two open doors, go inside the room which is at your right and stop near the door.

17174.instruction: Starting in a laudry room take a step out towards the hallway. Once oyuve take the stepoutside of the hallway, look towards the right youll see pictures on both sides of the wall. Direclty ahead of you it looks like there is a violin on the wall. Go in front of that voilen. Once in front of the violen look to the right youll see an open doorway to what it looks like a living room and a hallway to your left. Take the hallway to your left. Once you are in the hallway to you left, you see its a very long hallway. Go towards the very end of the hallway. Once you are at the end of the hallway youll see in front of you is a doorway, to your left is a kitchen way to your right is another doorway. To your direct right is a staircase going down stairs. Go to the bottom of the stairs. Once at the bottom of all these staircases, there should be a pot to your left with a bunch of designs on it. Youll see a door directly in front of you that is opened. Go to this door that is opened. Once you are in front of this brown door that is open, take one step over the rug that is directly in front of you. Once youve take one step over the rug youll see there are some lockers on the left. Take one step to the right so you are directly in front of these lockers. Once in front of these lockers, the lockers should be to your left looking forward. Take one step forward. Looking forward it looks like its an opening to a garage. Take one step to the right and you are done.

17220.instruction: You are now facing the cupboard, from there take an about turn. Walk straight near to the red color carpet, from there take a left turn, go near to the entrance of the door. From there enter into the room which is in front of you. Walk a few steps forward and stand near the yellow carpet. From there slightly turn to your left, walk few steps forward and stand on the red carpet facing towards the pillar.

17221.instruction: Now we are near the chair, turn around, move straight and take left, move straight, enter into the opposite room, and take slight right, move straight and take slight left, move straight, there is a table and we reached the destination.

17222.instruction: Slightly turn to your left and move forward, you can see an open arch to the right, enter into it, now turn back, you can see an open door in-front of you, enter into it move forward till the sofa's, now you can see an open door to your right, exit the room and take right, move towards a table, you can see a glassed window, stand in-front of the window, that's your end point.

17223.instruction: Right now you are facing towards the arch entrance. Make a slight left and go near to the arch entrance on you are left side. From the arch entrance make around and in front you can see a opened door. Go  closer near to the open door and walk through the corridor. In front you can see a two open entrance just get into the two open entrance. On you are left side you can see a large table with chairs on you are right side you can see a closed door move straight and go closer near to the brown sofa chair. On you are right side you can see a open entrance just turn towards you are right and go straight near to the table. Here we reached our destination at the back side of the sofa and in front of the.

17226.instruction: Right now you are facing towards a portrait, turn right and walk straight in through the narrow way and pass through the open door and walk in the path way and walk through the another open door and stop in the middle of the this room and this is your final point where you have two chairs on your left and an open door in front of you.

17227.instruction: You are facing towards the wall, and there is a fire place. Turn to your right, walk straight towards the open door, and walk through the open door. Move forward, turn slight left, move towards the open door on your left. Turn to your left, move forward, and walk through the open door. You are standing on a red carpet, and facing towards an open door, which is your final destination.

17316.instruction: Now, you are facing towards the pillar and the table. Turn slight left and move forward. Now, turn right and walk straight where you can find sofa and chairs on your right side. Turn right from here and pass through the chairs and the cupboard on your left side. Now, turn right from the chair and move forward towards the soccer table. Now, take a slight left and move forwards towards the glass window. Turn right from the glass window and walk straight towards the photo frames on the wall and that will be your end point where you are facing the photo frames attached to the wall and window in front of you.

17317.instruction: Right now you're facing towards the lamp, turn slight left and move forward. Turn right and move forward. Turn right you'll see sofa which is in front of you, move towards the sofa, passing through the sofa, turn right and walk behind the sofa. You'll see snooker table which is in front of you, turn slight left and move forward. Turn right you'll see paintings which are in front of you, stand in front of the paintings and that is your end point.

17320.instruction: Enter the dinning room and turn slight right,go straight and follow the path way of the dinning room, continue withe the path way in the dinning room, enter the door which is in dinning room,and your destination is arrived.

17321.instruction: Right now you are at a door where red carpet is on the floor. By entering that door you will see a dining table with chairs. You have to walk straight on the right side by passing the dining table. Continue going straight, you will find a door by continuing going straight. At the entrance of the door you will see a room. Stand at the entrance of the door. This is your destination.

17340.instruction: You are facing some brown double doors ahead of us in a bedroom. Turn to the right and exit the bedroom going across the bed. Now you are in a hall,turn to your right. Continue forward and you are in a bathroom. Continue walking between the bathtub and the sink that is on the left going straight. Stop right in front of the doorway heading into the little room. You are standing with the medicine cabinet that has light bulbs on it and a toothbrush on your left. You are done.

17381.instruction: You are standing in the bathroom. Come out and turn left. Walk straight and get down the stairs. Take the second left and enter into the living room and walk straight till the fire place behind the table. You have reached your point.

17382.instruction: Go straight from the place you are standing, and turn left, you will find open door, now enter into the open door, there you will find stairs, walk all the way down through the stairs, and keep moving forward, on the left side, you will find an open door, now enter into the room, there you will find table with two chairs, and a portrait to the back of the table, go and stand in front of the portrait, that will be your final destination.

17383.instruction: We'll begin by facing a large pathway with some ropes to the side, as well as some statues that are beyond. Let's just take one step, and this will be our destination.

17517.instruction: You are facing towards the washing machine, turn to your left there is an open door, exit the room through the open door, now tun to your right and move towards the toilet seating through the open door, it is your end point.

17518.instruction: You are in room facing towards the washing machine, tune left and move towards the door, turn right and enter into the bathroom.

17555.instruction: You begin facing a dining area and a living space, in front of you there is peach colored couch, take 2 steps towards that couch, in front of the couch, there is a olive green chair, take a step behind that chair so that it's to your left and there's a fireplace to your right, in front of you there's a staircase, take 2 steps towards that staircase, take 3 steps to go up the staircase ,once you're all the way at the top of the staircase, take one tiny step forward and you're done.

17641.instruction: You find yourself in a hall, facing towards the glass descriptions and black table behind the glass description. Turn around and head towards the open door, now you find yourself at the entrance of another room facing towards an open door and a chandelier above you and a table and some chairs on your left and a vase on your right. This is your final point.

17642.instruction: You are facing towards a small display board, turn to your right and you can see an open door. Move forward a few steps and stand near the entrance of a room and this is your destination.

17646.instruction: You will start by standing in a home gym. To your left there's a staircase going down. Walk down these stairs. Once you've reached the first floor. Continue to walk forward towards the plant. Now stand slightly on the left side of the caramel coloured couch. Now stand behind that couch and take one step towards the stools on the kitchen counter. Once you are facing the kitchen counter then you are done.

17677.instruction: You are facing towards an open door, turn slightly left and pass through the open arch in front of you, move forward. Turn slightly right and move forward. There is a kitchen counter on your left, move forward towards the stove. Now turn left and move forward. Turn slightly right and pass through the open arch. Turn slightly right and you can see another open arch, pass through it and there is another open arch, pass through it. Turn slightly to your left and pass through the open arch which has a portrait on its wall, turn slightly left and move forward towards the staircase and you can see an open arch which is just beside the staircase, enter into it and move forward. There is an open door which is right beside the mirror, enter into it. You are now in a bedroom and there is a bed on your right side, move forward walking on the carpet. You can see two open doors right in front of you, enter the door on the left side and move forward. Now turn to your left and move forward. You are now standing beside a brown cabinet and facing towards a glass window and this is your destination.

17678.instruction: You are facing an open door, turn left, walk straight. Turn right and walk straight. Now you are in the kitchen area. Turn left and move a step forward. Slightly turn right and walk towards the closed door. Turn right, walk straight towards the potted plant. Slightly turn left and walk towards the stairs. Pass through the stairs and enter the first entrance which is opposite to you. Walk straight, in the front you have an open door. Enter into the bedroom. Walk straight, pass through the curtains. There is another open door, enter into it. Slightly turn left and move forward. Now you are in front of a window with curtains and a small cupboard. This is the end point.

17695.instruction: You will start by facing a wall. Turn to your left and you will see an open doorway. Exit this room. Take a step forward on this hallway. Now turn left and walk inside the first room on your left. Take another step towards the wall. Once you're standing in front of the wall and to your left is a staircase then you're done.

17770.instruction: Okay now you are in a room facing towards a closed glass door. Turn to your right and exit the room passing the white towels on the right side and two sinks on the right side, until you enter a bedroom. Now in front of you there is a bed and adjacent to it on the right side there is an open door. Exit the bedroom through that open door. Now you are in the corridor with a wall clock on the left side. Walk all the way through the corridor passing the wall clock. Slightly turn to your left and move forward. Now you are at the edge of the stairs, which are on the left side and adjacent to it there is wide open door. Enter through that open door, turn to your left. Now you are in the living room. Walk all the way straight through the living room passing the glass teapoy and couches on the right side, until you are in front of an open door with a pool board inside it. Slightly turn to your left and move forward to the left edge of the pool. Now slightly turn to your left, now in front of you on the left side there is an orange chair and to the right side there is a dining table with four chairs. Go straight and stand in between the orange chair and the dining table, and that is the end point.

17771.instruction: You are standing near the closed door.Turn around and exit the room. Go straight in between the sink and bathtub. Go closer near to the open door beside the bathtub. You will just entered into a bed room and make a slight right turn beside the bed and make a straight move from the open door. And walk through the corridor and make a slight left turn through the wall. You will just entered  into an arch .Just get into the arch you will enter into a room. Just walk into a room in the middle way and go closer near to the two open doors. Turn towards left there you will find a dinning table. Here we reached the destination near the chair.

17777.instruction: From where you're standing, you're gonna walk forward towards a dark blue couch with an orange pillow on it. You should see some mirrors on the wall to your right. Once you enter this bedroom, past a small closet to your left, you'll make a left turn. As you're facing the bed, walk to the left side of the bed and turn left into the bathroom. Walk all the way into the bathroom and turn left again before the shower. You'll end up in the toilet and just in front of the glass door and the picture on the wall is gonna be your destination.

17895.instruction: Our starting point is dining area, on the right there's a shelf with decorations and beside it there's a brown wooden chair, and on the left there's a long dining table with decorations on top. Walk pass the wooden chair, in front of you there's a living room, walk towards the living room, turn around, on your left there's a staircase, walk towards the staircase, go all the way down the staircase, we're now in a seating are, in front of you there's a white coach and beside it there's an open door, we're now inside a bathroom, on your left there's a sink and on your right there's a toilet and that's your destination.

17978.instruction: You are going to start facing a closed door. Turn 45 degrees to the left and take the door in front of you. Walk past the white and brown rug and go straight through the archway that you have in front. Pass the open door, keep going straight and you are going to stop right in front of the bathtub. Once you are there, you are done.

18050.instruction: Your're looking at a white wall you can see two chairs in front of you. To the left there's an open door, walk towards this open door. Then you'll see a room with white floors and a white bed in the middle, take a step towards the bed. And then take a step to the left of the bed. Then take one step to the corner where this sink is and you've reached the end.

18124.instruction: Okay, now you are in a room facing towards the window, turn left and go straight towards the books, which are in front of you. Now turn left and exit the room through the open door, which is in front of you. Now you are standing at the entrance, slightly move forward and stand next to the chair, which is on the right side. Now turn left and in front of you there is a narrow passage, sorry narrow open entrance, go straight towards the narrow open entrance. Slightly turn to your left and exit the room. Now slightly turn to your left and in front of you there is a staircase, go straight and stand in front of the staircase. Slightly turn to your left and go up the stairs and stand on the third step from the bottom. Now turn behind and in front of you there is a room with carpet in it, go straight and enter the room. Now go straight towards the closed door, which is in front of you. Now turn left and go straight towards the cardboard boxes, which are in front of you and that is the end point.

18125.instruction: You are facing towards a table with vases and lots of stuff on it, turn to your left, you will find books and three portraits in-front of you, walk towards the books, from there turn to your left and exit the room from the open door. Immediately turn to your left and exit this kitchen from the open door in-front of you. From there turn to your left, you will find a staircase in-front of you, go and stand on the fourth step of the staircase, from there turn back, you can see a dining table in-front of you, enter into the room, stand near the dining table, you will find so many portraits on your left side, and four vertical carton boxes behind the dining table, walk towards the carton boxes which are below the portraits on your left side, go and stand in-front of the first carton box which is just below the house portrait hanged on a closed door. You have reached your destination.

18147.instruction: You're in a washroom facing the wall, turn towards your right, go straight, and exit the room, then turn right, you'll enter the bedroom, again turn right, in front you'll find glass door, two steps away from the glass door you'll find your destination.

18148.instruction: You are facing towards a wall with a portrait on it, turn to your right and you can see an open door, move forward passing through the door. Turn right and there is another open door, enter the bedroom through the door. Now turn to your right and you can see a mirror, move forward towards the mirror. You are now standing facing towards a mirror and on your right side you have another open door and this is your destination.

18166.instruction: You are facing towards a sofa chair, turn around, walk towards the wall, turn left, walk straight in the corridor till you reach towards a portrait on a wall, turn right, walk in the corridor till you reach towards a window, turn left, step into the arch, continue walking straight and step into another arch, slightly turn left, walk towards the left side of the bath tub till you reach towards a wall. You are now facing towards a wall with a glass window on your left and a shower room on your right. You have reached your destination.

18167.instruction: Right now, you're facing towards the couch. Turn behind and move towards the wall. Now, slightly turn left and move forward until you reach a table in front of you. Now, turn right and continue to move forward until you reach a window in front of you. Now, turn left and move forward towards the bath tub which is in front of you. Now, slightly turn left and move forward until you reach a wall in front of you and that is the end point.

18187.instruction: You're facing the cup boards, turn towards your left, go straight near the door, exit the room, and go few steps forward, then turn right, go straight till the wall, then turn left, you'll find stairs, climb the stairs, then turn left, you'll find glass windows to the right, again turn left, to the left you'll find brown table, and flower pot on the table, go straight along the table, at the end you'll find white lamp,  between lamp, and cream sofa you'll find your destination.

18188.instruction: There are closets in front of you, turn to your left side and go straight, in front of you there is an open door, exit the door. Turn to your right side and go straight till the end. Turn to your left side there is a staircase in front of you, go up the stairs, turn to your left side, go straight, there is a wooden stool beside you, turn to your left side, there is a staircase in front of you, go up the stairs completely and move forward. Take left and go straight, turn to your left side and go straight, there are sofas in front of you, go straight till the end. There is a white color lamp in front of you, stop there in front of the lamp, this is your final destination.

18274.instruction: Right now you're facing towards a mirror. Now turn left and exit the room. You can see an open door in front of you, move towards the door. There are two frames on the wall in front of you, move towards the frames and turn right. There are portraits on the wall to your right and an open entrance in front of you, move towards the entrance and pass through it. Now turn right, you can see a cupboard in front of you, move towards the cupboard and turn left. There is an open door in front of you, move towards the door and enter in to the room. You can see a portrait on the wall in front of you, move towards the portrait and stand in front of it and it is your end point.

18275.instruction: You are in front of the wash basin. On your right, you will find an arch which is the entrance of the another room. Go straight through the arch, you will find another door opened. Pass through that door, take right from the corner. Go straight, you will find photo frames on your right side. Move forward from the wall which has two photo frames on your both sides and take right from there. Move forward, you will find two doors on your both sides. Move forward through the ironing table. Take left from the corner. You will find a door to the entrance of the room. Go straight, pass through the black table and a photo frame. Move forward, you will find a door on your left.
