Now turn left and stand in front of the closed window which is near to the entrance which is the endpoint.

21795.instruction: You are standing near the open arch facing towards the door. Turn left you can see a staircase, climb the staircase completely. Now you are standing near the flower vase. Keep moving forward. Turn slight right and move towards the pot. Turn right and move ahead. Slightly turn left and move towards the mirror which is on to your right. Now turn left and move towards the open door which is at your left. Now move out of this room. You are standing  near the window and facing towards the wall. The position you are standing is your final destination.

21796.instruction: You're facing towards the room which is on you are left side, slightly turn your head straight. Then you can see stairs, climb the stairs, walk ahead, then you can see a staircase on your left side, climb two stairs, immediately get down the stairs. you can see a passage straight to you, move into that passage. There you can see a brown door move towards the brown door, after moving towards the brown door, you can see an open entrance, enter into that open entrance. There you can see a two sofas, move towards the sofa which is on your left side and stand between tea poi and sofa. That is your end point.

21797.instruction: Turn left from the place where you're standing and exit the room. From here, turn left and you will come across a small staircase. Walk all the way up through the stairs. Now, slightly turn left and you can see an another staircase. Walk towards that staircase. Now, turn right and get down the stairs. Walk towards the closed door which is in front of you. From here, slightly turn right and move towards the couch, which has two cushions on it and that is the end point.

21893.instruction: From the dining table, you wanna head to the right to exit the room. Once you're on the tile floor, you wanna make a left. You'll continue past the ovens on your right side, you'll also see a fireplace on your left. Keep going through the double doors. You'll go into the next sort of living room between the couches and the small table in the middle. Once you make it to the dining with a flower a white table mat, at the bottom of that table is your stop.

21975.instruction: Our starting point is in a dining room, and we're facing towards a set of glass windows, turn around, on your left there's a dining table, walk pass the dining table and turn towards left, on your right there's a shelf with decorations, and next to the shelf there's a wooden chair, walk towards the front side of the chair, walk towards the space between the tall lamp and the dresser, one you reach the living room, turn towards the right, and walk towards the top of the staircase that's on the right, on the left there are three sets of glass windows, once you reach the top of the stairs, walk towards what appears to be a lottery machine on the left, and that's your destination.

22047.instruction: Do a 180 from your starting position. Take one step inside this walk in closet and you're done.

22068.instruction: You are facing towards a drawer, turn right and exit the room through the door, slightly turn left and walk towards the chair opposite to you, you are now facing towards the chair. You have reached your destination.

22069.instruction: You are inside the room where there is a bed, a rack and a table lamp on to your left side. Take a slight right, you will find a walk way to step out of the room. Walk through the walk way you will find yourself in a room where there is a white color cupboard onto your right side and a table which has books on it. Take few steps a brown color sofa, which has two cushions on it. You have reached your destination.

22112.instruction: You are standing in a lawn area, facing towards a steel compound wall, turn left, walk straight. In-front of you you can see a single step, climb the step and walk straight, You have another single step, climb the step and walk straight, to the left you have an close window, walk straight passing through the close window. Now to the left you have an another close window, stop at the second close window, that's your end point.

22113.instruction: You are outside facing wall. Turn left. Move forward. Move forward. Go on to the steps. Move forward. Move forward. You have reached your destination.

22196.instruction: Move forward from your [place and slightly move to your left, you can see a lamp, now take right from there, you can see a staircase, get down the stairs, after reaching the last step, slightly move to the right, you can see an open door, enter into the room and stop, that's your end point.

22197.instruction: Slide right, move straight beside the rack, move towards the brown wooden table, walk towards the wooden floor near the steps, walk down the stairs, slide right, move towards the white door and enter the bathroom.

22295.instruction: Turn around and move forward, and enter into the hall.After entering into the hall, take right and move forward near to the dining table, and end near the dining table.

22296.instruction: You are standing in a room, facing towards the door, slightly turn left, in-front of you there is a open door, walk through the open door and exit the room, slightly turn left, in-front of you there is a open entrance, walk through the entrance and exit the room, turn left, in-front of you there is another open entrance, walk through the entrance and enter the room, turn right, walk straight, in-front of you you can see a potted plant, walk to the plant and stand in-front of it, to the left you have a round table with four chairs around it, that is your end point.

22300.instruction: You're standing in a room with a brick floor, walk to the staircase on your left. And go up these stairs all the way to the top to the second floor. And then at the top take two steps to your left. And you'll be next to a lamp, look to the right and you'll see a white shelf in the next room to the right, take a step towards it. And then you'll see some windows in the back, walk towards these windows. And then turn left into this open door in front of you and go up these stairs. And stop when you're about three quarters of the way up and you've reached the end.

22323.instruction: "Now you are facing towards cupboard, turn right, go straight, you can see fencing towards your straight, turn right, you can see another room, enter inside it and walk two steps on the carpet, your destiny has been arrived."

22324.instruction: You are facing towards the wall, which is a wooden wall. Turn slightly right and move forward. To your right there is open door, enter through the open door. You are now facing towards the open door and to your right there are two chairs, and this is your endpoint.

22408.instruction: You will begin facing a window in a bathroom, turn to your left, let me just tell you this one is going to be just one step, turn to your left, you will see an open door, take one step out of the open door, and you're done, you should be standing in a closet right in front of the doorway to the bathroom.

22443.instruction: Right now you can see a thin pillar in front of you. Turn towards you're right side and you can see a large window in front of you. Move towards that window and take a right turn and you will be entering into the kitchen area. Now you can kind a stove on the right side and a dinning table on the left side. Move little forward and walk behind the dinning table. Now you can see a chair in front of you and a crockery set from there take a left turn and move forward and now you're in a living area, In front of you, you can see a large cupboard, move towards that cupboard. Move till the end where you can find a opened door. Enter into that and now you can see a staircase, walk all the upwards through the staircase. Now you can find a television in front of you. Turn around and you can find a brown couch slightly towards you're right side and in front of you, you can see a bench with two chairs. Move towards that bench and two chairs and on the left side you can see a large a painting and on the  right side you can see a chess board bench, move little forward and now you can see a idol in front of you stand in front of that idol and that is the end point.

22444.instruction: Now you are standing beside cream couch, slightly move towards your right walk and walk forward till the end of the glass door now take left move forward you can see a brown dining table with a chairs around it to you left side and a kitchen stove to your right side, walk between that and take left, walk behind the dining table, move forward, now take left at the ed of the dining table, move forward, you can see a white rack with some glass metals placed on it to your right side, move forward and take right, walk forward,you can see a grey cabinet to your right side and one chair to you left side, walk forward, you can see a open wooden door to your left side, enter into it,you can see staircase, climb the staircase and take left, you can see a wooden table with shoes and helmet on it to your left side, walk forward and stop near metal statue n front of you that's your end point.

22458.instruction: Your are facing towards the door which is locked, turn to your right side. You will see a sofa, chairs and a staircase and a dog move forward.

22459.instruction: Turn right from the place where you're standing and move forward. Here, on the right side you can see a staircase and on the left side you can see a close door. Move forward till you reach a dining table on the right side and a window in front of you and that is the end point.

22482.instruction: From the room, you wanna take the exit in front of you. This will bring you to a hallway. You're gonna go straight ahead just to the left of a potted plant on the right is gonna be your stop.

22518.instruction: We start off facing a bed. Turn around. Take a step on through the doorway on the white carpet. Take a step into the center open doorway where there's a glass door. That's a shower. Um Turn to your right. Now take the open doorway where you can see a toilet. And stop there you are done.

22526.instruction: We're facing towards a double door, turn towards the right... We're now in front of a staircase, walk up the stairs... Walk all the way up the stairs, once you land, you'll come across a console table, above the console table there's a mirror, walk towards the left side of that table, turn around, on your right there's an entrance to a room, and on your left there's another entrance. Walk towards that entrance that's on your left... We're now inside a bedroom, on your right there's a chair, and on the left there's a bedroom covered with some white and beige sheets, in front of the bed there's a white rug, walk towards the foot of the chair that's on the right... You'll be facing towards a double window, next to the window there's a painting of a lady dressed in a red dress, turn towards the right... We're now facing towards a small hallway, on the right there's a bathroom and on the left there are two windows and below there's a console table with two sculptures, you'll be facing towards the entrance to what appears to be a closet and that's your destination.

22637.instruction: Turn right and move little forward, now slide right towards the staircase, now walk up the steps, now slide left and walk straight along the path, now slide right and walk straight towards the potted plant, now again slide right and walk straight towards the open entrance and enter into the room, now walk straight towards the grey color chair, now slide little left and walk straight between the grey color chairs towards the bed, now slide right and walk straight along the path between the bed and the open door, now walk straight towards the open entrance, now slide little right and walk straight towards the open door which is towards the right, enter into the room and move straight towards the brown color cupboard where there is a hat placed on it and you have reached your destination.

22638.instruction: Now you are facing to the wall.Turn slightly right and move forward,on your right there is a stair case take the stairs case and climb up and turn left,pass through the railing till you reach red vessel,on your right their is an open entrance move forward,if you look forward there is a couch,move towards the couch and turn slightly left,you can see a open door move towards the open door,now  you are facing the bed in your right and the open door on your left,if you look forward there is an open entrance move towards it and turn slightly right, there is a open door enter into the room which you can see a white mat and stand in front of a small cupboard and stop.

22671.instruction: You are facing towards the bed , turn right and move towards the bed. Turn right and move out of this room. You are facing towards the open door, turn right and move forward. You can see an open door to your left and to your right. Now turn right you can see washing machines, move into that room. Now you are standing in a room and there are 2 washing machines in it. The position you are standing is your final destination

22672.instruction: You are standing facing towards the bed. Slightly turn right. Walk  a few steps ahead. Exit the bedroom through the open brown door in front of you. Walk few steps ahead and turn right. Walk few steps ahead. Turn right again. You are now standing facing towards the brown cupboards and two washing machines in a room. Enter inside the room and stand in front of the brown cupboards. You have reached your point.

22707.instruction: Begin facing the wall and  light switch. Turn left and head to the rug by the bed. From here head to the arched doorway on in front of you and you're done.

22785.instruction: At the point, go forward towards the landline, slightly turn right to enter the arch, turn right pass through the sink on the right side, turn left pass through the stove on the left side and take a right enter the arch. Go straight, enter into the left side arch now you can see a staircase, go and stop at the fourth step of the staircase. This is the endpoint.

22786.instruction: Go staright crossing the chair towards the wall, Go to the wall, Go left side on the platform, Go straight, Go staright near the wall, Go straight and turn right towards the steps.Stop here.

23033.instruction: "Okay now, you can see the books on the left side. Move forward, and exit the room, you can see the dining table in front of you. Now turn left, and move forward, you can see the open door on the left side. Now enter into that room, you can see the stair case in front of you. Now go near to that stair case, and turn around, you can see the another room in front of you. Now enter into that room. Now you can see the closed door in front of you. Turn left and move forward, you can see the carton boxes in front of you. Now, you have reached your destination."

23034.instruction: "Now you are facing towards the door, exit the door and walk forward, you can see dining table, turn left from it, there you can see another white door, exit the door, walk near the stairs, then after turn right, you can see a room, walk inside it, there you can find a table, go and stand in between the table and window your destiny has been reached."

23112.instruction: You begin in a dining area, turn around and go through the doorway, into the kitchen and then keep the kitchen island to your left and go to your right, ignore the pantry and then go through the very big opening on your right, you will see a staircase to the left, ignore it, continue going to the front foyer on the right, once you see the main entrance with a white rug, take 2 steps to go in front of the main entrance and you're done.

23113.instruction: You begin looking over a velvet rope at an immaculate room. And a green table most particularly. Turn to your left and follow the red carpet. All the way down. Continue following the red carpet as it curves left, and as soon as you get through the first wooden doors after that curve, you're done.

23173.instruction: You are facing the railing, turn right, walk straight. Exit the room through the open door and walk straight on the red carpet. There is another open door right in the front. Walk towards it and stop. You are at the entrance, facing the frames. This is the end point.

23174.instruction: From the place you are standing turn slightly right, and keep moving in a forward direction along the path. Go and stand near the last entrance door you have reached your destination point.

23208.instruction: Now you are facing towards the bed, turn slightly left and move straight, from there take left turn and move out through the open door. Here you can see two frames opposite to you, now turn right and go little steps till you find piano on your right side and glass window on your left side and on the left side of the piano is your final destination.

23209.instruction: Slide left towards the open entrance beside the t.v, now walk straight towards the open entrance, now slide left and walk straight towards the open door and exit the room, now slide right and walk straight along the path and stop near the path between the glass door and the chocolate color stool and table you have reached your destination.

23375.instruction: You begin facing a chair with a leg piece, turn around completely and take a step towards that same chair that's on the other side, then take a step onto the tile flooring towards the gray cabinet, and then turn slightly more to your right, and walk past the pillar and the glass doors, the wooden doors with glass panels in them, take 2 steps towards the railing of the staircase, and then take a step towards the kitchen area behind the dining table, keeping the dining table to your right, take 2 steps forward, stand in front of the oven, turn to your right, take 5 steps forward, passing some chairs on your right, and some wooden doors with glass panels in them on your left, you will stop right in front of the pool table, you are done.

23404.instruction: You are facing a walkway into a kitchen.  You are going to turn to your right and you are going to move forward down this hallway.  You will go thru an archway and once thru the archway you are going to make a left and you are going to go down these steps in front of you.  You are going to take the steps down and once at the bottom of the steps facing a large vase in the corner you are going to turn to your right and move forward towards the open wood door. Once near the open wood door you will make a left entering a garage.  You are going to move forward across this garage passing some cabinets on your left and heading towards the closed garage door.  And then you will stop and you will be facing the garage door and on your left will be the grey cabinets with 2 blue coolers on top of them against the wall and you are done.

23411.instruction: You will begin in a vintage styled dinning room. You will need to exit this dining room by moving forward to your left passing  dinning table to your right and the study desk to your right and the study desk to your left. You will see an open doorway go through that doorway and into the hall turning right and move forward up the stairs. Once you are at the top of the stairs  you will see an open doorway move forward straight through that doorway. once you are there you will enter into a washroom. Straight ahead you will see a black radiator or heater. Move forward and stand in front of that radiator. Once you have done that you have reached your end point.

23562.instruction: You are in a washroom facing the commode, turn right and exit the washroom. Right beside the pillar is your destination.

23563.instruction: You are in the washroom right now, turn right and exit the washroom, now you are facing towards the potted plant, that would be your end point.

23572.instruction: you begin by look at an empty closet organizer if you turn all the way around, you should see a white carpet in the middle of an even bigger closet area. step onto the white carpet, turn to the right. you should see 3 doors. one that is leading to a shower area with a bathtub, one that is open but you cant see inside and one that is closed. go into the one that is slightly open that you can't see inside. and you are done

23577.instruction: You are facing towards the portraits right now, turn to your left, you can find an opened door, go near the opened door, stand at the entrance, that would be your end point.

23578.instruction: Right now you are facing two portraits on the wall, now turn back, and move forward, you will find two open doors, now go straight, that will be your final destination.

23583.instruction: you start staring at a old wooden stand, if you turn to the right you see a pathway leading out of the old stand area that you are in. head to the very end of that pathway. once you are up against the wall by the last chair to your right. if you turn to the left you see a way to get onto the stone flooring in front of you. step onto the stone flooring. if you turn your body to the right you should be right next to a stone doorway. in front of you there is a stone table. you are going to want to take a left, head to the left of that stone table once you are on the left of that stone table, it is to your right. if you look to the left you will see a stone carving of what looks like two doors. once with a tree on it. if you are in between those stone cravings and that stone table you are done.

23648.instruction: Okay now you are in the washroom facing towards the mirror and sink. Turn behind, you will have an open door. Exit the washroom through the open door and to your left there is a room with bed in front of you. Go near the bed, now you will be on the white mat. Turn to your left and exit the bedroom through an open door which is in front of you. Continue going straight until you reach an open door on the left. Enter through the open door you will be in the bedroom. Go straight to the bottom of the bed, then take a sharp left you will have a room with narrow open and white shelves in it. Enter the room and that is the end point.

23649.instruction: You are near the sink and make a back turn near the door and go straight you will just entered into a bed room and go straight near the bed from bed take a left turn to exit the bedroom door go straight near the corridor area from their you will just entered into a room get into the room go straight near the bed and from their make a left turn their  will be a open door in an empty room,here the destination in an empty room.

23719.instruction: You are facing a sink.  You are going to turn to your right and go out the door. And go to your right down this hallway.  Continue down the hallway and it will open up into a circular room with a clock in front of you.  You are going to go to your left.  And you have now entered a bedroom.  You are going to walk straight thru the bedroom moving forward with the patterned curtains on your left and go into the open closet in front of you. And once you have just stepped into the threshold of this closet you are done.

23731.instruction: We're facing towards a wall with some decoration on, on the right there's a table with a plant, and behind the plant there's a mirror and there's a bedroom right next to it... Turn around... You're now facing towards another bedroom... Step into it... On your right there's a chair and in front of the chair there's a small table, on the left there's a bed... Walk towards that table that's in front of the chair... You're now facing towards a window... Turn towards the right and enter the hallway that's in front of you... On the left there's a window and below there's a table with some miniatures on to, and that's on the left, and on the right there's a bathroom... Walk towards the closet that's right in front of you... You'll be facing towards a small window... On the left there's a shelf, rather, many shelves and on the right there are also shelves too, and you'll be standing right in front of this room.

23745.instruction: You are on some stairs.  You are going to continue down these stairs.  Then you will make a left at the first walkway.  You will enter this room and there will be a table with 2 chairs in the middle on your right and you will see a fireplace slightly to your left and there will be a lamp in the corner.  You are going to go towards that lamp.  And once you are on the rug facing the lamp and the fireplace slightly to your right you are done.

23779.instruction: We're going to start by looking at some paintings and a white sofa. We're going to turn out heads slightly to the right, and see a clock. Let's walk towards the clock. As we're now standing in front of the clock, let's turn our heads slightly to the right, and walk towards the small pathway between the kitchen and the living room. Now, as we're standing between the living room and the kitchen area, we're going to walk to the large cabinets that are in the corner of the room below some paintings. As we're standing in front of it, we're going to turn our heads to the right, all the way, and we're going to walk towards the small chair with some cushions that's in front of us. We should now be standing in the living room in front of the mat. We're going to turn to the right and walk towards the middle of the entire room: the kitchen, the living room, and the dining area. This will be our destination.

23808.instruction: You are facing a wood door.  You are going to turn to your left and head down the pink runner rug.  Continue down the rug as it curves and you are going to go thru some double doors.  Continue moving forward down the pink rug.  And you will pass another walk way with double doors.  There will be a picture on each side of the door of a woman.  And once you have continued forward you are going to stop on the pink runner rug right under neath the chandelier hanging from the ceiling and you are done.

23809.instruction: Now you are standing in a room where towards your right there is a black chair. Walk straight towards the pillar, walk straight until you see a couch. Now you are standing beside a lamp and a window. The destination is reached.

23810.instruction: You are facing towards a glass window, turn around and go straight towards the sofa which is on the carpet, and go straight up to a floor lamp near the radiator which is on the left side. This is the endpoint.

23886.instruction: You are facing towards the wall. Turn slightly left and walk straight through the path until you are facing towards the grass. Turn slightly right and walk straight through the path until there are stairs to right. Climb up the stairs and move towards the open glass door. Enter through that open glass door, you are now facing towards the couch, move forward. Now move towards the steps which are in front of you, to your right there is a fridge, and this is your endpoint.

23887.instruction: Now you are in the outer space. Turn slightly left and walk straight in between the walls. Now take right and walk in between the wall and the lawn. Now turn right and walk all along the steps towards the living area. Now turn left and walk straight a bit far, then take right and enter into the living area. Now move straight in between the couch and the TV towards the kitchen. Now go and stand near to the bottom of the staircase and the refrigerator and near to the wall which is the endpoint.

23903.instruction: Okay, now you are in the washroom with a bathtub in front of you. Now turn behind go straight towards the open door, which is on the left side. Now you are standing at the entrance of the washroom, turn to your left and exit the washroom. Now you are standing next to a staircase, which is on the left side and this is the end point.

23904.instruction: Now you are facing towards the bathtub, turn around and move towards the open door. Now turn left and move out of this room. Now you are standing near the statue, the position you are standing is your final destination.

23941.instruction: You are facing towards a glass window, turn slightly right and move forward. Now turn slightly right and you can see an open door, move towards the door. Turn slightly left and exit through the door. Now turn slightly right and you can see a staircase, get down the steps and pass through the open door right in front of you, move forward. Now turn slightly right and you can see another open door, enter into it. You are now facing towards a wall and this is your destination.

23942.instruction: You're facing the window, turn towards your right, go few steps forward, then turn right, go near the door, and exit the room, then turn right, you'll find stairs, get down the stairs, you'll enter the balcony, near the pillar, turn right, you're in a washroom, which is your final destination.

23949.instruction: Turn to your right. Jump over the treadmill into the hallway under the chandelier. Turn slightly left. Walk forward to the back of the couch where the design comes down where the area rug is. Turn left. Take one step forward. Turn right at the back of the couch. So that you are walking along the other side of the couch with the table behind it. On the left you see an open doorway. Turn left. Take one step down that tile hallway. Turn left again. Take a step into the kitchen, you're going to step towards the stove. Step down that walkway between the stove and the island. Continue straight past the fridge through the doorway. Keep going straight. You will end up in front of a wood table that has a bunch of kitchen gadgets on it. Turn left. You are going to take one step towards the corner of the kitchen, wood kitchen table with all the gadgets on it closest to the calendar and that's where you end.

23958.instruction: We are facing a white bed. Turn to the left so that we can exit the bedroom going down the hall. As you get to the end (midway) part of the hall, there will be a picture in the middle of the two halls and a black desk underneath, you want to go to the right an enter into the open dark brown door. Now you are in that room and it is full of wood with a light on top. You want to walk straight all the way to the first set of double doors to the far right corner, stopping in front of the first set of double doors ahead of you. There are four doors in the room and you want to stop in front of the set that is closest to you by the corner of the room. You are at your destination.

24025.instruction: You're facing the pillar, turn towards your left, and go straight, you'll enter in to kitchen, go till the end, and turn left, go straight, you'll find brown color chair, from there turn left, and go straight till the end, turn left, and enter the room, you'll find stairs, climb the stairs, then turn left, go straight till the end, you'll find wooden roof on the top, at the center you'll find your destination.

24026.instruction: Now you are in the living area, turnaround and move straight. Now you are in the dining room. Now take left and walk in between the cabinet and the dining table. Now take left and walk straight in between the closed door and the couch. Now you are in a living area, take left and exit the room. Now walk all along the staircase. Now take left and walk straight in the living area. Now stand in front of the closed window which is the endpoint.

24066.instruction: Right now you're in a room facing a door, now move towards the door and exit the door. Now take a right turn and stand on the carpet and move along the carpet. Now you will be entering into a dinning hall. Now move towards the dinning table and stand backside of it. Now slightly take a right turn and move towards the door and it will be your end point.

24067.instruction: Enter into the room which is infront of you, turn right and move forward, to the right you can find a big portrait and to the left you can find portraits, move forward, enter into the opened door which is infront of you, you can find a dining table to your right and an opened door infront of you, stand infront of the opened door, where to the right there are four chairs, that would be your end point.

24131.instruction: Right now you're facing towards a curtain. Now turn behind, there is a cabinet in front of you, move towards the cabinet and turn left. Now exit the room through the arch which is in front of you and slightly turn right. There are chairs in front of you, move towards the chairs and cross the chairs. You can see two arches in front of you, move towards the arch which is to your right and turn right. Now move a bit forward in the walkway up to the arch which is to your left and turn left. Move in to the arch, now you are facing towards a chair. Now slightly turn left, there are two lamp stands in front of you, move towards the lamp stand which is to your left and stand in front of it and it is your end point.

24132.instruction: You're standing near the window, facing towards the curtain and the potted plant. Turn behind and walk into the open arch, which is in front of you. You're in the passage, walk through the passage. At the end of the passage, turn right and walk a step forward. Now turn left and walk into the wide open arch. Go stand at the left corner near the lamp. This would be your end point.

24261.instruction: you start by looking out of a window into a very nature like scene there is trees and ferns and all that. if you turn right you see an antelope head on the ground. you are going to walk past that antelope head to the room with a couch. once you are in the room with the couch you are going to turn to the left  until you see a door that open. exit the room through that door. you should now see multiple doors one directly in front of you leading into a room with green paint, the one next to that leading to a second section of that room. you are going to head to the second door on your left. once you can see inside of the room clearly walk into the room onto the carpet. in this room on your right there is a fireplace with a large painting on it. walk up to that fireplace and once you are there you are done.

24314.instruction:
We start in the lounge area of a cabin in front of a fireplace.
Immediately on our left, we see a small study desk with a wooden/glass cabinet. 
We walk towards it and make a right towards the stairs that lead to the basement. 
We go down the stairs and there will be a small window on the left with three figures on the sill, almost at the bottom of the stairs. 
Then we will find ourselves into a plain area with an entry table on the left and a couch with three pillows directly in front of us.
Then we will steer right towards a restroom, there's a toilet on the right and a sink on the left with pictures hanging right in front of us.
We will stop right here.

24385.instruction:
you can see a door turn around,you can see a bathtub in your front, move forward..turn around to your left ..you can see a passage move forward...go through the passage..right
to the wall, you can three photo frames of  a boy.go the left ..left side ..there you can see a bedroom....and in the bedroom ,move forward...you can see a large window,where you can see the scenery of the outside area and right beside it you can see a couch.

24386.instruction: Right now you are standing at the entrance of the room. Just go straight near to the bath tub and make a slight left turn in front you can see a open arch and go near to the open arch and make a slight left turn. In front you can see a open entrance just get into the open entrance and go closer near to the wooden table. Here we reached our destination near the wooden table.

24395.instruction: You're facing a door turn to the right and take a step out to the left of the wall. And walk forward past the chair that you see at the end of the room that's by a brown door. And once you're standing in front of the chair turn around and walk towards this brown towards the corner of it turn right and walk to the corner of this room so you're to the right of these windows. And once you're in the corner you're done.

24458.instruction: You are facing towards the open door move towards the open door, now turn to your left and enter into the room through the open door, now you are facing towards the cabinets on your slight left, now turn to your right and move forward now slightly take right, and move towards the brown closed door it is your end point.

24459.instruction: You can find an opened door infront of you, go near the opened door, turn left and move a bit forward, turn right and move a bit forward, turn right, you can find a door infront of you, stand infront of the door, that would be your end point.

24535.instruction: You are facing towards the open door and the chair. Move towards the chair. Slightly turn left and walk through the open door. Now you are facing towards the wall which has photo frames mounted to it. Slightly turn left and move towards the white cabinet near the wall. Again slightly turn left and move towards the open room. Now you are at the entrance of a kitchen. Walk straightly towards the chair which has a small round basket on it. Turn right and walk through the open door. Now you are at the entrance of a room. That will be the end point.

24536.instruction: Right now you are facing towards a open door. Just go closer to the open door and step out the room and move straight in front you can see a open door and just get into the open door on you are left side you can see a  round table with chairs and move straight and make a  slight right turn. In front you can see a open door just entered into that room. Here we reached our destination near the entrance of the room.

24586.instruction: Right now you are standing in front of the dining table. Now turn right and keep moving forward. Right now you are in front of the chair. Now turn left and keep moving forward. On the left side you will find lamp. Now slightly turn right and go straight. Now again slightly turn right and go straight. You will find stair case. Now walk all the way down through the stairs. Now slightly turn right and go straight. You will find an open door on the right side. Now enter into the open door. That will be your final destination.

24587.instruction: Right now you're facing towards a dining table. Now slightly turn right and move to the other end of the dining table. Now you are facing towards a chair. Now turn left and move towards the chair which is beside the cupboard. There is a lamp stand in front of you, move towards the lamp and slightly turn right and move a bit forward. Now again turn right, you can see a staircase in front of you, move towards the staircase and get down the stairs. Now slightly turn right, there is an open door in front of you, move towards the door and enter in to the room and it is your end point.

24647.instruction: We are going to start facing an open door with two windows. We are inside a bedroom. We are going to take that door that we should see in front, walking towards the towel, white towel, that we can see inside that room. This is a restroom. Just take one more step towards the white towel. Now, we should be facing the toilet, and we are done.

24700.instruction: You are standing near a kitchen, turn on your left and proceed forward towards the carpet, once you are near the carpet turn left through the opening on your right. Once you are inside a bedroom which has black sheets and green throw on it, proceed towards the night stand near the window and you are done.

24712.instruction: You begin facing a couch, hop over the couch towards the door in front of you, exit through that door, and go into the room that's right in front of you, look to the left, you will see a very tall lamp in the corner of the room, next to the fireplace and the radiator, go towards that lamp and you're done.

24730.instruction: You are standing on stairs, go downstairs, when you reach the floor you should see their is a table and two chairs and on your right their is a chair in front of you, and a hall way straight ahead, proceed straight ahead staying in between the closet on your left and the sitting area on your right, proceed straight ahead, crossing the two art pieces and the doors on your left and on your right their is another sitting area proceed straight crossing the lamp and the console on your right and some pillars on your left, once you are standing near the chair and in front of you their is a kitchen and behind you their is a trolley with some alcohol bottles in it, turn around from it, now the trolley should be on your back and straight ahead their should be stairs, go down the stairs and once you are on the floor and on floor their is a rug on the floor and take a step on the carpet, on your right their is a desk with a table lamp and flag on the wall on your left their will be a open white door, and in the middle their is are two closed door with a shelf on left with some flyers and paper work,once you are standing inside this area, you are done.

24745.instruction: You begin facing a door, turn to your left, take one step forward and then turn to your left again, take one step into the toilet room in front of you, and then look to your right again, and just take one last step onto the white fluffy rug, you are done.

24842.instruction: You are facing towards the metal railing. Turn right and move forward, you are now facing towards the plant. Turn slightly left and move forward to the circular mat. Get down through the stair case which are in front of you. At the first step of the staircase, turn slightly left and move towards the wall which is in front of you. Turn slightly left and move forward, wherein there is a photo frame to your left and also the flower plant. Enter into open straight room which in front of you, move towards the dining table. Turn around and move forward, to your right there are couch and a flower plant on the table. Move to the fire place and stop at the table which has a flower vase on it, and this is your end point.

24843.instruction: Turn around from the railing to the right,you will find the small space which will lead you down to the stairs,following that stairs towards down,take left you will find a way entrance to the living room where you find dinning table with some chairs and on the right you will find sofas and moving further from there,there is a window at the corner where you can see some trees outside from that window.

24878.instruction: Okay, now you are facing towards the window. Turn behind and walk straight passing the fire place on the right side, until you reach the white chair, which is on the right. Now slightly turn to your left and move straight towards the arch shape entrance in front of you. Now slightly turn your right and move towards the narrow entrance in front of you. Now walk all the way straight passing through the narrow entrances in front of you, until you reach in front of a small window, which is on the wall. Now slightly turn to your left and move forward. Now slightly turn to your left, in front of you there is a washroom, move forward and stand at the entrance of the washroom. Now slightly move forward and enter the washroom. Now you are standing in front of the sink and this is the end point.

24879.instruction: Now you are standing facing towards the windows, turn behind and you can see a sofa, a teapoy in front of you. Start walking in between the white couch and the sofa. Walk straight and enter into the kitchen.After you enter the kitchen door take a right turn and there is a other door start walking into that door and you will come across the another door, walk straight passing all the doors till you reach the end. You can see a wall with a small window from there take a left turn and you can see a walk way. After taking left take a another left there is a wash room enter into that and stand in front of the mirror and that is the end point.

24966.instruction: Right now you're facing towards a table. Now slightly turn right, there are two open doors in front of you, move towards the open door which is beside the table. Now turn left, there is an open door in front of you, move towards the open door and enter in to the room. Now turn right, step out of the room and move towards the staircase which is in front of you, climb up the stairs, there is an open door in front of you, move towards the door and enter in to the room. There is an entrance to your right, move towards the entrance and turn right. Now enter in to the shower room and stand in the middle of the shower room and it is your end point.

25026.instruction: You begin looking at a brown door standing next to  what looks to be an indoor barbecue grill. Turn to your left and step towards the greyish or beige chair next to the fireplace close to you, then turn left again and walk through the set of  open double doors. Now if you just look slightly to the right you're going to see two sofas arranged in front of a fireplace. Walk to the far right corner of the sofa that is right in front of you and then you're going to hop over the sofa through the archway that you can see just behind them. You'll be standing in a small room with a circular table with four chairs around it. Move to the left and walk through the open set of double doors. Now continue down this pathway and keep along the right side of the room passing the brown table on the left and make your way into the living room. Now walk up behind the sofa, standing next to the glass topped table and then what you wanna do is walk over to the brownish almost armchair-looking chair and stand next to the set of double doors and you are done.

25068.instruction: Begin in an outdoor patio area. Turn right and head to the opposite side of the door. Then head to the tall white table. from here turn towards the house and enter the family room. Head past the family room between the tv and the rug. Head down the long narrow hallway until you reach a set of stairs. Stop at the base of the stairs.

25069.instruction: Facing so the bed is on your left and the paintings of the Eiffel Tower and New York City are on your right, walk out the door straight ahead. You will be into a hallway with two doors directly in front of you, take the door to the right. Walking past the study area on the right. Once you're in bed, with a blue comforter, a yellow blanket on it, a picture just above and a small number 5 decoration on the dresser to the right of the bed. Walk to the near corner of the foot of the bed. Once you're there, you're done.

25098.instruction: You begin facing a staircase, and a lamp, turn to your right, you will see a gray cabinet to your right, take 3 steps going forward and moving past that cabinet, you will see a door come up in front of you, to the left of the windows, go through this door, it will be a staircase going up, go up the stairs, once you get to the top of the stairs, turn to your left and you will see, 2, you will see 3 couches, surrounding a coffee table, take a step towards the couch that's on the very left, once you're facing this couch, it will have a red pillow on it, you are done.

25138.instruction: You are facing a book shelf, turn left and exit the room. Turn left, walk straight and take the immediate left. Walk straight, you have a mirror and a flower vase in the right. Slightly turn left and walk straight and enter into the entrance which is in the left. Now walk straight, pass through the curtains which is in the right. Now you are in the bedroom. Stand on the carpet. To the right you have a window and curtains and to the left you have the bed. This is the end point.

25139.instruction: You are facing towards a shelf, turn around and exit this room, turn left and go one step forward, turn left and go forward, slightly turn left and go forward towards the first arch from the left, go forward passing through the opened brown door, go forward until you reach the carpet beside the bed, here just beside the bed you have reached the destination.

25247.instruction: You are standing on some stairs. You want to move up and left on the stairs. Now you will be on a landing that is circular and you want to go around the white carpet and to the first room on your right, which is a hallway. Step onto the carpet and continue going straight. You will see a white planter with a shapely plant in it. Walk to the right of that planter and veer right going into the opening between the two red vases. Continue walking straight in that hall into the room with the blue chair. Before you reach the blue chair, take a left. Now you will be standing in front of a white fireplace. You will be standing in between a little brown ottoman on your right and the the white fireplace. You have reached your destination.

25384.instruction: You are stainding in a living room.  You are right next to 2 chairs and if you look out in front of you there  are a bunch of wood window panes,you can see outside , go towards straight to those windows.  Once you are in front of those windows you will make a left.  You will enter a kitchen area.  To the right will be a stove and more windows.  In the middle of the rooom with be a large woooden table with chairs.  Go in between the table and the stove.  You are going to make a left.  You will be in between the table and wall with lots of drawers and cabinets on it.  You will continue walking in between the table and wall with the doors and cabinets.  In front of you will be a chair and a shelves with lots of knickknacks on it.  You are going to make a left and go in between the table and shelf with all the knickknacks on it.  To your right will be a wooden column.  You are going to go past that.  To your right will be more windows.  To your left a large seating area with lots of chairs.  You are going to continue walking straight.  On your left will be a room with a fire place, a glass table and more cahirs.  To your right will be a desk with 2 chairs, a window in front of you.  There is going to be  a wood door that is open.  You are going to enter that door and in front of you will be wood stairs.  Go up the stairs.  Once you go up the stairs you will enter a seating area with a large rug, you are going to make a left. To the left of you is a wooden cabinet with football helmets sitting on top.  To your right is snall desk with a checkeerboard, a rug and a chair and a lookout.  You are going to go in between those 2. And you will walk into an open area with a wood floor. There will be a couple of windows to your left anbd a small rocker in the corner.  To your right will be a lookout.  You have reached your destination.

25402.instruction: you begin facing a dining area, turn to your left and go towards the refrigerator, and then go up the steps next to the refrigerator, go a little bit forward and then go up the stairs, once you get to the top of the stairs, take a step into the second room, so the room that's to the left of the room that you first see when you come up the stairs, and then take one last step right in front of you next to the side table, beside the bed, you are done.

25465.instruction: you are in a museum. turn to your right, so you are looking at portraits and a sign that says "SALA [XIV]" and a white rope. stay on the red carpet but walk toward the red throne. walk toward the doorway staying on the red carpet walk thru the next doorway. when the red carpet ends and you see tile, walk into that room. staying in between the rope, walk toward the stairs but stop in front of [the area where] the chandelier that in the lower part.

25505.instruction: you are overlooking a bed. turn to your left so you  can see the two doors. exit thru the door on the left. walk into the hallway to the left of the doorway in front of you . turn left and face down the hallway where you will see a violin. walk to the violin. turn left. walk down the hallway passing the piano on the left. when you reach the dresser in front of you turn left and walk to the middle of the door way so you can see the bathtub in front of you  and there's going to be a door that is open to the left in front of the bathtub. step into that doorway. turn left and you will be looking into a closet. take one step to the right of the bench. take another step right on to the shoe thing.

25512.instruction: We're going to start out in the corner next to a dinning table and some white dinning chairs and to the left of a window. We're going to move towards the potted tree in the corner, and we're going to take a slight right into the open doorway to the left of the mirror. In this open doorway we will find ourselves in the kitchen, alongside an espresso machine or a water dispenser, along with a gas range. We are going to take a right at the island and walk along it, passing the sink to our left and the wine fridge to our right. We are going to enter this doorway to our right that is open, passing the bedroom to our left. And as we enter this hallway through this doorway we will pass some stairs to the left, we are going to turn the corner of the stairs, passing a painting of multiple rectangular objects pasted together. And we're going to go straight into the bathroom at the end of the hallway that has a silver filigreed square in front of it. Once we come into the bathroom, we are going to stop in front of the pedestal sink and the toilet to our left. And you have arrived.

25542.instruction: You're standing in the middle of some stairs. Go up these stairs to the next landing. You should be facing a window, turn around you'll see more stairs going up. Go up the rest of these stairs. And in front of you you'll see a doorway to the right of this statue. Go through this doorway and walk past the ladder and walk past this doorway on the left. Go through the doorway in front of you. And walk to the right of the statue. And once you're standing to the right of the statue and these laundry machines you've reached the end.

25589.instruction: You're looking at a fireplace. Turn around and take a right through the first archway on your right. Through this archway, you'll see you're standing on a foyer. In front of you is a closed door. To your right is an open archway. Walk through that open archway, and stand in the middle of that room. In front of you, you'll see two time glasses and a globe. Once you're there, you've arrived.

25683.instruction: You begin looking towards an entryway with a billiards table in it. Turn completely around and you should see a sort of ugly couch, and a less ugly, but still moderately ugly tan chair. Jump over the hexagonal  table between those two and towards the wooden archway. Once you are in that archway, turn right and move into the archway on the right into a circular atrium. Once you're looking into that circular atrium, you're going to see some stairs on the right. Go to the foot of those stairs, don't go up them, and go into the archway to the left of those stairs, through to another small circular atrium. In that one, go into the door on the left, just on the other side of the faux window. I'm not sure what else to call that... Just a fake window, for decorative purpose? I dunno. Continue down this new narrow hallway, past an open door on your left and curtains on your right, and into a bedroom. Circle around the bed to the foot of it, between the bed and a bunch of curtains, and then between the bed and the TV, and, finally, once you've gone completely around the bed, basically, stand between the bed and the desk on its side with the telephone and nothing else. And, you are done. There should be a weird little white rug beside you to the left, between you and the bed.

25691.instruction: Now you are facing towards the tipoy. Turn slightly left. Move forward to the second open door in front of you. Turn slightly right. Move forward to the fireplace. You have reached your destination.

25692.instruction: Now you are standing on the carpet and you can also see a table with lamp and other object, walk straight and enter the door entrance there you will find a campfire area that is your destination.

25704.instruction: You begin looking down a hallway with a bench on your right with a cowboy hat on it, and a wicker basket to your left with a basketball in it. Continue down the hall until the first opportunity to turn right. Turning right, you should see a few bar stools lined up with a counter. Move towards that counter and make an immediate right before the line of bar stools. Continue onto the hardwood floors towards the kitchen island, and then pass the refrigerators on your right, towards the gate-like door in the back. Once you are in the corner, with the gate-like door in front of you, the kitchen on your left, the refrigerators behind you, and a small hallway to your right, you're in the right place. Stay there. The men in black will be there to pick you up soon.

25740.instruction: Now you are standing beside a chair. Walk straight towards the portrait. To your right there are two pots. Take the right turn. There is a staircase. Get down through the stairs. Once you reach the end point of the staircase, take a right turn. Take the immediate left turn and walk into a room which has many bottles and stools. Walk straight and slightly take a left turn. Now you are standing beside the portrait and behind the dining table. The destination is reached.

25741.instruction: Okay right now you are facing your sofa. Turn slightly left and you see a frame hang on the wall to the right. Go towards that way and there is a pot to your right.  Beside that pot there are staircase. Climb down the stairs. Once you climb down the stairs take a right turn and climb the remaining stairs. Once you reach the base, turn to your right and walk straight. To your left you  see an arch door, walk through the door. There are wine racks to your right and left sides. Go straight till you reach the table in front of you which has candle holders on it. Then to your left you see a wall and there is stool near the wall. Go and stand near the stool. That is the end point.

25831.instruction: You are in your living area, beside a snooker table. Turn towards your right and move forward near to the table in front of you. Walk across the table and stand on the other side of the table. Turn towards your slight left and move forward beside the chair in front of you. Go near the table, which is on your right side and stand there. Turn towards your slight left and in front, you can find a door. Go near that door and turn towards your slight left again. Climb up three stairs and stand on the third step. You reached your destination.

25832.instruction: You are facing towards the shelves, turn slight right and move towards the table. Keep moving forward. Turn slight left and move towards the cupboard. You are facing towards the chair, turn left and move towards the open door. Turn slight left and stand on 3rd step of the staircase. You are facing towards the staircase, which is your final destination.

25862.instruction: Right now you're at the entrance and facing a bed. Move little forward. Now slightly towards your left and you can see an opened door. Walk through that opened door and you will come across an another opened door. Walk through that opened door and stand out of that room and that is the end point.

25863.instruction: Now you are in a exhibition facing bed. Move forward. Slightly turn left. Move forward. Slightly turn left. Go into the opened door. Walk through the passage. Go through the opened door. You have reached your destination.

25870.instruction: So we are in the living room where there is a couple of couches go forward beside the couch go straight there is a kitchen type area so go left go forward from the corridor go straight and turn left we are in the bathroom area go forward and we are in the end point infront of mirror.

26068.instruction: Standing in the shower, walk out on to the red carpet. On the red carpet, you should see the mirror in front of you with the shower to your back. Look left, and walk to the top of the stairs. Once at the top of the stairs you should see a statue in front of you resting on a table, to your left should be another set of stairs, and that's it.

26092.instruction: You are facing towards the lamp on the table, go near the window, turn right go near the door, move towards the stairs, down the stairs turn right, again go down the stairs and this is your final destination.

26093.instruction: You are facing towards the table, move forward turn to your right and move towards the open door, exit the room through the open door by slightly turning to your left, you are facing towards the stairs, turn to your left there is an another open door, enter into the room through the open door, now you are facing towards the couch, turn around and go all the way down through the stairs, get down it is your end point.

26100.instruction: You will start by standing on a hallway. Turn right and walk down he staircase on your right. Once you're at the foot of the stairs. Take one step towards the bench in front of you and you're done.

26136.instruction: You are facing a wall, turn left, walk straight. Turn right, walk straight. Turn right, enter into the living room. Walk towards the couch, turn slightly right and stand in front of television. This is the end point.

26137.instruction: You are in a corridor where there is restroom in front of of you and another room onto your right side. Now take a complete turn, you have staircases onto your left side. Take few steps towards the wall and also you have a white color door which is closed. Now take a slight right you have a wooden door in front of you which is closed. Now take again a right turn, you will find yourself in a room where there is cream color sofa a table which has table lamp onto your left side. A table which has flower vase and some books onto your right side. You are standing in between the sofa and the table. Take few steps towards the television which is in front of you. You have reached your destination.

26140.instruction: You are facing towards an open door, turn around and walk towards the bathtub, slightly turn right and walk towards the open door. You are now facing towards a stool, walk towards it, turn right and enter into the washroom with a commode. You are now facing towards a glass window, you have reached your destination.

26141.instruction: You are facing an open door, turn back and walk straight you will reach a bathing tub in front, walk few steps ahead you will find two entrances, enter into second entrance at the right side, its a washroom reach the door, you will find your destination in front of a door.

26155.instruction: Go straight from the place you are standing and exit from the door. Now turn right and keep moving forward till you reach the kitchen. Now turn left and keep moving forward. Now slightly turn right and enter into the narrow opening. On the left side you will find two chairs and a round table in between the chairs. Now go straight. You will find sliding door in front of you. Now slightly turn right and enter into the sliding door. On the left side you will find pool table. Now keep moving forward and stand in front of the sliding door which is in front of you. That will be your final destination.

26156.instruction: You are standing in front of the open door, go straight, exit the door, go straight, turn right, go straight, now you are standing in front of the table, turn left, go straight, slightly turn right, go straight, slightly turn right, go straight, slightly turn right, go straight, now you are facing in front of the open glass door, slightly turn right, go straight and exit the door, slightly turn left, go straight and stop in front of the glass door, this is your final destination.

26250.instruction: Starting in the bathroom right in front of the shower step out in front of the sink and turn left just before the bathtub,. Hop over the bathtub towards the open door on your left take a step inside you will see a toilet, stop.

26264.instruction: You are standing on a pink runner rug.  You are going to go to your left which will be a very long walkway with a pink runner rug.  So you are going to go that direction.  You will see it roped off on both sides of the runner rug.  And you are going to go towards the entrance way.  There will be large pictures on both sides of the entrance way on both sides of the walls.  Continue to move forward on the pink runner rug.  You will walk under a chandelier and head towards another walk way with a painting on each side of it of a soldier.  Continue thru.  And then you will see that it splits to the left or the right.  You are going to veer to the left on the pink rug.  And once you get right next to the white rope you are done.

26322.instruction:
Now you are at the exit of the door, there is a mat front of you. To your right there is a mirror with.
In front of you, you see two open rooms. To your diagonally left there is a room walk through the room. The room has shelves and a window and stop.

26323.instruction: Turn right from the place you are standing. Now enter into the room which is next to the closed door. That will be your final destination.

26341.instruction: You begin facing a set of stairs, in front of you are some steps going down, take 2 steps going the steps, and then turn back around and go onto the stairs, and just take 2 steps up the stairs, once you're standing right before the first landing, you are done.

26352.instruction: You are in a living room near the sofa facing towards it, take a slide left turn go towards the hallway, in the front you can see tables and flower vase, and take a right turn and move forward to the pillar, from there take a right move forward near the painting, from there take a right turn and go toward the dining table which is on the left side, from there take a right turn and go towards the curtain, from there take a slight left turn and go towards the curtain and the glass window. This is the endpoint.

26353.instruction: You are standing in a living area, facing towards the sofa, slightly turn left, walk straight, in-front of you there is a entrance, turn right, to the left you have a entrance, to the right you have a table with lamp on it, walk straight and stand between them. Turn left, in-front of you there is a open entrance, walk straight to the open entrance, turn left, walk straight, turn back, in-front of you there is a dinning table, walk straight to the dinning table, turn left, sorry turn right, in-front of you there is a potted plant, walk straight to the plant, slightly turn left, in-front of you there is a window, stand in-front of the window, that is your end point.

26359.instruction: You begin facing a living space, turn to your right, you will see a patio, the patio is shaped like a square, take a step towards the very corner of the patio wood flooring, take a step towards the dining table with the metal chairs, turn slightly to your left, next to the kitchen there is a opening, take a step towards that opening, take another step forward and then turn to your right, take 3 steps going into the bedroom, turn to your left, take a step forward and then enter the room on the left, turn to your left again, you will see a toilet room, take a step into the toilet room and you're done.

26389.instruction: Starting off on a staircase looking down if you turn around, go to the very top of this staircase. Once at the top of the staircase you should see to your right kind of in front of you there is an opened door. And to the left also there is an opened door. Go into the room to the left with the opened door. Once in this room youll see there is a bed and to the right there is a little sofa and a little dog. Step in front of the sofa. Once in front of the sofa to the right is a little hallway to a couple of rooms. Step into this hallway. Once in this mini hallway to your right is a bathroom there is a sink and mirror. Step in front of the sink and you are done.

26506.instruction: Your in a room with a wood floor, small rug. There's large wood doors with small wood cabinets above it. One counter has a printer and a window. 28118.instruction: You are facing towards the wooden wall. Slightly turn left and walk straight to exit the room. Now turn right and you will find the curtain hangings. So walk through them. Turn right, in-front of you there is a bed, walk to the bed, turn right, in-front of you there is a open door, walk to door and enter the room and stand in-front of the toilet pan, that is your end point.

28324.instruction: You are facing towards the glass window. Turn around and move towards the closed wooden door. Slightly turn right and move a bit forward. There is a washbasin on your right side. That will be the end point.

28343.instruction: You begin looking out of a glass door. Turn to your right, you should see a sitting area with coffee table. 28345.instruction: You are facing towards the bed. Turn slightly left and move towards the bed. Turn right and exit the room, and walk towards the stairs. Get down through the stairs, move forward. 28810.instruction: Now you are in a kitchen facing towards the sink, slightly turn left, go straight near the cupboard, now you are at the cupboard, in front of you there is a orange color sofa with a glass table, go near it, turn right towards the second open entrance, go near the lamp which in front of you, turn right, go straight near the scenario portrait, turn left and walk straight till the entrance of the room, turn right and enter in to the gym, slightly turn left towards the glass window, walk few steps forward, now you are beside the gym equipment, towards your left there is a wooden cupboard, this would be your final destination.

31897.instruction: Move little left from the place where you are standing and move forward till the wooden chair, walk behind the wooden chair till the cream colored sofa and take right, walk behind the cream colored sofa till the snooker table and take right from there, you can see the fire place to your right side, go near the fire place and stand, that is your end point.

31898.instruction: You are facing towards an open area, turn to your left, you can see table and chairs in-front of you. Walk towards the snooker pool, after reaching the snooker pool, turn to your right, you will find a fireplace on your right side. 31963.instruction: Okay, now you find yourself facing an open entrance facing towards the stairs. 31999.instruction: You are facing towards the staircase right now, turn to your left and move forward, slightly turn to your right, you can find a couch, go near the couch, slightly turn to your right, go near the pool board which is infront of you, turn left and move forward, you can find a staircase to your left, go near the staircase, slightly turn to your left, you can find two chairs, go near the first chair, turn right, to your right you can find a chair and a wooden cabinet, stand infront of the wooden cabinet, that would be your end point.

32092.instruction: You're standing in front of a pool table, if you turn to your left you will have a bench on your left side and the pool table on your right side, and a wooden door in front of you. To the right of the doorway there's 4 pictures on the wall, walk towards the left most picture on the wall and once you're just to the left of the left most picture, with a console table below the pictures, you're done.

32240.instruction: We're facing towards a dresser and on top of it there's a hat, turn towards the left and walk past the carpet that's in front of you... In front of you there's a fireplace and in the opposite side there's a small stool and two chairs, and your left there's the bed and once you're facing towards that fireplace, you have reached your destination.

32271.instruction: You are facing a counter with a microwave on it.  You are going to turn to your right and you are going to exit thru the wood door.  You are going to make a right. 32352.instruction: you are in a study room facing towards the mirror near the table, take a right turn and go towards the bookshelves, on the left side there is a glass window, take a right turn and go towards the door which is on the left side, and come of that room, and on the front you can see a staircase walk up the staircase, and on the front you can see there is a glass window, from there take a left turn and walk up the stairs to the middle of the stair. 32774.instruction: Now we are in a room, take slight right, move straight and take left, move straight and take slight left, move straight, there is a bed, lamp and a table, and we reached the destination.

Once you're there near the nightstand with the wig on it, you are done.

33048.instruction: You are inside a bathroom. Walk out the bathroom towards the bed. Once you're at the bed, turn right and head towards the mirror. 33144.instruction: You are standing inside a room which has pink carpet, take few steps straight ahead, once you are inside another room ahead, you are almost abut to reach the bed in front of you, you are done.

33150.instruction: You are towards the closed door, turn to your right and exit the room through the open door, now slightly take right and  move forward, now turn to your right and enter into the room through the open door, now you are in  the entrance of the room, turn to your left there is an another open door, enter into the room through the open door, now you are facing towards the wall turn around, and move towards the entrance of the room, the entrance of the room is your end point.

33151.instruction: Right now you're facing towards a closed door. Now turn behind, there is an open door in front of you, move towards the door and exit the room. Now move towards the entrance of the room and stand at the entrance and it will be your end point.

33155.instruction: You're starting in front of a grill inside a house. To your right, you'll see a doorway going down a hall and behind you, there's a sitting area with a fireplace. The end.
