Turn around and go straight to the door and keep moving forward along with the red carpet and go straight to the door which is in the front side and move forward, from there take slightly right turn and go towards the door which is on the right side. This is the endpoint.

35534.instruction: "Okay now, you are facing towards an open door. Turn left, you can see an another open door in front of you. Now enter into that room, and move forward until, you reach an another open door in front of you. Now, enter into that room, and move forward until, you reach the window in front of you. Now slightly turn right, and move forward. Now, you are at the entrance of an another open door. Now, you have reached your destination."

35607.instruction: You begin in a sauna area. Turn slightly left and move past the hot coals, through the door. You want to approach the beaded curtain and step through that, you should enter a pool area now. Keep on the left side of the pool and continue forward until the steps up, on the side of the bar. Take those steps up, and then continue up three more stairs and into the open doorway at the very back next to the rocks that say 'art', on the ground. Once you are inside this massage room, next to the table that has roses on it, you are done.

35627.instruction: For your start point you are standing in a narrow pathway, to the right there are windows and to the left there is a circle breakfast table. Turn to the left making your way around the breakfast table once you have done so move forward straight ahead towards the open archway that leads into a kitchen slash dinning room don't enter in however turn to the right and exit this breakfast seating area thought the open doorway. Once you have done that continue moving straight forward into the open doorway in front o you and enter into the dinning room.

35633.instruction: You are standing at the back side of the chair. Turn towards your right and go closer near to the glass table from glass table just you will see a dinning table. On the back of the sofa go closer to the dinning table. Here we reached our destination at the back of the dinning table on your right side and your left side  there is a closed door and wall.

35634.instruction: Move little forward from your place and take right from there you can find a black table and a pot on it. covered with some couches around it move little forward,move little forward and take right between the chair and a black table there you can find silver table and some glasses on it towards your left side. Move little forward from there you will be entering into dining room it is covered with some brown chairs and a table this is your final destination.

35636.instruction: Now you are facing to the couch.Turn around on your left there is a open space,move towards it,on your left there are stairs,take the stairs and get down and take right and move forward towards the open small arch,if you look left there is a open white door,move towards it you will be entering into the gym area,move towards the treadmill and stop.

35637.instruction: "Okay now, you are facing towards the potted plant. Turn around, and move forward, you can see the cupboards on the left side. Now slightly turn right, and move forward, you can see the white colour cupboards in front of you. Now slightly turn left, and move forward, you can see the stair case on the left side. Now go down through that stair case, and slightly turn right, you can see the closed door in front of you. Now move forward, and turn right, you can see the narrow path way in front of you. Now move forward, and slightly turn right, you can see the open door in front of you. Now go near to that open door, and slightly turn left, you can see the another open door in front of you. Now go near to that open door, and slightly turn right, you can see the gym equipment in front of you. Now enter into that room, and slightly turn left, you can see the thread mill in front of you. Now go near to that thread mill. Now, you have reached your destination."

35641.instruction: You're facing towards the windows on you're right side wall, turn around and move one step forward, turn slight right and move forward, turn right and you can see an open door in front of you move two step forward and walk through that open door, turn slight left and you can see an open arch on you're left walk near the open arch, turn left and move forward and you can see a sofa in front of you, turn right and you can see an open door in front of you move two steps forward and pass through that open door move a bit forward and you can see a wooden open arch on you're right, turn right and walk through that open arch and you can see a stove in front of you walk near the stove and stand near the stove and this will be your end point.

35642.instruction: You're facing towards a wall turn right and move forward and turn right there is a wooden door, which is opened. Walk straight, you have another room. Which the door is opened . Move a step forward and turn left now, you have entered a living room. Turn right beside the sofa and walk straight towards another room. Enter the room. Now, you're facing to a sofa. From there turn right. There is an entrance. It is a kitchen room stand beside the stove is your destination.

35693.instruction: You are facing the wooden wall, turn left, walk straight. Slightly turn left, you can see stairs, climb up. Climb the stairs by passing through the portraits which are in the right. Turn left and walk straight. Walk straight, closer to the potted plant. You can see an arch in the front. Slightly turn right and enter into it. Walk straight, from the chair slightly turn left and walk towards the bed. Walk straight, there is another arch beside the lamp. Walk straight, now you are at the entrance of the restroom where you are facing a bathtub. This is the end point.

35694.instruction: Right now you are infront of the wooden cupboard slightly turn towards the left and move forward move little forward and take left on the left you can find the stair case move upwards the steps move little forward on the right side of the stairs you can find the portraits move little forward take left and move forward, move left and then forward take left and move forward on the left you can see the flower pot and the black railing move little forward we can find the arch enter in to the arch infront you can see the long mat move little forward and you can find the wooden rail beside it you can see the plant. Go through the narrow path move little forward enter in to the arch on the left you can the flower pots on the left you can see the window move little forward, slightly take left move towards the sofaset infront of you take left and move right infront you can find the bed move little closer to the bed slightly take left, in the left you can see the open door on the right you can see the bed move little forward enter into the arch move little forward and stop near the open door at left side of you. And here is the destination point.

35725.instruction: Facing the table with red table cloth and a small red chair behind it and the red curtains. Turn 90 degrees to your left and walk through to open doors along the red carpet way. Turn 45 degrees to your right, jump over the red tape towards a large kind of structure, a brown structure. Jump over the red tape towards the base of it. Continue to the right of the structure towards a wall with a very large painting on it in front of a red wall. It's a large painting of many faces. Facing that painting, turn 90 degrees to your left, continue down the carpet, keeping the large structure on the left with art pieces on the right will be the red wall. Continue along the red carpet towards the chair at the end of the carpet, but stop short of the end of the carpet, on your left should be the structure still with the paintings, on your right should be a window with white curtains pulled back on the right side. Once you're in line with that window, still on the red carpet, you're done.

35780.instruction: You are going to start facing a double door that is closed. Turn 45 degrees to the left, and you should see three archways, you are going to take the one on the right. Walk towards the chairs that you can see through the archway, and turn slightly to the left once you are next to the chairs. You are going to take the hallway that is on the middle of the kitchen and the glass table that we are currently standing next to. Take two steps to be near the windows that we can see in the background and turn left. Take one more step towards the single chair that is at the end of the multiple windows on the right side. Once you are there, you are not next to that single chair, but you are in the middle of the kitchen stools. You should have four windows on your right, and on your left, you should see the kitchen, and that is the destination.

35831.instruction: You will start by facing a poster. Turn right and take two steps towards the doorway. Once you're on the doorway, to your right there will be a room with a spa bed in it. Take one step inside that room. Now turn around and go back to the doorway. In front of you, there will be a large hallway. Walk down this hallway towards a large opening in the end. You will also walk down a couple of steps. To your left there's a reception. To your right you will see an open door. Walk towards the open door. Walk past this open door and at the end you will see an opening with beaded curtains. Once you're in front of that curtain then you're done.

35837.instruction: You're looking into a corner somewhere. If you turn around, you'll find there's a magenta-velvet couch in front of you. You'll also see a door slightly to the left, next to a column. Walk through that door and continue straight onto the door opposite of where you're exiting. Once through that door, you'll see a fireplace across from the square table with the two candles on it. Aboce this fireplace, you'll find a painting with two men, kinda creepy. Stand in front of that fireplace, and you've arrived.

35877.instruction: Right now you're facing towards  a closed door. Turn right and you can see a teapoy. Move towards the teapoy. Now slightly turn towards your left and you can see an arch, move towards that arch and there is an opened door on the left side. Move towards that opened door. Here you can find a sink on the left side and an opened door in front of you. Move forward and exit the room. Now turn right and move little forward, here you can see a sofa in front of you. Slightly turn left and move forward where on the right side you can see a sink platform and on the left you can see a portrait. Move little forward where on the left you can see an arch and on the right side you can see a kitchen platform. There is an arch in front of you, slightly turn right and move towards the arch and you will be at the entrance of the dining area. Move towards the dining table. Now turn left and move forward, right now you're facing the edge of the two doors and that is the end point.

35878.instruction: Right now you're facing a closed glass door. Now turn right, you can see a sofa and a table in front of you, move forward towards the table and turn left. You can see a wooden arch beside the sofa, move forward towards the arch. You can see an open entrance in to the room, move forward towards the entrance and enter in to the room. Now, you can see an open door in front of you, move towards the door and exit the room. Now turn right, you can see an arch in front of you, move towards the arch and turn left, move a bit forward towards the marble, slightly turn left, you can see a walkway in front of you, move forward in the walkway. You can see an open entrance to your right, move towards the entrance and turn right. you can see a dining table in front of you, move forward towards the dining table and turn left. You can see an arch to your left, move forward towards the arch and stand in front of the arch and it will be your end point.

35879.instruction: You will start by standing in the bedroom. Take one step towards the foot of the bed. Now turn right and exit the bedroom. Take two steps towards the staircase in front of you. Now turn right and continue to walk down the staircase. Once you've reached the foot of the stairs, turn right and you will see a lounge chair in the corner with a foot rest. Take one step towards the right side of that. Once you're standing in between the dining table on your right and the lounge chair on your left with a little side table then you're done.

35905.instruction: You are in an unusual room with in front of a wall with white and blue tiling above a stone sink with some bronze faucets. You are going to turn so that's to your left. Step in front of the door. Step through the door towards the pool. On your left are two brown velvet lined chairs and past that are white stone steps. Step in front of the stone steps. Walk up the stone steps. Walk up the second set of stone steps and stand in the open door way to your right. Then you are going to enter the room at the end of that hallway where you can see the massage table. Step right in front of the massage table your end table is between the massage table and the wooden door.

35931.instruction: Right now, you;'re facing towards the sink, turn right and exit the room. Now, turn right and move towards the mirrors. Now, again turn right and exit the room. Continue to move forward until you reach a closed door in front of you. Now, turn right and enter into the room. Stand at the entrance of the room and that is the end point.

35932.instruction: You're facing the wash basin, turn towards your right, you'll enter in to bedroom, then turn right, again turn right, go straight till the end, then turn right, at the entrance, beside the door you'll find your destination.

35940.instruction: You are in an empty utility room. Turn right, head out of this room. Head through the french doors across the hallway. There will be a glass table and chalkboard that says art above it. Stand in front of the chalkboard and stop.

35983.instruction: You are standing inside a washroom, near a unique style sink and faucet, turn around and now you should be near a bed on the right and a opening on your left, so take two steps ahead and exit from the left entrance. Now you should be facing a big indoor pool, turn left and walk straight towards the counter near the stairs on the floor, so you are now near the open door and the stairs in front of you. Go inside the room their is a small walk way and two three stairs in front of you, so take the stairs and enter through the first entrance on your right this will be a massage room, so go at the foot of the massage bed and their should be a closet no 13 on your left a door in front of you and a bath gown on your left, once you are near the bath robe you are done.

36007.instruction: You're in a living room to your right you'll see a large white couch. Take a step towards the small archway on the left and then take a right walk alongside this brown table. And then take a left into this large archway and you'll see a glass table with two chairs. Walk towards this table. Then walk towards the large brown table slightly to your left and then walk between this table and this cabinet on the right towards the window with the two lights on both sides. And then take a step towards the window and you should be looking at a grill and you've reached the end.

36053.instruction: You are facing a wall, turn right, walk straight. Exit the room through the open door. Walk straight closer to the bed. Turn left, walk straight and exit the room. Slightly turn right and take a step forward. There is a mirror and a potted plant in the left. Turn right, you can see stairs. Get down through those stairs. Walk towards the couch by taking a right turn. Slightly turn right and move a step forward. You are facing a stool and in the left you have a chair with pillow and a fire place. This is the end point.

36054.instruction: You are now in front of the wall. from there slightly turn to your right, walk straight and stand at the entrance of the room. From there walk a few steps forward and enter into the room which is in front of you, from there walk straight near to the bed and take a left turn, go straight and stand near the door. From there slightly take a right turn and walk straight near to the staircase facing towards the mirror. Take an about turn walk down the stairs and go near to the brown color chair. From there take a right turn, walk a few steps forward and stand in front of the cream color chair.

36165.instruction: You begin looking through a white door. Step straight through to the corner hallway. You should be able to look right, and see a bathroom with amber light spilling out of it. Go directly to that door from the corner and then look in, see the bathtub, move behind it. Once you are in the corner of the bathroom next to the towel rack, you're done.

36166.instruction: You're looking at a cabiet with some shelves. If you turn to the right you'll see a desk with once chair on the left and two on the right. Walk towards the chairs on the right. You're now standing in front of this plant. If you turn around you'll see two white open doors. Walk through these doors. And then walk to the front of these stairs that are going down on the right. And you'll see some paintings on the right, walk down this hallway. And walk through this doorway and in front you'll see that it's a bathroom. Walk into this bathroom. And you'll be standing in front of a sink and a mirror and you've reached the end.

36220.instruction: You are at the entrance of the room, facing the wall, turn around and move towards the cupboard. Turn left and move towards an open entrance beside the cupboard, now you have reached the kitchen area. Go straight, passing the sink till you reach the open entrance on the left side. Turn left and move towards an open door beside the closed door and portrait on the wall, now you are at the entrance of the room and stop in front of the closed door, now you can see the portrait on the wall on the right side and small black boxes on the left side, this is the endpoint.

36221.instruction: You are standing at the entrance of a bedroom facing towards a small cupboard, turn around and move forward towards the white coloured cupboards. Now turn slightly left and you can see an open door which is on right side of the white coloured wall, enter through it. There is a sink on your right side, move forward and enter the kitchen area. Walk in between the gas stove and the sink and move forward. Now turn to your left and pass through the open entrance and enter the door which is on the left side of the painting. You have a sink on your left side, move towards the glass door and you have reached your end point.

36357.instruction: You're at the corner of an island turn right and walk in between the island and the other island on the right and walk past them. And then hop over this counter top in front of you towards this table with the chandelier over it. And then turn around through this large archway in the middle. And you'll be standing in front of a table with a lamp on it. Turn right and walk towards the painting on the wall and turn left and take a step forward and walk through the archway towards this treadmill on the right. And then take a step to the left of this exercise bike and you're done.

36421.instruction: You begin looking over a velvet rope at a cabinet, writing desk type thing? It is a black desk with white drawers, kinda neat looking. There's also some kind of circular thing, in the middle of the floor there. It looks almost like a well dug into the middle of this room, which is silly. Maybe it has a mirror? I assume it's for artistic effect. Turn to the right and enter the ornate wooden doors, and then just follow the red carpet forward. Follow it through another set of doors, into a bedroom, and finally to the next set of doors through that bedroom. You should have made one ninety degree turn right while following the red carpet, and looking back, you should see the foot of the ornate bed. Once you're there, in that threshold of the doorway, you are done.

36438.instruction: You begin looking over a sacrificial altar with various offerings stacked upon it. Turn to your right and move to the side of the alter, and then out of the door to the right with the blue lighting. You should step straight towards a pool. Turn left and move to the concrete stairs. Go ahead up those stone steps, turning left, and then you should come to three semi-familiar rooms. Go up three more steps towards the corner that says art, and then move into the room directly across from where you entered. You will go around the head of the massage bed, and into the corner. You should be in the corner right next to the massage bed. Far right corner. You're done.

36468.instruction: You are facing towards the open door, move forward and stand at the entrance, now turn left and move towards the bookshelf, turn right, exit the room, and move towards the steps, now climb the steps, now turn right, and enter the room, which is next to the stairs, now turn slightly right and move towards the window, now there is a window on your right side, and a couch on your left side, this is your end point.

36469.instruction: You're now facing the door. Walk out of the room and then turn right. Enter the other room which is in the complete right and go near the stairs. Walk on the stairs completely, then take right. Walk straight towards the bathtub and after crossing the bathtub, stand towards the frames placed on the wall, you will reach your destination.

36499.instruction: You are standing in a living room, facing towards the wall, turn to your right move towards the wall clock. Now turn right and move forward till your reach the brown color dining table, which is on your left side. This is your end point.

36500.instruction: You are facing towards a wall, turn around and go forward towards the wall that is having a clock on it, turn right and go forward towards the dinning table, here at the edge of the dinning table which is having a small green plant on it and chairs around it you have reached the destination.

36711.instruction: You are in the living area facing the couches. Turn right and walk towards the TV. Now turn around and walk all the way down the stairs. Now turn right and walk straight in the hallway till you find a wooden door to your left. Now turn right and walk straight towards the windows. From the windows, turn right and walk towards the snooker table. After reaching the snooker table, slightly move to your left and walk straight towards the wall which has three photo frames to it. Now exactly in front of that wall will be the end point.

36712.instruction: You are facing towards the sofa at the right side you can see a wooden single chair turn around and go near to the television and from the television turn a turn to wards right and get down the stairs and again turn towards the right walk through the corridor and turn towards the right where you can see a dinning table. Walk in between the dinning table from there you can see a single sofa set with chairs turn towards right at the back side of the single sofa chair and go straight near to the glass window. And walk behind the large table go straight in front you can see painting frames on the wooden wall. Here we reached our destination opposite to the panting frames of the wooden wall.

36725.instruction: You are facing towards a brown coloured cabinet, move towards it. Now turn slightly right and move forward walking alongside the table. Turn slightly left and you can see an open arch, move forward passing through it and there is another open arch right in front of you, move forward passing through it. Turn slightly to your left and you can see an other open arch, enter into it. You are now facing towards a brown table with a lamp on it. Turn around and enter the open arch on your left. You are facing towards a kitchen counter with a plant on it. Turn to your right and enter the open arch in front of you. You are now standing near a glass top table facing towards a couch. Turn slightly left and move forward. You are now standing near the entrance of an open arch and this is your destination.

36726.instruction: You're now facing the wooden cabinet in front. Walk towards it and walk straight towards the oval shaped glass table. From there, walk towards the lamp which is placed on the bench behind the sofa set. From there, turn around and walk towards the wooden cabin in front. You will now find a washbasin on your left. Turn right, now move towards the oval shaped glass table. Take one step ahead and stop there facing the window, you will reach your destination.

36787.instruction: You're going to start, facing a couple of dark statues in between two separate rooms. Turn around and face into the room` the dining table covered by a rug and a fire place. Now to the right of the table you'll see a all table. Head to the bass of that. From there head towards the back of the room to the window and you've arrived.

36829.instruction: (mic problems)... you are in a toilet room. if you see the 4 pane window in front of you with some towels in front of it, turn to your left and exit the toilet room. now you should be in the bathtub/sink/mirror room. continue to exit this bathroom until you enter the bedroom. there is going to be a bed in front of you, a chair to your left and a table to your right. next to the table on your right will be a wall full of windows/doors/curtains, follow that wall and exit the room thru the door. once you are in the doorway you will see a red tiled floor with a circle the hallway. turn right into the next hallway. this hallway has a red and white rug, step onto that rug where you will see a painting of men on horses. you will see another bathroom to your left. it has white tiles with red accents, a toilet and a sink. step into this room and stop in front of the mirror.

36905.instruction: Now you are facing towards a small table with three chairs in front of you turn towards your left you will be able to see a pool walk beside the pool and the opening which is beside the pool as soon as you enter you will see a dustbin in front of you then turn towards your left you will see an wooden door opened go near it and this is your final destination.

36906.instruction: Turn left from the place you are standing and go straight. On the left side you will find swimming pool. On the right side you will find chairs. Now go straight. On the right side you will find wall and you will find narrow opening in front of you. Now enter into the narrow opening. Now turn left you will find an open door. Now go and stand in front of the open door. That will be your final destination.

36940.instruction: You are facing towards the potted plant, turn to left and move forward move towards the stairs, walk straight there are some stairs go all the way down through the stairs, after going down slightly turn to your right and move forward, now you are facing towards the wall, now turn to your right and move forward towards the open arch, now move towards the portrait on the wall now turn to your right, there is an open door enter into the room through the open door, move towards the bed and stand in front of the window it is your end point.

36941.instruction: Turn left and walk near the stairs, walk straight from the stairs and turn slightly left and you will find the other staircase. Get down on the stairs completely and make a U turn towards your right. Now walk straight completely to the other room. After reaching the other room, you will find the glass door on the left and the wall on your right. Turn towards your right and enter the bedroom which is in front of you. Go near the bed and face the window side, you will reach your destination.

36950.instruction: Turn left from the place you are standing, you will find open door, now step out of the room and turn left, you will find open door, now enter into the door, there you will find a cupboard, and a hat place on the cupboard, go and stand in front of the cupboard, that will be your final destination.

36951.instruction: You are facing towards the cupboard in front of you. Slightly turn left and walk towards the door. Now walk straight and exit the room. Now turn left and walk through the door that is open. Now walk towards the cupboard which has a hat on it. So exactly in front of that cupboard with the hat will be the end point.

36998.instruction: You are facing towards the wooden round table, take a slight left. Walk near to the black cub board again take left, you can see a open door walk through the door. And turn to your slight right enter into that open arch, move forwrad enter into that open door. Move forward and turn to your left near the wall frame through the open door, enter into that and stand in front of the sink.

36999.instruction: Now you are standing on the carpet in front of a wall, walk straight towards the table and chair, again walk towards the door, exit the door and take right and then walk on the carpet on the right side you will find some curtains there you will find a door enter that you will find a wash room that is your destination.

37033.instruction: We are going out of the doorway that is directly in front of us. Take one step out and then turn to the right. We are now going to go into the spa room. Taking a step going toward the radiator that is on the wall. Now turn around and go out of this room. We will now go into the second doorway that is open on our left. When we are just inside of this doorway, we will now turn around and go out. Going down the three small steps and out of  this area. We are now going to go down another small set of stairs. A reception area/ kitchen something will be on your left and some chairs will be on your left. You’ll want to walk forward. Waking up where you will be on the left hand side of the pool. You will be up high and have the three lounge chairs on your left.

37035.instruction: You are in a corridor facing towards the stairs, go up the stairs turn back again go down the stairs, move towards the closed door, turn right and move towards the table, move forward towards right side of window and stand, this is your final destination.

37036.instruction: You are facing towards a staircase, move forward, climb uo two steps. Now turn to your right, get down the two steps, take a slight left and move forward towards the brown coloured closed door. Now turn to your right, you can see an open entrance, enter through it and move towards the centre table. Turn slightly right and move forward towards the glass window which is on the right side of the TV. You are now facing towards a glass window and this is your end point.

37271.instruction: You are facing towards a mirror, slightly turn left and exit the washroom. Now walk towards the bed, slightly turn right and exit the bed room. Take a few steps ahead and turn right, you will see two open doors, reach towards the door on your right and step into it. You are now in a laundry room, this is your endpoint.

37272.instruction: Okay, now you are in front of a wall, which is white in color and to the right there is a wash basin. Now turn left a little bit and in front of you there is a open entrance. Now move into that entrance and take right and in front of you there is a bed. Now move towards the bed and beside the bed there is a lamp and in front of you there is a open entrance. Now move out of this room, by that entrance. As you exit, take right and on either side of you there are photo frames and to the left there is a small table. Now move forward and on either sides, there are entrances. Now turn right and move into the right side entrance. As you enter to the left of you, there is a wash basin and to the right, there are washing machines. Now stop here and this is your final destination.

37279.instruction: You're standing at the entrance of the room, facing towards the wall. Exit the room and walk into the open entrance. Turn right, walk forward in between the kitchen counter tops. Exit the kitchen, from the open door, which is in front of you. Now walk into the right side open door, which is a bedroom. Go stand near the chair. This would be your end point.

37280.instruction: You are facing towards a wall, move a bit forward, turn right and move forward, to the left you can find a sink, you can see an opened door infront of you, move towards the area which is to the left side of the opened door, now you are in the bedroom, move forward towards the narrow window which is infront of you, that would be your end point.

37304.instruction: You will start by standing in front of a black board on your right. Turn left take a step forward and turn right exit this room. Now once you're on the hallway, turn left and take a step on your right just at the top of the staircase. You will see a doorway in front of you. Continue to walk inside this doorway. You will see the kitchen on your left. Take a step towards that and continue to walk forward standing on the left side of the kitchen island. Once you're facing the stove, turn left you will see a dining table walk towards the left side of the dining table. You will see another living area. Take a step towards the coffee table and you're done.

37312.instruction: "Okay now, you are facing towards the glass door. Turn around, and move forward, you can see the open door in front of you. Now go near to that open door, an slightly turn right, and move forward, you can see the single seated sofas in front of you. Now, go near to sofa, and slightly turn right, you can see the table in front of you. Now go near to that table, you can see the potted plant, and the window in front of you. Now, you have reached your destination."

37313.instruction: Turn around and move forward from the snooker board, to enter into another room, after entering into another room, move near to the sofa, and from the sofa, move near to the plant, and end by watching the plant.

37335.instruction: You are facing a long table with chairs.  You are going to turn around and walk down a walk way.  You are going to continue forward.  There will be glass doors on your right and on your left will be a marble island with stools at it.  You are going to stop right in between those glass doors and the marble top island with the chairs and you are done.
