39293.instruction: Go straight from the place you are standing. You will find an open door. Now enter into the door. Now slightly turn left and go straight. You will find another open door. Now enter into the door and keep moving forward. You will find an open door. Now go and stand at the entrance of the door. That will be your final destination.

39388.instruction: You will begin facing a bunch of wooden railings in a, what looks like a cabin, turn around completely and you will see a white bed in front of you, take a tiny step towards that bed and turn to your left, you will see an open that goes into a bathroom, take one step to get in, right before the doorway of the bathroom. You will see a green antique sink, take one step to go into the bathroom, you will see an open door in front of you that goes out into another bedroom, take one step to go into that bedroom, you will see that there is a white bed with a chest in front of it, take one step towards the chest, now turn to your left, you'll see the railing and stairs going down, take on step towards the railing, you should now be standing at the edge of the stairs, take 3 steps to go down the stairs, you should now be just before the end of the stairs, take one last step, you should now be right at the base of the stairs and in front of you should be a kitchen, you are done.

39444.instruction: you begin in a closet area, if you turn your body to the left you will see the rest of the room. take a step towards the bed. turn your body to the left one more time and you will see a door leading outside into the hallway. you are going to head into the hallway. take one step into the room, the very first room to your left. turn your body and take one step in front of the foot of the bed. turn your body to the left and take one step into the bathroom. once you are standing in the door frame of the bathroom you are done.

39457.instruction: You're looking inside of a closet. Turn to your left and exit the bedroom, and continue into the other room across from that bedroom. Inside, you'll see that it's empty. Stand in the middle of that room, and you're done.

39522.instruction: Turn around and move forward near to the window, and from the window, take left and move forward near to the stove, and from the stove, take left and move forward near to the table, and from the table, take left and move forward near to the chair, and from the chair take right and move forward near to the stairs, and then take right to go down the stairs, after moving down the stairs, move forward near to the door, and end near the door.

39523.instruction: You're now facing a wooden pillar in front. Walk towards it and move forward, you will find the stairs on your right side. Get down on the stairs completely and walk towards the open door which is slightly towards your right. Stand in front of that door, you will reach your destination.

39529.instruction: Now, you are facing towards the curtain. Turn slightly right and move towards the glass door. Now, turn right and you will find an open glass door onto your right side. Enter through it and that will be your end point where you are facing the wall in front of you and hangers on your left side.

39530.instruction: You are facing towards the curtain, turn slight right and move towards the glass door. Turn slight right and move forward. Turn right and enter into the closet room. You are facing towards the wall, which is your final destination.

39556.instruction: You can see a sink on to the left side, turn left and go forward towards the brown table, turn left and go forward towards the second brown chair, slightly turn left and go forward towards the edge of the wall, slightly turn right and go forward towards the curtain that is just beside the brown table, here facing towards a glass window you have reached the destination.

39557.instruction: You're standing in the kitchen between the two kitchen counter tops, facing towards the oven and the refrigerator. Turn left, you could see three arches. Walk into the middle arch. Again turn left and walk towards the dining table. Walk forward towards the cabinet behind the table. Stand near the curtain beside the cabinet. This would be your end point.

39628.instruction: We start off looking at a couch. Turn to your right. And continue to turn until you see the larger um couch. Take a step towards the larger couch. Turn to your left. No walk out of the doorway into the hallway. Slightly turn to your left and you'll see a flight of stairs going up. Walk up the flight of stairs. Continue to walk up the stairs until you have reached the top. Once at the top you'll take a step into the doorway directly in front of you with the two grey chairs. Turn to your right. Take a step towards the side table of the bed. Turn to your right. Walk into the restroom and once you're at the um threshold of the restroom. Stop you are done.

39657.instruction: Now you are facing the door, turn left and go straight now you enter the dining area. Turn left and go straight passing through the sink towards the coffee maker, turn left and go straight along the table, you can see a chair with a red pillow move towards it, now you can see a closed door stop infront of the door, this is the destination.

39658.instruction: You're facing towards the door, turn to your left and move forward, you can see an open door, go inside the room and to your left, you can see table and chairs move forward, till you find the kitchen and then take left you will see a table and chairs move forward, you will find sofas and chairs, move forward and then take left you will see a mirror and the doors, stand near the mirror. This is your end point.

39681.instruction: Right now you are facing towards a wooden shelf. Make a slight right turn on you are left side you can see a windows with curtains and move forward in the middle you can see a open door in front of you, just exit the room from the open door and move forward. On you are left side you can see a arch attached with open door. Just turn to left and step into that open door and move forward on you are right side you can see a bed move forward. On you are left side you can see  a closed door which is covered with curtains, stand near the closed door. Here we reached our destination.

39682.instruction: You are facing towards a shelf, turn around and go forward passing through the arch, go forward and pass through the opened brown door, slightly turn left and go forward, slightly turn left and go forward passing through the opened brown door, go forward on to the carpet, here beside a bed you have reached the destination.

39721.instruction: In the room with the message table, exit the room, staring out in the hallway, there's a second doorway on the left, walk into that doorway. Don't go in the room, go back out, continuing in the direction you were, through the open door with the blue background on the wall behind it. Once you're through that door walk down the three steps. You should have a bar area to your left and a pool to your right. Walk to your right, keeping the pool on your left and walk towards the narrow doorway with the beads straight in front of you. Walk into the room with the beads. Standing on the carpet, walk left, and into the sauna. Take one step deep into the sauna so you're sitting basically on the bench at the far wall of the sauna. You're done.

39742.instruction: You're looking into an archway. If you turn around, you'll see a bathtub. Walk towards the bathtub. To your right, you'll see two doors. Walk towards the leftmost corner door with the pink step stool beside it. Step inside that room. Inside the room is a toilet. You're done.

39861.instruction: You are in a room inside a house. Face 180 degrees away from the fireplace, directly down towards a large dining room table. On your left, you'll see a couch with two chairs around a coffee table and a giant lamp between the couch and the chair on your left. Walk straight towards the dining room table where the couch and chairs are on your left and the wall is on your right. Walk past the archway on your right all the way to the dining room table. You'll be on the right the of the table, facing straight ahead, you'll see a mirror, on the right is a small picture as well as two open archways. You will take the second open archway and go through it on your right. You'll enter a hallway. Straight ahead you have three double french doors that are closed, you will take a left while facing those doors and you will enter a very large kitchen. On your right are two ovens and on your left is a kitchen island. Keep going straight, past the kitchen the island and ovens and past the sink on your left. Just past the sink, you'll be facing a fireplace and you'll be behind a couch, with another couch on your left and an open french doorway on the right of the fireplace. Turn to your left and stay behind the couch and between the chairs that are facing the kitchen. Walk straight ahead through the archway directly in front of you. Once you walk through the archway you will be in a room with a small table with four chairs around it and a tea set on a small table directly to your right. To the left of the kitchen table there is an open doorway, walk through the open doorway. You'll be standing atop a door mat and there you have reached your final destination.

39899.instruction: You are facing towards a table, turn right and move towards the opened door, turn right and move a bit forward, turn left and move a bit forward towards the opened door which is infront of you, now you are at the entrance of a room, where you can find wine bottles on your right, that would be your end point.

39900.instruction: Now you are in the living area. Turn slightly right and walk straight a bit far, then take right to exit the room through the door. Now walk a bit far, then take right and walk straight to enter into a room. Now stand at the entrance of the room which is the endpoint.

39949.instruction: You're currently standing in the kitchen. Turn around, and face left. Take two steps forward, passing the silver fridge on your left and the silver oven on your left. Turn around, and face right. Take a step forward, passing the silver sink on your left. Now, you're at the left-corner of a wooden dining table. Turn around, face right. Take three steps forward in front of you, passing the brown dining table on your left and the island counter on your right. Once you're standing in front of a grey sofa, turn around and face left. Take a step forward to the sliding glass door, across from you. Take another step forward, through the glass sliding door, and onto the balcony. Excuse me, patio. Take a step forward, so you're standing behind the purple armchair and next to the white table on your right. Take a step forward in front of you, landing on the grey pavement in the backyard. Take a step forward, to the middle of the green lawn in the backyard. Take a step forward to the left row bush. Once you're standing directly in front of green bush, and directly to your right, is the small white staircase going down in the backyard, you're done.

39963.instruction: You are facing towards the wall, slightly take right and move forward through the open door, now turn around move forward, through the passage now slightly take right, and enter into the second right room, now slightly take right and move towards the bed, it is your end point.

39964.instruction: You are facing towards the door walk out of that door, you are in the bed room now again come out of that door. Walk straight you will see two open doors, enter into the door which is beside to the table and the chair walk near to the bed and stand.

40037.instruction: Right now you're in a living area facing a sofa set. Now slightly turn right, you can find a entrance to the passage to your right, move towards the entrance of the passage, now turn right and enter the passage, you can find a way to the hall, which is in round shape and move into the hall, you have a staircase to your right and an arc in front of you, move into the arc. Now you will be in the other hall, which is in round shape and you can find a grilled window on your left and there is an arc beside the window, move into the arc, now slightly turn left you can see a narrow passage, move towards the end of the passage, you can find an entrance to the bedroom, enter the bedroom, you have a bed to your left and curtains to your right, stand in front of the bed facing the curtains, now there is a television to your left, now turn left, you can see a dressing room in front of you, move towards the entrance of the dressing room and stand there and it will be your end point.

40038.instruction: You are standing at the back side of the sofa chair. Walk towards straight and make a slight turn towards your right. Go straight in between the arch and again make a slight right turn near to the open arch. Get into the open arch and again make a slight left turn where you can see a arch. After entering to the arch you will see a  door. Just get into the open door and walk towards straight through the corridor on your right side you can also see a curtains and on your left side you can see a open door keep moving straight in between them. And walk towards the bed after walking towards the bed near to the curtains and from curtains walk towards to the television and make a slight left turn there you will see a open door which looks like a dressing room. Here we reached our destination near to the enters of the door.

40063.instruction: Right now you are facing towards a door closed and you have a small drum in front of you in brown colour, turn around and you have a table in front of the sofa, move forward towards the table and turn around you will find a door closed which is used to go to the corridor, Move forward towards the door and again turn right. Move three steps forwards towards the pool table and here is your destination.

40064.instruction: Turn back from the place you are standing, you can find a teapoy, move towards the teapoy, slightly turn to your right, you can find a closed glass door, move towards the closed glass door, slightly turn to your right and move a bit forward, now you are facing towards the pool board, that would be your end point.

40077.instruction: We are at the bottom of some stairs. Turn going up the stairs. You will not go all the way up the stairs. You will just take two steps up. When you are on a little landing. If you look ahead of you just to the right you will see some sports pictures. This is where you will stop.

40079.instruction: Turn back from the place you are standing and move forward, now you are facing towards the wall, turn left and move towards the bed, turn left, go near the opened door which is infront of you, to your right you can find a staircase, go near the staircase, you are facing towards the mirror right now, slightly turn to your right and get down the stairs, you can find a closed door infront of you, stand infront of the closed door, that would be your end point.

40080.instruction: At present you are in the washroom turn back and walk straight then turn towards left and walk straight, you will see a bed, take left again and walk straight out of the room you will see a stair case on your right get down through the stair case ,you will find a sofa towards your right and a door in front of you which is your destination.

40135.instruction: You begin facing a doorway, go through it, and then immediate to your right, there is a archway, go through that, go forward and then turn to your right, go through the kitchen, keeping the kitchen island to your left, once you are at the stove, turn to your left and go forward, and then turn to your right and go down the hallway, you will pass 2 arches on your right, go through the third arch, go towards the small coffee table with flowers on it in front of you, go towards the open glass doors but to the right of the red chair across the room and then looking slightly to the right, you will see a silver, console table against a wooden wall with 2, i guess lamps on it that are shaped like glasses, and you're done.

40139.instruction: You are facing a glass window on a wall.  You are going to turn to your right and you are going to go thru the arched entrance way.  You are going to move forward and go thru the open double doors.  You are then going to turn into the first room on your left.  You are going to take a step in and you are going to stop with the sink  on your right and on your left is going to be some burgundy towels hanging and you are done.

40158.instruction: Right now you're facing towards a wall, turn right from the place where you're standing and move forward until you reach an open arch on the left side. Now, turn left and move little forward. Turn right and you can see a passage, walk in the passage till you reach an open entrance on the left side. Now, turn left here you're facing towards a portrait. Slightly turn left and walk forward. Right now you're standing at the entrance of a room, where you can see a sink on the left side. Move forward that stand near the sliding door and that is the end point.

40159.instruction: You are standing in the narrow walkway, facing towards the wall beside the wooden table, turn right and move forward, here to your left you can find an open entrance, turn left and move forward. Now turn right and move towards another open entrance, you have now entered the kitchen area, move forward passing through the refrigerator which is on your right side, till you reach the open entrance on your left. Now turn right, here you can see a portrait in front of you on the wall, take slight left and move towards the open entrance, you have now entered a small washroom, move forward towards the closed glass door, you are now facing towards the closed glass door, which is your end point.

40171.instruction: Facing the small basket of sports balls, turn slightly to the right and walk through the doorway onto the tile and then on to the hardwood floor, on the right you'll see a brick archway. Stay to the left and walk between the kitchen island and the fridge on the left. Turn right and walk between the kitchen island the second island, both having sinks on each. Walk straight ahead towards the table in front of you. Past this table you'll see some chairs. Jump over this counter top towards the chairs in the distance, which are two chairs are sitting in front of a glass oval table. Turn 45 degrees to your left, you'll see a dining room table with ten chairs, walk to the table, to the second chair from the left on the near side of the table. Stop there, you're done.

40355.instruction: You are facing towards a wall, turn to your right and you can see a dining table with some chairs. Move towards the glass window which is on the other side of the table. Now turn to your right, you can see an open door, exit through it and move forward. There is an open entrance on your left, move forward towards the open door and enter through it. Now turn slightly right and enter the first arch which is in front of you and move forward. Now turn slightly right and move forward. You are in the kitchen area and you have a countertop on your left side, move forward towards the stove. Now turn left and move forward. Turn slightly right and enter the open arch and move forward until you reach the third open arch on your right side. Turn slightly right and enter through it, move forward. You can see some cushions and a couch on your right side, move forward. There is a round centre table and two chairs in front of the fireplace, move towards them and you can see a small table with a flower vase on it, move towards it and you have reached your destination.

40356.instruction: Now you are standing behind the chair turn right and walk behind the chairs and go straight there you will find a door entrance with door mat, go straight from the door entrance towards another door entrance where you will find another door mat, from there walk straight towards the table and there you will find a right turn beside the table and then go towards the mat and then take a right turn between the wall and table and then take a left turn in-front of stove, from there you will find a right turn take a right towards the arch from there you will find three arches walk straight there you will find another curved arch go straight towards the sofa set from there go straight, from there you will find another chairs go straight there you will flower vase on the table that is your destination.

40359.instruction: You're standing near the door, go few steps forward, and enter the room, then turn left, you'll find an exit, exit the room, turn left, then turn right, you'll find stairs, get down the stairs, at the last stair you'll find your destination.

40360.instruction: Turn right and move towards the bed. Now, turn left and move towards the door which is in front of you. From here turn left and move towards the closed door which is in front of you. Slightly turn right and you can see a staircase. Walk all the way down through the stairs and stand on the second step and that is the end point.

40436.instruction: You are near the stairs climb the stairs and go straight and make a left turn and again you will find the stairs and go straight and again make a left turn and again climb the stairs after climbing the stairs you will find a open door get into the door in a room u will find a mirror  and make a straight move near the glass window and slightly turn to the right side  there u will find a room its a bathing room , here we reached the destination

40437.instruction: Right now you are standing on the staircase, start walking on the staircase and take a left turn there is another staircase start walking, move forward and take a slight left turn and move forward until you reach the end point of the staircase after reaching the end point of the staircase take a slight left turn and you can find a room enter into that room , at the left side you can find mirror and all move little forward  in that room and take a right turn and that's the final point.

40513.instruction: You're starting in a loft, facing the corner of the room. The bed's on your left and a chair's on your right. Turn around behind you. You will notice a walkway with a railing on the left and a large brown cabinet. There's a rug between that cabinet and the railing. Take two steps onto that brown rug with the black outline in front of that cabinet, and you're done.

40558.instruction: For your star point you are in a living room, turn to the right and exit the living room by passing the coffee table on your left and the cream colored couch to your right. You will need to pass the accent chair on your right that has two two pillows in it and the stair case to your left. Pass the the staircase on your left and straight across you should be able to see another set of stairs move forward toward those stairs and go down the stairs. Once you have made your way down the stairs you will make a right turn around the banister and move forward through the hall with the two wicker vases on the left corner at the end of the hall you will see an open doorway fight next to the wicker vases go through that open doorway. Straight ahead you will see a wash room to your left you will see a large wall, wine rack wall that is barricaded by glass doors and to the right you see a open doorway that leads into a bedroom. Move forward into the bedroom passing the bed on your left and making a slight left turn so then you will pass the floor plant that would be on your right now. And once you are at the side of the bed standing in the middle there would be the window beside you on the right, the bed to the left and in front of you there is a  table stand, night table stand. You have reached your end point between the bed and the window.

40599.instruction: Right now you are facing towards the wall turn slightly right and enter the arch keep moving forward. Then turn left where there is a restroom. Go and stand in front of the commode you have reached you're destination point.

40600.instruction: You are in a hallway facing towards the wall near the glass frame, take a slight right turn and go straight in the narrow corridor, and keep moving forward to the door, from there take a slight left turn and go towards the door near the rug, take a left turn and enter into the washroom near the washbasin. This is the endpoint.

40626.instruction: Turn left from the place you are standing and go straight. Now you will find an open door. Now exit from the door. Now turn left and go straight. You will find an open white chair. Now enter into the door. On the right side you will find glasses. On the left side you will find table with four chairs. Now go straight and turn right. You will find an open door. Now keep moving forward and turn right. You will find another open door. Now enter into the open door. That will be your final destination.

40627.instruction: You are in the corner of a room facing the white wall with paintings on top of it, turn left side and walk towards the open door, now turn to your right side and stand on the stair case, turn around and stand in front of the painting, move towards the entrance of the room which is just beside the painting, to your slight right side there is a small white fridge, move towards it,now turn right side and walk straight towards the closed glass door which is beside the blue cupboard,now turn right side and enter the room, now you are inside the room facing the empty photo frames and that is your destination.

40664.instruction: You begin in a bathroom. Turn all the way around, exit the bathroom, and head right in the hallway. Continue following the hall until you come upon the circular atrium with the clock across from you, and go through the archway to the right of that clock. You should enter... Another circular atrium! This one with more doorways. You'll take the one immediately to your right. Once you've taken that doorway you should be in a very small wooden room with a circular rug, and shelves on all three walls. Gaze upon the shelve with the two hourglasses and the globe. They remind you of your limited time on this Earth. That being said, once you are in that room, at the back left corner, kind of near the desk lamp, you're done.

40672.instruction: You will start out in a bedroom facing a bed. Turn around in the opposite direction. As you are turning, you will see a doorway to a bathroom and a doorway to a closet. Continue turning until you see the doorway out to the hall and go through that door to the hall. Once you are in the doorway, you will see stairs going down to your right. Straight ahead there is a wide open doorway into another room. Take four steps forward into that room. You will now be in another bedroom standing at the corner of the bed. Turn to your left and walk toward the nightstand that is on the left side of the bed. Then turn to your left again and walk into the bathroom, taking one step onto that white rug and then, actually a second step onto the white rug just ahead of you. Now you will see several doors in front of you. There is an open door into an empty closet, then a glass door into another room, and just to the right of that there is another open white door. Step into the open white door on the right side. This will be the room with the toilet. Then turn all the way back around and you want to take one step toward the glass door that is immediately on your right. You can't really see it, you can just kind of see the hinges of that door. You want to take one step right toward those hinges and once you are standing basically right next to that glass door looking into a room with a shower and a bathtub, that is where you will stop.

40787.instruction: moving forward from the right there is a path of the red carpet, moving further from that carpet , there is a indoor space where you find lot of  wall posters and a figurine at the very right corner and a table is placed beside it and there are some chairs on the floor with very antiquity ceiling of the room.

40788.instruction: You are facing towards a portrait, slightly turn right and go forward towards the opened door, go one step forward, here at the opened door you have reached the destination.

40852.instruction: "Okay now, you are facing towards the open door. Turn around, and move forward, you can see the curtain in front of you. Now slightly turn right, and move forward, you can see the window in front of you. Now slightly turn right, and move froward, you can see the narrow path way in front of you. Now go towards that narrow path way,and move forward until, you reach the mirror in front of you. Now slightly turn left, and move forward, you can see the bedroom on the left side. Now enter into that bedroom, and slightly turn right, you can see the chair in front of you. Now move forward, you can see the open door in front of you. Now enter into that room, you can see the mirror on the left side. Now, you have reached your destination."

40853.instruction: You will be facing a lamp and an open door in front of you. Turn around and walk towards the curtain on the right side of the TV. Make a right and move forward. Turn slightly right and move forward towards the opening arch. There will be a narrow walkway arch, continue walking all way down, till you reach a step. Once you reach a circular area facing a clock and a mirror, take a left from the mirror. There is an open door and a room with a bed in it, walk inside the room. Walk towards the open door on the right. Step inside the open door, which is a bathroom and stop.

41002.instruction: Starting off, we are facing a door and two paintings. To the left, there's two entrances on each side of the hallway that we're facing. To the right, there is the rest of the hallway that we're in. We're going to move in that direction and take the first left down the steps where we will see that there is an artifact, a knick-knack. And, further down, we will see that there is a large, um, pot-sculpture and a painting on the left. And there are two entrances, and we are going to enter the one that is the wine cellar. Inside the wine cellar, we see that there is wine. Moving further down the wine cellar, we come to another area where people can sit and drink the wine. This is where we will stop.

41040.instruction: We start off looking at some cleaning supplies. Turn around. Walk through the open doorway and walk through the open doorway where there's a white door. Take a step towards the um picture that's on top a cabinet. Turn to your left and you'll see a dining room table. Take a step onto that carpet where there's a dining room table. Turn back around and you'll see the stairs. Once you are at the third step  from the top of that stairs stop you're done.

41097.instruction: Now facing towards a white wooden rack, slightly turn to your right and move forward, now you are facing towards a bed, take right and exit the room through an open door, take left and move froward till the wall, you can see an open door to your right, enter into the room and move forward, you can see two grey colored chairs in-front of you, go near the chair with a pillow on it and stand, that's your end point.

41098.instruction: Right now you're facing towards the shelf. Now turn right, there is an open door in front of you, move towards the door and exit the room. There is a bed in front of you. Now turn right, there is an open door in front of you, move towards the door and turn right, step out of the room and turn left, move forward towards the open door which is to your left, there is an open door to your right, move towards the door and enter in to the room. There are two chairs in front of you, move forward and stand in front of the chairs and it will be your end point.

41233.instruction: You begin looking at two archways on either side of an oven. Use the archway to the left, and then step in front of the couch on the other side of that archway, between it and the fireplace. Continue with your forward momentum and head through the open double doors, and then through the large entryway on the right, through those doors. Once you're in that archway you should have a grill in front of you. Turn right and move past the microwave and toaster oven on your left through the open door. Continue going forward through another open door, and one last open door. There should be a light fixture hanging above you, and you should be in a hallway now. Turn left and continue down, past the bathroom and another door on your left which is closed, and finally the last door on your left before you enter the atrium should be a laundry room. Go into the laundry room and in front of the dryer. Once you're there in front of the dryer, you are done.

41269.instruction: You are in a bathroom. Turn all the way to your left, passing the shower and you will see a doorway where you take a step up onto the wood floor and a white bedspread on a bed. When you reach the bed, go left.  This will take you across the brown rug into a hall with another brown rug. Go straight down this hall, passing the large brown furniture on your left. This is also a bedroom, there will two beds on your left.  You want to stay on the carpet in the straight line you were taking. Continue going all the way to the wall past the second twin bed. Stop right where the one piece of wood on the lower part of the wall is slanting to the left. Stop there in front of it and you are still on the brown carpet. You have reached your destination.

41324.instruction: You are at the top of some steps.  You are going to continue going up and you are going to move forward into the room in front of you.  You are going to hop to your right landing in front of the fireplace and once you have landed right in front of the fireplace you are done.

41344.instruction: You are facing a vase and a railing. Slightly turn right and walk straight. You can see an open door. Stand at the entrance of the room, on the red carpet. This is the end point.

41345.instruction: This is the starting point and you're facing towards the curtains. Turn right. Walk towards the open door. You're standing near the open door. This is the end point.

41364.instruction: Begin in a bathroom. Exit through the door directly in front of you and head to the massage room on your right. Exit out and head down the hall towards the pool. Stop at the plants to the left of the pool.

41367.instruction: You begin facing a corner, turn around and take a step outside to exit the bathroom, turn to your left, take a step towards the staircase going down, take 2 steps to go down the staircase completely, turn to your left, take a step into the room on your left, turn slightly to your left again, take a step towards the door near the window, and then turn to your right and take a step into the pantry area you are done.

41440.instruction: You are facing towards the corner of the wall, move forward between the table and the wall. Then take a slight left walk near to the single sofa chair, and there you can see steps to your left side, walk through the steps move forwrad. You can see few more steps to your right side, climb down the steps completely then turn to your right, you are in front of the wall again turn to your right. Move forwrad  take a slight right you can see an opening, enter into that and take a immediate right room the wall which has switches on it. you will see a open white door, enter into that room walk through the bed, and stand in front of the glass window.

41441.instruction: You're facing towards a wall walk straight turn left and move towards the cream chair. Move forward on the left side, you can see the stairs walk beside the stairs move forward you can see the stairs to get down. Get down the stairs completely. Turn right, you are facing towards a wall. Turn right and walk towards the narrow path walk all the way from there turn right now in front, you can see the entrance enter into that room and walk straight towards the wall. From there enter the bedroom in front, you can see the windows walk towards the windows and stand. Here is your destination.

41577.instruction: You're going to start in the middle of a staircase. Go all the way down. Once at the bottom, turn right, and take your first right. You're going to jump over the brown and white chair towards the fireplace, just two steps. Once you are between the fireplace and a rectangular coffee table, you're done.

41640.instruction: Right now you are standing in an living hall. Make a slight right turn and move forward in front you can see a table with chairs stand near the table and make a slight right sorry left turn and move forward near to the entrance. From the entrance make a slight right in front you can see a portrait which is hanged to a wall. Move near to the portrait and make a slight right turn in front you can see a open door and move forward and make a slight left turn and move forward. On you are right side you can see a bed, on you are left side you can see a open door. Just enter into that room. On you are right side you can see a glass with sink, on you are left side you can see a open door. Turn to, you are left and enter into that room in front you can see a portrait which is hanged to a wall stand near the entrance of the door. Here we reached our destination.

41641.instruction: Okay now are in the middle of a room and to the left there is a TV and in front of you, there is a wall and to the right there is a sofa, which is black in color. Now turn right and move forward. Now to the right of you, there is a table and chairs around it and they are white in color and to the left there is a small round table and in front of you, there is a table. Now move towards that table and on the table there is a flower pot. Now turn left and in front of you, there is a open entrance. Now move towards that entrance and move forward towards the wall and on the wall, there is a frame. Now turn right and in front of you, there is a open entrance and now move forward into that entrance and now in front of you, there is a black chair and to the left there is a bed. Now turn left and move forward and in front of you, there is a flower pot and turn left and in front of you, there is a open entrance and now move forward and now to the right there is a wash basin and to the left there is a open entrance into a small room. Now enter into that entrance and now in front of you,there is a frame on the wall and to the right there is a flush toilet. Now stop here and this is your final destination.

41650.instruction: Right now your facing towards the dining table turn slightly left and exit the room. Enter into the opposite room keep moving in a forward direction. Then turn slightly right and move towards the cupboard which is in opposite to you. Stand in front of it, and this will be your final destination point.

41651.instruction: In front a table in a room turn left and exit this room.Go straight and come to the living room then turn  right side in front a desk beside a two picture on the wall.

41656.instruction: Begin in a family room. Facing a bunch of couches and a coffee table on a rug. Head past those couches towards a dining table. Once you get in front of the table turn around. you'll see arched doorways. Head though the one on your far right. Pass through anther arched door way towards you right into a circular room with a set of stairs. Head up 4 stairs and you're done/

41751.instruction: Now we are at the entrance of the room, turn around, move straight towards the bed and take slight right, move straight, stop at the entrance and we reached the destination.

41752.instruction: Okay, now you find yourself facing towards the staircase. Turn left and head inside the room and go straight by walking though the brown open door which is opposite to you and take a step forward and from this point turn slight right towards the brown open door and immediately turn right and stop at the entrance of the brown open door. This is your final point.

41778.instruction: You are facing towards the photo frames which are attached to the wall. Turn around and move towards the white open door. Turn right and there is a staircase in front of you. Climb the stairs and stand on the eighth step. That will be the end point.

41779.instruction: You are now facing towards the frames. From there take an about turn, go straight near to the door and take a right turn. Start walking straight and stand on the staircase.

41833.instruction: You are facing towards the stairs, turn around and move forward towards the sofa chair, which is in front of the bookshelf, now turn left and move towards the center table, now there is a center table in front of you, and there is a sofa chair on your right side, this is your end point.

41834.instruction: You are now facing to the staircase, from there take an about turn. Walk a few steps forward and stand beside the cream color, from there start walking straight and stand in front of the cream color sofa. Here take a left turn, walk a few steps forward and stand in front of the brown color table.

41895.instruction: You are now facing to the wall. Turn left and move forward, and enter into the open door room and stop facing the bed, and this is your end point.

41896.instruction: You are facing towards a wall, turn left and move towards the bed, now you are facing towards the bed, where to the right, you can find a window, that would be your end point.

41942.instruction: You are facing a kitchen and a sitting area, turn around now you should be facing a walk way where their are windows on your left and another sitting area on your right, so proceed straight ahead towards the pool table stay at the right side of the pool table and take a step towards the chair and the stool,when you are standing on the pool and the sofa turn right and take a step towards the coffee table and the sofa, hop over the table and move towards the another similar chair and the stool in front of it, then turn left towards the windows which has console table and the two candle holders, when you are standing in front of it turn left, go upstairs, once you are top of the stairs and at the upper level of the house and looking at the TV turn left and now proceed straight ahead towards the sitting area near the railing and the table which has checkers and on the left their will be sports gear  displayed, take few steps ahead after them and you are done.

41958.instruction: Now, you are facing towards the cupboard. Turn to your right and pass through the entrance. Now, take left from the bed. You will find an open white door. Enter through it and turn slightly right. Now, turn left where you can find an open entrance. Enter into it and turn right towards the white stool and that will be your end point where you are facing a window in front of you.

41959.instruction: You are facing towards the white color in front of you, turn right, go straight near the bed in front of you, turn left, there is an open door in front of you, go straight near the open door, slightly turn left and exit the bedroom, go straight, there is a bedroom on the left side, slightly turn left and enter the bedroom in front of you, slightly turn right, go straight near the stool which is beside the bed and stop in front of the window, this is your final destination.

41969.instruction: Starting in the bathroom, turn behind you and exit through the open brown door, walk through the door onto the rug, stop.

42143.instruction: you start in a bathroom, with a 2 pane window right behind you. in front of you, there will be an entrance to a room to your left and to your right there will be a door that is open. proceed towards the door. turn slightly to your right until you can see the inside of a glass shower. further behind the glass shower next to some windows will be a bathtub, painters next to the windows and a sink. proceed into the glass shower and we will end it here inside the shower.

42150.instruction: You are facing towards the wall, turn left and exit the room, slightly turn right and move a bit forward, turn left and move towards the wall, where to the left you can find a staircase, that would be your end point.

42151.instruction: You are facing towards the wall, turn left and exit the room, slightly turn to your right and move a bit forward, turn left and move towards the wall, where to the left you can find a staircase, that would be your end point.

42224.instruction: You begin looking towards a black board that says ART on top of it. Turn far to your left and move through the open double white doors. Once you're through those doors looking at the weird hanging tile thing, turn left and step out towards the wicker vases, I guess you'd call them? The weird tall wicker baskets that are sort of bottle-shaped. Once you're in front of those turn left and move to the front door with the large white carpet. Well, not really large. And not really white... Just, you're in front of thew double doors that are probably the entrance to the house. There's a consul table with a weird figure of a robed... Figure, on top of it, as well as a mirror, and to your right is the staircase. Once you're there, you are done.

42393.instruction: You are standing facing towards the sink. Turn left. Walk a few steps ahead and exit the room. Turn right. Walk a few steps ahead. Turn right. Enter into the bedroom. Turn left. Walk a few steps ahead. Turn left. You are now standing facing towards an open white door. Enter into the room. Stand in front of the white racks. You have reached your point.

42394.instruction: You're facing towards a mirror, now slightly turn to your left, and walk a few steps forward where you can see a bath tub on to your left, exit the washroom. Walk a few steps forward, and take right, you can see an open white door in front of you, enter the door, now you're in front of a bed, and slightly turn to your left, walk a few steps forward and you can see an open white door in front of you, enter the door and you are standing facing towards the white empty racks and that is your final destination.

42405.instruction: You are standing on a pink carpet looking at a sort of museum where their is a dining room on your right and their are ropes around, so turn left and walk on the floor and turn first right, now proceed straight ahead keeping the rooms on your left and right and walking on the pink carpet, crossing the areas and entering the threshold of a room straight ahead and once you are at the threshold of the bedroom, you are done.

42406.instruction: You are now facing towards a countertop, turn slightly left and move forward towards the dining table. Now turn right and move forward. Move forward till you have reached the grey coloured couch, turn left and move forward. You can see an open glass door, exit the room through the glass door, turn slightly left and move forward between the table and the chair and move forward. You are now in the garden area, turn slightly to your left and move forward. You have now reached the corner of the garden area and you are facing towards a fence and this is your end point.

42407.instruction: "Okay now, you are in the kitchen facing towards an island. Turn slightly left, and move forward, you can see the dining table in front of you. Now slightly turn right, and move forward until, you see the  sofa set in front of you. Now turn left, and move forward, you can see the open door in front of you, Now exit the room through that open door, you can see the dining table in front of you . Now slightly turn left, and move forward, you can see the stair case in front of you. Now go down through that stair case, you can see the garden area in front of you. Now slightly turn let, and move forward until, you reach the edge of the wall and the small trees in front of you. Now, you have reached your destination."

42480.instruction: We start off facing a desk with two chairs. Turn to your left. Take a step through the open double doors. It will now put you in another doorway so turn to your left and take a step back into the hallway. Turn to your right. Take two steps forward. You will now be in like a circular area with a violin to your right on the wall and you're done.

42515.instruction: You are standing in a living room facing two chairs. Turn all the way to the left and behind us.  Walk out into that hall to the left of the three wood glass windows. Take a left and walking down a hall with glass on your left and your right. Forward until you see a white vase pot at the end of the hall on a desk.  once you reach the desk take a right into that opening. Take your first left and you will be into another hall. At the end of the hall you will see a large glass cabinet with three items on top. Turn right at the cabinet and you will be in a bedroom. Once you are in the bedroom turn left and go to between the desk and the black bed going left and take the opening out of the room through the arch.  You will be in a bathroom. Walk to the blue rug in front of the sink. Turn right and walk straight to stand in front of the two blue towels at the wall. You will see a shower on your left and a toilet on your right. You are at your destination.

42542.instruction: You are facing a bed.  You are going to go towards the foot of the bed.  And you will make a right exiting the bedroom.  You are going to walk down the walk way passing the stairs on your right.  You are going to enter into a bedroom.  There will be a sun burst mirror on the wall to your right and the bed to your left.  You are going to turn left so the bed is on the right hand side of you.  And you are going to enter that walkway and step onto the white rug.  You are going to go straight across the rug and enter that small door.  And you are going to stop right in the doorway and you will see you are facing a small empty walk in closet and you are done.

42756.instruction: You are facing towards the window right now, turn to your left you can find a mirror infront of you, go near the mirror, turn left and exit the washroom, turn right, you can find an opened door, go near the opened door and exit the bedroom, turn right, to your left you can find an iron stand, move forward  till you see a fiddle on the wall which is infront of you, turn left and move forward towards the cabinet, where there is a vase on it, turn left and move forward, to your left you can find a half opened door, enter into the half opened  door, that would be your end point.

42757.instruction: Right now you are facing in front of the commode, now turn left and keep moving forward and stand in front of the mirror, now turn left and step out of the bathroom, now you will enter into the bedroom, go near the bed, and now exit from the bedroom and go straight, on the right side you will find corridor, keep moving forward, there you will find a guitar on the wall, from there turn left and keep moving forward, on the left side you will find piano table, now go straight and again take left and go straight, on the left side you will find a single door open, in that room you will find clothes, enter into the room, that will be your final destination.

42758.instruction: You are facing towards the door. Take a right turn and walk towards the door. Now take a slight right turn and walk towards the frame, which is placed on the wall. Now take a right turn and walk towards the open arch. Now take a left turn and walk towards the chairs. Now take a slight left turn and walk towards the open arch. Now take an immediate right turn and walk towards the kitchen. Now walk straight towards the house plant. Now you are facing towards the house plant. This is your destination point.

42759.instruction: You are facing towards a glass window, turn right, walk towards the sofa chair, now walk towards the wall, turn right, walk towards the first arch, turn left, walk towards the four chairs, take a few steps ahead and turn right, enter into the kitchen, keep walking straight towards the arch, step into it. You are now in a living room, walk towards the potted plant. You have reached your destination.

42796.instruction: Right now you are in front of the wall. Now turn left and go straight. Now turn right. You will find narrow opening. Now keep moving forward until you reach the kitchen area. Now turn left and go straight. On the left side you will find oven. Now turn right and keep moving forward. Now turn left and go straight. You will find closed glass door in front of you. Now turn right and go straight. You will find dining table in front of you. Now slightly turn left and go straight. On the right side you will find dining table. On the left side you will find mirror. That will be your final destination.

42797.instruction: You are facing towards a wall with a portrait on it, turn slightly left and move forward. Now turn to your right and you can see an open entrance, move forward, pass through it and there is another open entrance right in front of you. Move forward passing through it. Turn slightly to your left and move forward. Now turn to your right and you can see two kitchen counters, move forward walking in between them. Now turn to your left and move forward. Now turn right and move forward. You can see an open arch. Turn slightly to your left and enter through it. You are now standing between brown coloured cabinets and a table with many chairs and this is your destination.

42828.instruction: You are facing towards a rack on which towels are hanged, turn around and you can see an open door, exit the room through the door and move forward towards the wall. Now turn to your left and pass through the open entrance right in front of you. You can see paintings on the wall on your left side, move forward and turn slightly right. You can see a staircase, get down the steps and move forward. Now turn slightly right and move forward. Now turn around and you can see a narrow passage, move forward. There is an open entrance in front of you, pass through it. Turn to your right, you can see an open door, enter through it. You are now in a bedroom, turn slightly left and walk towards the bed. You are now facing towards a potted plant which is on a round table and this is your end point.

42829.instruction: You are in the art room facing towards the sheet stand turn around and move forward to  the white door and enter into the hallway and take right turn move forward up to the staircase near the paintings, and take slightly right turn near the staircase and move forward go down all the way through the staircase near the table in the door, take right turn and move forward go straight up to the the empty vessels in the corridor. Keep moving forward and enter into the another hallway near the paintings and the doors, take right turn and enter into the other room through the white door. You are at the entrance of the bedroom, take slightly left and go towards the bedroom near the plant pot and near mirror, this is the destination.

42831.instruction: You'll start in a hallway facing a statue, to your left looks like a library. To your right is another room. You're going to walk through that door on your right. In here you'll see a bed to your left and some suitcases on the floor to your right. You're going to continue walking straight to that wall in front of you. When you get to this wall, you should see the last window to your left, and you're done.

42912.instruction: Right now you are facing a wall, turn around where you can see a dining table pass through the dinning table towards your right there is an opening to a kitchen now you are in the entrance of kitchen area  move here, there is a pathway move forward where you will find a refrigerator to your left and stove to your right and move forward exit the kitchen room now take slight right now you are into a bed room where you find a white bed and a chair at the corner in front of you move towards the chair this is your destination point.

42913.instruction: You are facing towards the wall. Turn right and move forward. Turn right and move towards the wall. Turn left and move towards the black couch. Turn right and move towards the open entrance which is in front of you. Now turn left and walk straightly in the hallway till you find an open sliding door in front of you. Slightly turn right and move forward by passing through the sliding door. Now you are standing in front of a bedroom. Walk through the open door and enter into the bedroom. Now walk straightly towards the chair. That will be the end point.

42916.instruction: You are in a washroom facing towards a commode, turn around, exit the washroom and walk towards the white carpet. Slightly turn left and enter into the bedroom, walk towards the brown cabinet with a mirror. Stand facing towards the cream chair at the corner of the room. You have reached your destination.

42917.instruction: Now we are in the washroom, exit from the washroom, and take left, go forward, and take right go near to the bed, and we reached the destination.

42918.instruction: We're going to start facing a bed and you're going to turn towards your right so that you can see an opened door that leads to a hallway not the bathroom. So the door on the right hand side, so head towards that door. If you're looking outside you're going to see the railing for the staircase head towards the railing Then you're going to go down the stairs all the way down. Then once you reach the bottom of the stairs you're going to turn towards your right and take those two steps down and then you should have an opened door right in front of you that leads to a toilet. Walk towards the door and then inside the room so that you're standing right in front of the sink... well in front of the sink and kind of in between the sink and the toilet. This will be your finishing point inside of the bathroom.

42925.instruction: You are now facing towards a glass door, turn to your left and walk straight till you reach the wall. Now turn to your left, you can see a black coloured couch, walk towards it, take a slight right and walk in the walkway. Move forward, now turn to your right and move forward. Now turn to your right and enter through the open entrance where you have a wooden shelf on your left side and a wash basin on your right, move forward. Move straight, you can see a gas stove on your left and  a wash basin on your right, move forward. Now there is an open entrance on your left, stand just before the entrance and that is your end point.

42926.instruction: You're standing near the wide entrance. Turn behind and walk through the hallway. As you pass through the mirror which is on the right side, turn to right. Now again turn right and walk into the room beside the portrait. Move forward, go and stand at the end of the white dining table which is served with food. This would be your end point.

42927.instruction: You are facing towards a portrait, turn right and move forward, to the left, you can find a closed door, move a bit forward, turn left and move towards the opened door which is infront of you, move a bit forward, slightly turn right and move towards the opened door, now you are at the entrance of a washroom, move a bit forward, where to the left you can find two windows and to the right, you can find a wash basin, that would be your end point.

42928.instruction: You are facing towards the photo frame and the wall. Turn around and move forward, and take next left and enter into the open arch where in there are photo frames to your left and right. Enter into the open door room and move forward. Turn slightly right and move towards the curtains, and enter into the open door which is a bathroom and stop facing towards the shower room, and this is your end point.

42942.instruction: You're looking into a hallway. Continue down the hallway. Keep straight and, once you've reached the dark couch, take a right and stand next to the TV. Once you're looking at the TV, you're done.

42986.instruction: Now you are facing a hallway in fornt of you, you will need to walk through this hallway. Walk straight forward until you have reached a round area where you have a wall clock and a mirror in front of you. In this area you will need to walk towards the entrance that you have to your right. Once you have passed this entrance you will reach another round area and here you will need to turn to your left taking up the stairs that you have to your inmediately left. Once you have reached the upper level stepping on the first round carpet, you are going to see another hall in front of you, you will need to walk through this hall, it's more like a messani. At the end you can see a plant and a few vases to both of your sides entering another hall that leads you to a bedroom. Now that you are in the bedroom you have a big mirror to your right and there's a  chair in front of that mirror. You will need to walk towards that chair. Now you have that chair to your right and an ottoman to your left and you have 2 doors that leads you to the balcony. You are going to step outside of this room through the door that you have to your right of the room, walking between the bed and the 2nd chair. Once you have reached the balcony, the entrance for the balcony you are going to step in the middle of the balcony having the pool in front of you and the door that you used to enter the balcony to your right and the other door to your left.

43038.instruction: Look around, you're currently standing on top of a brown staircase. In front of you, you see a white closed door. Turn around, and face right. Take a step forward to the entrance of this living room. Once you're at the entrance of this living room slash kitchen, take one large step forward until the marble island counter top is directly to your left. Once the marble island counter top is directly to your left, you're done.

43156.instruction: Turn around and move forward into the house, take left near the dining table, and move forward near to the door and enter into another room, after entering into another room, take left and move forward, and take left near to the washbasin, and end near the washbasin.

43157.instruction: You're facing the wall, turn towards your left, go few steps forward, you'll find table, and chairs, then turn left, enter the room, and go few steps forward, then turn left, again turn left, you'll find white table, turn left, then you'll find white mats on the ground, on the last mat you'll find your destination.

43203.instruction: Right now you are facing towards a wall, turn left and exit the room through an open door in front of you and turn right and walk straight till you reach the wall and turn left and enter into the open door which is a bed room and turn right and move forward towards the wall and turn right, you have an open door, enter into that door which is a closet room and this is your final point.

43204.instruction: You are facing towards the wall, turn left and come out from the open door, turn right and walk towards the wall, left side you will be able to see an open door, enter inside the open door, you will see a white bed, and right side there will be one more open door, enter inside and stand in the middle of the room, you can see empty cupboards and shelfes, its your destination.

43222.instruction: You are facing towards the open arch, turn slight left and move towards it. Turn slight right and move towards the photo frame. Turn slight left and move forward. You are facing towards the open arch, turn left and move towards the glass table. Turn around and move into the kitchen area. You are facing towards the kitchen area, turn right and move towards the window. You are facing towards the window, turn left and take few steps ahead. You are standing next to the chairs, which is your final destination.

43223.instruction: at present we are in a dining room where there is a dining table to our left. Go straight from the dining table, turn slight to your left go straight and then turn slight to your left again where there is a glass table with flower vase on it and two chairs. Turn back from that and there is a kitchen area with brown cabinet pass through that then turn right from the kitchen area go out from the kitchen area take left move forward and that will be your final destination.

43260.instruction: You begin facing a door, turn to your right and exit out, then turn slightly to your left, next to the bedroom in front of you, you will barely be able to see a table, go towards that, it is a dining table, then turn to your right and between the lining that divides the patio and the living room, there is a gray chair with a blue and white pillow, take one last step towards that chair and you're done.

43365.instruction: You are facing towards the door, turn right and move towards the chair. Turn slight left and move towards the open door. Turn slight right and move towards the open arch. Turn slight left you can see an open door to your left, move towards that door. Turn left and enter into the room. Turn slight right and move towards the bath tub. You are facing towards the bath tub, which is your final destination.

43366.instruction: Okay right now you are facing towards the brown door. Turn to your right and you see sofa in front of you. Walk straight towards the sofa. Now turn slightly left and walk straight towards the bed and you see an open arch way in front of you beside the lamp. Walk into that archway. Now you see another arch which is open to your left side. Enter into that room and go and stand near the bathtub to the right side. That is the end point.

43368.instruction: You are in the kitchen facing towards the countertop. Turn left and exit the kitchen. There is a wooden cabinet on your left side. Turn right and walk straightly in the hallway till you find an open arch on your left side. Turn left and walk through the open arch. Now walk straightly till you find an open door in front of you. Slightly turn right and enter into the room by passing through the open door. Now you are in the bedroom. There is a glass window on your left side and a bed on your right side. Slightly turn right and walk straightly towards the open door. Walk through the open door and enter into the room. Now you are in the washroom. There are two glass windows on your left side and a commode on your right side. That will be the end point.

43369.instruction: You are inside the kitchen, in front of you there is a table and there is a flowerpot on the table, turn around until you see an open door, go straight, now you will enter the room in which telephone is present beside you, turn your right side, go straight into the walkway, in front of you there is a pot, now turn to your left side, go straight, there is an open door in front of you, enter the door, go straight, in front of you there is a white color sofa and to your left side there is a bed, slightly turn to your right side, go straight and cross the bed, there is an open door in front of you, exit the bedroom, now you are in the bathroom, beside you there is a towel, stop there, to your right side there are three mats placed on the floor and the toilet sink and wash basin on your right hand side, stop here, this is your final destination.

43476.instruction: You're starting in a pantry (there's a lot of stuff in here), looking toward a black cabinet. Take a step toward that black cabinet. Take a left, going out the white door with the two glass panels. You'll pass the pile of papers on your right. When you're in this doorway, across from you will be a short, beige cabinet with two glass doors and a light hanging above it. Take a step toward that cabinet. Then turn left. You'll see two doors. Take the one on the left with the dining table. Step onto the rug to the right of the dining table. This will take you near a back door with windows. Turn left so the dining table is on your left and take one step up to the cardboard box that says "Large" on it. You're done.

43563.instruction: Turn around, you can find a stair case, go up the stairs, enter the room which is infront of you, where there is a statue on the table, you can find a couch to the left of the statue, go near the couch, turn right, you can find a fire camp over there, go near the left of the fire camp, turn right, exit the room, you can find a portrait your left and card boxes to your right, turn right and exit room, to your left you can find a washroom, move forward and stand in between the stairs which is to your left and the two rooms which is to your right, that would be  your end point.

43564.instruction: Right now you're standing on a staircase facing a wall. Turn around you can see an opened door in front of you, move towards that opened door and enter into that room, where on the left side you can see few portraits on the wall and in front of you, you can see a window with a couch in front of it. Move towards the couch and turn towards you're right side. Here you can see an opened door, move towards that opened door and take a right turn. Now you're facing a room which has a carpet and a idol in front of you. Move little forward and take a right turn where you can see an opened door. Walk through and exit the room. Now you will come across an another door walk through that door an exit the room. Right now you're standing in front of an opened door where on the left side you can see a staircase. Stand on the red carpet in between the opened door's and the staircase. That would be the end point.

43577.instruction: We start off looking at a fireplace. Turn to your left. Stay on the brown floor walkway keeping the couch on your right and walk straight until you've walked into the kitchen. You'll be at the corner of the counter top and turn to your right. You're going to hop over the white tile and into the room with a small glass table and two chairs.
