47849.instruction: you are looking into the kitchen. turn right until you see a wooden door in front a glass door that leads outside. walk to the full wooden door. turn left, into the bathroom. walk straight to the next door passing the sink and the toilet to your left. turn right, exit the room into the gym. at the door of the gym turn left and exit the gym thru the archway crossing over the work out equipment. face the room and there will be doors in front of you and windows on both sides of the door and a TV to the right. turn left and walk along the couch past the painting of a country side turn right before the archway, pass the light switches on your left. enter thru the middle passageway but go diagonally into the dining room to the right. once you are in the room that has a glass table two round chairs and a red couch turn left so the couch is behind you and you are facing a long dining room table. walk to the right of the table. stand in front of the window. you can see the grill outside.

47958.instruction: You are facing towards the white chair at the dining table. Move forward from the backside of the chairs. Now, take right from the dining table. You will find a door on your left side. Enter through that door. Now, you are entered into the kitchen. Take right, go straight until you reach an entrance at the right side. Enter through it. Move forward. On your left side, you will find stairs. Cross the stairs and move left. There will be portraits on your right side of the wall. Move forward. To the left, you can find an open door. Enter through that door. Now, you are in the washroom facing the washbasin. That will be your end point.

47959.instruction: Right now you are standing beside the glass table with chair. Move forward and make a slight right turn in front you can see a open entrance, just enter into that open entrance. Right now you are in a kitchen area move forward and  make a slight right turn on you are left side you can see a sink plat from. Move forward until where you can see a entrance on you are right side, Turn to you are right and enter into that entrance and move forward and make a slight left turn on you are right side you can see a portrait which is hanged to a wall, move forward through the portrait until where you can see a open door on you are left side, just enter into that room and stand in front of a sink. Here we reached our destination.

47962.instruction: Facing the coffee table, turn 90 degrees to your right and walk down the hall, keeping the seating area on your left. You'll bypass another seating area on the left with a standing lamp close to you. The second archway on the right, walk into that archway. In front of you will be brown double doors lining the right side of the hall. Walk down the left keeping those doors on the right. You'll go under one archway and under the second archway and veer left of the kitchen island. Walk between the kitchen island on the right and the stove on the left. Continue walking, keeping the kitchen island on your right, you'll walk towards another counter top with a sink as well as some other tea kettles and such on it. Once you walk up there turn to the left, you'll walk into a room with a small breakfast table. Turn left and head outside. Walk across the outside towards the opposite door with the floor mat. Walk in through that door and walk one step inside so that you're standing to your left is a dining room table and you're next to the head of the table, to the right is a couple brown doors with window panes, you're done.

48014.instruction: You are starting in the corner of a room. Looking out into the room there are two doors. Go through the one on the right. From here you can see a landing with a stairwell. Take one step towards the stairwell. Look away from the stairwell. Take the first door on the left from the room you just entered. You're not going to walk through that door. Just take a step toward it. Walk down the hall. And when the hall dead ends turn left. The end point is two steps, one step into the room. Near the, near the doorway.

48059.instruction: We're in a bathroom, and we're facing towards a shower area, on the right there's a beaded curtain, turn slightly to the right, walk towards that curtain and exit towards what appears to be a spa area, on your right there's a swimming pool and on the left there's an open door, take a few steps forward, on your left there are two chairs, walk past those two chairs... You'll be facing towards a reception area, on the left there's a counter and on the right there's a coffee table which is surrounded by three chairs, you'll be facing towards that area, and that's your destination.

48066.instruction: You begin looking towards shelves with pictures of butterflies on most of them. Well, not most of them, but some of them. Turn to your left and move through the white double doors. Step out and turn right, and you should see a bathroom. Move into the bathroom and as soon as you're in the door and can see the oval shaped mirror, you're done.

48117.instruction: You are facing towards the wall. Turn around and now you are facing towards the closed white doors. Slightly turn left and enter into the open room. Now you are in the bedroom. Slightly turn right and move towards the glass window. Turn right and walk through the open door. There are white shelves on either side of you. Move a bit forward. Now you are standing at the entrance of a washroom. Walk straightly towards the towel hanger. Turn right and move towards the wall. Now you are in the shower room. That will be the end point.

48118.instruction: Now you're facing towards the wall, turn around and slightly move left towards the bed room, enter into the bed room, from the door take right turn, go straight till the table, turn left and exit the bed room, towards your left there are empty cupboards and in front of there is a washroom, enter in to the washroom, go straight towards the wall, in front of you there are towels and towards your left there is a toilet seat, turn right and go straight till the wall, its a shower room, this would be your end point.

48249.instruction: Starting in the corner of the room, walk towards the end of the long brown table and then turn right and walk towards the open doorway stopping just before it . Make a left into the kitchen behind the counter top, Continue forward through the open doorway in front of you. Turn left once you're through that open doorway down this very short hall past the picture and them immediately right towards the brown slotted door. once you are just before the doormat, stop.

48267.instruction: You begin facing a large window with big curtains on it turn on your right and now you are standing on the pin carpet and looks like a museum. Go outside the two open doors moving straight. Now you are in a hallway turn left when you are facing a pink chair in front of you turn a slight right and move near the across the large wall which has some painting on it go at the back of the wall and now stop just in front of a two red chairs which has a boundary you can not cross and two tables which has two lamps sorry two candle stands on it and their are white curtains as well on the wall this is where your destination ends.

48311.instruction: Okay, now you are facing towards a bookshelf, slightly turn to your right and exit through the arch shape entrance, which is in front of you. Now slightly turn to your left and in front of you there is wide arch shape entrance, go straight through the wide arch shape entrance passing the staircase, which is on the left side. Now you are standing at the entrance, walk straight passing the couch, which is on the right side until you reach in front of an open entrance and that is the end point.

48312.instruction: Right now you are in a room facing towards the rack, turn right and move forward and exit the room, now turn slight left where you find staircase and an entrance beside it, move towards the staircase and enter the entrance, which is next to the staircase on the right side, enter into the room, move forward until you reach a glass door which is opened in front of you, stand at the entrance of the glass door this is your final destination.

48374.instruction: You're standing inside a shower and in front of a bathroom sink, walk towards the bathroom sink in front of you and turn left. And head to the bedroom past the walk-in closet. Once you're standing in front of the bed, turn to your left, and walk towards the door ahead, now turn left and you'll see stairways going down and there's an open door on the right side, now turn slightly right and you'll see there's another doorway that leads to another bedroom. Walk towards that bedroom and stand in the. Once you're in the bedroom you'll turn right and you will walk to the wall in front of you, which has two small windows. And once you're in front of that wall with the small windows you'll turn right and you'll see there's another walk-in closet with shelves that have some sort of metal tiny sculpture or something like that. Walk towards those shelves and stand right in front of them. In the closet. That's your spot.

48402.instruction: Starting off you are in a junction hallway with a vase and a tapestry in front of you. Turn around you will see a hallway going downward with paintings on either side of the wall. Go down the hallway until you see a living area on the right. Continue down the hallway, turn to your right and there is a stairwell going down, descend the stairs. At the landing at the bottom there is a tall vase. Turn right there on the far end of the hallway that is open. Go through this hallway onto the mat on the ground, you're in a garage. Turn immediately right you will see a black car and an open area go to this open area you will see a garage door. Turn left look at the car to the left of the car approach the driver side door. That is your destination.

48422.instruction: Slide left towards the backside of the couch and walk straight along the path, now slide right towards the table which has a glass top and tow chairs in front of it, now slide left behind the chairs and walk straight towards the another table, now slide left and walk straight along the path and move straight and stop near the another table which is towards the left and a glass door towards your right and you have reached your destination.

48423.instruction: You are in a hall facing towards the sofa chair, turn to your left and move forward again move forward, move forward towards the kitchen, turn right and move towards the carpet, turn left move forward again move forward towards the dining table, turn left and move forward again move forward towards the closed door, this is your final destination.

48463.instruction: Starting at the top of some steps, you're going to look right, and see a looks like a living room. You're going to walk over to that carpet and you're going to stand in the middle of the carpet to the left of that ottoman. Here with the ottoman to your right you'll see a cabinet to your left or a dresser to your left. You're going to walk passed that and now you should see a small chair to your left and the two chairs to your right , you're still going to be on the carpet . You're going to walk to the edge of the carpet, look left and you'll see the stairs going up. When you get here walk up the stairs. Once you get to the top of the stairs you should see a bed and an open door. If you look to the right it looks like you can see the end of another bed. You're going to walk passed that cabinet to your left. Leaving the first bed behind you, and the railing will be to your right. You're going to continue along the path, and you'll see there's actually two beds to your left and a small chair to your right. Pass the first bed, and walk pass the second bed to the edge of the carpet and stop.

48529.instruction: You will start by facing two open doorway. Turn to your right and take one step on the doorway on your right. Now turn around and take one step on the doorway to the left of you earlier and now is one your right. Once you're standing on the doorway of the washroom then you're done.

48552.instruction: OK now you are facing a glass window and a white table with 2 figures and a small vase with flowers and you will need to turn to your left. In front of you, you will see a twin bed, you will need to stand, step in that bedroom, walking straight fwd, stand in the front of the bed then turn to your left to enter the next room, which is a hallway. And then you will need to walk straight fwd until the end and then turning to the right, we are not taking the stairs. So, we are going to walk straight fwd to step in this other bedroom. This bedroom has the bed to your left and the dresser to your right. You will need to turn to your left, to your left, so the bed will be to your right, walk towards the nightstand and then turn to your left. And here, we are going to walk across this next area, crossing the carpet and entering, not to the closet in front of you but to the room that is next to the closet, in front of you. You can see a shower, to your, inside of this room and when you step at the door of this bathroom, you can see a, at the end of the bathroom, there's a white bathtub. And you will need to jump inside the shower, and this is going to be your end.

48568.instruction: You'll startout facing a piece of workout equipment used for rowing. A rowing machine as well as a window to your right. There will be a small drawer on the right side as well. As you face forward, you'll see a treadmill on your left. You're gonna go straight ahead toward the opening leading to an open seating area. Before getting to the long couch, make a left. Continue through the opening ahead of you. Make a right turn right after going through that opening. You'll see a kitchen area on your left, make a right turn and go straight ahead towards the small dining area with a set of two chairs a chandelier in the middle. There will be a glass table set with a flower pot and red candle on top. You're gonna veer to your left of that table set. As you walk down the walk way, you'll see another flower vase directly ahead of you, with a semi circle counter right on the wall. There will be a lamp right above that. There will be a long opening entrance to your right. You're gonna veer right into a larger dining area. This dining area is gonna have a long wooden table with chairs, as well as a chandelier. There'll a long square rectangular windows with long curtains. You're gonna veer just to the left of that table set. You'll see a mirror on the left of the wall. There will be a bronze statue of a horse and three candles on top of the drawer. This is your end destination.

48593.instruction: Begin facing a shelf. Turn around enter the bedroom. Head to the foot of the bed. Turn round head to the door and you're done.

48614.instruction: You are facing towards the wall. There is a dinning table towards your left and cabinet towards your right. Slightly turn right. Walk straight and enter inside the arch that is in the front. Turn left and walk a few steps ahead. Turn right and enter inside the arch. You are now standing beside the stone pillar. Turn around and enter inside the arch that is in the front. You are now standing beside the oval shaped glass table. Turn right and walk a few steps ahead. Turn right. Walk straight till you reach the painting in the front. Turn left. Walk a few steps ahead and turn right. Enter inside the arch. Slightly turn left and walk a few steps ahead. Stand in front of the gym equipment. There is a cupboard towards your left side. You have reached your point.

48615.instruction: You are standing beside the dining table move forward, you will see an open entrance enter into that. Then take a left turn move forward and enter into the open are to your right side, turn around and you can see two chairs in front of you go near to them. Then take a right turn walk near to the curtain then again turn to you right side, walk along the bench until you reach the wall with a frame. Then turn to your left side walk back side of the sofa,  then turn to your right where there is open space that is a gym area and go and stand beside the wooden cub board.

48732.instruction: Now you are in a corner of the room, turn left and you can see an exercise machine. Move forward, turn slight left and you can see a sofa. Move towards the sofa, now move forward and turn right. You can see an entry into the other room, move towards it. On your left you can see a dinning table, go and stand near the chair which is in front of you. On your slight right, you can see a window beside the dining table, go near the window and we have reached our destination.

48733.instruction: You are now facing towards a wall and in a gym room, turn to your left and walk towards the open arch. Take a slight left and exit through the arch. You are now standing behind a huge white coloured couch. Turn slightly left and move forward. There is an open entrance right in front of you. Turn to your right and move forward, take a slight left and pass through the open entrance which is right in front of you and enter the open entrance on your right side, move forward. You can see another open entrance on your left, pass through it and move forward. Walk towards the corner of the table. You are now standing between the corner of the table and a wooden cupboard on your right side, facing towards a glass window and this is your end point.

48780.instruction: You begin in a shower. Turn completely around and move to the left side of the toilet. Turn left and exit the bathroom into a closet. Continue forward into a bedroom and once you hit the bed, turn left and exit the door, into a hallway with a staircase. You're going to move around the right side of the stair's railing, towards the end of the hall. At the end of the hall you're turning left and continuing into a mostly empty room. Once you are standing in the middle of the empty room, you are done.

48801.instruction: You're standing in the kitchen of a house and you are facing the kitchen island with four black wood chairs, if you look to the left you're going to see a dining room and you're going to walk towards that dining room. Keep walking into the dining room until you're standing right in front of the dining room table, which has many chairs, and to your right side you will see a pink-ish couch and another small room, which seems to be a coffee room. Walk into that room once you're standing in the room with the red or kind of pink couch, you will see there's a coffee table and two chairs, and in front of you,  you will see a hallway leading to the living room, walk pass the table and into that area, and once you're standing in the living room, to the left you're going to see a painting and a window with curtains to your left, and right in front of you there's going to be a chimney and the living room couches that are beige. Walk towards the chimney and step in the white carpet in front of the chimney, and that's it.

48821.instruction: begin in  toilet. Exit the toilet and take a right heading through the arched hallway towards a kitchen island. Once you get to the kitchen island take a left. head out the big arched doorway. Take a right into the dining area. Head past the kitchen table towards the tall lamp. At the lamp make a left and you've arrived.

48838.instruction: You are going to start facing a staircase going up. Turn 45 degrees to the left and walk all the way down. You are going to pass a wooden pillar on your right, and take two more steps forward, and you are going to turn to the right. Take one step towards the right of the big console table that you can see on the left, and once you are there, you should be facing the big console table with some figures on top. If we turn around, we are going to see the living room and a coffee table with a candle on top. Once you are there, you are done.

48862.instruction: You're facing towards a wall. Turn slight left and move forward. On the right side, you can see a wash room. Enter into the wash room and stand here is your destination.

48863.instruction: You can find yourself facing towards a wall, which has a wall painting. Turn slightly towards your left, and walk near to the bathtub. And enter the very first room, which has a commode and a small table. And stand in front of the window. This is the final endpoint. You have reached the destination.

48889.instruction: Now you are facing to the glass door.Turn around move a bit straight and turn right,you can find stairs take the stairs go up turn right, there is a open door,go towards the door you'll be entering into the washroom and there is a open door again,enter into it,corner of the room you can stop.

48890.instruction: Now you are facing towards the glass doors. Turn to your right. Move forward beside the sofa chairs. Turn right. Move forward. Turn left. You can see the stairs, go up the stairs. Move forward to the brown table in front of you. Turn right. Go in between the bed and open door. Turn right. Go into the open door. You can see another open door in front of you. Go towards the open door. Go through the open door. Move forward and stand near the wooden wall in the corner and beside the bed, where you have a white chair and a light in right of you. You have reached your destination.

48944.instruction: You are facing towards a white wall, turn around and go forward, slightly turn right and go forward, go forward and get down those steps, go forward towards the entrance which is on to the right, turn right and pass through the entrance, here facing towards a brown cupboard you have reached the destination.

48988.instruction: You are facing towards the cupboard. Take a right turn and walk towards the opposite room. Now enter into the room. Take a slight right turn and walk towards the window, which is your destination point.

48989.instruction: You are facing towards a small brown stool. There is a sofa towards your right side. Turn right and walk straight towards the open entrance. There is a TV towards your left side. Continue walking straight and stand in front of the window. There are glass doors towards your right side and a dinning table towards your left side. You have reached your point.

49030.instruction: You are in a bathroom or actually in a spa. in front of you there should be two blue lights or blue windows heading above a small pool. take head down the stairs, turn to the left and you should see a bar, a reception desk laid out in front of you with a telephone and in front of that reception desk there should be a small wooden table. you are going to walk in between the wooden table and the bar and you are done.

49044.instruction: You are going to start facing a black fence. Turn to the right and follow the concrete pathway. Turn to the right again and take one big step until you are in front of the opening. Turn right and take the skiding door that is open on your left. Go inside the house. Walk in front of the TV towards the fridge. Once you are close to the fridge and the kitchen area, you are going to turn slightly to the right, jump over the kitchen island towards the kitchen stove. Facing the kitchen stove, you are gong to turn to the left and take one step towards the wall. Once you are right in front of the wall, if we turn to the right, we are going to see the steps going up, if we turn to the left, we are going to see the TV and the living room area, and behind us should be the kitchen and the firdge. You are done.

49046.instruction: You're standing in a red carpeted hallway in a display room. Turn around there is a path going left and a path going right go right. Keep going down that path on the right through a door that has a green sign above it. Step just past the door and stop, you'll be in a room with a dining table int eh center and a chandelier above it.

49060.instruction: You are in the passage facing the grill, turn left and there are few red color pots on the floor, pass through them, now you are in the entrance of a passage with windows on either side, walk straight and exit that passage, there is a light blue color chair in front of you, go towards it, stand in between the two blue chairs, now there is a narrow passage on the right side, go towards it, now there is a photo frame on the wall in front of you, turn right side and move forward, there is a mirror to you on the right side and two rooms on the left side, go to the right side room which has a white carpet on the floor, to your straight there is a small window and a table below which has a white hat on it, go and stand near that table and that is your destination.

49061.instruction: You're currently standing on a carpet, turn slightly left and you can see a narrow passage, walk past the door and you have a plant on your right side and a small passage into the bedroom.Take a few steps straight, now you are in the bedroom.You have a mirror on your right side and take a few steps onto the carpet straight, you can see two cushioned chairs, walk between the chairs and now you can see a bed on your right side, walk beside the bed, you have a door on your left side, pass the door and you have an entrance straight, walk past it.Take a few steps, you have a room with a carpet, walk on the carpet, take slightly right and you can see two doors.Walkpast the door on your right side.There are wooden cabinets with a carpet.Take a few more steps straight and you have reached your destination.

49097.instruction: okay,moving from the living space on the very right corner there is a room with table and chairs and windows at the right side on the left there is window with carpet on the floor and a wall frame which is attached to the wall.

49098.instruction: Okay, so you are facing a couch. Walk straight, in the right there is an open door, exit the room. In the front you can see an open door. Enter into that room. Slightly turn left and walk straight towards the lamp. Now in the right you have a fire place, a portrait and a lamp. In the opposite there is a statue. This is the end point.

49102.instruction: You're standing in a TV room with two sofas one on each side, walk towards the one on the right and then turn left and walk out of that TV room through the doorway in front of you. Now turn left and you'll see stairways going up on your left side. You'll go upstairs all the way once you reach the second floor turn left and in front of you you'll have three open doors. Walk straight and then enter the door in the center which leads to a bathroom. There's a large white bathtub to your right side and there's a towel hanging on the wall there, and once you're standing after the tub and in front of the towel, with the sink on your left, you have reached your spot.

49111.instruction: You are in a shower room, turn towards your slight left and walk through the glass door in front of you. keep moving forward and walk beside the bathtub, which is on your left. In front, you can find a brown door, go pass through the brown door and you enter into your bedroom. On your left, you can find a sofa set, turn towards your right and go near the window curtain in front of you. Then turn to your right, you can find a black color door. Go pass through the door and you enter into a wardroom. Go near the cupboard in front of you and you reached your destination.

49112.instruction: You now find yourself in a washroom, facing towards the entrance. Head straight and exit from the washroom, head straight from the open door which leads you to the bedroom. Immediately take a slight right towards the curtains and take the immediate right to exit from the bedroom from the brown open door, which leads to the wardrobe. Enter into the wardrobe this is your final point.

49130.instruction: You will start by facing the fireplace. Turn left take a step towards the front of the red chair. Now take another step forward towards the coffee table and walk towards the right side of the couch. You will see an arched opening. Continue to walk forward. You will walk past the oval glass table on your right. Take a step towards the head of the dining table and turn left. Walk towards the kitchen island with stools on it. Continue to walk forward you will see two arched openings. Walk towards the one on the right where you can see the railing handle there. Turn right and stand in the middle of this hallway. Just stand right beside the clay vase on your left and you're done.

49147.instruction: You're facing the wall, turn around, go straight, and enter the room, to the left you'll find brown table, and chairs, from there turn left, and go straight, stop near the entrance, turn around, in front you'll find cream sofas, and table, go straight, exit the room, again to the left you'll find table, and chairs, go straight near the glass door, three steps away from the exit point, and to the left of the glass door, you'll find your destination.

49148.instruction: You are facing towards the wall, turn to your right move forward. And take left after the dinning table, and enter into the third open arch. Take a about turn then take a left turn, move forward and take a right turn near the sofa chair. You can see a open glass door, enter into that room, then walk between the round table and the snooker table. Move forward and stand on design marble, in front of the closed glass door.

49168.instruction: Turn right from the place you are standing and move towards the opened door, now you are at the entrance of the room, move a bit forward, turn left and move towards the closed door which is infront of you, you can find a passage infront of you, walk through the passage, to the left, you can find a staircase, go up the stairs, you are facing towards the closed door, turn left, you can find a portrait on the wall, move towards the portrait, slightly turn to your left and move forward, turn right, you can find an opened door, enter into the room, slightly turn to your left and move a bit forward, now you are facing towards the black board, that would be your end point.

49169.instruction: You are in a bedroom, turn towards your right and keep moving forward. In front, you can find a white color door. Go pass through the white color door and you enter into a corridor. Turn towards your left and keep moving forward in the corridor. In front, you can find a white door. Go near the white door and turn towards your slight right and enter into the other section of a corridor. Keep moving forward and on your left you find a staircase. Climb up the stairs, all the way to the top floor and in front, you can find a white door, go near that white door and turn towards your left. You can find an other corridor, walk into that section of a corridor, beside a staircase support and keep moving forwards. Towards your right, you find a glass door. Go pass through the glass door and you enter into a art room, which has a board hanging on the wall, towards your left. Go near that board and stand in front of it, beside a glass table. You reached your destination.

49177.instruction: You're currently in the dining room. Turn slightly to the right, and take a step forward so you're standing right in front of the white door. Turn around, face right. Take a step forward to the left side of the base to the staircase. Now, turn slightly to the left. Take a step forward to the entrance of wine cellar. Once you're at the entrance of the wine cellar, you see rows of wine from the entrance, hanging from a wrack, you're done.

49215.instruction: You will start by facing a living room. Turn around and you will see a pool table in front of you. Turn left and take a step in the opening on the left side of the pool table. You will see another living area. Turn left and walk behind the brown arm chair. Take one more step forward and you will see a dining table in front of you. Walk towards the second  arched opening from the right and once you've done that you will see another arched opening on your right. Continue to walk forward towards that you will walk past the staircase on your right. Just continue to walk forward towards another room. Take a step inside this room on the left corner. You will see a bunch of shelves and a lamp on your left and you're done.

49233.instruction: We're facing towards a wall, turn slightly to the right... On your right there's a shower area, walk past that... In front of you there's a sink and below the sink there are cabinets, walk towards the sink and then turn towards the left and enter the bedroom that's in front of you... Once you're in the bedroom, turn towards the right... On the left there'll be the bed and on your right there'll be the dresser, walk towards the bed, turn slightly to the right and you'll come across a doorway, walk past that doorway... On your left there's a shelf and in front of you there's an arch door, walk towards that arch door, turn towards the right, on your left there's a bench, and on the right there are pictures on the wall, walk past the bench and turn towards the arch door that's on your left, you'll come across an empty closet, step into it, and that's your destination. You'll be facing towards the wall, on the right there's a desk and on left there's what appears to be a closet or... There are cabinets.

49235.instruction: You begin facing a kitchen, turn around to your left, you will see the living space, behind you there is a dresser, take a step forward so that the dresser is to your right and the coffee table and couches are to your left, take another step forward towards the antique chair, looking slightly to the right, you will see some railing for a staircase, take a step towards that, and then turn around again, from where you're standing the living space should be to your left, in front of you at the very end of the room there should be a window, take 2 steps towards the window, to the left of the window there is a bookshelf and underneath the bookshelf, there is a armed chair, take a step towards the chair, and then turn to your left, you will hop over the coffee table towards the pool table, take one more step towards the pool table and then turn to your left, take one step towards the glass doors that go outside, you should be heading back to where you just started from, take one more step forward and then take one last step forward, so that the glass doors are to your right, the kitchen is in front of you, the living space is to your left, you are done.

49291.instruction: From inside this doorway, take a step towards the long dining room table with the elegant chandelier, stop.

49332.instruction: You are near the staircase facing towards the wooden wall, take a slight left turn and move forward, and go straight near the pillar, and move forward near the armchair, and go straight, take a right turn and move forward near the armchairs and the dresser. This is the endpoint.

49333.instruction: You're facing the wall, turn towards your left, and go straight, to the left you'll find cup boards, go straight, again to the left you'll find door, from there turn right, you'll enter the living room, opposite to the brown table, on the carpet, you'll find your destination.

49405.instruction: We're going to start facing a picture frame on the wall. We're going to walk towards the bottom of the stairs that we can see in front. We're going to turn to the right, and we are going to enter that room with the dining table that has the white table cloth on it. Now that we are next to the closed door, we are going to turn to the left, and we should see a bunch of boxes. We're going to walk towards the one that says, large. Now that we are in front of that big box, we are done.

49438.instruction: You begin in a sauna. Turn around completely and exit the sauna, and then take the right hand quote unquote, "door". It's a bead curtain. Just go through the bead curtain. Once through the curtain of beads you will be in kind of a pool room. Follow the edge of the pool until the stairs on the left. Just a couple of stairs, not that many. Go up those stairs, and up the, like, three steps in front of those, and then of the three doors on top of those three steps, go into the center one. Once you are in the threshold of the center doorway, and can see a marble staircase across from you, you are done.

49451.instruction: Turn all the way to your right and behind you. You will be facing an open area. On your right are two urns. Go across the tiled floor into the next room ahead of you. You are continuing past the urns on your right all the way to the next room  where you will see a large white grey cabinet on your right. Continue walking past that and at the end of the room on your left you will see a door that is open.  Go through that door and you will see a staircase in front of you. Walk up the wood staircase to the top of the landing. You will see a TV in front of you. Walk to the TV and then turn to your left. You will cross the white square carpet that you are on into the room that has a checker patch brown and white carpet with a little brown desk on it.  Now you are facing a fairly empty room ahead of you. You want to walk straight and to the middle of that room.  You are at you destination.

49474.instruction: For your start point you will be facing a wall that has a bunch of crosses. Turn around you will need to exit this room to the left through the open doorway, you will pass a statue of Jesus and Mary. Once you have done that you will need to make an immediate right turn through the open doorway passing baby Jesus to your left. Continue moving forward straight ahead, you will enter through another open doorway where you will pass Mary and baby Jesus to your left and you will need to stand in between a freezer to your left and  a book self to your right. Once you are in between the two facing a window that has plants on the ledge you are done.

49591.instruction: You will start by facing the window. Turn slightly to the left and take a step forward. Jump over the couch on your right towards the arched opening. Take a step towards the right side of the treadmill. Now jump over the gym equipment towards the doorway on the other side of the room. Walk inside the bathroom. Now turn to your left. Walk inside the room with a bookshelf inside and turn right. Take a step towards the fridge. Once you're standing in front of the fridge then you're done.

49601.instruction: For your start point you will begin in a pathway, turn fight around and move forward through the double door to the left you will see a kitchen seating area with a circle table and white orchids flowers on top,surrounded by four chairs and a black candle style chandelier above the circle table. Turn to your right and move through the open archway you will enter into a kitchen, move forward towards the area rug right in front of you and make a right turn. Move around the kitchen island that's to your left you will pass a stove to your right and move forward towards the double glass door straight ahead of you and turn to your right. You will move forward through this hall you will pass two open archways on your right move through the open archway on your right. You will see that there is a seating area with a couch and two accent chairs you will need to hop over the accent chair to the left and the standing lamp that's to the right. Just hope over that chair and you will see a sliding glass door that has a pool table. Move through the sliding glass door towards the pool table and turn to the left of that pool table. You will see that there is another circle table surrounded by chairs you will need to make your way towards the back of that table turning left and once you make your way around the back of that table you will see a glass window straight ahead. Move forward towards that glass window if you look up there should be a black lantern to the left side of the window and there will be a chair to your left tucked under the circle table. Once you are in front of that window you have reached your end point.

49626.instruction: You are facing a red carpet, turn right and walk straight. Pass through the dining table which is in the left and walk straight. You are on the red carpet, facing an open door. In the left you have chairs, in the right you have curtain. This is the end point.

49627.instruction: You are in a dining room facing towards the front door, take a right turn and go straight to the table which is on the right side, take a slight left turn and move forward to the door, and go straight along with the red carpet up to the door which is on the left side near the chairs, take a slight left turn and move forward to that door, take a slight left turn and go straight, and move forward, in the front you can see a door. This is the endpoint.

49696.instruction: You are facing towards a wall, turn around and exit the room through the open door right in front of you. Turn slightly right and move forward until you reach a wall. Now turn to your right and move forward towards the white coloured cupboards. Now turn to your right and you can see a staircase, get down the steps completely. You can see a TV and there are two windows on either side of the TV. Move towards the window which is on the right side. You are now facing towards a window and this is your destination.

49697.instruction: Right now you are facing a wall, turn left and exit the room, now turn right and move forward, now you are beside the railing, now turn right and move forward towards the closed door, now you will find downstairs on your right, go downstairs completely and turn right, where you will find two more steps, get down the steps and turn around, now move forward, now turn right and move towards the closed door, now again turn right and move forward towards the black table, which is in front of you, now move towards the window, which is on your right side, now stand at the corner of the room facing towards the window, this will be your end point.

49725.instruction: You are facing the grey colour cupboard, turn back, move towards the snooker table. 49726.instruction: Right now you're facing towards a cupboard. Now turn behind and cross the table which is in front of you. 49748.instruction: You are now facing the brown color door, from there take a left turn step into the corridor and now take a left turn, walk straight and stand in front of the wall where there is a violin in front of you. 49996.instruction: Slide little right and walk straight beside the table, now slide right near the brown color chair and move towards the brown color open door and exit the room, now walk straight, slide little right and walk towards the another open door and stop at the entrance of the door, you have reached your destination.

50280.instruction: Right now you're facing towards a black chair. Now slightly turn right, there is an open door in front of you, move towards the door and exit the room. This will be your stopping point at the door of the wine cellar.

50357.instruction: You are facing towards a glass window, turn right and walk straight towards the pillar opposite to you. You are now facing towards the corner of the room, you have reached your destination.

50358.instruction: You are facing towards the glass window. Turn right and walk straightly till you find a lamp on your right side. There are two glass windows in front of you. You should now be on the doorway looking into a big bathtub. YOu are done.

50446.instruction: You are facing towards the wooden door. Turn left and walk straightly in the hallway by passing through the two open doors till you find a glass window in front of you. 50447.instruction: Okay, now you are standing on the red carpet facing towards the door, slightly turn to your left and walk straight on the red carpet until you reach an open entrance in front of you. Now slightly turn to your left and go straight towards the open entrance, where rope is tied to that entrance. Now you are standing in front of the open entrance with rope tied to that entrance, go straight and pass by the rope, and stand at the entrance and this is the end point.

50525.instruction: You are facing towards the sofa, turn right and move towards the window. Turn right and move towards the staircase. Get down of the staircase completely. The position you are standing is your final destination.

50526.instruction: Now you are facing towards the brown coloured animal toy, turn slightly right and move forward towards the television, now go straight and get down the stairs completely by passing through the picture frames on your left side. Now take immediate right turn here you can see the brown coloured chair on your right side, now move forward till you find the sofa set on your right side, now stand near the brown coloured table and lamps here you reach your final destination.

50527.instruction: Now you are facing the staircase, slightly turn left and climb down the two steps. Now you are facing the toilet, turn around and climb up the six steps on your left side. This is the endpoint.

50528.instruction: You are facing the stairs, slightly turn left, walk straight. There are two stairs, get down through those. You are facing a washroom. Turn around, in the left you have stairs. Walk straight, turn left and climb those. You are standing on the second step of the stair. This is the end point.

50615.instruction: We are facing a sink. Let’s turn around leaving this room. Take one step into the hallway. Take another step where you are walking beside the stairs that are going down and continue walking in the direction of the stairs going up. Go past the stairs. Jumping over the pug and the chair with the orange pillow. Now you will be beside the dining room table and you will take one more step when you are on the far side of the dining room table closest to the windows. Stop when you are beside the large plant.

50616.instruction: Go through the open French doors in front of you. And stop at the top of the staircase on your right. Go down the staircase to the very bottom. Once you get past those there's an open doorway to your left, straight ahead is a another open doorway that has couches, ignore that.  Go into the doorway to your left that leads to a hallway. Once you get into that room you see a bathroom in front of you, a wine room to your left, another open door opposite the wine room, you can't see where that leads. And then you're going to go to the right, into I think a bedroom. You're going to walk straight into the bedroom keeping the bed on your left towards the plants with 2 pillows on the floor. Once you are in front of those that's where you end.

50627.instruction: You are facing towards the kitchen. Turn right, walk straight. Turn left and walk between the chairs and the couch. Turn left and walk straight towards the open door passing through the dining table. Walk straight, walk towards the couch. Move forward, there is a fire place in the opposite. Walk closer to the tea poy which is in the left. You are opposite to the fireplace and the potted plant. This is the end point.

50634.instruction: You're standing to the left of a table with a white cloth. Walk forwards towards the doorway in front of you. And you'll see two doorways on both sides of you, go to the one on the left towards the table. And hop over the table towards the fireplace. And you'll see a large painting above the fireplace and you've reached the end.

50636.instruction: You're looking at two couches. Turn to your left and walk straight. You'll find a dark blue couch sectional on your right. There's also a TV on your wall on the right. 50660.instruction: We are going to start by seeing a door frame in front of us, to our left side we see that there is a path that leads us to another room, we are going to take a step in that direction and then we'll see that we have the opened doorway in front of us, we are going to take a step into this room. Now, this room has a bed, and also has a dog in front of the bed. We are going to go to the sofa that's behind the dog, and now we are going to look around to our right side and see that there is a pathway that will lead us to a hallway, perhaps. We are going to take a step there, and this will be our destination.

50677.instruction: You begin looking into a wooden area with shelves on three out of three walls. You're going to see a round atrium behind you, and you're going to move up the stairs that go directly from that atrium, with a stained glass rose on the right. Just go up those stairs, all the way up, they curve around to the left. And once you're up those stairs you're going to move immediately to the other side of the white patterned rug, the circular rug at the top of those stairs, and just follow the railings, past the weird spiral shrubberies, and past the little bank of orangey-red and black pottery, that is on the left and right. They have dead sticks in them, which is, y'know, real classy. Everyone loves dead sticks in pots. Once you pass the dead sticks in pots you'll see a little bird statue on the window to the right, you're going to continue past that and another stick pot on the left, and you should see a bedroom ahead of you, move to the front of the green armchair, and then between the two green armchairs at the foot of the bed. Then you're going to move to the left of that bench, and finally to the left of the bed, and proceed through the archway by the bed's nightstand on the left. Once you are through that archway you're going to turn right, moving in front of the framed picture, and then through the door to the right of that picture. You should be entering a... I guess sort of a walk-in closet area. There's closet double doors all around on two of four walls, and then the last wall has a counter with a printer and a globe on it. Just over into the back right corner between two of the closet doors, and you are done.

50758.instruction: You're starting in a bathroom, facing a shower. Turn right and exit the bathroom into a walk in closet with a dark brown floor. 50762.instruction: You're currently standing in a living room, that's slightly unfurnished. Take a step forward to the table with two chairs attached to it. Take another step forward to your left. 50767.instruction: You are in bedroom, turn left and go forward towards the white shelf passing through the door, you have reached.

54728.instruction: You begin facing a living room, turn to your right, and take a step towards the very first arch on your right, and then take a step through the middle arch, take a step into the kitchen, hopping over the counter in front of you, take one step towards the windows in front of you, turn to your right, take another step forward, turn to your right, take 2 steps forward, turn to your left, take a step towards the mini dining table to the left of it, take one, and then turn to your left and take one step to the left of the main dining table, and then take the last step towards the window in front of you, you should be facing the window there should be a cabinet to your right, you are done.

54746.instruction: You are standing at the entrance of the room, to the right you have a black steel gate, walk straight, to the right you have an open door, walk to the open door, enter the room, walk on the red carpet. Stand between the glass instruction board on your left and two chairs with round table in-front of it on your right, that's the end point.

54747.instruction: Move forward from your place where you are standing' you can see an open door to your right side, enter into the room through the open door, move forward and stand in between the first two poles, that's your end point.

54836.instruction: You begin looking over a bathtub. Turn right from those, you should see a long hallway with a piano on the right and a lot of pictures. Move past the piano and all of the pictures, and take the first right turn after them. You should be staring down a hallway with pictures on either side, two arched doorways, and what looks like a T-intersection at the end with a curio cabinet. Take a couple steps forward and go to that first door on the right, right next to the ironing board. Inside, it's kind of a closet-ish area. A whole little sewing area, okay, well, once you've entered the sewing area, you are done.

54877.instruction: You begin in a bathroom, look to your right and exit the bathroom, and then take one final step towards the window in front of you, that's next to the map, you should end up standing a couple inches away from the window, you are done.

54901.instruction: We're facing towards what appears to be a hall... On your left there's another doorway, on the right there's what appears to be a painting and there are two vases on floor, on the left there's one vase and one lamp, take three steps forward, and you have reached your point.

55026.instruction: You are facing a round table with four kitchen chairs. Turn to your left and walk to the left of the chairs and right before that open brown door. The one in front of you and the one on your left are the same size windows on the tile floor. You are at your destination.

55212.instruction: Right now you are facing towards the glass window turn around and exit the restroom. Then turn right and move forward towards the wall, you have reached your destination point.

55213.instruction: You are facing towards the window, turn left and exit the washroom, now turn right, move forward and enter the room, now there is an open door on your left side, and there is a showpiece in front of you, this is your end point.

55259.instruction: Starting on the staircase, come around and walk down into the kitchen towards the table. Stop when you reach the power box on the brick wall.

55316.instruction: You will start by standing inside the garage. Take a step forward towards the black cupboards. Take another step towards the black storage cupboards. Now on your left, you will see an exit. Walk towards the exit on your left. The exit has a carpet in front of it and walk through that doorway. Now turn right and go up the stairs. Keep going up the stairs and once you're at the second floor. You will see the kitchen on your right. The kitchen with chairs. Walk towards the kitchen counter and once you are in front of the black single that is close to the wall and you're done.

55405.instruction: You are facing towards a pillar, slightly turn right, you can find a fireplace, move towards the fireplace, move a bit forward, that would be your end point.

55406.instruction: Turn right from the place where you're standing and you can see a sofa in front of you. Move forward toward the right side of the sofa. Now, take a few steps and you will be facing towards a wall and that is the end point.

55455.instruction: You can find an opening infront of you, move towards the opening, slightly turn to your left and move forward, slightly turn to your left, you will be entering into the kitchen area, to your left you can find a stove, move forward, turn right and move forward, slightly turn to your left and move forward, you can find a round table with four chairs infront of you, move towards your right and stand behind the table, where to the left you can find a chair and to the right you can find a wall, that would be your end point.

55456.instruction: You are facing towards an arch, go forward and pass through the arch, turn left and go forward, go one step forward, pass through the arch and go forward towards the white cabinet, turn left and go forward, now you are facing towards a sink, turn right and go forward, go one step forward, turn left and go one step forward, slightly turn right and go forward towards the brown table, go one step forward, here just behind the chair facing towards a window you have reached the destination.

55530.instruction: Right now you're facing towards a window, move towards the window and turn left. There is an open door in front of you, move towards the door and exit the room. Now move forward and stand on the carpet facing the black table and it will be your end point.

55531.instruction: You are facing towards the wall and the glass window. Slightly turn left and move towards the mirror. Turn left and move towards the open door. Slightly turn left and move forward. Get down the steps. Slightly turn right and stand on the carpet. Turn left and enter into the open room. Now walk straightly towards the black table which has a glass box on it. That will be the end point.

55580.instruction: You begin facing a wooden wall, turn to your left and go up the staircase, once you get to the top, look slightly to your left and you will see a pillar close to you, underneath the staircase, take a step to the right of the pillar, and then looking to the left you will see a very tall lamp right in front of you, and behind the lamp, there is a dresser, take a step to the right of the dresser, the lamp and the dresser should now be to your left and there should be a chair and a coffee table to your right, you are done.

55650.instruction: We're in front of a hallway, on the left there's a board with some letters, walk past that... On your right there's a shelf with some decoration, I mean on your left there's a shelf with some decorations, and on your right there's  a board that says New York, Los Angeles, Paris, Venice, Florence, Amsterdam, and London... You have reached your destination.

55871.instruction: You are facing towards a wooden railing, turn around and walk straight towards the carpet. Now turn left, you can see an open door, enter into the room through the door, take a few steps ahead. You are now standing in between a wooden cabinet on your left and a shower room on your right. You have reached your destination.

55872.instruction: Now, you are facing towards a relaxing chair and the wooden roof. Turn around and move towards your right side. Go straight and take left. You will find an open door. Enter through it. Now, you are in the washroom. Move forward and that will be your end point facing the shower room with a glass door and wash basin on your left side.

56007.instruction: Now you are facing towards the wall, turn your back and move into the open door, now move forward towards the carpet, now take right turn and walk through the narrow path by passing through the open door on your right side and stand at the entrance of the open door in front of you is your final destination.

56008.instruction: You are facing towards a flower vase, turn back and move towards the opened door, move forward towards the single couch which is infront of you, turn right and move towards the opened door, now you are at the entrance of a room, that would be your end point.

56038.instruction: Slightly turn left and move towards the bed. Now, turn right and exit the bedroom. Slightly turn left and walk in the passage till you reach an another bed in front of you. You can see an narrow opened door in front of you. Move towards the entrance of that narrow opened door and that is the end point.

56039.instruction: Right now you are facing towards the door, slightly turn left and enter into the bed room. And exit the bed room through the door in front of you. And move forward towards the pathway and enter into the door in front of you and turn left towards the cupboard in front of you with a lamp shed and turn left from there. 56104.instruction: You'll start with a fireplace in front of you, turn around. You'll see there's a kind of an orange, peach colored chair in front of you. Now standing at that doorway you'll see a picture on the wall straight ahead, walk towards the right side of that picture. Turn left. Now that pictures on your right side and that circle table is kind of slightly to your left in front of you. Walk straight ahead towards the windows and stop.

56175.instruction: You are facing towards the black fence. Turn right and walk straightly in the passage till you find a garden in front of you. Turn right and walk straightly till you find steps on your right side. Turn right and now move towards the white chairs. Now slightly turn left and walk through the sliding glass door. Now you are in the living room. There are couches on your left side and the TV on your right side. Walk straightly till you find steps in front of you. Now turn around and move towards the dining table. Now you are standing near to the dining table. That will be the end point.

56176.instruction: Right now you are facing towards a fencing wall, slightly move right, you will find grass in front of you on the floor. Move towards the grass and turn right. Move forward you will find a entrance to the house towards your right. Climb the stairs and enter into the door. Once you enter into the door you will find a television towards your right and a sofa with two pillows on your left and a table in between the sofa. Move forward through the hall way you will find a stairs. Move forward towards to the stairs and turn back, you will find a dinning table with eight chairs. Move forwards towards the chairs and here is your destination.

56177.instruction: You are in a bedroom facing towards a mirror, turn slightly right and move forward towards the open door which is right in front of you and exit the bedroom. 56178.instruction: You are facing towards the glass door. There is a bed towards your right side. Turn right. Walk straight  and exit the bedroom through the open door. Walk straight and stand in front of the window beside the wall. You have reached your point.

56184.instruction: You are facing towards a portrait, slightly turn right and go forward towards the edge of the carpet, slightly turn right and go forward towards the entrance of this room, go forward and climb up the four steps, turn around and get down those steps, slightly turn right and go forward towards the entrance of the room which is on to the right, go forward towards the carpet, slightly turn left and go forward, slightly turn right and go forward towards the sink, here just beside the sink you have reached the destination.

56185.instruction: Now we are in a room, move straight and take right, move straight, climb up the stairs, and stop in between, and get down the stairs, and move straight and turn right, move out of the room, go straight and take left, go straight and take right, and we reached the destination.

56233.instruction: Turn slightly right. Walk out the doorway, down the hallway. Continue straight until you come to stairs on your left. Go up the stairs. Walk past the statue on the right into the bedroom, up to the mirror on the chest and then turn left. Walk towards the window passing the bottom of the bed. Turn left. Walk up to the bedside table and end standing in front of the bedside table next to the window.

56240.instruction: Right now you are facing a white couch, turn left and move forward in a walkway, where you will find a sink on your left and couch on your right, now move forward towards the dining table, now turn around and move forward towards the carpet, now you will find a television and a shelves beside it, now move towards the shelves and stand in front of the shelves, this is your destination.

56241.instruction: Turn around on the left there is a path which will lead you towards the dinning table, along the right there is an other path which will lead you to the living room where you find some sofas and there is a clear view outside structure from that room and the glass door is placed in between the living room and the outside balcony.

56245.instruction: You will start by standing at the top of the steps. Turn left and stand on the hallway in between the railing on the left and a bunch of picture frames on your right. 56253.instruction: You are facing towards the white cupboard which has photo frames and decorative items in it. Slightly turn left and move towards the open door. Turn around and slightly turn right and move a bit forward. Now turn left and walk through the open door. Now you are standing in the washroom facing towards the mirror and the washbasin. That will be the end point.

56254.instruction: You are facing towards the shelves, turn left and move towards the open door. Turn right and move out of this room. Now you are facing towards the wall, turn slight right you can see an open door next to the wall, move towards it. Now turn around and move forward. You are facing towards the door. 56321.instruction: For your start point you begin in a washroom turn to the right and exit the washroom through the open doorway that leads you into a bedroom. 56358.instruction: You are facing towards a table, go forward towards the table, slightly turn left and go forward towards the fire place, slightly turn right and go forward towards the window, here facing towards the wall and the window you have reached the destination.

56420.instruction: Looking straight ahead, you should see a window straight in the distance. On your right some wooden doors with glass panels and two black small statues surrounding the door. 56446.instruction:

56447.instruction: Right now you are standing in front of the sofa. Make a slight left turn and move straight walk behind the stair case. Here we reached our destination in front of the palnt.

56592.instruction: Starting off facing the sink and the mirror, we're going to turn all the way around to where we are facing the door to exit the bathroom. Once exiting the bedroom, we are going to be faced with the hallway, we are going to go around the corner and then down the stairs. Descend the stairs. 56599.instruction: You begin looking towards a tiled corner. Turn around to your right and exit this overstuffed pantry area. Go ahead towards the laundry room and stop in front of the washer and dryer, between them.

56635.instruction: You are facing towards the wall which has a portrait on it, slightly turn right, go straight, there is a staircase in front of you, go straight and climb the stairs, turn left, there are stairs in front of you, go up the stairs completely, go straight, slightly turn your left, there are sofas in front of you, go straight near the sofa chair, turn around, go straight, there is a closed door in front of you, stop there, this is your final destination.

56652.instruction: Jump over the foot of the bed to stand between the two arched doorway with the small table between them. 56696.instruction: You will start out facing a wooden arched door. If you turn just slightly to your left, you will see that that door is open. When you reach a set of double doors with glass panes in them, you will see a desk ahead of you. You want to take a step inside that room, going behind the desk chair on your right. Ahead of you, you will see a set of double doors leading outside, take a step to those double doors and once you are standing directly in front of those double doors with curtains on either side, that is where you will stop.

56709.instruction: Begin in front of a sink. Exit to the bedroom on your left just before the rug and you're done.

56742.instruction: You are at the door, facing to the table. Turn towards your slight left and keep moving forward. In front, you find an other door. Turn towards your slight right and enter into a shower room, by crossing the glass door of it. You reached your destination.

56743.instruction: Now you are at the entrance of a room, move straight through the door and enter into the bedroom. Now take left and exit the room through the door. 56766.instruction: Okay right now you are facing the railing. Turn to your left and walk few steps forward and now turn around. To the left side and you see an open door. 56767.instruction: You are in front of the shelf, turn to your left and go near the bed, turn and go near the door, enter into the bathroom, move towards the next bedroom, go near the table which is in front of the bed, go near the stairs, down the stairs move forward, go near the dining hall, turn to your right go near the sofa chair, again turn right and move forward near the table which is in front of the sofa.

56794.instruction: You begin facing a bedroom, turn to your right and exit the bedroom, go down the hallway and then turn to your left, you will see a staircase that goes down, go towards that staircase and then go down the stairs, once you get to the bottom, turn to your right and go forward until you see a opened doorway on the left, step out into the garage, and then turn to your right, and take a step to the left of the black car in the garage, once you're standing slightly to the left, behind the Mercedes, you are done.

56806.instruction: You begin facing a set of doors, turn to your right and take a step out of the open door, looking at the cabinet in front of you, there is a archway right next to it, take 2 steps going through that archway, take 2 more steps forward into the bedroom, and then turn right and take a step out onto the balcony, once you're in the doorway, look to you right, and look to the bottom a little bit, you will see an outlet, take  a step towards the outlet on the balcony and you're done.

56831.instruction: You're starting in a hallway right off of a bedroom, facing an arched doorway that leads into a hall with two framed photos ahead of you. 56858.instruction: Starting in a Victorian looking home with pink walls. You'll be facing a bunch of paintings and a big brown door. You're going to turn left towards another set of double doors. Head into the room, following the pink carpet laid out on the floor. Continue down the pink carpet to another set of double doors. Once you've passed through the double doors You've arrived.

56916.instruction: You're in a museum, facing the corner of a room with a bust standing on a white marble pedestal in the corner of the room. There's also a white rope in front of you.
