Turn left and move towards the chairs. Turn slight left and move forward. Now turn slight left and move towards the dinning table. Now you are standing near the dinning table and facing towards the wall. Turn right and move towards the wall lamp. Now you can see dinning table on your right side and left side you can see a window. The position you are standing is your final destination.

62443.instruction: Right now you're facing towards a lamp, move towards the lamp which is on the wall and turn left. There are chairs in front of you, which are beside the platform, move towards the chairs and turn left. There are some cabinets to your left, move a bit forward towards the cabinets and turn left. You can see two chairs in front of you, move towards the chairs and slightly turn left. Now move a bit forward and turn left. There is a dining table in front of you, behind the dining table there is a cabinet with candle stand on it, move towards the cabinet and turn right. There is a plant pot in front of you, move towards the plant pot and stand in front of it and it is your end point.

62475.instruction: You're facing the windows, turn towards your right, you'll find stairs, climb the stairs, stop at the end of the stairs, turn  around, go straight, and enter the room, you'll enter the bedroom, go near the sofa which is at the corner, from there turn right, to the left you'll find white stool, and window, at the entrance itself, beside the white stool, you'll find your destination.

62476.instruction: You are in the living area, facing towards a corner of a door, turn towards your right and in front, you can find a staircase. Climb up the stairs, all the way to the top floor and turn around towards your left. In front, you can find a white door. Go near that white door and turn towards your slight left. Move forward near to the bed, which is on your left side and turn towards your right. You can find a section, go pass through the section and stand there. You reached your destination.

62601.instruction: You're facing towards a wall. Turn right and exit the door. You can see the entrance and a mat on the floor on the right side, You can see another entrance which you can see sofa on the left side and red colored design mat on the floor. From there turn right and walk near the statue beside the statue on the left side is your destination.

62602.instruction: Okay, now you are in a room facing towards the lamp stand, turn to your right and go straight towards the open door, which is on the right side. Now turn right and exit the room through that open door. Now you are facing towards the wall, slightly turn to your left and go straight, and enter through the open entrance, which is in front of you. Now you are standing at the entrance of a room with a couch in front of you. Now slightly turn to your right and go straight, and stand on the carpet, which is in front of you. Now turn right and move forward onto the other carpet, which is in front of you. Now in front of you there is a window, go straight towards the window by passing the statue, which is on the right side. Now you are standing at the edge of the last window and this is the end point.

62618.instruction: We're going to start by seeing a closet full of clothes that are hanging. We're going to look to our left and we are going to see the half of a doorway that is opened; we are going to go thorugh that doorway. Then, we are going to look around and we are going to have a bedroom in front of us, and to our right we are going to have another opened doorway, we are going to go through that doorway. We are going to see some diplomas or some certificates in front of us, and we are going to walk in front of them, then we are going to look to our right, we are going to see a huge hallway with a lot of pictures and frames, as well as a piano in the middle. Now we are going to walk straight and take various steps until reaching a place where you can see to your right a vase and a painting, perhaps. To your left you'll see another large hallway: walk straight into that hallway and take another various steps until reaching a point where you can see a living room to your right. There's four sofas and a lot of cushions in that livingroom, so we are going to jump into the first sofa that we see, and then we are going to jump over again to the marble table with metallic borders and frames below it, and that will be it.

62633.instruction: "Now you are facing towards the door, turn slightly left, and walk forward, turn right immediately, you can find another white door, enter inside it, walk forward towards the bed, then turn right, enter the another room, and stand near room entrance, beside you you can find table, above the table there is a window, towards right, you can find washroom and that will be your final destination."

62634.instruction: Now you are facing a door. Turn slightly left. Move forward. Turn right. Go into the open door. Go near the chair. Turn right. Move forward. You have reached your destination.

62638.instruction: You are facing a living room straight ahead turn left, walk towards the dining table and the chairs then turn right and walk towards the grey sofa on your right then turn left walk straight ahead outside in the patio, when you are facing white table and the patio and chairs and on your left their is a white patio sofa with purple cushions, stay in between them and look straight ahead towards the grass and take step on that and turn left come back on the concrete near the bushes on your left and then once you are facing the fence and the concrete stairs, walk straight ahead and once you are standing near the pipe hole on the ground and the meter on your left towards the closed door on your left you are done.

63048.instruction: You are going to start facing two paintings. Turn 45 degrees to the right. Take one step to go outside that room. Turn to the left and take one step forward towards the steps that we can see on the left. Once you are there facing a fireplace and a staircase on our left, and you are going to see a staircase going down, go down the staircase. Walk straight. You should see an open door on the first landing, and you are going to go inside that room that has half... half a Jesus on the window. Turn to the left and take one step into the shower, and you are done.

63096.instruction: Right now you're facing an arch. Now slightly turn right, you can see a plant pot on the table which is in front of you, move towards the table and turn left. You can see a table with a lamp on it in front of you, move towards the table. You can see a table in front of the sofa, move towards the table and slightly turn right, you can see a cream colored couch in front of you, move forward towards the couch. You can see a plant pot in front of you, which is beside the fireplace, stand in between the fireplace and the plant pot and it will be your end point.

63097.instruction: Okay, now you are in the living room facing towards an arch shape entrance. Slightly turn to your right and move forward. Now turn to your left and in front of you there is an arch shape entrance, go straight towards that arch shape entrance. Now you are standing in front of a table with lamp on it, and in front of you there is a teapoy with potted plant on it, go straight and stand next to the teapoy. Now slightly turn to your right and in front of you there is a fire place, go straight and stand in front of the fire place. Now slightly turn to your right and in front of you there is a potted plant, go straight and stand in between the potted plant and fire place, and that is the end point.

63117.instruction: You are facing slightly to the wall turn right slightly, move forward there will drawer cupboard on you are right from there take left walk between the books stand and the door on you are left.There will be a exit door from there take right move forward, there you can see a showcase on your right, turn left there will be a enter door to dinning room get inside turn around there will be stairs on you are straight walk straight and there will be wall on both sides and this is you are end point.

63118.instruction: You are facing towards a wall, turn slightly right and move forward through the open entrance. Now turn slightly left and walk towards the open door. Turn slightly right and exit through the open door. Turn slightly to your left and you can see an open door, enter through it. Now turn around and you can see a staircase right in front of you. Climb up four steps and stand there, this is your end point.

63119.instruction: You are facing an open door.  You are going to turn to your right.  You will see in front of you a white rug in the middle and if you are facing forward with the rug in front of you, you will see directly in front of you a bed in a bedroom and to the right of that doorway will be white shelving and cabinets.  To the left of that door into the bedroom you will see a walk in closet with a light on.  You are going to head towards that closet.  And you are going to take one step into this empty closet and you are done.

63134.instruction: You are facing towards a wall, turn left get down the stairs, walk towards the dining table, turn right walk towards the couch, turn left walk towards the open glass door, step out of the house through the door, walk towards the lawn, now walk towards the left side of the stairs. You have reached your destination.

63135.instruction: You are in the steps facing towards the wall, take a left turn and walk down the steps, take slightly left turn and go straight near the dining table, take a right turn and go towards the sofa, take a left turn and go straight to the glassdoor, take slightly right turn and go straight near the table, take slightly left turn and move forward near the table, and go straight in the garden, and move forward, take slightly left turn and go straight to the plants near the steps. This is the endpoint.

63180.instruction: You're standing inside a sauna room, turn left and walk towards the blue tile work on the wall, then turn slightly to your right and walk towards the exit of the sauna and step out of it in the direction of a pool in front of you. Once you're outside of the room turn left, you will have a chair to your left, the pool on your right some steps directly ahead, walk towards those steps and keep walking towards the bar area in front of you until you reach the corner or the edge of that bar, and then turn left. You'll see the stairs lead to another room and there's going to be a door on the back wall after a second set of steps, walk towards that door in the back past the second set of steps and past an open door on your right side, and you'll notice there's a small planter on the left corner of that same wall where the door is open now in front of you. There are some pebbles in the floor with the shape of an A, R and a T. Walk towards the planter on that corner stepping on the pebbles. That's your spot.

63226.instruction: You are in a washroom get out of it then take right, again take a right and go straight you will find a door. Enter in to the next room and go forward, again you will enter in to the another room, go straight turn left. You will enter in the living room go straight, you will find a white color chair to the right below it you will find your destination.

63227.instruction: You are now facing towards the wall. Turn around and exit the bathroom. Turn slightly right and move forward, you are now facing towards the cupboard. Turn slightly right and enter into the room. Walk straight and exit the room using the open door which is in front of you. Walk straight and exit the room where in there a washbasin to your right. Walk straight, you are now facing towards the closed door. Turn right and move towards the white colour chair. Now move towards the fire place and stop facing towards the flowers which are yellow in colour, and this is your end point.

63289.instruction: you begin in a kitchen, in front of you is a little serving island or a prepping island. if you turn your body to the left you see a sink, another sink on another prepping island. and in between those two prepping islands there is a walk way, in front of you should be a cabinet area. walk up that cabinet area, turn your body to the right and you should see two, three archways. you are going to go through the middle and the tallest archway. turn your body to the left until you are looking out into the dining room. you are going to take a step forward into the dining room in between the dining areas. once you are in between the two dining areas, to your right there should be a oval glass table with a couch and two chairs. to your left should be a full on dining table. once you're there you are done.

63294.instruction: You are facing towards a wooden edge of a wall, turn right and enter into the room through the open door, keep walking straight till you enter into another open door, continue walking in the path of the carpet till you enter into another open door. Take a few steps ahead and stop when you are facing towards an open door with a round table on your left and two round pots on your right. You have reached your destination.

63295.instruction: Now you are facing towards a brown wooden pillar. Turn right. Move forward in the walkway. You will see an open door. Go through the open door. Turn slightly right. You will see another open door. Go through the open door. Stand in front of the open door where you will find a brown table to your left and a pink sofa and chairs to your left, and a fireplace to your right. You have reached your destination.

63411.instruction: You are facing towards the photo frames which are mounted to the wall and the open door. Turn around and walk through the open door. Now you are standing at the door facing towards the photo gallery. That will be the end point.

63435.instruction: You begin looking into a fancy bathroom. Turn to your left, almost ninety degrees, and you should see an open door next to a shower. Go through that open door and then turn right and move through the archway into a bedroom with an active fireplace going. Take a step forward, towards the side of the bed, and then turn right and move through the open double doors, outside. Once you're on that, I suppose it's kind of a balcony, move to the left side of it, on the other side of the pillar, and once you're on the other side of that pillar you are done.

63440.instruction: You begin next to a bed looking out of a door, go ahead through that door and then through the door at the back right of this squarish atrium. You should be entering a bathroom. Go ahead past the shower and towards the bath tub just one step. Once you are basically in line with the beginning of the bathroom counter on your left, and the end of the shower stall on your right, you are done.

63510.instruction: You are facing towards the green trees, now turn around there is an open door, move towards the entrance of the house, there are some stairs climb up the stairs and move forward, now slightly take left and move towards the wall, now you are facing towards the three switches on the wall, now slightly take left and enter into the room through the open door, now slightly take left and move towards the lamp, stand in front of the lamp it is your end point.

63511.instruction: You are facing towards an arch, turn around and climb up the steps, go forward on to the carpet, slightly turn left and go forward towards the entrance that is beside the stairs, pass through the entrance, slightly turn left and go forward towards the lamp that is at the corner of the room, here facing towards the lamp you have reached the destination.

63531.instruction: You begin in a kitchen, turn to your left, you will see a stone archway, next to the stone archway, there is another archway, through that archway you can see a black table against the couch, take a step towards that table, and then turn to your left again, take a step towards the dining table in the distance, ignore the small dining table, and take a step behind the very long dining table, once you're standing to the left of the cabinet with a mirror on top of it, and the dining table is behind you, you are done.

63532.instruction: You will start by facing a statue. Turn right you will see a table ahead of you and on the right side there's an opening. Walk towards the opening on the right. Turn right exit this room. Once you're on the hallway turn left you will see an opening on the left with a maroon couch inside. Walk inside this room. Take a step forward and turn right. You will see a white statue. Walk towards that and stand on the left side of it and you're done.

63636.instruction: You are standing near a bookshelf on your right and a desk on your left,turn left and exit the study room, then take few steps inside the hall way, near the console table staying in front of it and then turn right now their is a very long hall way straight ahead so start walking, you will pass some doors on your right and on left, then you will pass a console table on your right and then you will pas another hall way on your right and some doors on your left then you will see that their are pots on the floor, pass them then enter the threshold of the arch way straight ahead and then turn right, their is another arch hall way where their are four pictures on your right and one big picture on your left, and a walk way straight ahead inside a bedroom, enter this bedroom take a step in the front of the beige couch near the window, once you are in front of it and the bed is on your right, walk near the foot of the bed, just in front of the bench and the windows, then their is another arch opening on left inside  washroom their is a window and a towel hanger in front of it stand near it and you are done.

63686.instruction: Right now you are facing your brown door. Turn slightly to your left and exit the door sorry exit the room. Walk straight and you see two doors to your left. Walk towards the second door to your left. Stand near the entrance of the door.  Turn around, you can see a door to your right. Walk towards the door to your right and stand near the entrance of the door. Now you see a spa bed in front of you. Turn to your right and you see a door which is opened. walk towards the door and stand at entrance of the door. This is the end point.

63687.instruction: Now you are standing in the washroom. Exit the door which is towards your left and take the immediate left turn and enter the room where you have a plant towards your right side. The destination is reached.

63758.instruction: You are in a living room. Turn right until you see stairs, go up, at the top of the stairs look right. You will see a bed and further right still you will see a large wooden armoire maybe. Continue past that into the next room which has two beds in it but keep going forward toward the furthest bed away from you. Stop when you are left, right of this last bed staring at the slanting ceiling.

63808.instruction: You are standing inside a closet door, exit and now should be facing a bed which has yellow and white bed covers and a  bear on it. Turn right and exit from the open door in front of you. Once you exit you should be standing near a staircase railing so turn left, so now their should be a small door way in front of you, go straight ahead and crossing the washroom on your left and entering the room in front of you into a room which ha white bed covers and a brown throw on it, with blue pillows, once you are inside the bedroom and facing the bed, move towards the right side of the bed near the night stand, once you are here turn right and move straight ahead crossing the closets on both sides and entering through the open door in front of you which is a washroom, once you are near the pot, you are done.

64009.instruction: You are on the fifth step from the bottom, facing towards the wall, turn right and get down the stairs, you are now facing towards an open entrance and a narrow path. Turn extreme right and move towards the stairs, turn slight right and get down the stairs, you are now facing towards the open door. Turn slight right and move towards the passage, you are now facing towards the wall, turn right and get down the stairs completely, here you can see three open doors, two in front of you and one on your left, move towards the entrance, which is in front of you, beside the two portraits on the wall on the left side. Turn slight right and move towards the closed door, which is in front of you, now turn left and move towards the carton boxes, you are now standing in front of the carton boxes, facing towards the portraits. This is your end point.

64010.instruction: You are standing on the staircase facing towards the wall. Take a slight right turn climb down the steps. You will find yourself standing on a blue color Carpet. Now take slight right turn where you will find some more staircase. Get down the staircases. You will find a door, step out of the door. you will find some more staircases. Get down the staircases, where you can see a painting onto your right side and a door which directs you to the another room. Walk though the corridor, you will find yourself where there is table and 2 chairs which are places on the red color carpet. Walk till the white door which is in front of you. Take a slight right turn, where you can see some brown color boxes which are covered with the plastic covers. Go near the box which is in front of you. You have reached your destination.

64074.instruction: You are facing towards the wall, turn around and move towards the television. Now you are standing near the sofa, turn slight right and move towards the stove. Turn right and move forward. Now you are near the sink. Turn right and move towards the dinning table. Turn right and move towards the sofa which is in front of you. Now turn right you can see steps, move towards that steps and completely climb them. Keep moving forward. Take few more steps ahead. Now you are facing towards the closed door and to your right you can see a window and a commode. The position you are standing is your final destination.

64075.instruction: You are facing towards a glass door, turn around and move forward, walk in between the centre table and the chair and move forward towards the fridge, turn slightly right and move forward between the countertop and the stove, move forward. Turn right, you can see a wash basin on your left, move forward towards the table. Turn right and walk in between the table and the countertop and move forward. Turn to your right, you can see stairs, climb up the stairs and move forward. You can see a white coloured closed door on your left and onto your right side you can see some stairs. Move a few steps forward and stand there. You are now facing towards a brown coloured closed door and on your right side you have an open bathroom door and this is your end point.

64090.instruction: You are facing a table.  You are going to turn to your right.  You are going to exit this area.  You will step onto to some tile and on the right will be a telephone sitting on a counter.  You are going to make a left on the tile and go down this hallway.  You will go thru an archway in front of you.  Once thru the archway you are going to make a left.  There will be a picture on the wall on your left and 4 pictures on the wall on your right.  Move forward heading towards the open door in front of you.  You have stepped into a bedroom.  You are going to go around the bed heading towards the open arched doorway.  You are going to step into a bathroom.  And you are going to move into this bathroom heading straight into it and stopping with the windows on your left and the toilet sink area on your right and you are done.

64132.instruction: You are standing on the steps, climb the steps take a left turn. Go two steps ahead then take a right turn, you will see a door which is open. Enter into that, you will see a dog and a open door walk into that, go straight near to the wall which has a window.

64133.instruction: Now you are facing the railing,turn around and go up,if you turn left there is a open door which is in the corner,enter into it move towards the sofa and turn right,move forward there is a open door,move towards and stop in front of the wall.

64157.instruction: You are in a living area, turn left, in front you can find a corridor. Keep on moving forward till you find a white color table in the kitchen area. Stand near the table and turn left, you can find a section. Go through the section and you will enter an other corridor, keep on moving forward till you find an other entrance in front. Go through that section and you will enter into a circular room, stand in between two wooden doors and you reached your destination.

64158.instruction: You find yourself in a living room, facing towards the sofa's. Take a left and head straight towards the kitchen area and take a left towards the open arch which is present on your left and head straight towards the open door which is in front of you. That leads to two closed doors, stand in front of the wall. This is your final point.

64196.instruction: You begin in a living room of sorts. Turn ninety degrees to your right, you should see an open doorway. Move through that open doorway and down the hall towards the wicker baskets. Once you're at that corner with the wicker baskets on your right, turn left and move all the way down the hallway, again. Once you're all the way down the hallway you should have a set off stairs on your left hand side. Move up those stairs, all the way, and at the top of the stairs you should turn right. Moving through the open doorway on your right, you should just take one step through them and make an immediate left. You should see a kitchen area. Move along the left side of the kitchen island, keeping it on your right until you are directly at a... Wow, I don't know what that is. Maybe an espresso machine or something? There's some kind of built in machine with a stove top to its right, you're going to move to the left though. You should see a glass dining table through the open doorway. And then, as soon as you're through that open doorway, turn right and move between the dining table and the window with the fence outside. Once you are between the near side head of the dining table and that window, you're done.

64207.instruction: Right now you are standing in a room facing a wall. Turn around and you can see a opened door and you can see a cupboard with two lamps on it. Move towards the cupboard which has two lamps on it. Take a left turn and move towards the window and that is the end point.

64208.instruction: You are in a room facing towards the wall and a small wooden table which has a decorative item on it. Turn around to your right and walk straightly towards the wooden desk which has books and two lamps on it. Now slightly turn left and walk straightly towards the window in front of you. You are standing in front of the window. You have a wooden desk on your right side and a statue on table to your left side. That will be the end point.

64272.instruction: Walk up the steps, now slide right towards the open door and move straight, enter into the bedroom, now walk straight towards the glass door beside the bed, now stop in front of the lamp which is beside the bed where you can find a window towards your right and you have reached your destination.

64273.instruction: Right now you are on the stairs, facing towards the railing, now climb up stairs, where you find an open entrance on your right, enter into the bedroom and move towards the closed door, now stand facing towards the closed door, where you will find a cupboard on your left and a chair on your right, this will be your end point.

64283.instruction: You are facing a room with a dining room table in the corner.  You are going to turn to your left.  And you are going to walk between the tan sofa on your right and the wall with a painting on it on your left and make a left down the hallway.  You are going to continue down the hallway.  You see in the corner on  your right 2 wicker vase shaped baskets, you are going to go to the left.  Continue down the hallway.  You are going to take the hallway all the way down to the end and you will see on your left a staircase.  You are going to go up that staircase.  At the top of the staircase you are going to turn right. You will be entering a large area with a kitchen area to your left and a living room area to your right with a fireplace.  You are going to head right towards the seating area across from the fireplace.  There will be wood cabinets and shelving on the wall to your right and there will be a brown end table next to the couch.  You are going to go to the left of that end brown table so you are walking towards the corner, middle corner of the couch.  So you will be walking in between the couch and the coffee table.  And you are going to stop right in front of the couch at the corner of the coffee table to your right.

64329.instruction: You are in front of the dining table. Move forward, pass through the chair. Take left, you will find upstairs. Take the stairs and go upward direction. Once you reach up, take left. You will find an opened door in front of you. Enter into that room through that door. Take right once you enter into the bedroom and that will be your end point that is on the carpet, beside the bed and then stop.

64330.instruction: Now you are in a hall and facing towards the mirror. Turn slightly left. Move forward to the red chair. Turn slightly left. You will see a stairs. Go up the stairs. Turn left. You will see an open door. Go into the open door. Turn right. Move forward to the bed. You have reached your destination.

64413.instruction: You begin facing a chair and a pool table in a cabin, take a step to the left of the pool table, and turn to your left, you will see a kitchen in front of you, some windows and glass doors to your right, and some furniture to your left, take one step towards the glass double doors, and then take 1 step towards the staircase to your left, take one more step forward and then take 3 steps to go up the staircase, once you're standing on the third step on the staircase, take 1 last step forward so that you're, you've reached the very top of the staircase and that's your endpoint.

64430.instruction: You begin facing a kitchen, turn around to your left, take 2 steps going down the kitchen, from where you're standing, there is a bathroom in front of you and like barely to the right you can kind of see a hallway, take a step into that hallway, you will see a bedroom, turn to your right, take a step into the room that's right next to this bedroom, once you're in the threshold of this room with a gray wall and a bed with a green throw, take one last step into the very far corner of the room with the lamp, once you're facing the corner, you're done.

64474.instruction: We start off in a room facing a couch and a TV. Turn around. You will see a passage out of the room and into the hallway. Take a step into the hallway. Turn left and you will see a flight of stairs. Walk to the flight of stairs. As you are at the step of stairs turn to your left an you will see a few steps that lead you down. Walk down those steps and stop. Just as you are on those steps. You are done.

64590.instruction: You will start by facing the wall. Turn left take a step towards the toilet. Turn left once again and exit the washroom. Once you're facing the bed turn left and walk towards the door. Turn left once again and exit the bedroom. Once you're facing the staircase railing turn around and there will be another bedroom to the left. Walk inside this bedroom and stand at the right bottom corner of the bed. Once you're here, you're done.

64623.instruction: You are now facing towards the wall, walk straight and take slightly right and move towards the wall and stop beside the black colour chair where there is flower plant at the left. Turn slightly left and walk straight. You are in the kitchen. Now turn slightly left and walk towards the two chairs which has a glass table, with a plant on it. Then turn slightly right and move towards the room, there is a photo frame to your left and also the window glass. Now move towards the square table which is to your right. You are now facing towards the fire place, and this is your end point.

64624.instruction: You are standing beside the dinning table, slightly walk towards the left side. Go straight, then turn to your left side, your are in the kitchen then walk forward, then turn left side, you will be in a living room. Walk until you reach the main hall.

64644.instruction: For your start point you are in a hallway to the right you will see there's a black framed hanging mirror move forward passing the console table to your left with the two gray hanging pictures.  Continue moving forward through the hall you will reach an intersections to the right you will see there's a living room and your left there is a hall move forward to the left through the hall. You will pass two entry ways on either side of you and you will make your way to another seating area it could be a study that's straight  ahead of you. Turn to the right and move forward through the short hall. You will see that there is a open doorway straight ahead of you and you will see an open doorway to the left. Go through the open doorway to the left and enter into the bathroom. And stand in front of the bathtub once your there you have reached your end point.

64696.instruction: You are facing towards the window, turn left and move forward. Now you are facing towards the marble platform, turn right and move towards the sink. Now turn left and move towards the open entrance which is opposite to you. Pass through that. Now slightly turn left and move in the narrow path. Keep moving straight. Now you are facing towards the fire place. Turn left and move towards the carpet. Now you are facing towards the chair and table lamp. Turn left and move on to the steps. Now climb the steps completely. You are facing towards the wall, turn left there is an open door, move towards it. Now turn right and move towards the bed. Now you are facing towards the bed and to your slight right there is a table lamp. The position you are standing is your final destination.

64697.instruction: You're facing towards the glass window, turn around and towards your left, you can see a glass round table, from the table turn to your right, walk a few steps forward, and then slightly tun to your left, you can see a gas stove towards your right, walk a few steps forward you have an open white door in front of you enter the door, walk behind the dining table, go straight you can see a sofa onto your left, from there turn to your left, towards your left you have a staircase, climb the stairs now turn right, sorry left, you have an open white door in front of you, enter the door walk straight till the bed facing towards the lamp is your final destination.

You should have the bed on your right and you should see a chair kind of in front of you on your left and then you're going to turn towards your left until you see the next archway. Walk towards the archway and look into the room and you should see a blue/grey rug in front of you. Step onto the blue/grey rug so that you are looking at a mirror.

66238.instruction: You are facing towards the open door in front of you, turn around, there is an open door in front of you, go straight near the open door, slightly turn right, go straight and enter the open door, in front of you there is another open door, go straight near the open door, slightly turn right, go straight and exit the door, slightly turn right, there are two chairs and cupboards on the right side, go straight, there is an open door in front of you and two chairs on the right side, go straight and exit the door and stop there, this is your final destination.

66239.instruction: You're facing to the door. Turn around, you can see doors open on your right. Walk towards the doors. Turn slight right, walk straight towards the opposite doors. You can see a wall with photographs in front of you. Walk towards the wall taking a slight right turn. And you have the wall with photographs on your left now. Turn slightly right, you can see doors open in front of you. Walk to the doors. Enter the room. Stop right beside the arch. It is your destination.

66294.instruction: Turn left from the place you are standing and go up the stairs, now you are facing towards the wall, turn left and move a bit forward, you are facing towards the door, where to the left you can find steps, that would be your end point.

66295.instruction: You are now facing the wall, from there take a left turn. Start walking up the stairs and when facing to the wall take a left turn, walk a few steps forward and stand in front of the door.

66296.instruction: You begin facing a white-sheeted bed with a door open just to the right of you. SO what you're going to do is walk up to the corner of the bed, turn right and then exit through this door into the small bathroom. Now walk through the middle of the bathroom, past the sink on the right and the toilet on the left through the door at the other end, and you will find yourself in another similar bedroom. What youre gonna wanna do is walk to the edge of the  brown carpet in front of you in front of the railing and go around this door. And then take a few steps forward along the railing to the left until you are standing just in front of where you began with the large piece of brown furniture and the glass jug to your right.

66355.instruction: You are standing in a hall way outside the massage room, go inside the massage room, take a step only inside the massage room and turn back into second room on your left. Now their is another massage room which has bath robe hanging near the bed take a right near the bed and a soon you are near the dustbin and the sink you are done.

66376.instruction: Take a right turn, start moving straight till the wooden book shelf, here take a right turn, go straight till the black color door. Step outside the door and here take a right turn, enter into the room which is beside the stairs. Start moving straight until we see a frame on the wall.

66377.instruction: You are facing towards the big window and a table with a telephone. Turn around and take left passing through the mirror. Now, take right from the bookshelves. You will find an open door. Pass through that door and take right. You will find another open entrance. Enter through it and that will be your destination point in the middle of the room facing towards an open door.

66404.instruction: You are standing on a staircase, go up the staircase and proceed straight ahead towards the opening in front of you, cross the ladder on your right and take the first left, then enter this library kind of room and turn right towards the heater and the book on the floor near the right side window, you are done.

66421.instruction: "Okay now, you are facing towards the wall. Turn slightly right, and move forward until, you reach the stair case in front of you. Now turn left, you can see the open door in front of you. Now enter into that room, and turn left, you can see the window in front of you. Now go near to that window, you can see the statues in front of you. Now, you have reached your destination."

66422.instruction: You are facing towards a wall, turn right, walk straight in the narrow path till you reach towards the staircase, turn right and enter into the room through the open door, turn left and walk towards the statue, you have reached your destination.

66444.instruction: You are facing towards the washing machine, turn back move little forward and exit the room, take right and walk straight and enter into the second open door at the right side, walk straight and exit the room, and take left where you can find a sofa, fire place and a dining table, walk straight behind a sofa you can find an another room in front with a round table and four chairs, and there is an open door at the back of the chair, go straight and reach the door you can find your destination at the back of the chair and front of door.

66445.instruction: You are facing towards a wooden cupboard, turn around and exit the room through the open door right in front of you. Turn right and move forward in the narrow walkway until you reach an open arch, pass through it and turn slightly right and enter the room on your right and move forward. You have wooden cupboards on your right side, move forward through the open door. turn slightly left and enter the open arch on your left side. Turn slightly left and walk towards the couch. Turn slightly left and walk in between the bar stools and the couch and move forward towards the open  entrance which is right in front of you, pass through it. Turn slightly left and move forward. Turn slightly to your right and move forward. Stand between the open glass door and the table on your right and this is your end point.

66489.instruction: Walk to the end of this wallwat. Walking to the cabinet that has a vase on top. Now you will turn into the kitchen. Once you are just inside the kitchen, turn left again. This will have the refrigerator on your left side and the island on your right. Take another right inside the kitchen. Now you will have sinks on your left and right side. Walk to the end of the kitchen and once you are at the island that has the fine china, you will hop over that counter and go into the dining area with the glass table top. Now turn toward your left and walk toward the more formal dining table. When you are at the head of the table furthest away from the window, you will turn left and you will find you are going back into the kitchen. Take two large steps in the kitchen. When you are beside the four barstools, right in the middle of the four, and an outside door you have reached your final destination.

66627.instruction: You're now facing the television. Turn left, walk slightly forward and turn left again. Now walk straight towards the open entrance and turn left just before the open entrance. Now move forward by passing the stove on your right. Move forward where you will also cross a washbasin on your left. After crossing the washbasin, turn slightly right and you will find two rooms. Get into the second room where you will find a table with two books. Get inside that room and walk to the corner where you will see the window on your left and that is your end point.

66628.instruction: You are facing towards a television, turn left, walk towards the table with four chairs, slightly turn left, walk towards the open entrance, turn left, walk in the path between the kitchen counter top and the stove, continue walking straight till you reach towards an open door, step into it. You are now at the entrance of a bed room, turn right, take a step ahead, turn left, walk towards the left side of the bed. You are now facing towards a window with a bed behind you. You have reached your destination.

66635.instruction: Facing the pool table, walk to the left through the open sliding door. Once you're through the open sliding doors, turn a hard left and walk towards the dining room table in the distance, staying to the left of the chair and couch and to the right of the wall and the side table with the very large wine glass looking thing. Keep heading towards the right most portion of the dining room table. Stop when you just get to the last chair on the right side. Turn around, there's two identical archways to the left and a bigger archway to the right. Take the bigger archway. Head straight through the little archway into the circular foyer area where there'll be stairs just to the right. Walk towards the stairs but don't get on. Just to the left of the stairs is in archway, walk into that near archway. In another circular area, where there is a large clock on the wall to the right, to the left of that a mirror and a star light on the ceiling. The two archways in front of you, take the left one. Keep walking straight down that hall. Take the first left after the picture of people on horses. Walk into the bathroom and stand in front of the sink. You're done.

66648.instruction: You are facing towards the glass windows. Turn around and now you are facing towards the living room. Slightly turn right and move towards the chair. Now slightly turn right and walk straightly in the hallway till you find a staircase on your left side. Turn left and walk all the way to the top of the stairs. Turn right and move towards the bed. Now you are standing in front of the bed. That will be the end point.

66649.instruction: You are facing towards the window right now, slightly turn to your left, you can find a single couch, move towards the single couch, move a bit forward, to your left you can find a staircase, go up the stairs, turn right and move a bit forward, now you are infront of a chest box, which is infront of the bed, that would be your end point.

66725.instruction: You begin in a very fancy red room, on a red carpet. Turn around to your left, nearly fully around and follow the red carpet around the small right hand corner and then towards the door... The first door on your left. The not quite as fancy door. As soon as you're through that door on the square and triangle patterned tiles, you're done.

66814.instruction: Turn around and move forward, and take left near to the chair, and move near to the table, and from the table, go near to the chair of dining table, and from the chair, go near to the stairs and move upstairs.After moving upstairs, take right and move near to the bed, and from the bed enter into washroom, and from the washroom move forward and enter into the bedroom, and from the bedroom, move forward near to the chair, and then take right and move forward near to the cupboard, and end near the cupboard.

66815.instruction: You are near the stairs, turn towards your right and keep moving forward. Walk along side the staircase support and turn towards your left, in front you can find a brown color dinning table. Go near the dinning table and turn towards your right. Keep moving forward along the dinning table on your right and turn right again. In front you can find a stove, go near that and turn towards your right. In front you can find a staircase, go near the stairs and climb up the stairs, all the way to the top floor. Now you are on a top floor, turn towards you right and you are in a bedroom. Go and stand beside the bed and turn towards your right. You can find a white door on the right side, keep moving forwards and pass through the door. You enter into a washroom. In front you can find an another white door, go pass through the door and you enter into an another bed room. Stand beside the bed and turn right again, move forward near the staircase support and turn right. Walk along side the staircase support and the brown color cupboard on your right. Move forwards and stand between brown color cupboard and a staircase support. You reached your destination.

66840.instruction: Right now you are standing infront of the long table with two chairs slightly take left and exit the room take left and move forward and take right move forward on the left you can see the pot on a table and the portrait on the wall, move little forward on the right you can see the guitar and this is your final destination.

66841.instruction: Now you are facing towards the table with two chairs, turn left, in front of you there is a open door, enter in to the room by going straight, turn left and exit the room, walk straight towards the closed room which is in front of you, turn right and walk straight, towards your right there is a table, on the table there is plant pot which is in rectangular shape, from there slightly turn left and walk straight few steps and towards you right there is a guitar on the wall, this would be your final destination.

66911.instruction: Now you are standing in a wash room facing towards the wall, now turn to your left, you can see a open door in-front of you and washbasin to your right, exit the room and stand, that's your end point.

66912.instruction: You are standing near the toilet commode make a slight left turn and exist the washroom in front you will find a room with a cupboard at the left side and right side in that cupboard room we reached our destination in the middle of the room.

66915.instruction: You are standing in the doorway of a bedroom.  To the left of you you will see some stairs, to the right is a walk way.  Go towards that walk way.  You are going to enter a bedroom straight in front of you.  In the middle of the room will be a white fluffy rug, on the right on the wall will be a painting of a girl.  You will see a walk way on your right past that painting.  Go thru.  And you will make an immediate right  into a bathroom.  And you will stop right in front of the sink by the door.  You are done.

66939.instruction: "Now you are facing towards photo, turn towards left, walk straight, you can find a door, go forward till you reach the dead end. You many come across several doors, towards dead end, there is left side way, enter inside it, turn left there is statue, walk forward towards it and turn left you can see another door, exit from the door. You can find the steps get down the steps. Towards last fourth step, your destiny has been arrived."

66940.instruction: Turn left from the place you are standing, walk towards the open brown door on your opposite, step out of the room through the door and walk towards another room on your opposite, enter into the room through the open door, turn left, enter into another room through the open door, turn left and walk towards the black statue, turn left, exit the room through the open door and walk towards the staircase, get down the stairs till you reach towards an open door, turn right, take a step ahead, turn right and get down the stairs till the half way. You have reached your destination.

66951.instruction: You'll start facing a door and a bed. Step to the foot of the bed and turn left. Now you'll see there's another open door/. Walk through that open door into the hallway and take a step towards that white railing where the stairs are. Now facing two double doors and the stairs to your right, to your left, walk through that doorway into that bedroom. Now you should be facing the bed and to your left is two chairs. You're going to look straight ahead and walk towards that end table and turn right. Walk through the closet. You're going to step into the bathroom and stop when you're in front of the toilet.

66972.instruction: You're starting in a dining room, facing a window with curtains. Turn to your left until the table is on your left hand side and you can see a hallway going down the right. You will also see white flowers down that hallway. Take a step toward the white flowers. You'll see bar stools in front of the counter that the flowers are on. Take a step to the bar stool that's closest to you. Then take a left into the kitchen, passing the flowers on your right. You'll then walk between the two islands on your right. There's a farm sink on the left island and then there's a farm sink farther down on the right island. Go ahead and walk straight through these toward the microwave. At the microwave, take a left and walk past the refrigerator on your right. Then take a right past the refrigerator and walk across the hall into the room in front of you. There are two bright windows and a brown table in that room. Take another step and you'll see two white refrigerators on your right and then to your left, at the far end of the room, you'll see a wooden door that has a rounded top. It's open. Take a step to that wooden door. Once you're in front of that door, to your right is a wooden bookshelf and to your left is a bathroom. When you're here, you are done.

67008.instruction: For your start point you will begin in a bedroom. You will need to turn to your right and hop over the bed on your right and make your way to the threshold of the open doorway on your right. So now the bed should be behind you and your standing at the doorway between the bedroom and the walk in closet. In front of you, you will see a shaggy area rug. And you are done.

67053.instruction: You begin facing a console table, looking slightly to the right, go all the way down this hallway, you will pass a living area on your right, once you enter a room with a kitchen on the left and al living space on the right, take a couple steps forward and then go through the opening on the left that's after the kitchen and turn into the room immediate to your right, take 3 steps forward and then enter the room that's on the left, next to the bed, it is a bathroom, take one step into this bathroom and then take one last step into the toilet room on the left, you are done.

67060.instruction: Okay, now you are in a room facing towards a wide open entrance, slightly turn to your right and go straight through the wide open entrance by passing the chairs, which are on the left side. Now turn left and go straight by passing the sofa chair, which is in front of you. Now you are standing next to the staircase, which is on the left side. Now slightly turn to your left and move a bit forward. Now you are facing towards a closed door, slightly turn to your left and go straight through the open entrance, which is in front of you. Now you are standing at the entrance, slightly turn to your left and enter the room. Now turn right and walk all the way straight towards the chair, which is in front of you. Now you are facing towards the chair and there is fire place on your right side and this is the end point.

67061.instruction: "Okay now, you are facing towards the white colour chairs turn slightly right, and move forward, you can see the small table in front of you. Now slightly turn left, and move forward, you can see the mirror in front of you. Now slightly turn left, and mover forward, you can see the potted plant on the left side. Now slightly turn left, and move forward, you can see the dining table in front of you. Now slightly move forward, and turn right, you can see the sofa set on the left side. Now slightly move forward until, you reach the black colour chair in front of you, and there is a fireplace on the right side. Now, you have reached your destination."

67105.instruction: Right now your standing in a living area. Go closer near to the white sofa chair at your right side from the sofa chair go straight there you will find a open door just entered in to the open door. Go straight until you can see a stair case. Go straight on the left side you can see a closed door on the right side you can see a stair cases. Here we reached our destination in between the stair case and open door.

67106.instruction: You are in the balcony area facing towards the wall. Now walk towards the white tea-poi and the sofa. Slightly turn right and walk towards the entrance beside the white dining table. Again slightly turn right and enter the living room. Now walk straightly in the hallway by passing the couches on your left side and a refrigerator on your right side towards the stairs. Now climb the five steps in front of you and walk straight till you reach the white closed door to your left and a staircase to your right. So that will be the end point.

67146.instruction: You are standing in a bedroom at the foot of the bed with a wooden chest on your left.  Head to the open door on the right of the bed leaving the bedroom.  Now you are in a bathroom with a tiled white floor. Walk directly to a few feet in front of the toilet with a glass shower on your left and a sink on your right.  You are at your destination.

67163.instruction: Starting off you should see a kitchen with a lot of stone. We are going to 90 degrees to the right and you should see some black chairs, or stools, by the island. Looking past the black stools you should see a hallway, so we are going to walk towards this hallway. You are going to continue walking straight down this hallway with the lights above. Stepping forward you should see in the hallway that there are pictures on the wall, four on the right and one on the left. And then there is a room at the end of the hallway, you are going to step into that room. In the room you should see a white chair, and there's a picture on the wall and then some blinds or curtains, so we're going to step towards that left curtain. Standing there by the curtain and the glass door we will look to the right and you should see another room. We're going walk in through that door into this room. Looking in the room you will notice it's a washroom, and there are two, sorry, three blue mats on the floor. We are going to stand in front of the left mat of the three. Once we are standing in front of these mats we are done.

67220.instruction: Begin facing 2 windows in the corner of a room. Turn left to see a dining table. Head down the left right of that table until you see an open door leading outside on your right. Head outside then head back inside through the door opposite you. Head past the new dining table on the right side to the back of the beige couch. Hop on the beige couch like a cat and head to the small circular table by the fire place and you're done.

67278.instruction: You will start by standing in the middle of the stairs looking down. Turn right and continue to walk up the stairs. Don't mind the open doorway to your right. Stop once you've reached the floor where there are two open doorways in front of you. There's one on the right where there is a statue on top of a table. Take one step inside that room. From there, turn around and take one step towards of the staircase on your right. Now turn around again and walk towards the second room where there is a brown table and a statue on the left, on the floor. Take one step inside this room and turn to your left and you will see a large opening with teal coloured doors. You will see a fireplace on your right and a large window in front of you. Walk towards the large window. Once you're standing in front of that and to your left you will see a bookshelf, then you're done.

67279.instruction: You begin facing a lamp and a fireplace, turn around, you will see a doorway, go through it, take a step forward and then go down the staircase to the right, you will see a door that will open up, stand in the threshold of that door, and you're done.

67280.instruction: You are standing in-front of the black car, turn slight right, move forward. Turn alight left, move few steps forward, turn to your right, move towards the wall opposite to you, where you can see a mat on the floor. Turn to you left, walk through the open door, turn to your right, move towards the closed door on your left side. Move towards the stairs, turn to your left, climb the stairs until you see wall opposite to you. Turn to your left, move forward. You are standing in-front of the wall, and on your right side you can see table with a statue, which is your final destination.

67281.instruction: Now you are in the parking area. Turn right and walk straight a bit far, then take left. Now turn left and walk straight to exit the room through the door. Now exit the room through the door. Now take right and walk in between the walls. Now take left and walk all along the staircase. Now take left and stand near to the wall and near to a stool which is the endpoint.

67291.instruction: Good God, make your way out of this run down wine cellar and walk towards the stairs. Turn right into the room beside them and you will stop in front of that light colored door. There will be a gold statue on the window sill of - i think that’s virgin Mary - i really hope it is because the chances of you surviving in this haunted looking basement are slim. You’re done.

67306.instruction: You are facing towards a chair, turn slightly left and move forward towards the pool table. Turn left and move forward towards the glass door which is right in front of you. Turn slightly left and walk towards the second cushioned chair on your left. Turn slightly right and move forward. Now turn left, you can see a staircase, climb up the stairs and  move forward. You are now facing towards a chair and a brown coloured desk and on your right side you have a bed and this is your end point.

67307.instruction: You are standing facing towards a brown chair. Slightly turn left and come forward till the blue table. Walk a few steps ahead towards your left and exit the room. Now you are standing facing the cream sofas. Move forward passing through the sofas and turn left. You are now facing towards the steps. Climb the steps and stop near the last step in front of the brown box. You have reached your point.

67365.instruction: You're standing in a kitchen. There is an island in front of you. Keep to the left of that island, and walk toward the fireplace down the room. Before you hit the fireplace, there is a couch in front of it. Stay behind the couch and between the bar stools. Keeping the couch to your right and the bar stools to your left, walk through the kitchen into the arched entryway. Once you're standing at the entrance of the archway, you'll find there is a breakfast table in front of you and an open doorway to your left. Enter through that open doorway to the left and continue straight. Keep going straight past the open doorway. Inside again, you'll see there is a dining in front of you. Keep the dining table to your left and walk straight, continuing straight. Now, you'll find yourself in another common area with a fireplace down on the other end. But, closer towards you, you'll find there is a couch, and there is a red arm chair as well. Stand between the couch and the red arm chair. Once you're between the couch and the red arm chair, you'll see there is a coffee table with a houseplant sitting on top of it. Step over the coffee table towards the middle of the room. Once you're standing at the middl of the room, walk towards the two other arm chairs that are next to the fireplace. Once you are standing between the two arm chairs next to the fireplace, you'll see on your left there is a side table with a sculpture of a pig on top of it. A small sculpture of a pig. Walk towards that side table. Once you are there, you should be looking at the pig, and on your right is the fireplace. You have arrived.

67424.instruction: Now you are facing towards the door, turn back, you can see a staircase to your right, walk down the stairs and move forward, slightly move to your right, you can see an open door, enter into the room through an open door and move forward, you can see a black chair in-front of you, take right from there,you can see an open arch enter into it,move forward now slightly move to your left, you can see some books, stop there that's your end point.

67425.instruction: Right now you're facing towards a door. Now turn behind, there is an open door in front of you, move towards the door and turn right. There is a staircase in front of you, get down the staircase. Now, there is an open entrance, in front of you, move towards the entrance and enter in to the room. Now turn behind, there is a closed door beside the staircase, move towards the door and turn left. Now, there is an open door in front of you, which is beside the portrait, move towards the door and enter in to the room. In front of you, there is a chair and a fridge beside the chair, move towards the fridge and turn right. There is an open door in front of you, move towards the door and enter in to the room. There is a black box to your left, move towards the black box and stand in front of it and it will be your end point.

67434.instruction: You are facing 2 closed doors.  You are going to turn to your left.  You are going to head into the first room on your right.  There will be  a desk in the room.  You are going to head towards the plant in the corner next to the doors.  Once at that plant facing the doors you are going to turn to your left and move forward so that the side of the table is on your left and the closed doors on your right.  When you have reached that point you are done.

67446.instruction: You are facing a wooden rack with books and a lamp, turn around and exit through the wooden archway. You will have three arches towards your left, continue walking straight towards the rightmost open arch. Turn right after entering the arch, and continue walking straight through the white arches. After the last arch, move forward to enter the kitchen area and stop.

67447.instruction: You are facing towards the brown cupboard, turn back and walk straight and exit the room, move forward into the room which is beside the window, you can find a flower vase at the corner, turn right, walk straight through the passage, till you reach a kitchen counter space, there is a closed door at the right side and a kitchen counter space at the left side, the position now you are standing is your destination.

67519.instruction: You begin in a bathroom, turn to your left, and exit the bathroom, immediate to your right, there is a archway, go through that archway, go towards the left of the fireplace, there is a archway there, keep going forward through the open door, you will now be in a walkway, go through this walkway, once you get to the end, there will be a staircase, go down the staircase, once you're at the bottom of the staircase, immediate to your left, there is some, double open doors, take 2 steps into this opening and you're done.

67534.instruction: You're in a bathroom facing a shower turn left and take one step out. And then turn into the room on the left towards the bed. And then turn to the left and go out the open white door. And then go down the hallway to the right and you'll see some stairs on the right and a mirror on your left. Go in the room in front of you, walk all the way to the chair in the corner of the room and you've reached the end.

67564.instruction: You are standing near a staircase on the middle landing turn left go downstairs on the floor and turn left, now turn left and take few steps towards the another set of stairs , go down stairs, once you are at the foot of the stairs near the thermostat on your left , you are done.

67578.instruction: You are in the dining room facing the dining table, turn left side and walk towards the opening of the dining room, move little forward and exit the dining room, turn right side and pass the counter on the left side and enter the opening on the right side, move little forward and get down the stair case, turn right side and move little forward, again turn right side and move towards the two pots, turn right side and stand in between the two chairs in the front, that is your destination.

67579.instruction: You are at the backside of the chairs. Move forward and take right. You will find an entrance. Pass through it and take right. You will enter into the kitchen area. Go straight, there is an entrance on your right side. Get into it. Now, take left, you will find a staircase on the left side. Take the staircase and go towards down. Once you reach down, take your right side and turn towards your right and walk straight till the corner. On the right side, there is a walkway. Move forward, you will find an entrance. Enter through it, there will be a sofa on your right side. Move straight and pass through the sofa and stand in front of the two chairs at the corner. That will be your destination point.

67598.instruction: You are standing on the threshold of a empty closet, turn left and you should be facing a bed and the mat on the floor, walk towards the mat or step on the mat and you are done.

67743.instruction: You are facing towards the wall, which has number of photo frames on it, turn left, you can find an open door, exit the room, now you are facing towards the closed door, turn left, move forward, on the left you can find stairs towards up, climb up the stairs, turn left and climb the remaining stairs, move forward, there is a statue at the left side, walk straight you can find a ladder at the right side and an entrance, turn right, and enter into the room through an open door, you can find a bed, walk straight towards it by taking left, turn around, walk straight towards the lamp, now you are in front of a lamp, beside the window which is your destination.

67744.instruction: You are facing towards the wall that has some paintings on it. Turn left and exit the room. Turn left and walk straight till you reach the steps towards your left side. Turn left and climb the steps completely. Enter inside the room that is in front of you. There is a ladder towards your right side. Turn right and enter inside the bedroom through the open door. Slightly turn left and walk towards the bed. Turn left. Walk straight and stand in front of the chair. There is a bed towards your left side and window towards your right side. You have reached your point.

67788.instruction: Starting it looks like you are looking at an opened door.Turn to your left you see there is another opened door going throught a bathroom. Go through that door. Once you are through this door, to you left you see some workout machines and an opening. Stand at that opening to the left. Once at this opening you see a couch to your left. Step at the corner of this couch to the left. Step to the far corner to the left. Once there you see an opening in front of you. Step at this opening. Take a right to the opening on the right side of you. Once you are at this opening, looking forward you see a little piece that is sticking out from the wall that has a plant in a pot. Go stand in front of that, directly ahead of you. Once you are there you see to the right, there is a window with some curtains that are opened. Stand at these curtains at this window to the right.
