71443.instruction: Right now you're facing towards a chair. Now turn left, you can see two pillars in front of you, move forward and stand in between them and move a bit forward. Now turn left and exit the room through the open door which is in front of you. There is an open door in front of you, move towards the door and enter in to the room, there is a table in front of you. Now turn left and move towards the second door which is in front of you. You can see a cross statue in front of you, move towards the cross statue and stand in front of it and it is your end point.

71444.instruction: You are facing towards the black chair turn to your left side, you can see two pillars walk into them then take left turn. You will see white open door go through that door and enter into the door which is exactly opposite to that, then take a right turn then you can see a statue of a women go and stand there.

71463.instruction: You begin in a kitchen next to an island, looking towards a dining area. Turn around to your left and move to the left side of the fridge, then turn right, step in front of the fridge and then towards the chair on the left side of the glass doors. Once you're there, turn left and move into the foreboding archway and down the stairs. You should see a statue of a robed figure with kind of a flame pattern on the robe. Very cult-ish. Turn to the right and continue down the staircase. The next strange artifact that you will come upon is a giant wine bottle, of sorts. If you look to your right you can see why, this is a wine cellar, at least partially. You'll be stepping to the entrance of the wine cellar portion, and then past it, past the thermostat and towards the open door. Move through that open door into the subterranean garage. You will see that this garage, though fancy, has only one black car in it. Move slightly to the right of that black car. You should end up looking at a garage door. A single garage door, next to what one could assume are a bunch of tool cabinets. Go ahead, close to that brown garage door, on its right side. Once you're standing in front of the right side of the garage door, you're done.

71487.instruction: Turn right from the place you are standing and exit from the room. Now go straight. Now you will find an open door in front of you. On the left side you will find stair case. Now walk all the way to the top of the stairs. On the left side you will find an open door. Now enter into the door and go straight. On the right side you will find cupboard. Now turn left and go near the window. Now turn left and go straight. Now you are in front of the lamp. That will be your final destination.

71488.instruction: Okay,moving to the right you will find a path which will lead you to the stairs and moving further from the stairs to the up you will find the large figurine placed on the very right corner of the stairs and moving further from the figurine ,you will find a bed room with windows,a glass windows with a complete outside view and there is a table on which some books and lamp is placed.

71494.instruction: Walk straight behind the white color chairs and then take right and walk straight and exit the door by taking the slight left. Now enter the kitchen and turn right. Walk straight and take first the right. Now walk straight again and after crossing the stairs, take left, then walk straight towards the door which is in front of you and enter the door and stand in front of the wash basin and you will arrive at your destination.

71495.instruction: Move forward from the place you are standing, turn right and move forward, now you are facing towards the sink right now, slightly turn to your left and move a bit forward, turn right, enter into the third room which is to your right, you can find staircase to your left and a closed door to your right, enter into the area which is to the right side of the staircase, you can find portraits to your right, move towards the opened door which is infront of you, stand infront of the wash basin, that would be your end point.

71575.instruction: You are at the entrance of the room. You need to move forward and take a right, and this is the end point.

71576.instruction: You are standing in the middle of two doors, move forward, after moving you can able to see an open door, which will be right side to you, go and stand in between the open dooor, this is your destination.

71583.instruction: Right now you're in entrance of a room and facing towards the cupboards. Turn left you'll see toilet basin, stand beside the toilet basin and that is your end point.

71584.instruction: Right now you are facing towards the open door take left, infront you can see the open door enter into the open door and now you are in a washroom you are facing towards the closed window infront of you and on the left you can see the sink and this is your final destination.

71651.instruction: You are in corridor facing towards the wall, turn back and move forward, turn left and enter into the room, this is your end point.

71652.instruction: Right now you are standing beside the white open door turn back on the left you can see the railing, move forward on the left you can see the white open door enter into the room now you are in a empty room facing towards the wall and this is your destination point.

71656.instruction: Right now you're facing towards a door. Now turn left, there is a chair in front of you, move towards the chair and turn right, move a bit forward and turn behind. There is a fireplace in front of you and a chair beside the fireplace, move towards the fireplace and turn right. There is a cupboard in front of you, move towards the cupboard and turn right and move a bit forward. Now slightly turn right, you can see a dining table in front of you, move towards the dining table. In front of you, there is a cupboard, move towards the cupboard and turn right. There is a dining table to your right and some cupboards to your left, pass in between them and slightly turn right, in front of you, you can see a stove, move towards the stove and turn right. There is a staircase in front of you, move towards the staircase and climb up the stairs. In front of you there is a couch and a bed to your right, stand in between the couch and the bed and it will be your end point.

71657.instruction: You are facing towards the glass door. Slightly turn left and move towards the sofa. Slightly turn right and move a bit forward. Now turn around to your left and walk straightly towards the fire place. Slightly turn right and move towards the cupboard which has decorative items in it. Turn right and walk straightly in the passage till you find a closed door on your left side. Slightly turn right and move towards the dining table. Now walk straightly towards the wooden cupboard beside the dining table. Turn right and walk straightly behind the chairs till you reach the stove in front of you. Turn around to your right and walk towards the staircase. Walk all the way to the top of the stairs. Now slightly turn right and move towards the bed. Now you are standing in between the bed and the sofa chair. That will be the end point.

71688.instruction: As you're facing a brown table with a light lamp on top of it, walk around it to the left side and head towards the door that's wide open leading you onto a red carpet. Once you get to this doorway, there's gonna be a fireplace to the right which you're gonna walk to. At the bottom right corner in front of the fireplace is your destination.

71725.instruction: Okay right now you are facing your wash basin.Turn slightly left and exit the wash room. Go straight near your bed and turn to your right and walk near the wooden railing. Now turn to your right and walk straight till you reach your stairs. Now turn left and climb down the stairs. Once you climb down the stairs, turn right and go near the sofa in front of you and stop.

71726.instruction: Your starting point is from the rest room where there is a wash basin from there keep moving left and move forward where there is a bed from their move towards right and move forward from their again move towards right keep moving forward where you will find a white color mat and where there is a door towards the right and the bed from their  slightly move towards left then again move left where you find a stair-case then get down from the stair case completely from their move towards right where you will find a sofa chair which is your final destination.

71744.instruction: We start off facing an open door. Turn around and look at the tub. Take a step to the archway in the direction of the tub. Take a step to the right of the tub. in uh um in between both of those two open doorways. Now there's a footstool with a pink cover. Take a step towards that footstool with a pink cover and stop there you are done.

71782.instruction: You are going to start facing a wall towards a front door. Turn 40 degrees to the right and take two steps forward towards the right of the fireplace. Turn right and you are going to see a statue of a man in front of you. You are going to walk to the left of that statue. Once you are there, facing two paintings of a man and a woman, and behind you, the white statue with some writings, you are done.

71830.instruction: You are standing in a room facing towards the wall. Take a about turn where you will find cream color carpet on the floor. Onto your left side there is a table and a chair, you can find some books on the table. There is also a window and a cupboard in front of you. Take few steps towards the cupboard and take a slight left, where you will find yourself near the staircase. Climb the staircase, where you will find a brown color stand onto your side. You have reached your destination.

71831.instruction: "Okay now, you are facing towards the wooden wall. Turn around, and move forward until, you reach the stair case on the left side. Now turn left, and go up through that stair case until, you cross the window on the right side. Now, you have reached your destination."

71849.instruction: You are facing towards a bed, turn to your left and you can see an open door, exit the bedroom and move forward. You can see an open door right in front of you, enter through it. You are now in another bedroom, turn around and there is an open door on your right side, enter it, turn slightly right and move forward. You are now facing towards a bathtub and a window and this is your end point.

71850.instruction: Right now you're facing towards a bed. Now turn behind and exit the room. There is an open door in front of you, move towards the door and enter in to the room. Now turn behind, there is an open door to your right, move towards the door and enter in to the room. Now turn right, there is a bath tub in front of you, move towards the bath tub and stand in front of it and it is your end point.

71886.instruction: "Okay now, you are facing towards the wall. Turn slightly left, and exit the room, you can see the wall in front of you. Now slightly turn left, and move forward, you can see the dining table in front of you. Now slightly turn left, and move forward, you can see the glass window in front of you. Now, you have reached your destination."

71887.instruction: You are facing toward the wall, move forward towards the wall, turn slightly left and move towards the table, now turn left and move towards the glass window, this is your end point.

71888.instruction: You are facing towards a white coloured chair, turn to your right and you can see a white chair which is just beside a potted plant. Move towards the chair. Now turn to your left and you can see an open entrance, move towards the entrance. Turn around and there is an open door on your left, enter through the door and move forward. You can see a couch on your right side, move forward. There is a counter with three chairs on your right side. Now turn slightly right and move forward. You are now standing between two kitchen counters and move forwrd towards the gas stove. You are now facing towards a stove and a chimney and this is your end point.

71889.instruction: You are standing in a living room, facing towards the white color chair. Take a slight right, Where you will find  a chair with a brown color cushion on it and a table. Walk in between the sofa and the table. You will find your self near the white color chair which is onto your right side. There is also a plant beside the chair. Now take a slight left where you will find an entrance, which directs you to the other room. Now a slight right, where you will find a brown color glass doors, which are open. Go near the door and step out of the room, where you will find a red color carpet on the floor, which has a grey color sofa on it, which is onto your right side. There is also a brown color table which has a flower vase and a book on it. Walk through the walk way, where you will find, yourself in the entrance of the kitchen. Take few steps towards the right, where you can see a brown color cupboard. Now take a slight left. There is a stove in front of you and brown color cupboards. Take few steps towards the stove. You have reached your destination.

71920.instruction: You're in a study area. Turn left,you'll see a hallway going left and hallway going right take the left one. You'll see a painting on the right that says closer, head into the room in front of you, stop when you see the records on the wall just to your right.

71956.instruction: At present you are at the entrance walk straight and then turn slightly towards your right you will see an opened brown door pass through it and walk on the red carpet in front of you, go straight and pass through the another brown door in front of you and then slightly turn towards your right again and walk straight there are two chairs on your right beside a wooden cupboard  go near the chairs, towards your left there are photo frames mounted on the wall and towards your right there are two chairs beside the cupboard and this is your final destination.

71957.instruction: You are facing the door. Turn left, move a step forward. Turn right, move a step forward and exit the room through the open door. Walk straight on the red carpet. Slightly turn right, move a step forward. In the left you have the frames. Walk straight and stop. In the right you have a portrait, two chairs and in the left you have frames. This is the end point.

71958.instruction: You are standing in a utility room facing a washing machine. Turn to your left and exit walking to the hall and take your first right. You will see a bathroom. Walk to the edge of the sink and to the edge of the toilet will be your view from the front. To  your right will be a door with a handle.  You have arrived.

72073.instruction: We are going to start facing a white couch. We are going to turn 45 degrees to our right and we are going to walk towards the clock hanging on the wall. We are going to turn right and we are going to walk straight between the kitchen counter and the dark colored couch. Right after we pass the stools, the kitchen stools, we are going to take a left that is going to leave us in the living room area. If we turn around, we are going to see the kitchen. To the right of the kitchen, we are going to see a hall, we are going to take that hall. We should be now in front of a double door that is closed. We are going to turn to our right and we should see a sliding door right in front of us. We should have a sink on our left side. We are going to keep walking forward, pass that sink on our left side, and we are going to stop right next to the posters, wooden pictures/paintings that says New York, Time Square, Rockefeller, 5th Avenue. If we look to the right we are going to see those woods hanging, and right in front of us, we should see the sliding door closed, and to our left we should see a couple of towels. That would be our destination.

72124.instruction: You are facing towards the closed door in front of you, turn right, there is a staircase in front of you, go up the stairs, slightly turn left, there are few stairs in front of you, go up the stairs, slightly turn left, there is a staircase in front of you and stop in front of the staircase, this is your final destination.

72125.instruction: You're facing a closed door, turn right and climb up the stairs and at the turning of the staircase, stay there it is your destination.

72177.instruction: You will be in the middle of the stairway looking towards two rooms. Turn right and walk up the stairs. Turn left after reaching up and walk towards the rooms. Walk into the middle room. You will see a bath tub and towels hanging on the rack next to the mirror, walk up to the towels and stop.

72178.instruction: Now, you are facing towards the white grill that is beside the steps. Turn to your right and move upwards, taking the stairs. Now, take left and move forward. Again, take left and you will find an open door on the right side. Enter through it and move towards your slightly right side and that will be your end point which is in the corner of the washroom where you are facing the towel in front of you.

72218.instruction: You're standing near the sofa. Turn behind and walk into the open glass door. Turn left and walk behind the couch towards the dining table. Slightly turn right, there are four arches separated by a wooden pillar. Walk into the right side open wooden arch beside the pillar. Again, slightly turn right, there's another open arch. Walk into the open arch. Now you could see three arches, walk into the open arch beside the stairs. Again walk into the left side open arch beside the glass portrait. Walk through the passage till you find an open door onto your left. Walk into the open door which is a washroom. Stand near the commode. This would be your end point.

72219.instruction: Okay now you are in front of a sofa and also a flower pot. Now turn around and move forward towards the entrance, which is a glass door. Now exit that entrance. As you exit take left and move forward. There on the right you can see some sofas and now move forward from these sofas and to the left of you there is a dining table, which are brown in color and also a frame on the wall. Now turn right and you can see a wooden entrance. Now enter into that. Now take right and there you can see a flower pot, which is white in color and also a entrance beside it. Now move towards the entrance and go forward. Now to the right of you there are stairs and in front there are two entrances. Now move towards the right entrance. Sorry, right side entrance and enter into it and here to the right of you there is a table and a flower pot and also a wall clock on to the wall and in front of you there is a mirror to the wall and there are two entrances. Now move towards the left side entrance and go forward. Now to the left of you there is a photo frame on the wall. As you cross that take left and enter into a room and this is a wash room and in front of you there is a flush toilet and to the right there is a wash basin and a mirror on the wall. Now stop here and this is your final destination.

72226.instruction: You are standing near a console table and two pictures, turn right carry on straight ahead on this hall way, you will cross a room on your right and a console with mirror on your left then you will face a sofa on your right which has beige and grey cushions and a kitchen counter with sink on your left take a step towards the left as the kitchen counter ends, and when you turn left you will see that you are standing near a console table on the opposite room which has a dining table and chairs as well, once you are their turn and look at the wall which has thermostats in the cage go near them and turn a slight right, this is a room which has two tall glass doors, go in front of them, once you are in front of them you are done.

72233.instruction: Right now you are in the passage. Now walk straightly in the passage by passing the photo frames on the right side and a wooden door on the left side. Now turn right and walk towards the black bar chairs. From the bar chairs, turn right and walk straightly towards the wooden door. Now you are in front of the door. So that is the end point.

72234.instruction: Right now you are in the corridor, on the right side, you can find frames on the wall, now keep moving forward, and take right, and go straight, there you will find black chairs in front of you, now take right and go straight, now you are at the kitchen area, on the left side, you will find sink, and right side, you will find oven, walk in between them, you will find gate in front of you, go and stand in front of it, that will be your final destination.

72327.instruction: You should be facing a beaded curtain. We are going through the beaded curtain to a room with a pool on your right. Go straight towards what looks like a standing reception desk. We are going up the stairs on your left into another set of stairs. We are going up those 3 stairs as well. Towards those closed doors. We are going up again into the room directly ahead of you where there is a massage table. Once you are in that room, we are going to turn back around, skip that first door and go into that second door on your left with another massage table and a hanging robe. Go to the right of the massage table stepping forward towards the wall. You will be facing the wall, the sink will be very close to you on your left. You've reached your destination.

72341.instruction: We're facing towards a cabinet, on the left there's a stove, turn slightly to the left and walk past the stove, turn slightly to the right and walk towards the doorway that's in front of you... On your left there's a staircase, walk towards the edge of it, turn slightly to the right, walk past the doorway that's in front of you... In front of you there's what appears to be a laundry room, walk towards that... On the left there are the washing machines and on the right there's a sink, and you'll be facing towards the middle between the washing machines and the sink and that's your destination.

72353.instruction: You are in a bedroom facing towards a glass window, turn around and exit the bedroom through the open door which is right in front of you. Turn to your right and move towards the white coloured cupboards. Now turn slightly left and you can see a white pillar in front of you and there is an open entrance on the right side of the pillar, move towards it and enter through it. You are now standing beside a brown coloured shelf with some ceramic plates and bowls in it and on your right side you have white coloured cabinets and this is your end point.

72354.instruction: Now you are facing the window.Turn left and exit the room.on your right there is a closed door,move towards the door and if you look right there is a open brown door,move towards the door,you'll be entering into the kitchen and stop beside the brown rack on your left.

72395.instruction: You are standing on the red carpet and you can see a open door, walk through that door walk straight until you reach another open door go out side of that door and stand .

72396.instruction: Now you are standing beside the vase on both the sides. Pass through the red carpet, enter the next room, walk straight. Now you are exactly at the entrance of the next room. Towards your left there is a vase, a portrait and towards your right there is a couch and a portrait. The destination is reached.

72416.instruction: You are facing towards the down staircase turn slightly left and take right from the glass pot present on the floor and walk straight you can find two mats on the floor in between of the two mats on the empty floor near the cupboard is the end point.

72417.instruction: Now you are near the steps, Take a left, And towards the brown colour shelves, You will be finding a door, Stop here, This is your destination.

72503.instruction: You will start by standing inside a washroom with a spa bed in the middle. Walk towards the foot of the bed and exit the room through the doorway on your left. Now turn left and you will see a double door opening. Walk towards that. Here you will see the pool in front of you. Take two steps towards the pool. No jump over these couple of steps and stand on the left side of the pool. So now you should be standing in between the spa beds on your left and the pool on your right. You're done.

72540.instruction: You're in a bathroom facing a mirror turn to the right and exit to the bedroom. And then to the right there'll be a mirror take a step towards it. And turn right again and exit the bedroom through the door in front of you. And walk towards the brown doors in front of you. And once you're in front of the brown door turn to the right and take one step into this room. And you'll see a sink to your left and you're done.

72545.instruction: You are facing towards the steps, climb down the steps. And turn right you can find a open door, just beside the closed door. Walk near to the open door and enter the door and walk onto the mat. And walk straight till the globe and the books and stand in front of it. This is the end point and you have reached the destination.

72546.instruction: Okay right now you are facing the black railing. Turn slightly left and climb down the stairs. Once you climb down the stairs, turn slightly to your right and you see one open door in front of you to the  right. Walk straight towards that open door. Now turn slightly to your right and you see a shelves in front of you with books. Walk straight towards that shelves and stop near the sorry in front of the shelf. That is the end point.

72558.instruction: "Now you are facing towards the black sofa chairs, turn left, you can see three steps climb it, walk inside the room, then you can see another three steps climb those also, walk inside the room, which is in front and exit that room immediately, towards your left, you can see another door, go and stand in front of the door that will be your final destination."

72559.instruction: You're facing towards the exit of the swimming pool, now walk straight and you can see three steps in front of you, climb the steps and you can find an open wooden door, enter the door and walk a few steps forwards and you can see few steps in front of you, climb the steps, go straight, and you enter into a washroom, slightly turn to your left, go near to the wooden cabinet in the washroom, and come back exit the washroom, and right next to the washroom, you can find an open door towards your left side, stand in front of the door and that is your final destination.

72587.instruction: We are facing a window with a drape. Turn to the right and walk toward the four wood panel windows and take a right. Walk down this hall until you come to the second arch opening on your right.  This will be at the intersection with an open area on your left and a hallway to your front. Take a right. This leads you down a hallway and ahead of you is a white chair at the end of the room. You are on a wooden floor and in front the the chair is a white (blue flowery) carpet. Walk across the room toward the end of the bed all the way to the drape at the window to the right.  You will be on the wood floor and to your right will be the little white sofa at the end of the bed. You are at you destination.

72610.instruction: You begin looking into the reflective surface of a large television mounted diagonally. And, you will want to turn fully around, you will see that you are in a bedroom with a... Old-fashioned looking bed behind you. Skirt around the foot of the bed, keeping it on your right hand side as you move past it, and then around its other side, past the windows. Continue into the hallway past the lamp on the nightstand, and keep going, completely down that hallway. There should be open doors and paintings to your right and there should be windows to your left as you proceed. Once you reach the circular intersection of hallways and the clock, you'll want to move to the right, towards the entryway opposite the mirror. This should take you to another circular chamber. You'll want to move to the left side of that circular chamber and continue past the staircase and one open door, to the entryway that is roughly opposite of the one you entered in. Once you are through that entryway, you should see another hallway. There are open wooden double-doors on your right, the hallway continues further in front of you, and on your left is a wooden archway. Proceed through that archway into what looks to be a combination of living area and dining room. On your right you should see the dining table with many chairs, and you will want to proceed towards those. Keep them on your right hand side as you move towards the set of three double doors, the wooden double doors. Get close to those, and then move behind the chair at the head of that table. Once you're there, you're done.

72640.instruction: You will start by standing on the staircase. Continue to walk down and turn left take a step on the hallway. Turn left once again walk down the hallway. You will see an opening in front of you. The kitchen is on your left. Turn left and walk down the kitchen standing in between the stove and the island. Now turn right walk towards the head of the dining table. Jump over the chair towards the glass doors and turn right. Walk towards the other end of the glass doors facing the opening to the living room and you're done.

72682.instruction: You are standing near a counter and stools move towards the big shelf with artifacts on it. as soon as you are near the shelf turn on your left and move towards the big sofa in front of you near the coffee table, as soon as you are near the sofa and the coffee table you are done.

72685.instruction: Starting in a bedroom, walk olut the bedroom. Take oyur first left. Once youve taken the first left, walk through this doorway. You have to your left an opening to a bedroom and on the right is a hallway. Take the right to the hallway. Once down this hallway you see a stair case and theres a looks like another hallway to the left. Go up the staircase. Once at the top of the staircase take you first right into the opening . Once at this opening, directly ahead of you, you should see a table with four chairs under it and there is a window to outside. Walk directlty to that tabnle with fours chairs under, directly ahead of you. Once you are at the table with the four chairs under it, stand in front of the window that is inm front of you looking outside, and you are done.

72719.instruction: You're starting in a hallway, looking at a half open, arched door. Turn left and walk onto the white rug in front of the TV. This will take you into a bedroom. There is a tufted chaise lounge in the corner with orange pillows. Take one step to the left of that lounge, and you are done.

72720.instruction: You are facing a kitchen in front of you, turn around and now you should be facing a living room, which has beige sofas, and a TV on the wall, jump over the beige sofa in front of you and move towards the coffee table in the middle of them. Once you are standing next to the coffee table and near the blue chairs,look ahead on the wall in front of you now, the wall should be on the left which has a contrast painting on it, and beside the wall their is a stainless steel garbage bin, so move towards the garbage bin in front of you.Once you are near the garbage bin you are done.

72733.instruction: You are facing towards the wall, turn to your left there is an open door, enter into the room through the open door, the entrance of the room is your end point.

72734.instruction: You are facing towards the wall. Turn to your left, enter into the room and stand. Towards your right hand side you can see a mirror. You have reached your destination.

72794.instruction: You are in a room facing snooker table, turn left and you will see an entrance to the living room, enter that room, to your left there are two chairs a couch and a tea table in between them, stand in front of the right side chair and tea table, to the slight left you will see an arch entrance at the backside of the chair, go near that arch, now you are at the passage and will see couple of doors to your right, walk along that passage, at the end of the passage and to the slight left you will see a white marbled counter, go near it, you will see a sink and window above the sink and a stove to your left, go near that sink, turn right and move forward towards the front wooden counter, turn left and enter the room, you will see a photo frame on the wall and a wooden table in front of it, stand near the table, and now stand in between the back of the chair and the window, that is your destination.

72795.instruction: Right now you are in front of the pool table, now turn left, you will find sliding doors, now enter into the living area, and turn left, you will find glass table, now go near the table, and slightly turn left, and go straight, there you will find narrow opening, now turn left, and keep moving forward, now again turn left, and go straight, on the left side, you will find stove, now turn right, and keep moving forward, and now turn left, and go straight, you will find round table with four chairs in front of you, now turn right, you will find frame on the wall, go and stand in front of the frame, and now go straight, and stand back to the chair, that will be your final destination.

72818.instruction: You begin facing a living space, take a step towards the couch on your right and then take a step out of the opening, into the hallway, turn to your left, take 2 steps onto the staircase, and then turn around to your left, go down the staircase that you see on your left, take a step to go down, turn to your right and take a step into the laundry room, you are done.

72883.instruction: You are facing towards the washing machine. Turn around and exit the room, and enter into the white door room which is in front of you. Move forward, you are now facing towards the painting on the wall. Turn around and enter into the right side open door which has table with a white cloth on it. Turn around and climb up the stairs which are in front of you and stop facing towards the white door, and this is your endpoint.

72884.instruction: You will be facing the corner of the room with cleaning supple bottles. Turn around to find the exit of the room and step outside. Continue into the other open white door, and step towards the lamp in that room. Now turn left to the left most room with a table with a white cloth on it, step inside that room. From there, turn around and you will see a stairway. Walk all the way up the stairway and stop.

72910.instruction: Right now you are facing the couch and take your left where you can see another couch pass through the couch towards the wall beside the glass door, now take slight right where you can find two pots and arch on your right move towards the first arch and take left, now you can find find the black chairs in front of you, move towards the chairs, move forward until you reach the last chair now, take right and move forward in a narrow way where you can find a flower vase on the left and an orange couch and two chairs move towards the chairs and take left where you can find a dining table pass through the dining table where you can see a mirror and a curtain beside the cupboard, now you are in front of the cupboard take right you will find a pot with a green plant move towards it and this is your final destination.

72911.instruction: You are in the living area, standing in front of a chair, facing towards the wooden structure on the wooden table. Turn slight left and move towards the wide arch, now move towards the portrait on the wall, turn right to find two arches on the right side, move towards the first arch. Now turn left and move towards the chairs on the right side, turn slight left and move forward beside the black color chairs. You are now facing towards the arch, turn right and move forward, you have now entered the kitchen area, facing towards the rock arch. Turn left and move towards the two chairs, again turn slight left and move forward towards the arch, turn slight left, you are now facing towards the dining table, move forward and pass through the dining table, you are now standing in front of a wooden cabinet and the mirror, turn right and move forward towards the potted plant. You are now facing the potted plant, in between the curtains, which is your end point.

72915.instruction: You are in a living room near the dining table facing towards the dining table, take a left turn and go straight to the wall near the painting, move forward to the entrance, take a left turn and go straight near the entrance, take a right turn and move forward near the glass wall, take slightly right turn and go straight to the door near the painting, and move forward, and enter into the washroom. This is the endpoint.

72916.instruction: "Now your facing dining table towards your left there is sofa walk towards it. Towards left side of the sofa there is an opening enter inside it then after take right turn towards the opening you can see a glass door walk inside it, towards your straight you can see a door go straight towards that door. That is a washroom and stand near the wash basin your destiny has been arrived."

72948.instruction: You are standing in a room, facing towards the corner of the entrance, slightly turn left, walk straight, turn left, in-front of you there are two open doors, walk to the right side open door. Now you are at the entrance of bedroom, walk straight and stand in-front of the table with a lamp on it beside the window, that is your end point.

72949.instruction: Right now you are facing towards a wall. Turn to you are left and move forward and again turn to you are left. In front you can see a two open doors. Just enter into the right open door and move forward. In front you can see a sorry in front you can see a window to the corner of the room stand near the corner of the window. Here we reached our destination.

73013.instruction: You are in washroom door facing towards glassdoor, take slightly left turn and go straight near the door, turn around and move forward, again forward near the table, take a right turn and move forward near the table, and go straight, keep going straight near the glassdoor, move forward, again move forward near the glassdoor, and go straight and go near the pots, take a right turn and go downstairs, and go straight towards the wall, take a right turn and go straight, take a right turn and go downstairs, and go towards the empty vessel, take slightly right turn and go straight and move forward to the open door, take a left turn and go straight near the carpet, take a right turn and go straight, take slightly left turn and move forward near the pillar and the car. This is the endpoint.

73014.instruction: You're standing in the entrance of the room. The room is filled with books and you're facing the books, turn around and exit the room, after exiting in the front of you can see an open arch exit from that open arch, after exiting move towards your right and walk straight till you see a wide open arch onto your right side. Now you have reached the wide open arch, beside that, there are two more arches. Enter into the first arch, now you are near the first arch. Enter in that and get down the stairs, after getting down the stairs move towards your right. Onto your left, you can see an arch beside that, there is an open door move towards it and exit from that door, after exiting move towards your right. Then you can see a car move towards that ca, stand in between the pillar and the car. That is your end point.

73031.instruction: Now you are facing towards the red curtains turn towards your left and walk straight for few steps and then turn towards your right and walk for few more steps and slightly turn towards your left walk straight until you reach a white chair in front of you towards your left there are photo frames mounted on the wall and towards your right there is a window and this is your final destination.

73032.instruction: Now you are facing the wall, turn left and enter the room. Slightly turn right, move towards the wooden wall in the centre of the room. Move towards the portrait on the wall. Slightly turn left and move towards the glass window on the left side and stop on the carpet in front you can see a chair, this is the endpoint.

73057.instruction: Head towards the entry table with the mirror at the base of the stairs that are going up. but you will not go up. So continue moving forward and you will stop once you are standing in front of this big plant with these three vase or whatever. and you're done.

73149.instruction: You are facing towards a mirror, turn to your left and pass through the open door which is right in front of you. You are now standing at the entrance of a bedroom facing towards a chair and this is your end point.

73150.instruction: Right now you are facing towards the mirror and a wash basin, turn left and step out of the  room through the door. And you will find a bed in front of you. Here is your final destination.

73171.instruction: You will start by standing in the dining/kitchen area. Turn around and you will see the stove. Right next to the stove you will see an open doorway. Walk towards that open doorway and exit this room. Once you've done that, you will see a staircase to your left. Take a step towards the staircase. Now you are standing at the foot of the staircase. Take one step on the staircase. Now turn back around and you will see an open doorway directly in front of the staircase. It has a red carpet. Walk towards that. Once you are inside of this room you will see the red carpet and a large table in the middle. To left of this room you will see a one single chair. Walk towards that single chair. It should be at the left side of the fireplace. Once you are slightly in front of that chair, then you're done.

73212.instruction: You will begin in a room, facing a very old school door and some very old walls with portraits on them, turn around completely and you will see that there is a fireplace with a basket, take on step towards the basket and the fireplace, turn to your right, you will see that there is an open door, take a step towards the open door, outside of this red carpet there will be a red carpet, a radiator, another fireplace and a white statue on the ground, take a step onto that red carpet in front of you, turn to your right, you will see another open door and a long hallway, and at the end of the hallway, there will be green walls, take 2 steps towards the green walls, just before the room there will be 2 staircases to your left, one going up and one going down, take the one to your left, once you are at the base of that staircase there will be a small narrow room in front of you, ignore that, turn to your right, take a step forward, turn to your right again, and you will see another staircase going down, do not go down the staircase completely, just take one step until you are in the middle of that staircase and you are done.

73221.instruction: You are standing inside the washroom, in front of you, you can see exit of the washroom. Exit the washroom and in front of you you can see an open passage. Enter the passage, towards your left you can see few products inside the shelf and towards your right you can see sink. Keep going through the passage and reach the stove. Now you are standing in between the sink platform towards your right and stove towards your left. this is your end point.

73222.instruction: Okay, you are in the washroom standing in front of the white toilet commode. Slightly turn to your left and exit the washroom through the open entrance in front of you. Now there is another open entrance in front of you, walk all the way straight through the open entrance passing the sink platform, which is on the right side, until you reach another sink platform, which is on the right side and a stove on the left side, and that is the end point.

73270.instruction: You are facing towards the old wooden stand board, turn to your right, walk straight towards the wall opposite to you. Turn to your left, walk forward you can see an open entrance on your right side. Turn to your right, walk towards the two pillars, which is on your left side. You are standing in-between the two pillars, facing towards the wall, which is your final destination.

73271.instruction: Now you are facing the white color wall, from there take a right turn start walking straight facing white color wall. From there, take a left turn go straight until you see a way on your right side, from there take a right turn, walk straight diagonally till you reach white color pillar on your right side and stand in front of it.

73286.instruction: Now you are at the table opposite to you there is a television, slightly  move towards left and walk through the walkway towards your right there are two steps,  go straight through the walkway near the swimming pool, continue with he same path, there is curtain decorated with shell enter in to the room, opposite to you there is a dustbin,  take left turn and enter in to the room,  go straight at the end of the room,  opposite to you there are two clocks and towards your left side there is a glass window, that would be your final destination.

73287.instruction: At present you are in front of a swimming pool turn towards your right and walk beside swimming pool there is an opening straight in front of you go into that opening you can see a dust bin on the floor go near the dustbin and then turn towards your left you can see a small room with a wooden opened door go inside the room this is your final destination.

73318.instruction: You begin facing a shower, turn to your right and exit the bathroom, go straight, you will pass a winery on your right, go through the hallway to the right, keep going forward and then looking to the left, go up the staircase, once you get to the top, turn around completely, you will see a room next to the banister, go into that opening and then immediate to your right there will be some double doors, go through them and then take one last step towards the hanging artwork in the corner, there should be a table to your left, you are done.

73507.instruction: You're currently staring towards a closed brown door with a white thermostat to the left of it. Turn around, face towards the hallway. Walk down the hallways passing the three brown doors on your right. Stay on the hallway, until you see the first archway in front of you, open towards a kitchen. Once you're at the entrance of this kitchen, take a step forward, walking a long the white carpet. You'll pass the white sink to your right. Keep walking forward towards the new white archway. In this new room, you'll see a round brown table with four chairs surrounding it. Now, turn slightly to the left. You'll see two brown double doors that are open. Take a step forward, passing the two brown double doors. Now, take two steps forward, entering the two brown double doors across from you, ignoring the outside open on your right. Now that you're at the entrance of this dining room, you'll see a brown dining with two chandeliers hovering over it. Take a step forward so you're at the head of the brown dining table. Now, turn around and face left. Take a step forward, hopping over the brown dining table towards the brown archway open to the left. Once you're standing in front of the entrance of the brown archway, and you see brown table behind you. By the way, this brown archway should be closest to the left and you should also see white roses on top of a brown desk behind you as well. You're done.

73530.instruction: You're looking at a grey couch standing in front of a coffee table. To your right is an entryway. Exit the room and take a left. There are stairs on your left. Go up the stairs. At the top of the stairs, there is a bedroom straight in front of you and a bedroom to the left of that room. Enter into the bedroom to the left of that room. Inside, you'll see one bed, and, to the right, you'll see a closet. Enter the closet. Inside, there's a shelf with two metal round things. Step inside, and you're done.

73553.instruction: You are facing towards the wall and the window. Turn towards your left and walk straight. Towards your right there is a dining table, turn left and walk behind the sofa. Walk straight and take a left turn. Walk straight and stand behind the white sofa and beside the window. This is the end point.

73554.instruction: Turn left from the place  you are standing and go straight. Now turn left and go straight. On the left side you will find sofa. On the right side you will find two bar stools. Now keep moving forward and turn left. You will find white sofa and table in front of the sofa. Now go near the table. You will find window in front of you. Now go and stand in front of the window. On the right side you will find sofa. That will be your final destination.

73592.instruction: Okay, now you are facing towards the compound wall, slightly turn right and walk straight until you reach in front of the garden. Now turn right and walk straight until you reach next to the stairs, which are on the right side. Now slightly turn right and go up the stairs. Now slightly turn left and move towards the open glass door, which is in front of you. Now you are facing towards the edge of the open glass door, slightly turn right and enter the room. Now you are facing towards a TV, slightly turn left and move forward. Now you are standing next to the couch, which is on the left side. Now slightly turn right and go straight behind the kitchen counter top, which is in front of you. Now in front of you there is a stove, turn left and go straight towards the wall, which is in front of you. Now you are standing in front of the wall and this is the end point.

73593.instruction: This is the starting point and you're facing towards a metal wall. Turn right. Walk towards the garden area. Turn right. Walk forward. Turn right. Climb the stairs and walk towards the glass door. Walk towards the couch in front of you. Turn right. Walk towards the kitchen counter top. Turn around. Walk towards the wall. You're facing towards the wall and on your right there's a staircase. This is the end point.

73808.instruction: You are facing towards the shower room. Turn right and exit the shower room. There is a swimming pool towards your right side. Walk straight till you reach an open door towards your left side. Slightly turn right and walk straight till you reach the cupboard beside the two chairs. Stand in front of the cupboard. You have reached your point.

73809.instruction: Okay, now you find yourself facing towards the glass door of the shower. Turn slight right and take a step forward and turn right immediately from the opening and take a step forward near the brown open door and go towards the brown open chair and take a slight right towards the bottom of the staircase and stop. Now you find yourself next to the cupboard which has white towels and this is your final point.

73819.instruction: Right now you're facing a round table with four chairs around it. Now turn left, you can see an open entrance to your left, move towards the entrance and turn left. You can see a wall in front of you with two pots in front of the wall, move towards the pots and turn left. You can see a wall in front of you, move forward towards the wall and turn left. You can see a staircase in front of you, move towards the staircase and climb up the stairs. Now, you can see a closed door in front of you. Now turn right, you can see an open entrance in front of you, move towards the entrance and enter in to the room. Now turn right and move forward towards the carpet. Now turn left, you can see a sofa and a table in front of you, move towards the sofa and stand in front of the sofa facing the portrait on the wall which is beside the window and it will be your end point.

73820.instruction: You are facing towards the round table with chairs around it. Turn to your left, you can see a black chair in-front you, walk straight towards the chair. On your left you can see an arch, enter into that arch, go straight towards the white wall in-front of you with vases on its corner. After reaching the wall, turn to your left and again go straight towards the white wall in-front of you, from there turn to your left, you will find a staircase, head up the staircase, after reaching the first floor, turn to your right, you will be entering into an open door. You can see couches with a table in-front of it, turn to your right, go near the black table in-front of you. Go and stand near the couch just below the portrait which is mounted on a wall. You have reached your end point.

73978.instruction: You will start by facing a brown cabinet. Turn around and exit this room. Walk up the staircase in front of you. Once you're on the first landing take a step up on the next staircase and you're done.

73979.instruction: We're facing towards pillar and next to the pillar there's a white door, walk towards it... Step into the hallway and walk towards the staircase, turn slightly to the right and enter the room that's in front of you. Walk towards the red carpet, turn towards the left after you've taken a few steps, and walk towards the window that's in front of you... On your right there's  sculpture of a woman and on the left there's also a sculpture and in the middle there's what appears to be a cross and you've reached your destination.

74013.instruction: We're facing a tiled wall, we're precisely facing towards the corner of it, turn towards the right... We're now facing towards a wall, on the right there's a window which has a design on it, and on the left there's an entrance to a room, turn towards the left ad you'll come across the staircase, walk all the way up the stairs... Once you make the first landing, you'll come across two rooms, one on the left and one on the right, walk towards the one on the right... You're facing towards three windows, and in front of you there's a carpet and next to the windows... Precisely, next to the window that's in the middle there's a sofa, walk towards the left side of that sofa, turn towards the right, and you'll come across a wooden door, turn slightly to the right, and enter the room that's in front of you... On the left there's a fireplace and on the right there are some boxes, and in front of you there's a window and below there's a heater, walk towards that heater... And once you're facing towards the exterior part of the house through the window, you have reached your destination.

74016.instruction: You are standing in a washroom, facing towards the wall, turn right, in-front of you there is an open door, walk through the open door and exit the washroom, in-front of you there are few steps. Stand at the starting step. That's your end point.

74017.instruction: You are facing towards the door right now, slightly turn to your right and exit the room, now you are infront of the steps, where to the left you can find an opened door, that would be your end point.

74045.instruction: Facing the black fence. Turn to your right. Walk along the path between the fence and the building. Just before you get to the grass, make a right. Make another right up the wooden stairs. Go past the white table set and into the open glass doors. Go past the living room towards the refrigerator. When you're a few feet away from the refrigerator, make a sharp right turn around and walk a few more feet past the island in the middle of the kitchen and just before the black table top (dining set). You'll have arrived.

74046.instruction: For your start point you are in a bedroom, you will need to make your way out of this room by moving forward through the path that is ahead of you. You will pass several mirrored closet doors as your making you way out of the entryway into the hallway. You will need to make a left turn move forward you will pass a kitchen island to your right. Stop, turn to your right move midway through this path you would be behind a dark gray couch to your left and the the kitchen island will be to your right. Turn around move forward you will see that there is a dining table to your left but stay on the right side of that dining table and pass that dining table and make your way up to the window that is behind that dinning table. Once you are at the side of the window looking at the bushes through the window you are done.

74066.instruction: You begin looking directly at a toilet. Turn around to your left and leave the bathroom. You should end up at the top of a staircase with some doors on your left. Go ahead into the open door, to the left of the double doors, the one with the thermostat right next to it. Through that door is a bedroom. The bed has an orange throw blanket on it. Move to the right side of that bed, and then turn to the right and step straight through the walk-in closet, into the bathroom. Instead of stepping towards the toilet, this time you're going to step to the opposite side of the bathroom from the toilet, into the shower. Once you're there, you are done.

74078.instruction: Starting off it looks like you are in a cofee room, looking forward you should see there is atable in front of you with some cofee machines on it. Step to the corner closes to you of the table. Once there you should see to your right there is an opened door, step trough that door. Onced stepped through that doorway, you should be looking forward you should see a long hallway with pictures on both sides of the walls. take one step forward to this first openening doorway type thing, once you took your step you should see a little clay pot to your left and a door way to your left. Step to that clay pot. Once stepped to that clay pot, you should be looking at a doorway that goes straight down with stairs and the clay pot should be to your right. Go to the bottom of the stairs. Once at the bottom of the platform there should be a little table with a little figure on it. There should be more stairs going down. Go down these stairs. Once at the bottom of the stairs you should see another pot to the left. Also to the left is another opened doorway. Take that first left. Once you are that doorwway, you should see a long hallway. Go to the very end of this hallway. Passing wineracks, once at the very end of the hallway. Yous hould be looking into a room, that has a table wiht some candles on it and some wine on it and behind it. You are done.

74079.instruction: Right now you are facing the corner of the wall. Now slightly turn right and keep moving forward. You will find an open door. Now exit from the door. Now slightly turn right and go straight. You will find an open door. Now exit from the door and keep moving forward. Now slightly turn left and go straight. On the left side you will find stair case. Now go straight. You will find narrow opening. Now turn left. You will find portrait on the wall. Now slightly turn left and enter into the narrow opening. Now slightly turn right and go straight near the table. Now again turn around and keep moving forward. On the right side you will find sofa. Now slightly turn right and go straight. Right now you are standing in front of the round table. Now slightly turn right and go straight. Right now you are standing in front of the bench where flower vase is placed. That will be your final destination.

74080.instruction: You are in a washroom, turn towards your slight right and keep moving forward. In front, you can find a brown door. Go pass through the door and you will enter into your bedroom. Turn towards your slight right and go near the brown door in front of you. Turn towards your slight left and walk through that door and you will enter into a corridor. Walk through that corridor and turn towards your slight left. Move forward and in front, you can find a section. Go pass through that section and turn towards your slight left again. In front, you can find a dining hall. Go through that hall and go near that dining table in front of you. Turn around and move forward near the brown wall. go near that brown wall and turn towards your slight right. In front, you can find a sofa set. Walk across the sofa set and go near the brown table, which has a flower vase on it. Stand there and you reached your destination.

74382.instruction: You are in the outdoor area facing towards a wall, turn slightly to your left and you can see a step, get down the step and move forward, there is another step, move forward. Now turn to your right and move forward. Now turn right and you can see three steps, climb up the three steps and move forward towards the open glass door. You have a white table on your left side and there is a chair on your right. Move forward towards the open glass door, turn slightly right and enter through it. You are now in the living area and you can see a grey coloured couch right in front of you, move forward towards it. You can see a staircase, move towards it. Now turn to your right and move forward. You are now standing in the kitchen facing towards a dishwasher and on your right side you have a kitchen countertop and this is your destination.

74383.instruction: You are facing towards the window. Slightly turn left and walk straightly in the corridor till you find plants on your right side. Turn right and walk straightly till you find three steps on your right side. Turn right and climb the steps. Now you are standing in between the sofa chair and the white dining table. Slightly turn left and move towards the sliding glass door. Slightly turn right and enter into the living room by passing through the sliding glass door. Now walk straightly in the hallway till you find a staircase in front of you. Turn right and move a bit forward. There are white cupboards on your left side and a countertop which has fruit baskets on your right side. That will be the end point.

74428.instruction: you being looking at a wall, in front of you is a bunch of brass instruments and about the brass instruments is a bunch of tea pots. turn your body to the left continue looking to the left until you see a wooden staircase heading up you are going to take one step in front of that staircase. you are going to turn your body to the left again and in front of you should be a grey seat. walk up to the side of that seat and turn your body to the pool table to your left. and head towards the pool table. turn your body to the right and walk forward, right now the pool table should be to your left and to your right should be another seating area with a low glass table in front of it. you're going to walk up to that glass table, then you are going to jump over the glass table. right now to your left should be a caramel colored seat, and to your right should be a lamp a twisty lamp. if you turn your body to the left a little more staring at the caramel seat you are going to walk past the caramel seat walking towards the desk in the corner. you are going to turn to the left and you should now see a door in front of a staircase. walk up to that door. once the door is to  your right, to the left is a small chair and in front of you is a staircase leading up. you are done.

74497.instruction: You will be facing empty white racks in front of you. Turn towards your left and step forward towards the bed. Turn right and step towards the exit door. Turn right and exit the room towards the white railing. Turn left at the railing and step towards the opening on the left and stop. You should be at the entrance to the bathroom at the final point.

74498.instruction: Now, you are facing towards the empty shelves. Turn to your left and exit the room. Now, turn right from the bed, you will find an open white door on your right side. Pass through that door and exit the bedroom. Now, turn left and move forward towards the open white door on your left side and that will be your end point in front of the entrance facing the wall and the bathtub in front of you.

74507.instruction: We'll start by seeing some ropes that are around an unstructured rug. Let's get past these ropes into the rug, now in front of us we are going to see an opened doorway, let's walk past this opened doorway all the way down to the end of the large and historic hallway. There are some paintings and other historical features around the rooms that we are crossing. As we reach the end of the hallway, we are going to be seeing in front of us a large bed with golden ornaments and decorations as well. This will be it.

74585.instruction: You are looking at an exercise room. You are standing in a bathroom. You are going to turn around and go through the door that leads to a room where you can see a wood bookshelf through the door. Once you get into that room, you see a blue rug in front of the door that leads outside. You see a kitchen island with a mixer and a Crock Pot and some other kitchen tools on it. You're going to walk towards the corner of that table closest to you. It looks like there's a calendar that you'll see. From there you're going to turn so that that table is on your left, and you see an open doorway to the right. You're going to walk through that. Once you get there you'll see a basket with a basketball on the floor to the left. A bench to your right. The bench to your right has a tree/bush looking thing closest to you, a hat, a black purse and then an open book. You're going to walk and stand in front of the open book and that is where you finish.

74685.instruction: You will start by standing on the red carpet. Turn right and take a step forward on the doorway and you're done.

74693.instruction: You are facing towards the round table, turn left and move towards the open door. Turn slight left and move towards the steps. Now get down of the steps. You are facing towards an open door, now enter into the room. You are facing towards the window, which is your final destination.

74694.instruction: You are standing beside the fireplace, facing towards the windows, turn left and move towards the open entrance, beside the sofa, now turn left and exit the room and move towards the staircase, get down the stairs. Turn slightly right and move towards the open door, which is in front of you, turn slightly left and enter the room through the open door, you are standing beside the mirror, facing towards the window. This is your endpoint.

74711.instruction: You are on the stairs right now, turn back and get down the stairs, move forward, turn left, to your left you can find a stove, go near the stove, turn back, go near the couch which is infront of you, slightly turn to your left, move towards the sliding door which is infront of you and step out of the sliding door, slightly turn to your left, go near the single which is infront of you, you can find a small fridge which is behind the couch, stand infront of the small fridge, that would be your end point.

74712.instruction: Right now you're on the staircase facing a closed door. Now turn behind and get down the steps, move a bit forward and turn left. Now, you can see a kitchen area in front of you. You can see a stove to your left move towards the stove and turn right. You can see a blue color table in front of you, move towards the table and turn left. Now, you can see a sliding door in front of you, move towards the sliding door and exit the room. Now you are in the balcony facing a table. Now turn right, you can see a chair in front of you, move towards the chair. Now, you can see a sliding door in front of you, which is beside the plants, move towards the sliding door and slightly turn left. You can see a small fridge in front of you, move towards the fridge and stand in front of it and it will be your end point.

74719.instruction: You will start by standing inside the garage. Turn slightly to your left you will see the lockers in front of you with a yellow bucket above it. Take one step towards that. From here, Turn left and you will see a doorway with a carpet in front of it. Walk towards the doorway and go inside the house. From here, turn right and you will see a hallway. There will be a weird bottle decoration in front of the staircase. Walk towards that and go up the staircase. Continue to walk up until you've reached the hallway. In front of you there's a kitchen area. Turn to your left and walk down this hallway. You will walk past a table on your left and glass doors on your right. Continue to walk until you've reached the end of the hallway. Once you're standing in front of a table where there's a white jug on top of it. Turn to your left take one step. Turn left once again. There will be an arched opening here. Take one step inside this room and you will see a powder room with a rectangular window in front of you. Once you're here, you're done.

74726.instruction: You begin looking at a wooden door. 79934.instruction: You are facing towards a glass window, turn around, you can see a table with a lamp on it and you can see two open entrances right in front of you. Now turn slightly to your right and you can see a staircase going upwards, climb up the steps and move forward. You can see a statue on your left side. Now turn to your right, you can see an open door, enter through it. Turn slightly right and move forward. You are now standing between a wash basin and a bathtub and facing towards a window and this is your end point.

79951.instruction: Start facing a potted plant. Turn around to face the table. Head to the end of it. Turn left at the little coffee table and head towards the front door. Head towards there but turn left. Enter that room on your left and head towards the sink. And you've arrived.

80212.instruction: You are in the bathroom, standing beside the bathtub, facing towards the mirror, turn left and move towards the open door. Now turn left and enter into another open door, you are now facing towards the door, turn right and exit the room, move forward in the narrow path, you are now facing towards two open entrances, which are in front of you. Now turn left and move forward in the narrow path, passing the two open entrances on either side of you, move towards the wall, now turn right and move forward in the narrow path, towards the door, passing the mirror on your left, you are now standing in front of the door, which is your end point.

80213.instruction: You're now facing the glass mirror. Turn left and walk out of the room and then enter into the room which is in the left side. Now turn around and come out of the room again and walk straight, then take first left. Now walk straight passing the portrait on your left and then take right. Now move forward till you see a blue colour mat near the door. Stand in front of the blue colour mat, you will reach your destination.

80252.instruction: You are standing in-front of an open door, turn to your left exit the open door. Turn to your left, you are standing in-front of an open door, move forward. 80253.instruction: Turn around from the bathroom ,you will find the way inside on to the left ,there are some stairs which will lead you to the downstairs.

80298.instruction: Move forward from the place you are standing and exit the room, turn left and move forward, you can find steps to your left, go up the steps, you can find two steps infront of you, go up the steps, stand at the entrance of the second room which is to your right, that would be your end point.

80299.instruction: Yourself located in the room slightly turn to your right, and move forward turn to your left and move forward, now turn to your right and exit from the room, now turn to your left and go straight until you reach the black counter top, now turn to your left there are some staircases go all the way up, now slightly turn to your right and enter into the middle room, the entrance of the room is your destination point.

80307.instruction: Right now you are facing a sink, turn slight left and move forward to exit the door, you are facing a wall, now take left and enter an open door which is in front of you, now on your left you will find an open door, get into the door and take left, here you will find a bed on your right and an open door on your left, get into the open door, now you are facing the wall and glass this is your final destination.

80308.instruction: You are facing towards the washbasin. Slightly turn left and walk straightly towards the wall. Turn left and walk straightly through the open door which is in front of you. Turn left and move towards the small desk which has a photo frame, a potted plant and a lamp on it. Turn left and walk through the open door. Now you are standing in the washroom and there are two washbasins on your right side. That will be the end point.

80350.instruction: There is a window opposite, turn around and pass through the portrait and the dining table. Take a right turn and towards your right there is a round table with few chairs. Move forward, stand beside the dining table, the open door and the portrait in the corner of the room. This is the end point.

80351.instruction: Now you are near the windows. Turn left. Move forward. Go out of the opening. Turn right. Go out of the open door. Move forward. Move forward to a table. Turn left. Go forward. Turn right. Move forward. You have reached your destination.

80381.instruction: You begin in front of a gray couch... Well, to the side of a gray couch. Move across the front of the gray couch towards the open double doors that you can see on the wall to the right. Move to the left of that table and then towards the open double door, on the right. And, once you are there, right next to the breakfast table and between it and the part of the double doors on the right, that is open, like, the physical door itself, you're done.

80420.instruction: You'll start looking into an open area, looks like a living room. You're going to look left. There's an open door leading you to a bedroom. You're going to take one step through the doorway and stop.

80604.instruction: Okay, now you are facing towards the grill casing, turn to your left and walk straight towards the door, which is in front of you. Now slightly turn to your left and go straight through the open entrance, which is in front of you. Now slightly turn right and move forward. 80605.instruction: From the point your standing turn around, and go forward near to the opened door which is in your opposite. 80618.instruction: You will start by facing a bunch of picture frames. Turn right walk towards the open doorway. Now turn left continue to walk forward. Continue to walk inside this other room. Taking a step inside this room and turn left. Stand in front of the window and you're done.

80682.instruction: Now you are facing towards a closed door. Turn to your left. You will see an open door. Go into the open door. Turn right. You will see a small table beside the bed. Go towards it. Turn right. You will see an open door. Go through the open door. You will see another open door. Stand near the open door. You have reached your destination.

80683.instruction: You are standing facing towards the closed white door. Turn left. Walk a few steps ahead and enter into the room. You are  now standing in the bedroom. Turn right. 80686.instruction: You begin facing a staircase, turn around, take one step forward and you're done.

On your left you will see a green brass (iron) door and on your right will be wood paneling.  You are at your destination.

80745.instruction: Now you are on the floor mate. Turn slightly right move towards the closed door, on your right there is a open door, enter into the room and stop in front of the bed.

80809.instruction: This is the starting point and you're facing towards the wash basin. Turn slight right and walk outside the room. Walk towards the open brown door in front of you. This is the end point.

80892.instruction: Alright, turn around on the right there is a table moving forward there is an entrance to the stairs , moving forward from the stairs  on the top there is entrance to the room and on the left there is the another stair which will lead you the upside. Take a step towards the fireplace. You'll know be in front of a small white couch in front of a fireplace and right next to that read lazy boy and you are done.

80990.instruction: Now, you are facing towards the wooden door which is at the corner. Turn around and move towards your left side where you can find an open door. Enter through it and take right. Now, turn left from the mirror on the right side and that will be your end point in front of the fireplace.

It is your destination.

81092.instruction: Now, you are facing towards the sofa and a table. Turn to your left where there is an arch in front of you. Go towards the dining table and take left where there is an arch. Pass through it and there is a dining table in front of you. Pass through it and that will be your end point where you are facing a cupboard in front of you with some candles and statues on it.

81093.instruction: Now you are facing towards the sofa turn towards your left and go near the wide opening and then turn towards your right you will see a u-shaped open entrance pass through it and then slightly turn towards your right you will be seeing a sofa with two chairs and a table go near it and then slightly turn towards your left again there is a dining table in front of you go near the dining table, now there is a mirror with a wooden shelf beneath it go near it and this is your final destination.

Once you're facing the first and the second door, you have reached your destination.

81182.instruction: You are facing towards the edge of an open entrance. Slightly turn right and walk through the open entrance which is in front of you. Now move a bit forward. 81313.instruction: You are standing at the top of the stairs leading up from the basement. Turn around and through the doorway. Once you are standing inside the bathroom just in front of the sink you are done.

81318.instruction: Slightly turn to your right from the place you are standing and exit the room, slightly turn to your right, you can find an opened door infront of you, enter into the room, stand infront of the wash basin, that would be your end point.

81319.instruction: You are currently in the bathroom facing away from the sink. Exit the bathroom door, take a few steps straight, turn around, on your left side you can see another door. Enter the door. You can see a sink . Take a few steps straight and your destination has arrived.

81355.instruction: Slightly turn to your left from the place you are standing, you can find a couch infront of you, go behind the couch, now you are facing towards the treadmill right now, turn right and move forward towards the opening, to the left you can find a portrait, now you are in the kitchen area, slightly turn to your left, to your left you can find a stove, move forward towards the opening which is infront of you, now you are facing towards the table, where there is a potted plant on the table, turn to your left, you can find an opened door, stand infront of the opened door, that would be your end point.
