81683.instruction: Right now you are standing behind the door slightly take right and move forward on the right you can see the snooker game in front you can see the open door slightly take right and move forward towards the open door now you are in a living room slightly take left and move towards the sofa in front you can see the mat on the floor move towards the mat, slightly take right in the front you can see the opening on the right enter into the opening slightly take right and move forward on the right you can see the flower pot and the portrait on the wall move little forward and on the right you can see the stairs take right and climb up the stairs climb up all the stairs, move little forward on the left you can see the flower pot and the railing move forward to the opening in front you can see the mat in front you can see the wooden railing move towards the wooden railing and on the left you can see the plant and this is your final destination.

Once you're right in front of that then you're done.

81899.instruction: You will start by facing two red chairs. Turn around and you will see a table in the middle. Walk towards the red carpet on the right side of the table. You will see an opening on your right right beside the 4 red chairs. Walk towards this opening. Go inside this room and take 4 steps forward. You should now be facing a bunch of ropes on your right there's an opening and on your left is a staircase. You're done.

81900.instruction: Okay right now you are facing a banner, turn to your right. Exit the room. To your right there is a open door, enter the room. Stand near the cabinet, now exit the room and you see a open door in exactly in front of you, walk through the door. Once you enter the door you see reception to your left and stairs. climb down the stairs and take a right turn. Walk straight beside the pool and you see a beads curtain in front of you, stand near it and you reached your destination.

81901.instruction: You are facing towards three candles, turn right and exit the room. Slightly turn right you will find another room, enter into it, turn around and exit the room. Take a few steps ahead and get down the stairs, walk towards the brown door, get down few more stairs, take an immediate right and walk towards the extreme corner of the pool. You have reached your destination.

81942.instruction: Turn towards the living room and head in the direction of the dining table, staying on the right side. You will make a right just before you get to the small refrigerator. In the next room, you'll find a bunch of books, some pictures on the wall but you're gonna head to the left side of this room towards a brown box that sitting on top of a black container, there's also a small basket with a bunch of books or dvds in it. This gonna be your spot.

81975.instruction: You are facing towards the glass window. Turn around to your right and walk towards the cabinet and the mirror which is mounted to the wall. Turn right and there are two entrances in front of you. Slightly turn right and walk through the narrow opening. Now walk straightly towards the end of the carpet. Slightly turn right and enter the room which is open. Now you are standing near the commode. That will be the end point.

81976.instruction: You are in the bed room right now, turn around, you can find two doors, go near the door which is right to the lamp, enter the room which is right to the closed door, you will be entering into the wash room, stand infront of the door, that will be your final destination.

82006.instruction: You are facing towards an opened white door, turn left and go one step forward, turn left and go forward, turn left and go forward, here facing towards a wooden closed door and beside a shelf which is having books you have reached the destination.

82007.instruction: You're facing the door, turn towards your left, go few forward, and turn left, again turn left, and enter the room, to the left you'll find shelf, opposite to the shelf, you'll find your destination.

82027.instruction: Right now you are in front of the wall. Turn around you will find open door. Now enter into the open door and go straight. On the left side you will find bed. Now go near the chair. Now slightly turn right and go near the mirror. On the right side you will find round table. Now keep moving forward. You will find an open door. Now exit from the room. Now slightly turn right and go straight. On the right side you will find railing. Now keep moving forward. You will find steps on the right side. Now walk all the way down through the steps and stand on the fourth step from the ground. That will be your final destination.

82028.instruction: You are in the balcony, facing towards a wall, turn around and keep moving forward. In front, you find a brown door. Go pass through the door and you enter into your bedroom. In front, you find a green color sofa chair, go near that chair and turn towards your slight right. Move forward for few steps and turn towards your slight right again. In front, you find a section, go pass through the section and in front, you find a brown door. Go near that door step and turn towards your slight right again. You find a corridor. Go and stand on the mat on the corridor and turn towards your slight left. In front, you find an other section, go pass through the section and walk along side the staircase support. In front, you find a staircase. Turn towards your right and get down the stairs, go and stand on the fifth stair and on your left, you find a photo frame hanging on the wall. You reached your destination.

82036.instruction: We start off looking down a red carpet with a table on your left hand side and then a diner table on your right hand side. Walk down the red carpet between both those tables. Continue to follow the path and walk out the open double doors partially to your right in front of you. Once in the threshold of that doorway take a step forward into the open area. Take the first open doorway on your right. Once in that um threshold of the doorway stop you're done.

82071.instruction: Move forward from the place you are standing, to your left you can find an opening, move towards the opening, slightly turn to your left, to your right, you can find an opening, move towards the opening, slightly turn to your right and move a bit forward, turn right, you can find an opened door, move towards the opened door, slightly turn to your left and stand infront of the potted plant which is to the right side of the bed, that would be your end point.

82072.instruction: You find yourself in a room. Step forward towards the painting and exit from the room by the opening which is present on your left. Take the immediate left towards the opening on your right and take a right towards the painting on the wall and enter into the open door by taking a right, you now find yourself in a bedroom. Stand next to the bed facing towards the plant. This is your final point.

82083.instruction: You're starting in a hallway, facing a living room with white couches. Turn to your left and head down the hall toward the large windows at the back. Walk between the counter on your left and the blue couch on your right. When you get to the end of the counter, you'll see a dining area in front of you and to the left of that, is a white buffet table. Walk up to that white buffet table, and then turn around to your left and take a right into the walkway before you get into the kitchen. This will lead into another hallway. A very small hallway. You'll see an abstract painting (it's, like, gray and black) on the right, and two shut wooden doors with frosted glass pannels. Then in between those is what looks like a bathroom. Just take one steps into that room in front of the sink. This is where you stop.

82210.instruction: You begin facing a tiled wall. Turn to your right and you're going to exit through the door in front of you. Take another right through this open doorway into what looks like a massage room. Step into the room and take a step between the sink and the bed and you're done.

82245.instruction: You are in front of the door which is closed, turn your left side, go straight and now in front of you there is a white chair, turn your left side there is an open door, enter the door, now you are in the living room, go straight in your right hand side and cross the sofa in front of you, go straight and enter into the dining room, go straight and exit the room, go straight and you will enter into a room in which there is a big dining table, go straight into that room till the end where you can see sofa which is red color and stop beside the sofa. this is your final destination.

82246.instruction: You are facing towards a wall, turn left and walk straight, take the immediate left and exit the room through the door. Now walk towards the couch in the living room, take a few steps forward towards the arch, now walk towards the glass door on your left, step out of it and take a few steps ahead, get into the dining room through the door. Keep walking straight towards the couch in the living room, now walk towards the open door on your right, you are now facing towards a pool table with a chair on your right. You have reached your destination.

82502.instruction: You are facing towards the wall, turn around and move towards the sofa. Turn slight left you can see an open door, move towards the open door. Turn right and move towards the open door. Turn slight right and move on to the carpet, which is near to the chair. Turn left and move towards the fire place which is near to the lamp. You are standing next to the fire place and facing towards the lamp, which is your final destination.

82503.instruction: Turn around and walk straight and exit the room. Now walk into the room which is in front of you and walk near the table. Now turn left from the table and go near the lamp which is in the corner. Stand in front of the lamp and you will reach your destination.

82542.instruction: You are now standing in a washroom, facing towards the closed glass door. Turn to your left to find an open door. Move forward walking beside the sink. Now take slight left and exit the room. You have now entered the kitchen area onto your right. Take slight left and walk towards the living area. Move forward towards the single chair with two pillows on it and turn around. Now walk slightly to your right to the cabinet near the wall which is in front of the dining table. Your are now standing beside the cabinet, facing towards the wall with four portraits on it. Turn to your left where you can find an entrance in between the living area and dining table. Move forward and enter the small passage. Now turn to your left and walk towards the center table. Move forward passing through the center table towards the sofa. You are now standing near the sofa in front of the window with curtains. This is your end point.

82543.instruction: You are in the entrance of a small room facing the glass door, turn left side and move towards the entrance of the room, turn slight left side and move towards the living room, move towards the single chair with pillows in it, turn around and move towards the four photo frames on the wall, turn left side and stand on the back side of the couch near the opening, move little forward and turn left side, stand in the right side corner of the room facing the window beside the white couch, that is your destination.

82567.instruction: Turn right from your position, you can find an open door, walk straight in the passage, you can find an open door in front exit the room, and walk straight you can find an oven at the right side, move forward and exit the room, there is a closed door in front, turn left and walk straight towards the white chair, slightly take right and walk straight towards the window, you can find your destination in front of a window, beside the white chair.

82568.instruction: Now you are facing the arch, turn right and go straight till you reach the stove on the right side. Passing the closed door and the sink on the right side. From the stove, turn left and move towards the fireplace. Move towards the closed door and stop. Now you are standing behind the chair with a brown pillow on it. This is the endpoint.

82606.instruction: "Okay now, you are facing towards the open door. Turn around, and move forward, you can see the another open door in front of you. Now enter into that room, and move forward, you can see the window in front of you. Now slightly turn right, and move forward, you can see the open door on the right side. Now turn right, and move forward until, you reach the another open door in front of you. Now go near to that open door. Now, you have reached your destination."

82607.instruction: You are facing towards an opened door, turn back and move towards the opened door which is infront of you, slightly turn right and move towards the opened door, now you are facing towards the door, slightly turn right and move towards the opened door which is infront of you, that would be your end point.

82632.instruction: Right now we are facing towel hanger, make a slight right turn and walk through the walkway till your standing in front of a mirror and a washbasin, turn to the left side in front of a door and enter the room, turn to the right side beside the bed, then turn slightly to the right side and go outside the wooden door, move a little forward, turn to the right side you can see there is a corridor move forward, turn to the left side where you can find a wooden door enter the room, this a end point where you find a hanger stand,a table and a chair.

82633.instruction: You are facing towards the wall turn to your right side, move forward you can see a opening to your left side. Enter into the room then again turn to your right side, exit the room through the opening then turn to your right side, move forward and enter int the which is to your left side and stand.

82715.instruction: You're now facing the table. Turn around, walk straight towards the television and turn around around. Now walk straight towards the stairs and get down on the stairs. Stand at the bottom of the stairs and that is your end point.

82716.instruction: Now we are facing towards the table, turn around, move straight towards the television, turn back, move straight, get down the stairs, at the end of the stairs, we reached the destination.

82731.instruction: Right now you're facing towards a dining table, move towards the dining table and turn left. There is a window in front of you, move towards the window and turn left. You can see white cupboards in front of you, move towards the cupboards and turn left. Now move a bit forward and slightly turn left. You can see a table in the living area which is in front of the sofa, move towards the table and turn left. There is an open door in front of you, move towards the door and exit the room. Now slightly turn left and move a bit forward. Now slightly turn right and move forward and get down the three steps which are in front of you. There is a grass in front of you, move forward in the grass. You can see plants to your left and right, move towards the plants which are to your left and stand in front of them and it is your end point.

82732.instruction: You are in a kitchen facing towards the dining table, move towards the dining table, turn left and forward towards the window, again turn left and move towards the gas stove, turn left and move towards the fridge, move forward towards the sofa, move forward towards the open glass door, again move forward towards the table, turn slight left and go down the steps, move forward towards the lawn, turn slight left and move towards the small plant, this is your end point.

82833.instruction: Begin facing a sink. Turn around and head to the chair in front of you. Head to the foot of the bed, take a right and exit the open doorway. In the hall go left and take the 1st door on your left into a sewing room and you're done.

82916.instruction: Now you are at the table, towards your left hand side there is a landline phone,  turn right, towards your left there i a table with one chair, walk through the way, enter in to the room which has red carpet on the floor, go near the door, exit the room, turn left towards the stair case, climb to the 5th step, continue to climb the 4th step, there would be your final destination.

82917.instruction: Okay, now you are in a room with a small table in front of you. Now turn left and go straight towards the wide open entrance, which is in front of you. Now you are standing at the entrance, slightly turn to your left and go straight towards the open door, which is in front of you. Now slightly turn to your left and exit the room through that open door. Now turn right and go up stairs, and stand on the seventh step from the bottom and that is the end point.

82941.instruction: First you will start by standing in front of empty shelves. They are metal shelves. Now on your left side you will see an open door and a hallway. Walk across that door and on to the hallway. Across the hallway you will see a bedroom in front of you. Go inside the bedroom. There you will see a single bed and a white carpet on the floor. Stand at the foot of the bed. Now on your left side there will be an open door and across that is the hallway. Go to that hallway and walk in the middle of the hallway. On the right side there will be the stairs and on the left side you will see that there is another bedroom. Go inside that bedroom. Inside you will see a multi-coloured design of the bed and the carpet is also multi-coloured. Stand at the foot of the bed and that's where you stop.

82975.instruction: For your start point you are facing a large table move to the left and around that table. Ecit this room through the open doorway in front of you, you will see a pool you will need to move one step forward to the left of the pool and then back to the right going one step up onto the pool. If you  look in the distance you will see lounge chairs to your left. You will need to hop over in the direction towards the lounge chair and you will land right at the head of the pool where there will be some white crystals or stones and a plant that is in between those stones. Once you are there you are done.

83052.instruction: You begin looking out a window with brown curtains. Turn to your right and proceed through the small curved hallway into a circular atrium. Once you're at that atrium you're going to go into the door immediately to the left. Through that door there's a bedroom, proceed to the near side of the bed, and then to the foot of the bed. Once you're there you're going to circle around to the left side of the bed, and you should be squinched between the bed and the wall, not quite at the window, but between the window and the circular mirror, and once you're there pressed up against the wall, between the wall and the bed, you are done.

83099.instruction: Now you are facing the wall, turn right to exit the room through the open door. Move towards the glass wall, slightly turn left move towards the open space. Now you are facing the doors, turn left, walk through the narrow path besides the closed door, and move towards the small table. On your left you can find the staircase, climb up the stairs, in front you can see the closed door, turn left, and stop in front of the open glass door, there you can see the walkway on your left and pots on your right. This is the endpoint.

83100.instruction: You are facing towards the wall. There is a treadmill towards your left side. Turn right and exit the room through the open door. Walk a few steps ahead. Slightly turn left and walk towards the open entrance in the front. There are two pots towards your right side. Slightly turn right and walk straight till you reach the steps towards your left side. Turn left and climb the steps. slightly turn left and walk two steps ahead. There is a plant in front of you and an open door towards your left side. You have reached your point.

83111.instruction: You're in a bedroom. To your right is an archway. Exit the bedroom and take an immediate left into the hall. Once you've taken that corner into the hall, you'll see a piano to your right. Past the piano, you'll reach a round entryway. To the left, you'll see a violin. Continue a little further past the violin, and take an immediate left down the hallway. As you continue down the hallway, you'll see on the right there is a console with a wheel, and a mirror, and a housplant. Just next to that wheel is a large entryway. Inside this entryway, you'll find four tan arm chairs and a pink round ottoman with a metal plate on top. There's also a brown console with a vase of white flowers on it. Stand next to the console. Keep the chairs to your right. Once you've taken a step here, you've arrived.

83133.instruction: Now, you are facing towards the gym equipment. Turn around and move towards your left side where you can find an open door. Enter through it and turn to your left side where you can find a brown open door. Pass through it and move towards your right side through the table. Now, take right from the table where you can find an open entrance. Enter through it and turn to your left side and move forward, you will find open entrance. Pass through it and turn to your right side and move forward. That will be your end point where you are facing the black chairs in front of you and an open entrance.

83134.instruction: You are facing towards the gym equipment, turn around, there is an open door in front of you, go straight, enter the washroom, now you are in front of the western toilet, slightly turn left, go straight and exit the washroom, slightly turn right, there is a table in front of you, go straight near the table, slightly turn right, go straight and exit the room, now you are in the corridor, go straight, there is a pot in front of you, turn right, go straight, there is a table and four chairs in front of you, stop in front of the chairs, this is your final destination.

83205.instruction: You begin in a closet staring at some clothes. Turn around to your right and leave this massive closet through the open double door. Once you're out, turn right and move through a more open set of double doors. Following that hallway to the right, continue past the piano and past a large number of pictures on the right hand wall. Once you get into the little bitty atrium with a circular pattern in the tiles below, and a violin on the left. Turn to your right and go all the way down the hallway to the curio cabinet. Once you're at the curio cabinet, turn right, enter the bedroom with the striped bed, move to the foot of the bed and then turn left and enter the bathroom. Once you are in the bathroom step forward onto the blue mat in front of the sink, and once you are standing in front of the sink, you are done.

83252.instruction: You are facing a door, turn right, walk straight. Stand beside the table which has few stools in the left and in the right there is a couch. This is the end point.

83253.instruction: Now you are facing towards a closed door. Turn right. You will see an open door in front of you. Go through the open door. Move forward beside the marble table with small chairs. You have reached your destination.

83294.instruction: From the place you are standing turn right and move forward then turn left, and exit the room move towards the dining table. You have reached you're destination point.

83295.instruction: You are facing towards table with some papers on it. Turn slightly right and move forward, you are now facing towards the portraits. Turn left and move forward, until you are facing the dining table which has four chairs, and this is your endpoint.

83338.instruction: Take one step out of this restroom towards the bottom of this small staircase and stop. you're done.

83346.instruction: Right now you're facing towards a wall. Now turn behind and move a bit forward towards the entrance which is to your left. Now turn left and exit the room through the entrance which is in front of you. Now turn right, you can see an open entrance in front of you, move towards the entrance and enter in to the room and it will be your end point.

83347.instruction: You are facing towards the wall right now, turn back and exit the room, turn right, you can find an opening, stand at the entrance of the opening, where to the left you can find an opened door, that would be your end point.

83391.instruction: You're standing in the doorway of a closet, take a step towards the bed in front of you. Turn to the right and exit the room. And then go to the room on the right. And you'll see a white rug a bed on the left, take a step towards the chair that's on the right corner of the room. Turn right and go through this doorway. And you'll pass a bathroom on the right. Continue towards the doorway in front of you. And enter this closet, and once you're in the middle you've reached the end.

83394.instruction: You begin in a small bathroom. Don't worry, the door behind you is keeping you from looking deep into the toilet. You'll want to move in the direction you were facing though, outside of the bathroom door, to the corner of the desk that you can see. Once you've moved out there and seen the desk, turn completely around and move down the hallway outside of that bathroom. You should pass the bathroom on the right, and then a hallway on the right. Once you get to the circular pattern on the floor, you should be able to turn left. You'll also see a violin on the right hand wall at that turn. Once you make that turn there's another hallway. This time with an arched door on each the right and the left, and a curio cabinet at the end. You'll pass an ironing board on your right as you approach the curio cabinet, and then you'll see two doors, either side of the curio cabinet. Move into the one on the right behind the ironing board. You should now be in a bedroom, with a black and white striped bed. Go ahead to the foot of that bed. There are some diplomas on the wall, it looks like. Turn left from those and head into the bathroom. Step onto the little blue rug and then turn right. There's a toilet. Step in front of the toilet, between it and the standing shower, and you have now navigated, once again, from one bathroom to another. That's it, you're done. One bathroom to another... Wow.

83537.instruction: You are facing a wood wall.  You are going to turn to your right and you are going to hop over the corner of the wood banister in front of you and the chair.  Once you have landed you are going to turn to your right and you are going to take one step forward and you are going to stop right there.  On the right of you is going to be the side of the wood table and on your left is going to be a wood counter with shelves under it and you are done.

83558.instruction: You are facing a sink.  You are going to turn around and you are going to go to your left right thru the open door.  You are going to stop there and turn back around and you are going to move forward into the hallway.  You are going to continue forward in this hallway and you will pass another hallway on your right.  You are going to move forward and you are going to see some glass doors on your right and you are going to stop right there in the middle of this hallway. So on your right is going to be the wood framed glass doors and just slightly ahead of you on your right is going to be a piano and you are done.

83587.instruction: You're standing in a hallway, and you can go either right or left. Go left, and continue down this room where you'll find a large desk. Stand behind the desk and between the desk and the bookshelf with the printer, computer, and phone line. You're done.

83706.instruction: Turn right from the place you are standing and go straight. Now slightly turn right and go near the portraits. Now turn left and go straight. On the left side you will find sofa. On the right side you will find sink. Now go straight. Now turn left and go near the fire place. That will be your final destination.

83707.instruction: "Now you are facing towards shelf, turn towards right and walk forward, till the wall which is towards your right, where you can see four photos, go near it and again take left and walk in between black sofa and the table, there you can see an open entrance, walk inside it, towards your left, you can see another opening, walk inside it, where you can see, white sofa towards your left and right and in between them, there you can see a photo frame, go and stand in front of the photo frame, your destiny has been reached."

83754.instruction: Right now you're facing towards a wall. Now slightly turn right, there is a staircase in front of you, get down the staircase and stand on the last step of the staircase facing towards the window and it is your end point.

83755.instruction: You are standing at the start of the staircase facing towards the wooden wall, turn right and get down of the staircase. Continue moving forward. Right now you are standing at the steps, to your left you can see a window and a map hanging on the wooden wall and in-front of you, you can see a window with 3 dolls, you are standing at your final destination.

83821.instruction: You're starting in the corner of a living room. Turn around behind you and find the clock hanging on the wall in the hallway. Take two steps toward that. Turn right and go straight between the blue couch on your right and the kitchen counter on your left. You'll take three steps and stop at the first, right corner of the long dining table across from the kitchen. You should be looking through windows into the backyard in front of you. To the right, is an open patio, and to your left should be four framed, black and white pictures. You're done.

83836.instruction: You're facing towards the frames, turn towards your right, go few steps forward, turn right, and enter the room, at the entrance itself you'll find your destination.

83837.instruction: You are now facing the frames on the wall from there take a left turn. Start walking straight and stand in front of the room which is to your right side. Take a right turn, walk a few steps forward and stand at the entrance of the room.

83864.instruction: We start off looking at an aerial picture. Turn to the right, walking down a hallway past a basketball. Going past the first closed door. We will walk down. Take a left and walk down a hallway. It has a welcome with a bear sign. Go all the way down to this hallway. Entering into a bedroom. Go past the foot of the bed, turning right. Entering into the restroom. You will stop at the towel rack.

83891.instruction: You begin facing an open door, take 2 steps to go through it, you will enter a bedroom and there will be a bed with white sheets, in front of the bed there will be a chest, you should be standing next to the chest right now, in front of the chest there is wooden railing with a set of stairs going down, take one step towards the stairs and then take 3 steps to go down the stairs, you will see a kitchen to the left, take one step towards the oven in the kitchen in front of you, now turn to your left, you will see a dishwasher, in the kitchen, take a step towards the dishwasher, now turn slightly to the left, with the dining table to your left, and the counter tops to your right, take 2 steps forward towards the chair in front of you, now turn to your left and you will see the staircase and underneath the staircase there will be a very tall antique lamp, take 2 steps towards that lamp, you should now be standing next to the lamp, looking forward, you will see a white cabinet against a wall next to the main doors, take a step towards the white cabinet, now take another step forward so the white cabinet is directly to your right, looking forward you will see an open door, an open wooden door, take a step towards it, take another step to go into the doorway, you will see a set of stairs going up, take 3 steps to go up the stairs, you will see a TV, take one step towards the TV, now turn around completely, next to the stair cause where you came from, there will be a walkway, take a step towards the walkway, you should be standing next to a table with chairs and a wooden table with a helmet on it and some artifacts, take 2 steps forward towards the empty balcony, you should be standing in the middle of the second floor and in front of you should be 2 pillows on the floor, and an artifact in the middle of those pillows, you are done.

83904.instruction: Right now you're facing towards a wall and a door. Now turn right and exit the bathroom. Now turn left, there is an open door in front of you, move towards the door and enter in to the room. Now turn behind, you can see an open door in front of you, move towards the door and enter in to the room. There is a sink in front of you, move towards the sink and stand in front of it and it is your end point.

83905.instruction: This is the starting point and you're facing towards a white door. Turn right. Walk forward. Turn left. Walk towards the glass door. Turn around. Walk towards the wash basin in front of you. You're facing a wash basin. This is the end point.

83940.instruction: You begin facing a door, turn to your left and just take one step forward towards the chair, you are done.

83989.instruction: You are on the staircase. Go in the downward direction and walk straight by taking slight left. Move forward and take right from the dining area. You can see sofa chairs. Take left from here. You can see an open glass door. Go through the door and get out of that room. You will enter into the balcony now with sofa, chairs and a dining table. Go straight towards the garden area. You will find a staircase. Go in a downward direction by taking the stairs. Take left once you get down from the stairs. Walk till the corner and take left. Go straight until reach a glass door towards your left. Pass through the glass door and that will be your end point beside the wall and a white box attached to the wall and then stop.

83990.instruction: From the point your standing turn around and move forward towards the dining area. Then turn slightly right and move forward near to the sofa. Then turn left and move forward towards the glass door. Exit the room through the glass door and turn slightly left, and move forward. Enter into the garden area which is in front of you then turn left and move forward. Again turn left keep moving in a forward direction stand near the second window which is on your left side and that will be your final destination point.

84010.instruction: You're facing towards the path, move froward, turn to your left, you can see stairs at your left, get down the stairs, turn to your right, you can see an open door at your left, go inside, you can see a car, go near the pillar and stop.

84011.instruction: Now, you are facing towards the pathway. Turn slight right and move towards the pathway. You will find an arch, enter through it and move forward. Now, turn around and move towards your left where you can find a staircase. Take the stairs and go down. Once you reach down, turn right. Again, turn right and you will find a staircase. Take the stairs and go down. Now, turn right and move forward towards the open brown door onto your left side. Pass through that door and turn right towards the cupboards. Now, turn slight left and move towards the pillar with telephone and that will be your end point where you are facing the pillar in front of you.

84046.instruction: You're going to start facing a big bottle and painting of two hands. Turn to the right, and you're going to see a wine room on your left, take one step towards that wine room, and take another step to be inside that wine room. Once you are at the door, facing bunch of wine bottles, you're done.

84064.instruction: You begin facing a bunch of couches and 2 open glass doors, turn to your right, you will see, you will see a dining area behind some couches, next to that dining area there is a archway and a lamp, take a step towards the lamp, you should now be standing with the lamp and the couches behind you, the dining area to your left and an archway in front of you, looking at the dining area, take a step to the right of it, take one more step forward towards the console table, now turn to your right, you will see a bunch of doors in front of you, take a step towards those doors, now you will be in a hallway, take a step towards the left of the hallway, you will see a kitchen, to your right, there will be a very narrow hallway, take one step forward into that hallway and make a left on the first room to your left, and take one more step, you should be standing in a doorway of a corridor and you're done.

84210.instruction: Go straight from the place you are standing you will find chair on your left side. Now go straight near the chair. Now turn left and go near the fire place. Now go straight near the pool table. Now turn right you will find bench. Now walk in between the bench and pool table and stand in front of the window. That will be your final destination.

84211.instruction: you´re facing towards the wooden pillar on your right side you can see an a glass, wooden door on your left side you can see an a sofa set. You have to move towards the single seater sofa which is on the other side of the hall behind the single seater you can see a wooden cupboard after moving towards single seater sofa. You can see a fireplace on the right side of the single seater. You have to move towards the fireplace after moving towards the fireplace on the right side of the fireplace you can see  a single seater sofa again from there you have to take a right turn after taking the right turn you can see a snooker board. After reaching the snooker board you have to move towards the right till you reach the two seater sofa now you have reached the two seater sofa again you have to move straightly from there till you reach the glass window that is your endpoint.

84236.instruction: Okay, now you are at the entrance of a room facing towards the wall. Slightly turn to your right and go straight towards the open door, which is in front of you. Now you are at the entrance of a room with sink in front of you. Turn behind and slightly turn to your right and move forward, now you are facing towards the door. Now turn to your right and walk all the way straight through the open entrance in front of you, passing the wall art on the left side and staircase on the right side, until you reach an open entrance on the left. Now turn left and walk straight through the open entrance passing the table on the left side, until you reach the plant pot, which is on the right side. Now turn behind and slightly turn to your right, and go straight near to the desk, which is adjacent to the white door. Now you are standing in front of the desk, which is adjacent to the white door and that is the end point.

84237.instruction: Right now you're facing a wall with a painting on it, adjacent to that there is a room, move forward and enter into that room, where you can find a white cupboard and a sink in front of you. Turn around and exit that room now you're at the front of the wall. Slightly turn towards you're right side and you can see a corridor, walk through that corridor where on the left side you can see few paintings and on the right side you can see a staircase. And in front of you there is a potted plant, move towards that. From there take a left turn and enter into that opened room. Walk till the end where you have a plant on the right side. Turn around now you can find a table with a three chairs and a cupboard on the left side which is behind the door. Move towards that cupboard and that is the end point.

84258.instruction: You are facing towards the wooden cupboards. Turn right and exit the room by passing through the open door. There is an open door in front of you. Turn right and walk straightly towards the couch. Slightly turn left and move towards the bar chairs. Now walk straightly through the open arch which is in front of you. Now you are facing towards the round dining table. Now walk straightly towards the glass window which is behind the dining table. That will be the end point.

84259.instruction: Okay, now you are facing towards the sink platform, turn to your right and exit through the open door, which is in front of you. Now turn right and move towards the couch, which is in front of you. Now slightly turn to you left and move, sorry move towards the second bar stool, which is on the left side. Now in front of you there is an arch shape open entrance, go straight through the arch shape open entrance. Now in front of you there is a dining table and go straight towards the window, which is in front of you. Now you are facing towards the window with dining table behind and this is the end point.

84268.instruction: Right now you are facing towards a black table, now take slightly right and move forward into an open door, walk on the red carpet until you reach a bed on your left, now you can see a bed on your left, now take slight right and move forward where you can see an open entrance on your right, move towards  it, now you are in the entrance of the door this is your destination point.

84269.instruction: Turn to you are right from where you are standing. Move forward in front you can see a open door, just enter into that room and walk through the red carpet and again you can see a other open door, just exit the room and move forward and make a slight right and move forward. In front you can see a entrance stand near the entrance. Here we reached our destination.

84355.instruction: You begin facing a shelf. turn slightly left and walk through the door in front of you onto the white carpet. Turn to your right and you're going to see another hallway and an open door. We're going to follow this little hallway past the set of open double doors on your right and you should be standing at the foot of the white bed. What you're going to do is take one step forward so that you're standing just beside the white armchair and then take another step forward so that you're standing at the foot of the greyish armchair. Hop over it to the carpet in front of you and then follow this hallway down here through the arched doorway. Continue to the red carpet in front of you passing a plant to the right then we're going to make another left down this hallway, passing another plant. Continue down here past the circular carpet and you'll reach the top of a stairway. Go down the stairs and once you've reached the landing, turn just to the left and you're gonna see an archway immediately in front of you. Step into the threshold of that archway and you're done.

84374.instruction: You're looking at a hallway. There's a chair next to you. If you turn to your right, you'll see the kitchen island with the four bar stools. Walk to the other end of the kitchen island. Continue a little further in that direction. Before you enter into the dining hall, take a right and slight left. You'll see an archway in front of you, and, to your left, you'll see an oval glass table. Walk through the archway and continue straight to the fireplace. Stand at the end of the rug next to the fireplace. If you're looking at the fireplace, slightly to your left, you'll see the TV. And you're done.

84389.instruction: Right now you are in a bathroom, there is a basin and a commode in front of you. Turn around, you will find a door. Come out of the bathroom through that door. After exiting the bathroom, take left. You will find two entrances to two different rooms, ignore those entrances. Go straight, so that you will find stairs which are going down. Continue on the stairs which are going down till you reach the floor. There is a wall in front of you and a passage on the left. Walk through the passage by taking left, you will see an entrance to a room and a brown color door. Ignore that door and enter the room. In the room, you will find a sofa, television and a table in between them. Go in front of the television and stand over there, this is your end point.

84416.instruction: You begin facing a living space, turn around to your right and you will see a wooden table behind you and behind the table there will be 2 white console tables and above them with be 4 picture frames, all lined up, take a step towards those picture frames, now turn to your left, you will see, the kitchen, take a step in front of the kitchen counter, between the island and the sofa, right now you should be standing in front of the kitchen and the living space to your left, you should be next to the grey couch, looking straight ahead, down the hallway, take 1 step forward, you will see the main door, and you will 2 white couches to your left, ignore them, continue going straight, take 3 steps towards the main gate, you should now be standing in the front, near the front entrance, next to a table with a glass vase with a plant and next to a mirror, the main door should be in front of you, take one step so that you're standing right before the mat with door in front of you and you are done.

84417.instruction: Your standing in a room, turn back. To the left side you can see an arch, Walk to the arch. You can see a passage in-front of you, walk to the passage till the end. Now you can see a open door on your left. Turn left and enter into the room. In-front of you you can see washing machines, stand at the second washing machine. That's your end point.

84418.instruction: Turn around from the place where you are standing and now take left, you can see an open arch in-front of you, move forward, walk through a narrow path, walk till the another entrance of the door, you can see an open door to your left, enter into it and stop near the washing machines, that is your end point.

84498.instruction: You are facing a wall.  You are going to turn to your right and you are going to enter this bedroom heading towards the single green chair.  You are going to pass this chair on your right heading around the foot of the bed going towards the open arch way with a lamp right next to it. You are going to go thru this arch way passing the bed on your right hand side.  You are going to veer to the right and you are going to enter the open door where there will be a picture on the wall on the left of it and a small stand against the wall to the left.  You are going to enter this room.  And you are going to head to your left right over to the rug on the floor.  And you are going to stop when you are right next to the counter and the copy machine on the desk.  You are done.

84524.instruction: Slightly turn left and move forward to exit the room, after going out of the room, take right to enter into another room, after entering into another room, turn around and exit the room, after going out of the room, move forward and enter into another room, after entering into another room, take right and move forward near to the door, and take right to enter into another room, and end after entering into the room.

84525.instruction: Right now, you're facing towards the closed door. Slightly turn left and exit the room through the opened door which is in front of you. Now, slightly turn right and enter into the room which is in front of you. Now, turn behind and move towards the entrance of the room. Now, slightly turn right and move forward toward the main entrance, which is in front of you and exit the room. Now, turn right and move forward till you reach an opened door on the right. Now, turn right and enter into the room and that is the end point.

84572.instruction: You begin facing a bunch of doors, turn to your left and you will a staircase, go up the staircase, once you get to the top of the staircase, you will see a pillar right in front of you to your left, take a step next to that pillar and then in front of the pillar there is a lamp and a brown dresser, take a step to the right of the brown dresser and the lamp, to your right should be a bunch of chairs, a couch and a ottoman used as a coffee table, take 2 steps forward and then you will take the last step, towards the wooden window with glass panels in it, and take a step towards the one that's all the way on the left, you are done.

84604.instruction: Turn left from the place you are standing and move forward, you can find a closed transparent door infront of you, move towards the door, move a bit forward towards the opened door, now you are at the entrance of the washroom, that would be your end point.

84605.instruction: You are facing a switch board and portraits. Turn towards your left and exit the room through the open door. Slightly turn towards the right and you enter into the bedroom. Walk towards the curtain and the brown door. Stand in front of the door. This is the end point.

84606.instruction: We start off looking at a couple of treadmills. Take a step towards the grey ball to the right of the treadmill. take a step towards the side of the couch. Slightly turn to your left and take a step forward to that open archway in front of you. Turn to your right. Face down a pathway where the side table to the couch is on your right side. Take a step to the left of the side table. Then take a step towards the painting of the native american woman. Turn to your left. Take a step towards the chair directly in front of you next to the glass table. Turn to your left take one giant step towards the center counter top in the kitchen in front of you. You will now be facing the stove and oven in the center counter top. of that kitchen. Turn back around and face the small table glass table with the two chairs that you just came from. Take a step towards the left chair of that glass table. Turn to your left and you will now see the hallway. Take a step down that hallway. Turn to your right and you will see partially into the dining room area with the larger dining room table. Take a step to that back the head of the chair. Take one more step towards that side cabinet to the left of the dining table. Slightly turn to your right and you will see that plant that is shaped like a cone or circular or cylindrical. Take a step towards that plant. You will now be facing that circular plant to the right will be a chair on the head of the table and to your left will be the window. Stop there you are done.

84649.instruction: Now you are facing towards a door, slightly turn to your left and move forward, there is mirror in-front of you, now take right, move forward, you can see an open door in-front of you, exit the room and move forward, you can see an arch enter into it, move forward, there is a staircase to your right walk down the stairs, after reaching the last step turn to your left, you can see an open door to your left, enter into it and move froward till orange color chair, go behind it and stand, that's your end point.

84650.instruction:
you are in the entrance of the living area,move forward towards the mirror ..and move forward again towards the mirror and from mirror side take right and you will see a passage move forward . at this point  you can see a door which goes to another place might be the living area .so go through the door and take right and stop at the carpet .From the carpet side take straight. take left and you can see another carpet and stop there and take right  and you will see straight ..go down the stairs..after going down the stairs take left 
after taking left move forward  towards the living area  . move forward and right now you are in the living area.
take right towards the sofas..and after crossing the sofas ..you will see the large windows which is separating the living room and snooker pool room and this is your destination.

84706.instruction: "Now you are facing towards violin, turn right, move forward, towards your left, you can see a way, pass on that way, you can see glass doors in between, move forward after some distance, you can see two pots, towards your right, beside of it there are stairs, get down the stairs and turn right, walk till the dead end. Towards your left you can see an opening, walk inside it, till the dead end, just keep two steps away, your destiny has been arrived."

84707.instruction: You're facing towards the wall, turn to your right, move forward and then turn to your left, go straight, at your right you can see stairs, get down the stairs, after getting down the stairs, turn to your right, you can see an open door at your left, go inside the door and stop near the closed brown door.

84752.instruction: You are facing towards the closed glass door. Turn slightly right and move forward. You are now facing towards the fire place. Turn slightly right and move towards the wall. Turn slightly right and move towards the treadmill, and move forward to the closed glass door by passing the treadmill. Turn slightly right and enter into the open door. You are now facing towards the toilet seat. Turn slightly left and move forward. Turn slightly right and move towards the white colour fridge, and this is your endpoint.

84755.instruction: You are facing towards the clothes right now, turn back and exit the room, enter into the bedroom which is infront of you, stand infront of the lamp, where to the right you can find three portraits and to the left there is a bed, that would be your end point.

84756.instruction: You are inside the dressing room. Turn around and exit the dressing room. Now, you can see a bed in front of you. Go near the bed. Now, you can see a large window in front of you and three photo frames towards the left side of it. Go near the photo frames and this is the end point.

84760.instruction: You are facing towards the wooden black cub board, take about turn walk near to the plant then turn to your right. Exit the room then turn to your left move forward, you can see sofa and a floor mat in front of it, walk near to the floor mat then turn to your right. Walk near to the glass table and walk in the path between table and the wall, enter in to the room that is a kitchen then turn right. Move forward you can see white sofa and a shelves to your right go near to that, you can see plant between the chair and the sofa. walk near to that and stand on the floor mat, between the chair and the sofa.

84761.instruction: You're now facing the wooden cabinet. Turn around and walk towards the plant and then take right. Now walk straight, exit the glass door and take left. You will see the stairs in front of you. Walk in font of the stairs till you reach the white colour mat and then take right. Now walk straight where a glass table with multiple white colour chairs are placed. Walk in between the white colour chairs and the white cabinet on your right side. Walk straight and get in to the room where you will see a washbasin. Turn right just before the washbasin and walk straight completely till you see a white colour sofa on your left side. Go near the white colour sofa and stand in front of the lamp where you can also see a coffee cup. Stand in front of the lamp, you will reach your destination.

84779.instruction: Turn back from the place you are standing, and step out of the room, now turn left, and go straight, on the right side, you will find a room, enter into the room, and go near the bed, there you will find two certificate frames on the wall, go and stand in front of the frames, that will be your final destination.

84780.instruction: Now you're in front of an open door, exit the room, come forward and take left, you can find the showcase set in front of you and photo frames on the both sides of a walls, walk forward and take right, it is a entrance of a bed room, enter into the bed room. You can find brown table and photo frame on it to the left side turn left,you can find bed to right side and two photo frames on the left side of a wall, stop, this your end point.

84804.instruction: We start looking down a flight of stairs. Turn around. Walk up to the landing and you'll see a closed white door with a window with blue frame around the window. Take one step through that closed white door and you'll end up outside. Stop there you're done.

84865.instruction: Turn right from the place you are standing, you can find a sink to your right, exit the room, turn left, there is a portrait to your left, enter the room which is infront of you, move forward, turn left, you can find a white cloth hanged to the hanger inside the room, stand infront of the white cloth which is under the shelf, that would be your end point,

84866.instruction: Okay, now you are in a room facing towards the edge of the entrance. Turn behind and walk all the way straight through the open entrance in front of you passing the sink platform on the right side, until you reach in front of the wall. Now turn left and in front of you there is an open door, walk all the way straight through that open door passing the portrait on the left side, until you reach another open door on the left side. Turn to your left and enter that room, you are in a closet with hangers in it, and that is the end point.

84872.instruction: You are standing at the foot of some tiled marbles stairs. Turn all the way around heading toward the open door leading into a hallway with a different color floor (gray and wood).  Veer right past the word A R T written in right rock  heading down three stair steps, continue going straight through the wood open doors toward what looks to be a bath or an indoor pool.  Continue to the pool walking behind a circular brown chair toward the steps of the indoor pool.  Walk up the steps toward the wall. You have arrived at your destination.

84962.instruction: You're starting in a sewing room, facing a hallway. Take a step into the hallway and then turn right. Take a step toward the china cabinet right in front of you. Then turn right and enter the bedroom. Take a step toward the foot of the bed. Turn left and enter the bathroom through the arched doorway. Take a step up to the sink on the blue rug. Turn right and then stand in front of the toilet. You're done.

84963.instruction: Now you are facing towards a dining table. Turn right. Move forward near the sofa chair. Turn left. You will see the steps. Go up the steps. Turn left. You will see an open door. Go into the open door. Move forward near the bed. Turn left. You will see two open doors. Go into the second open door and stand near the wash basin. You have reached your destination.

84964.instruction: You are facing towards a table with white chairs, turn right and walk towards the cream chair with a brown cushion. Towards your left you will find a staircase, climb the stairs. Once you are done climbing, turn left, you will find an entrance of a bedroom, enter into it and walk towards the bed, turn left and walk till the entrance of the washroom. You have reached your destination.

84973.instruction: You begin looking at a landscape painting and an open door. Go ahead and turn around, moving the opposite direction down the hallway, until the first open door on the left. Actually, the first archway on the left, there's no door there so... Y'know. But just go down that hallway, you'll pass four smaller hanging images on your right, and a painting on your left, and you should enter a bedroom. Once your in this bedroom head to the curtains on the left side of the double doors, and once you're there, kind of between those curtains, and the bed, and a light, white armchair to your left, you're done.

84974.instruction: Looking at the bed, go out the open door on the right. Staring at the staircase, stay to the right and walk down the hallway. Keeping the railing on your left now and the wall on your right, take the second open door on the right. Second open door, you'll see a bed with yellow bedding on it, from the foot of the bed, take a left. Standing between the foot of the bed and the open empty closet, you're done.

85021.instruction: Right now you're facing towards a sink. Now turn behind and exit the room. Now turn left and move a bit forward and turn right, there is an open door in front of you, move towards the door and enter in to the room. Now turn behind, there is an open door to your right, move towards the door and enter in to the room. Now turn right, and move towards the bath tub and stand in front of it and it is your end point.

85022.instruction: Turn behind from the place where you're standing and take a few steps. Now, turn left and move forward. From here, turn right and walk into the room, which is in front of you. From here, turn left and enter into the room, which is on the right side. Slightly turn right and move forward towards the bathtub and that is the end point.

85035.instruction: You are facing towards an open arch, turn left you can see a narrow path, move in the path till you reach the pots to your right. Now you are standing near the pots, turn right you can see staircase, now completely get down of the staircase. Now you are facing towards the wall, turn right you can see an open door, move towards the door. Move forward. You are facing cupboards, turn right and move towards the cupboards, which are to your right. Turn slight left and move towards the pillar. Now you are standing backside of the car facing towards the pillar , turn slight right you can see cupboards, move towards the cupboards. You can see car to your right and cupboards opposite to you, the position you are standing is your final destination.

85036.instruction: Turn around from the place you are standing and keep moving forward till you reach the stair case on your right side. Now walk all the way down through the stairs. Now turn right and keep moving forward you will find an open door. Now enter into the door. Now turn right and go straight. Now slightly turn left and go straight you will find car on your right side. Now go straight you will find cupboards in front of you. That will be your final destination.

85135.instruction: You are facing towards the white couch which has six cushions on it. Turn right and move towards the wall which has a clock hanged to it. Turn right and move towards the bar stools which are on your left side. Slightly turn left and move towards the white cabinets. Now turn left and walk straightly towards the closed door. Now slightly turn right and walk through the open door. There is a washbasin on your left side. Now walk straightly towards the closed glass door and stand in front of it. That will be the end point.

85136.instruction: Now we are in a living room, move straight and take right, move straight and take left, and again take left, move straight take right, move straight, there is a washbasin, and we arrived the destination.

85200.instruction: We are facing a bed railing. Turn all the way to the left to go around the bed on your right. You will pass the picture of a soldier with a rifle on your left. Continue right and out of the bedroom. Continue forward until you see some stairs on your right. Go down the stairs to the first landing where some rocks are. Go to the second railing and then take one step down the stairs. Turn back around and walk directly in front of you into the room that has a statue of a bust on a table. Walk to the front of the couch at the end of the room facing you. You want to be in the middle of the couch standing on the carpet. That couch is multi colored and patterned. You are done.

85204.instruction: Our starting point is in front of a wooden wall, turn around, on the left there's a long wooden shelf and on the right there's a living room and there's also a pillar on the right, walk pass the pillar, walk pass the pillar, take three more steps further, turn right, in front of you there's a living room, on the right there are sofas, a coffee table a small table between the chairs, walk pass the two chairs that are in front of you, towards a set of windows, you're now facing the windows, on the left there's a kitchen turn towards the kitchen... We're now facing the kitchen, on the left there's a dining table and on the right there's the stove and a sink, turn towards the left... We're now facing a staircase, go up the stairs, go all the way up... We're now in a bedroom, turn towards the right, and walk towards the foot of the bed that's on the left, turn towards the right and enter the bathroom that's in front of you, once you've entered the bathroom, walk towards the doorway leaving the toilet on the left and the sink on the right, step into the bedroom, on the left there are two beds and on the right there's a chair, and there's a rug on the floor, walk towards the edge of the rug next to the chair, you'll be facing the corner of a wooden wall, the chair will be on your right, and next to the chair there's a lamp, and that's your destination.

85213.instruction: Right now you're facing towards an open door, move towards the door and enter in to the room. There is a dining table in front of you. Now slightly turn right and move forward on the red carpet. There is a dining table to your left and two glass items to your right, move forward and stand in between them and it is your end point.

85214.instruction: You are in a hall, turn towards your slight left and keep moving forward. In front, you find a brown door. Go near to that door and turn towards your slight right. Go pass through the door and keep moving forward. You can find a dining hall, which has a dining table to your right and some glass boards, which have something written on it, to your left. Stand between those two and you reached your destination.

85219.instruction: Turn left and move straight near to the wall,take slight left and go inside near to the slider door,take left and exit the slider door,you will see an open garden,take slight left and move forward,again slight right and move near to the garden,again take slight right and move and stop at the corner of the garden.

85220.instruction: Okay, now you are in a room facing towards a white colored wall clock, which is on the right side. Take sharp left and now in front of you there is a narrow open entrance, walk all the way straight towards that narrow open entrance passing the dining table, which is on the right side. Slightly turn to your left and in front of you there is a grey couch, move straight towards that grey couch. Slightly turn to your left and in front of you there is a slide door with open entrance, exit the room through that slide door open entrance. Now you are facing towards the white table with four chairs around it. Slightly turn to your left and go straight in between the white table, which is on the right side and a grey couch, which is on the left side. Now you are facing towards the lawn, slightly turn to your right and move forward. Now you are standing at the edge of the lawn. Slightly turn to right and go straight to the right corner of the lawn and this is the end point.

85308.instruction: We start off facing a wall Turn to your left and walk down the hallway. Take a step to the right pathway and you will see a closed brown door with rectangular windows in it. Turn to the right and look into the living area. Take a step towards the couch to the left of the tv. Take one step to the big screen tv and stop you are.

85322.instruction: You are facing towards the platform, turn slight right and move forward. Now turn left and pass through the open entrance. Now you are facing towards the pool, turn left and move towards the steps. Turn left and climb the steps. Move towards the open door on your right which is near to you. Now you are facing towards the door. Turn slight left you can see an open door, enter into it. Now move towards the bed. Now you are facing towards the bed. The position you are standing is your final destination.

85323.instruction: You are facing towards the marble table, move forward then turn left move forward, again turn left and move towards  the steps, go up the steps, turn slight and move towards the open door on your right side, move forward towards the open door, again move forward towards the bed and stand, this is your end point.

85333.instruction: Now you are facing the glass window, from there take a right turn start walking straight until you see brown color cupboard in front of you. From there slightly turn to your left and walk in the direction where you find sofa which is in cream color. From there search for the brown color doors and start moving in that direction. Now stand at the entrance of the door and take a slight left turn. Search for the white color chairs in front of you and stand near it.

85334.instruction: Now you are in a dining room facing towards the closed window. Turn slightly right. Move forward to the oven. Turn slightly right. Move forward to the opening. Move forward to the fireplace. Move forward to the open door. Turn slightly left. Move forward to the tipoy. Move forward to the dining table chair. You have reached your destination.

85359.instruction: You are facing towards the windows and stone wall. Turn left and walk straightly towards the staircase. Walk all the way to the top of the stairs. Now slightly turn left and walk towards the couches. Now turn left and walk straightly towards the dining table. Now walk straightly towards the wooden cupboard beside the dining table. Turn right and walk straightly behind the chairs till you reach the end of the dining table. Now slightly turn right and walk towards the stove. So exactly in front of the stove will be the end point.

85360.instruction: Go straight from the place you are standing, you can find stair case, walk all the way to the top of the stairs, then on the left side, you can find a sitting area with chairs, now turn left and go straight, you can see a dining table, now keep moving forward and take right, now go straight you will enter into kitchen, now stand exactly in front of the stove, that will be your final destination.

85369.instruction: Turn a bit left and start moving straight, here take a right turn and move forward towards the stairs which is near the wooden railing.

85370.instruction: You're standing near the table, slightly turn left and move towards the pillar. Now turn right, go and stand near the wheel shaped architecture near the stairs. This would be your end point.

85404.instruction: You are on the stairs, climb up three stairs. Walk straight, in the front you have a room which has a table and a statue on it, walk towards it. 86963.instruction: You're facing towards an white open door, enter into that door, and you can see a white carpet, stand on the white carpet, facing towards the wooden shelf on to your left side and that is your final destination.
