93236.instruction: From your starting point turn left and move forward through the sofa-set exit the room and turn right, Move forward through the wash-basin and the micro-wave oven. Exit from the door by moving forward then turn right move little forward then take left near to the table with the chairs arranged turn right and move forward near to the fire place from their move little forward where there is a television and a sofa in between that will be your final destination.

93266.instruction: You are standing in a stone old church building with very high ceilings. Turn where you are facing the four stone pillars. Walk through the first two pillars to the hallway turning left before the second set of 2 pillars. Now you are facing the holy water fountain. Walk toward that. Go around it with the fountain being on your right.  Continue going until you are at the part of the floor that does not have the black rectangle stones as a border.  At that point, on your left, you will see a little aisle. Walk about 2 or 3 feet in the aisle and stop.  You will see old wooden church pews on your right and directly in front of your.  You have reached your destination.

93354.instruction: You are facing towards the cub boards turn to your right, exit the room you can see an open arch in front you to your right. Enter into that move forward and exit the room through the opening, which is to your right and go and stand in front of the wall to your right.

93355.instruction: You are facing a closed door, turn right, walk straight and exit the room through the open door. Turn right and move a step forward. In the right you have an open door. You have an open entrance in the front. Walk towards the open entrance, now you are in the bedroom. Turn right and exit the room. Slightly turn right and walk towards the wall. In the opposite you have a railing. This is the end point.

93382.instruction: We start off looking at a pathway between a pair of beds on your right hand side and a railing on your left hand side. Walk straight down the pathway following the railing. Continue to walk straight until you have passed an open white door on your right and you'll see a bed with a comforter on your right. Take a step to your left towards the staircase and then turn back to look down the staircase and walk down the stairs. Once at the bottom of the stairs look to your right and you will see um a wall that is completely full of windows. And on the bottom there is like two doors that have square window. So basically it looks like square windows the whole way up the wall but take a step towards that wall that has windows. Then turn back around to face like the living area. Take a step between the center ottoman or foot stool couch and the brown um cabinet or table and then stop there. So you should be on your left hand side it would be the ottoman table with all the couches and chairs around it. Then on your right hand side should be the brown um chester drawers or table and stop there.

93423.instruction: Ascend the stairs. At the top of the stairs, you'll see to the left a seating area on a rug. Just to the right of that seating area there'll be a wooden pillar. Walk towards that wooden pillar. Behind that wooden pillar will be a kind of burnt orange chair which is to the right of a fireplace. Walk just past the post towards the chair. At that chair, you'll see an ottoman in front of it, turn to the left of the ottoman, you'll see a fireplace, walk towards the fireplace between the ottoman and the coffee table on the left. You'll see a matching chair just on the other side of the fireplace. Go stand in front of the ottoman so the chair is on your right and the ottoman is straight ahead of you, the pool table beyond that chair and then just behind you is the fireplace. Once you're there, you're done.

93436.instruction: You are standing inside a closet, straight ahead their is an exit door, so turn right and step on the marble floor, then right once again and exit through the two open doors, take one step towards the two certificates on the wall, you are done.

93477.instruction: You are facing towards the wall. Turn around and slightly turn right and move towards the bar stools. Slightly turn left and move forward. Turn right and move towards the cupboards. Now you are facing towards the cupboards and the refrigerator. There is a table with four chairs on your left side. That will be the end point.

93478.instruction: Right now we are facing towards the bridge scenery slightly take left and move towards the counter top take left and move forward infront you can see the back table and four brown chairs take right and move forward and infront  you can see the refrigerator and this is your final destination.

93500.instruction: You begin facing a cabin, turn to your right and take a step forward, in front of you, in the very corner of the room, there is a TV, take a step towards the TV, and then turn around, go down the stairs, then turn to your right and take 3 steps forward, in front of you there is a staircase, take a step to the right side of the banister, there should be a kitchen in front of you and a pillar to your left, now turn to your left and take a step forward, so that the pillar is slightly behind you, to your left and the banister for the staircase is to your right, you are done.

93508.instruction: We're facing towards a doorway, turn towards the right and you'll come across a hallway... On the left there's a staircase, walk past the staircase, turn towards the left... There is a staircase in front of you...  Walk all the way down... Once you land take five steps further... On your left there's a kitchen, on your right there's an Island, walk towards the stove that's on the right... Once you reach the stove, walk towards the dishwasher, turn towards the right, walk past the sink and the cabinet that's on the right... Sorry, on the left... On your left there's a clock and on your right there's a dining table with black chairs, walk past the top chair that's in front of you... Turn towards the right... On your right there's a white wall and on your left there's an exit towards a patio, walk towards the gap between the exit to the patio and the wall, you'll be facing a living room, and that will be your destination.

93509.instruction: You are facing towards the wall. Slightly turn left and move towards the wall. Slightly turn right and move towards the wall and stand on the doormat. Turn left and walk through the open door. Turn right and walk straightly in the hallway till you find a staircase on your left side. Turn left and walk all the way to the top of the stairs. Now turn left and walk straightly in the corridor by passing the photo frames on either side till you find a small wooden table in front of you at the end of the corridor. Turn left and walk towards the open door. Again turn left and walk through the open door. Now you are facing towards the glass window. Turn around to your right and walk through the open door. Now you are standing near the wooden table with two chairs. Turn left and move towards the closed door. That will be the end point.

93510.instruction: Slightly move left and walk forward, now take right, move little forward, you can see an open door to the left, enter into it and take right, move forward till the wall, you can see the staircase to the left, climb the staircase, after reaching the last step, take left and walk through a narrow path, you can see an open arch to the left and a table in -front of you, take left and enter into the arch, now  again, take left and enter into the open room, turn back and exit the room, slightly move to your left and walk forward, now take right, go near the closed door and stand, that's your end point.

93537.instruction: You're in a living room, take a step towards the opening that goes out to the patio on the right. And then turn slightly to the left and take a step towards the island in the kitchen. And then take one step to the right towards this white cabinet below these pictures. And once you're at the cabinet you're done.

93672.instruction: Right now you are facing a cupboard, turn around and move towards the dining table, which is in front of you, now turn left and move forward towards an entrance, which is beside the kitchen area, now you will find an open door on your right, get into the door and move forward, now you will find an bed in front of you, now take left and move forward, now again take left and get into the restroom and stand in front of a glass door, this is your end point.

93673.instruction: You're facing towards the wooden cabinet onto your right side, now slightly turn to your left, and walk a few steps forward, you can see an ash color sofa onto your right and from there turn to your left, walk a few steps forward and towards your right you can see a wooden table with a plant on it. Walk few steps forward, you can see an open entrance in front of you, now from the open entrance, turn to your right, you can see an open wooden door, enter the door, walk a few steps forward and towards your left you can see another open door, enter it. Now you're in a bedroom, go straight and from the bed, turn towards your left, you enter into a washroom, you're facing towards the sink and that is your final destination.

93701.instruction: You're outside walk forward down this path all the way to the end. When you get to the grass turn to the right and walk down this next path and you'll see a patio walk up the stairs towards the door on the left. And walk through this door into this living room walk past the TV on the right. And then turn right and take three steps in this kitchen passing the island. And facing the window turn to the left take a step into the kitchen past the sink. And turn left again and take one step towards the refrigerator on the right and you're done.

93712.instruction: You will start by facing a lamp. Turn around and walk towards the wall with a picture frame on it. Turn right and take a step towards the opening on the right on the right side of the picture frame. Walk down this hallway taking two steps forward. Turn left and take two more steps down the hallway. Turn left once again and walk up the staircase. Once you're at the top of the stairs take a step forward towards the closed door. Turn left and walk down this hallway with a bunch of picture frames on your right and the railing on your left. Take a step forward. Now turn right and you will see a double french doors. Take a step inside this room with a round carpet. Turn around and across this room you will see an opening and you can see a sink from here. Go inside this room and stand in front of the sink, then you're done.

93752.instruction: You're going to start looking towards a tan wall with a window just to the left Turn to your right, a bit over ninety degrees, and move through the kitchen, between the island and the counter on the right with the sink. Just move straight between those two, through the archway that you can see a circular breakfast table through. Once you're through that archway you're going to move turn immediately to the left through the open double doors, and then you're going to go forward for quite a ways. You should pass out, and back into the home, and then around the right side of a dining table, and finally you should reach the back of a tan couch. Jump over the back of that couch and the right armrest, and you should end up just in front of a red armchair to the right, and go ahead, pass by that to the back of the chair on the right in front of the fireplace, and once you are behind that chair on the right, in front of the fireplace, you are done.

93762.instruction: You are standing in-front of a wooden cupboard, turn around, walk towards the open door. Turn to your right, exit the room, turn to your right, move towards the end of the white carpet. Turn slight left, walk towards the open arche, now passing through the open arche enter the bed room. Now move towards the bed, turn slight left, walk straight towards the open arche right in-front you, passing through the two sofa chairs, and a brown stool. You are now standing beside the mirror, which is on your left side, walk straight towards the open arche. Turn to your right, move forward, now you can see an open door, exit the open door. Turn to your right, walk towards the wooden railing, turn to your left, move forward you can see an arche, right in-front of you. Turn to your left, walk in-between the two black railings, you are now standing beside a white flower vase. Move forward, turn to your right, you can see the stairs, get down the stairs completely until you reach the last step of the stairs. You are now standing on the last step of the stairs, facing towards the brown colour cupboard, which is your final destination.

93763.instruction: You are standing in a room, facing towards the brown cupboard, turn right, in-front of you there is an open door, walk to the open door, turn right, exit the room, slightly turn right, in-front of you there is a open arch, walk to the arch, slightly turn left, walk straight to the arch, walk straight, to the left you have a bed, in-front of you there are two chairs, stand between chairs, walk straight, to the left you have a huge mirror, walk straight to the mirror, in-front of you there is a open arch, walk to the arch, walk straight, in-front of you there is a open door, walk through the door and exit the room, slightly turn left and walk straight. Sorry, slightly turn right and walk straight, slightly turn left, in-front of you there is a open arch, walk through the arch, in-front of you you can see a staircase, walk to the staircase, climb down the staircase. In-front of you you can see a cupboard, to the left of the cupboard there is a chair, that is your end point.

93843.instruction: You're standing in the living room of a house, to your right there's a glass table and a leather sofa, in front of you there's a small end table. Turn around and now you'll be facing a dining room with wooden table and chairs, on top of a carpet. Walk towards the center of that carpet and turn to your right. You will see there are two wooden archways there, walk towards the one on the left and you'll see a hallway which has wooden doors that go outside. On the left side, after the last of those wooden doors, there's an archway too. Walk towards that right side of the archway and turn left. You'll see the kitchen island in the middle, a pretty large one, and you'll walk to the right side of that kitchen island and you will stand in front of the kitchen a island and in front of the kitchen sink, well, in front of a small kitchen sink, a secondary one it seems, on top of a rug, once you're in this spot, you're done.

93844.instruction: Now you are facing the bookshelf and the fireplace, turn right and move towards the closed door. Slightly turn right and exit the room through an open door. Now you can see the staircase on your right side, turn left and enter the room through an open door and move towards the sofa. Turn around and stop on the sofa facing the portrait. This is the endpoint.

93845.instruction: Now you are facing towards the bookshelf, turn slightly right and move forward, now turn your right side and enter through the open single door. Now you are standing on the carpet, here you can see two brown coloured doors on your left side, now walk into the second door now move forward here you can find statue on your left side which is placed on the wooden box, now you can see sofa on your right side move towards the sofa and on the sofa is your end point.

93865.instruction: Turn back from your position and move little forward you can find a curtain at the right side, enter into it, walk straight till you find three steps at the left side, climb up the three steps and move straight you can find three more steps in front and a pot at the right side, walk straight climb up the steps and move little forward you can find three rooms, enter into the second room at the right side, you can find your destination at the entrance of the second room.

93866.instruction: Turn back from the place you are standing and exit the room, move a bit forward, turn right and move forward towards the second room which is to your left, enter into the room, you can find two steps infront of you, go up the steps, now you are facing towards the closed door and a staircase, that would be your end point.

93962.instruction: Facing towards the living room area with pig sculpture on your near right and the grey chair a little farther on the left, stay between the grey chair and the wall. Continue walking along the hall, the couches on the left and the wall on the right. Go past the first arch way to the dining room table with 10 chairs around it and take the first the archway next to the dining room table, to the right. You are now in a hallway where there is several double doors with window panes on them. Take a left and walk down the hall into the kitchen area. Staring at the kitchen, you'll have a phone and stove directly to your left and a kitchen island also on your left. You'll want to walk over top of the kitchen island to walk to the other side, towards the sink. Once you're standing in front of the sink, facing it, and the fireplace, take a left and head towards the other dining room area where there are four chairs around a table. The chair on the left, based on your perspective of looking out the window, the chair on the left of the table, stand behind it and you've reached your destination.

94027.instruction:
Starting at the corner of the pool table, step towards the long glass double doors in front of you. make a left around those doors and around the corner into this living room walk behind the two hairs towards the staircase and the kitchen. Walk between the stove and the kitchen table towards the sink. Walk around the table with the sink now on your right hand side and walk down the length of the table circling around the other end. 
When you reach a mall little decorative buffet table, continue around that  corner to the right to reach the staircase going down, Descend the stairs. When you reach the bottom of the staircase step onto  the rug. Stop.

94051.instruction: We're facing towards a separator that's between two frosted windows, turn towards the left and walk past this area... We're now facing towards a bedroom... On the right there are two double doors and on the left there's a bed and in front of the bed there's a small bench... Take a few steps further, and walk past the carpet that's right in front of you, on your left there's a white chair, walk towards the right corner of it... You're now facing towards a painting, next to it there's a beige curtain, walk towards the doorway that's on your left, walk past it, and step into the hallway that's in front of you... On your left there are three pictures and on your left there's on painting... Walk past the archway that's in front of you, take a few steps further and turn towards the right... After you turn towards the right, step into the small hallway that's ahead... On the left there's a small bench a book on top, and next to it there's a bag and next to the bad there's a hat... On your right there's a small painting, and there's another painting next to it, and on your left there are pictures, and what appears to be a certificate, walk towards the cabinet that's at the end right at the end at this hallway... Once you're facing towards the top of the cabinet, you have reached your destination.

94118.instruction: You're standing in a room facing a white wall, if you turn around you'll see an open door that leads out of the room. Walk out of the room and turn to your right. You'll have an open door right in front of you and another open door further ahead. Walk towards that second open door and if you notice you'll see stairways on your right side, walk towards those stairs and go downstairs. Once you reach the bottom level turn to your right and you will notice another set of steps. Walk down those steps and as you reach the base of those steps, you will turn around and head back towards the wall in front of you, leaving the stairs on your left. Now turn to your left and you'll notice the entry door of the house. Walk towards that door and once you're standing in front of it turn to your right and you will notice there's a TV room or a living room in front of you with a black coffee table in the middle, walk towards the right corner of that table and keep walking from there towards the right corner of the room, and stand right in front of the window, of the tall window. That's your spot, next to the window and the couch, and the TV.

94130.instruction: You're now facing the door, walk straight and come out of the door and then TAKE RIGHT. Now walk straight and turn slightly right and enter the room which has a bed. From there, walk towards the table beside the bed and then turn right from the table. Now walk straight towards the toilet seat. Now stand beside the toilet seat, you will reach your destination.

94131.instruction: Okay right now you are facing the door. Walk straight towards the door. Exit the door. Turn slightly right and you see a way in front of you. Walk straight towards that way till you reach the door in front of you to which is to the right side beside the thermostat. Enter into that room. You see a bed inside the room. Now turn to your right and walk straight towards the glass window. To your right there is a room which is open. Enter into the room and Walk straight till you reach the towel in front of you. That is the end point.

94170.instruction: You can find a glass table with two chairs on your left, move a bit forward, you can find a kitchen infront of you, move a bit forward towards the kitchen, turn left, move towards the table which is beside the couch, which is infront of you, turn back and move a bit forward, slightly turn right and move a bit forward towards the dining table, that would be your end point.

94171.instruction: Turn slight left and move forward,take slight right and move in front of the flower pot,again take slight right and move inside the room,stop near to the dinning table.

94172.instruction: You are facing towards a window, turn around and go forward towards the chair, from the edge of the table slightly turn left and go forward, go forward towards the white cupboard, slightly turn left and go forward towards the chair which is having a footrester in front of it, slightly turn left and go forward towards the snooker table, slightly turn left and go forward towards the closed door which is the entrance of this room, turn right and go forward, go forward towards the snooker table, here just in front of the snooker table you have reached the destination.

94173.instruction: You are facing towards the glass window. Turn around and walk straightly behind the chairs till you find a wooden chair in front of you. Turn left and walk straightly till you find a lamp on your left side. Now walk straightly till you find a wooden pillar on your left side. Slightly turn left and move towards the sofa chair. Turn left and move forward. There is a sofa chair on your right side. Slightly turn left and move towards the closed door. Turn right and walk straightly towards the snooker table. Now you are facing towards the snooker table. That will be the end point.

94175.instruction: You are standing facing a very large painting, turn to your left and look ahead of you  across the oriental throw rug. You will see two beige pillars. You want to walk in between the two beige pillars into the next room. Now you will see a large white statue in the middle of the back window. You want to walk all the way to the left of the statue to the corner of the window. If you are standing facing the corner of the window ahead of you and on your left is a smaller portion of wood.(To to the right of you is the statue farther away). You have arrived at your destination.

94209.instruction: You're standing in a small study that's pretty empty. In front of you is an archway that leads out. Exit the study. Once you have exited the study, you'll see there are multiple paths to take. You'll find there are a set of stairs. To the right of those stairs is an archway. Head down that direction. Once you've gone through the archway, you'll find yourself in a living area. In this living area, you'll see a fireplace on the left and some arm chairs. And to your right is a couch, two arm chairs, and a coffee table, as well as a small potted houseplant. To the left of the coffee table is the arm chair that's made with sort of a gold and red patterned fabric. You want to stand to the left of that armchair, right before you enter through the sliding double doors that leads into the pool table. Where you're standing should be to the left of the red, velvet fabric armchair, once again. Once you're there, you are done.

94252.instruction: You will walk straight down from your starting position. Follow the red carpet and through these brown doors. You will enter a room. There will be two red chairs on the left, some portraits hanging on the wall. To the right there will be this informative glass panel with two vase. Anyway, we are going to continue walking straight down to the door in front of us and stop right when we are out. like at the entrance of the door.

94260.instruction: You are in the closet room, facing towards the clothes. Turn right and move towards the open door, and exit the closet room, now turn left, and move towards the open arch, now move forward towards the open door, now you have a bath tub on your left side, and a toilet seat on your right side, turn right and move towards the toilet seat, this is your end point.

94261.instruction: You are currently facing towards a wardrobe, turn slightly right and move forward. There is an open door right in front of you, pass through the door, take a slight left and move forward towards the wall. Walk forward and you can see an open door on your right and there's a bathtub on your left. Enter through the first open door and move forward. You are now standing facing towards a glass window in a bathroom and this is your end point.

94289.instruction: You are facing the wall. Turn slightly right and move forward, until you face the wall which has a wall hanging on it. Turn slightly left and move forward to your right, there are stairs. Climb up the stairs. At the top of the stairs, turn slightly left and move forward then you are facing towards the plants. Turn slightly right and move forward, then you are facing towards the plant. Turn slightly right and move forward until you are facing the wall again. Turn slightly right and move forward wherein there are some flower vase to your left and right. Move forward until the sofa, then turn slightly left and walk towards the bed. Now walk beside the bed and move forward, until you are facing the wall again. Turn slightly left and move forward, this is a bathroom and stop facing the bathtub and the windows, and this is your end point.`

94290.instruction: Slide little right and walk straight along the path towards the potted plant, now slide left, now again slide right towards the staircase, now walk up the steps, now slide left and walk straight, now again slide right and walk straight along the narrow path, now slide left and enter into the open door and walk straight along the path towards the sofa, now slide little left near in between the sofa and walk towards the open door, now slide right and walk straight towards the open entrance, now immediately take left and walk straight towards the open door, enter into the bathroom, now walk straight towards the bathtub and you have reached your destination.

94300.instruction: You are standing in a closet room, facing towards the wall, turn left, walk straight, to the right you have a open door, turn right, exit the room, turn right, in-front of you there is a open door, walk through the open door and exit the room, walk straight, turn right, in-front of you there is a narrow path, walk straight in the narrow path, until you reach the opening on your right, turn right, walk straight until you reach the cupboard in-front of you, turn left, in-front of you there is a open door, walk through the open door, enter the room, slightly turn left, in-front of you there is another open door, walk to the door, turn left, exit the room, now you are in a washroom, to the left you have washbasin, turn right, walk straight, walk straight till end of the wall, that is your end point.

94301.instruction: You are now facing towards the wall. Turn slightly left and exit the room using the right side open door room, then take next right and enter into the open door. Now turn slightly right and move towards the straight path where in there is a piano to your right. Walk straight and stop at the first right side direction and enter into that right side direction. Walk straight towards the wall, you are now facing towards the wall with some dolls. Turn slightly left and enter into the room. Move forward, you are now beside the bed. Turn slightly left and exit the room. Move forward, you are now facing towards the closed door and in the left there is a sink. Turn slightly right and move forward until you face the window and a painting on the wall, and this is your end point.

94394.instruction: You are facing towards a wall, slightly turn right and move a bit forward towards the opened door, slightly turn left and move towards the mirror which is infront of you, turn right and exit the room through the opened door, move forward until you see a staircase infront of you, get down the steps, slightly turn right and move a bit forward, turn right and move towards the opened door which is infront of you, now you are at the entrance of a bedroom, that would be your end point.

94395.instruction: Right now you're facing towards a wall. Now slightly turn right and enter in to the room through the open door which is in front of you. Now slightly turn left and move towards the fireplace which is to your right. You can see a wall in front of you, move towards the wall and turn right. There is an open door in front of you, move towards the door and exit the room . Now slightly turn right and move forward in the walkway. There is an arch to your left, now slightly turn left and move towards the arch and pass through it and move a bit forward. You can see a staircase in front of you, move towards the staircase and get down the stairs. Now turn right. You can see an arch in front of you, move towards the arch and turn right. There is an open door in front of you, move towards the door and stand at the entrance of the room and it is your end point.

94430.instruction: You're standing on the carpet facing towards the sofa chair. Turn behind and enter into the washroom. Walk into the open door which is in front of you. Now you're standing near the bed. Turn left and go towards the stairs. Walk down the stairs. At the end of the stairs, turn right and walk forward towards the billiards table. Stand near the billiards table. This would be your end point.

94431.instruction: You are in the bedroom, facing towards the chair, turn right and move towards the open door, exit the bedroom and enter the bathroom, you are now facing towards the shower area, turn slightly left and move towards the open door, you are now standing at the entrance of the bedroom, turn slightly left, move towards the cabinet near the bed, you are now facing towards the chair, turn left and move forward, now turn left and get down the stairs. Turn right and move towards the closed glass doors, now turn right and move forward towards the pillar, which is on your right side, you are now standing beside the pillar, slightly turn left and move towards the billiards table. You are now standing in front of the billiards table, which is your end point.

94537.instruction: Go straight , you can see the photographs on the wall , in the same way you can go forward , we are entering into wooden two wooden doors and then you can see left side clay pots , in the same way you are entering into the same two doors wooden doors , now slightly go straight now you ,  you can see the king bed and you reached your destination .

94538.instruction: Move forward from the place you are standing, until you see a bed infront of you, stand infront of the bed, where to the left you can find an opened door, that would be your end point.

94581.instruction: You will start by standing in front of a treadmill. Turn around and exit this gym room. Walk towards the wine cellar and on the left of the wine cellar, you will see a doorway. Walk towards that doorway. In front of you you will see a closed door. On the right of that is a narrow hallway. Walk along the hallway. Now you will see a staircase on your left. Go up the staircase till you've reached the second floor. Once you're there there will be a closed door and on your left there will be paintings on the wall. Walk towards that painting and now in front of you there will be another hallway towards more rooms. Continue moving forward. In front of you it seems to be a washroom and on your right there will be two open doors. Walk inside that room and in front of you you will see a glass table and on the left is a black chalkboard. Walk towards the black chalkboard and this is where you stop.

94602.instruction: Facing the microwave, with the fridge on your left and the coffee maker on your right, turn 180 degrees around and walk straight between the two kitchen islands, till you reach the next kitchen counter directly ahead. Once you reach the kitchen counter directly ahead, turn to your right and walk towards the stone archway. Once you reach the stone archway, don't go straight, turn to the left and walk towards the two chairs beneath the chandelier. Once you are at the two chairs, turn to the right and walk under that archway to your right. You have now entered a room with a fireplace directly ahead, a TV adjacent to the left and a large couch on your right. Walk straight towards the fireplace. Once you're just past the coffee table, facing the fire place, with a red chair on your left and a white chair on your right, you've reached your final destination.

94688.instruction: Right now you're facing a window and a photo frame. Turn around and walk towards the cupboard which is on the right side. Move little forward and exit the room. Now you're in front of an narrow arch. Turn left and move little forward passing portraits on left and right side. Now you can see a violin in front of you. Take a right turn and enter into the room where you can find two washing machines on the right side and that would be the end point.

94689.instruction: You are facing a curtain. Turn around, there are two exits for this bedroom. Exit through the left door. After you exit, turn left, you are in a passage and you can see two doors facing towards each other. Go and stand in between the doors. Turn to your right, you can a laundry room. Get inside the room. Now, you are inside the laundry room and this is the end point.

94786.instruction: You're standing in a long exhibit hall. Turn around and walk in the opposite direction. Take a right in the only path that you can take. Continue straight until you reach an exhibit room at the end of the hall. Before you enter, stand in the archway, and you're done.

94851.instruction: You are facing towards a window with curtains. Make a slight right turn and walk through the red carpet in front you can see a entrance of a door. From there make a slight left and walk through the red carpet. Here we reached our destination in front of the arch.

94852.instruction: Right now you're facing a large Windows with red curtains. Turn right and you can an opened door. Move forwards through that opened door. Here you can see few portraits in front of you. Slightly turn left and you can see a red chair. Move towards the red chair. Now, slight turn right and you can see three chairs and a large portrait in front of you. Move little forward and in between the walk way and that is the end point.

94905.instruction: "Now your facing toward your wall turn slightly towards your right then you can see stairs get down the stairs. Go straight you can see a plant pot beside the glass frame there comes your destination stand near it."

94906.instruction: Slightly turn to your right and start going down the stairs, on reaching the ash color wall in front on you, take a right turn and go down the stairs. Here again slightly turn to your right and go down the stairs entering into the narrow corridor. Walk straight until you see a tree to your left side.

94926.instruction: You are facing the wall with a photo frame. Turn around and exit the washroom. Now you are standing in front of the washbasin. From there turn right and walk towards the bed. From the bed, take another right turn and walk to the end of the room. Now turn right and walk straight till you exit the bedroom and walk towards the closed door in front of the room. Now turn right and walk straight in the narrow pathway along the washbasin on the left side, walk straight towards the glass door. Now exactly in front of the glass door will be the end point.

94927.instruction: You are facing towards the portrait right now, turn back, you can find a wash basin, go near the wash basin, turn right and exit the washroom, turn right, you can find a sliding mirror, go near the sliding mirror, turn right and exit the bedroom, walk towards the closed door which is infront of you, turn right, move towards the sliding glass door, stand infront of that sliding glass door, that would be your end point.

94968.instruction: You are near the  dinning table in your living area. Turn towards your slight right and move forward. Go near the table, which has a candle support in front of you and turn towards your right. You can find a brown door, walk through that door and you enter into your corridor. Turn towards your left and keep moving forward. You enter into a kitchen area, which is on your left side. Walk along that kitchen area, beside the sofa set in front of you. Keep moving forward beside that and you can find an another brown door in front of you. Walk through that door and you find an another living area, which has a sofa set and the table in front of you. Walk across the sofa set, and go near the dinning table, which has a flower vase on it. Stand near the table and you reached your destination.

94969.instruction: You're standing beside brown table, from there go straight, and turn right, then turn left, go straight, to the right you'll find frames on the wall, go straight, you'll enter in to living room, go near the white chairs, and white table, there you'll find your destination.

94974.instruction: You begin facing a bunch of wooden shelves, turn around completely and take a step to exit this room, looking to the left, you will see a wooden staircase with black railing, take a step to go up the staircase and then take a couple steps going up, once you get to the top of the staircase, you will see a hallway, following the banister, take 2 steps to go through the hallway, you will see some red vases with sticks in one, take a step towards those, and then take a step continuing through the hallway, take 2 more steps and you will see a bedroom start to come up, take a step towards the gray chair in front of the bed, and then take a step towards the red bench in front of the bed, and then to the left of the bed there is a opening with 2 double doors that goes outside, with curtains, take a step towards those doors and then take a step to go outside those doors onto the balcony, in this balcony, to the very right, there is a little outlet, at the bottom, near the floor, take a step towards the outlet, onto the balcony and you're done.

94999.instruction: Right now you're facing towards a mirror, slightly turn right and move forward in the walkway which is in front of you. There is a sofa to your right and a platform to your left, move a bit forward and turn right, there is a chair in front of you, move towards the chair and turn behind. You can see a dining table in front of you, move towards the dining table and turn right, there is a window in front of you, move towards the corner of the room facing towards the window and it is your end point.

95000.instruction: You are facing towards the couch, slightly take right and move forward, walk in between the counter tops and the sofa, and move forward now turn to your right and move towards the black chair, now turn to your left and move towards the dinning table, which is having a potted plant and tea cups on it, slightly take right and move towards the window, and stand at the corner of the wall, it is your end point.

95094.instruction: Your are in a bathroom facing towards a white sink and a mirror hanged to the wall, on your right there  is an open door. Now turn right and walk out through the open door. In-front of you there is a bed on left there is glass window, now turn right you can see another open windoor, sorry. you can see another open door, exit the room through the open door. On left you can see a flower vase on right you can another open door. Now walk to the open door, enter into the room on left there is a bed, in-front of you there is a table with flower vase on it beside that there is a couch, on right there is another open door. Enter into the open door, on left there is an white table, in-front of you there is an another open door, on right you also have an another open door. Now enter into the open door, you will enter into the bathroom again. In-front of you there is an sink and mirror on a wall, so that's your end point.

95095.instruction: You are in the washroom right now, exit the washroom, turn right and exit the bedroom, to your right you can find an opened door, enter through that door, you will be entering into the bedroom, move towards the couch which is infront of you, turn right and move forward, to your right you can find a washroom, stand infront of the wash basin, that would be your end point.

95130.instruction: Begin facing 2 grey chairs. Turn around and head into the open closet door way to the right of the bead. Head down the length of the closet towards the washroom and you're done.

95143.instruction: You are facing towards the sink, turn right and move out of this room. Now turn right and move forward. Turn left you can see an open door, enter into it. Turn left and keep walking straight. Now you can see table lamp, turn left and move towards the open door. Move out of this room. Now you are standing near the staircase, take few steps ahead. Now you are standing in middle of the steps and facing towards the open door. The position you are standing is your final destination.

95144.instruction: You are now facing towards the toilet seat. Turn around and exit the room using the open door. Turn slightly right and enter through the open door. Turn slightly left and move forward. Turn slightly left and move towards the table which has a statue above it. Turn slightly left and exit the room using the open door. Now get down through the stairs and stop at the bottom second step. Now this your endpoint.

95179.instruction: You are in the bedroom facing the stair case, get down the stair case, now turn left side, there is a closed white door near the stair case, move towards it, now enter the opening which is beside the closed door, move forward and stand in front of the window near the table with chairs, there is a closed glass door on the right side, that is your destination.

95180.instruction: Right now you're facing towards an entrance of a room. Now slightly turn right and exit the room. There is a staircase to your left, turn left and get down the staircase. Now you are facing towards a closed door. Now turn left, there is an entrance in front of you, move towards the entrance, there is a staircase, a closed door and an open door in front of you, move towards the open door and enter in to the room. You can see a dining table in front of you, move towards the dining table. There is a window in front of you and a closed door  to your right, move forward and stand in front of the window and it will be your end point.

95209.instruction: You are facing towards a marble structure, turn left, take a step ahead, turn right, walk towards the open door and step out of the room through it, turn left, walk towards the three pool chairs. You are now facing towards a wall with the pool chairs on your left and a swimming pool on your right. You have reached your destination.

95210.instruction: Now you are in a room. Turn slightly left and walk a bit far, then take right and walk straight. Now take right and walk straight to exit the room through the door. Now you are in the pool area. Take left and walk straight. Now take left sorry right and walk towards the wall. Now stand near to the pool and the pool chair which is near to the wall which is the endpoint.

95228.instruction: You are now facing towards a corner of a room, turn around and exit the room through the open door. Take a slight left and move forward. You can see stairs, get down the stairs all the way till the bottom. Turn slightly right and you can see three steps, get down the steps, now turn around, climb up the three steps and move forward. Take a slight right and move forward. You are now facing a closed door. Turn to your right and move towards the couch on your right side.You are now standing beside the couch facing the white wall, that is your end point.

95229.instruction: You're near the exit door of the bedroom you are facing towards the wall you have to turn around and exit from the door where you can see a staircase opposite to the bedroom door. You have to get down the staircase after getting down the staircase you can see a white wall opposite to the stair case. You have to move towards the white wall after moving towards the white wall, you can see a corridor left side of the wall. You have to enter into the corridor after entering into the corridor you can see a brown color door which is closed. Beside that there is an open entrance you have to enter into the entrance after entering into entrance you can see a white couch which is on the right side you have to stand in the corner of the white couch. That is the final destination.

95300.instruction: You will start by facing a doorway. Walk inside the doorway and turn left. Go up the couple of steps. Take a step forward and turn right. Walk towards the right you will see a brown door in front of you. Turn right once again you will see a living area. Stand on the left side of the couch and you're done.

95408.instruction: You are facing towards the sofa chair turn to your right side, walk through that arch and then turn to your left side go out of that room. Then take aright turn walk straight in that narrow path until you reach the room which has a the black table and book shelf's, walk near to the book shelf there you can see a door with curtains stand near the door.

95409.instruction: You are beside the white recliner sofa. Turn around and move forward passing through the bed, you will find an arch. Take a left, you will find a brown opened door. Once you are out of that door, take right. You will find two frames on your left side of the wall. Move forward, you will find many photo frames on your right side and glass doors on your left. Go straight passing through the arches. You will find a brown table on your right side, move forward. You will find an opened glass door in brown colour which is the entrance of the room. Go into the room. You will find a book shelves, pass through it. Now, take slight left. You will find a door that is close. That will be your end point and then stop.

95431.instruction: You are standing facing towards the wall. Turn left and walk straight till you reach the steps in the front. Turn right. You are now standing facing towards the table. Enter into the room. Walk straight till you reach the closed door in front of you. Turn left. Walk straight and stand in front of the brown  cardboard box. You have reached your point.

95432.instruction: Right now you are standing in front of the wooden door exit the room through it and walk straight towards the staircase which is present in the front now turn right from the staircase you can see three portraits on the wall towards you are left hand side enter into the room and walk straight towards the white door which is closed in the room and turn left you can see a closed boxes which are behind the dining table chair go near to the closed boxes which are packed right in front of the packed boxes is the end point.

95439.instruction: Right now you're facing towards a bed. Now turn left and exit the room through the open door which is in front of you. Now again turn left and move forward in the walkway up to the end and turn left. Move forward in the walkway up to the cabinets which are in front of you and turn left. There is an open door in front of you, move towards the open door. There is an open door to your left, move towards the open door and turn left. Now enter in to the dressing room, there is a platform to your left and shirts hanged in the shelves to your right, move forward and stand in between them facing towards the shoe rack and it is your end point.

95440.instruction: You are facing towards the bed, turn left move little forward and exit the room, move little forward take left and walk straight till you find a guitar on the wall in front, then take left and walk straight till you find a toy on the brown table, take left and walk straight till you find an open door at the left side, turn left and enter into the room, you can find number of racks with shirts, in front you can find a rack with shoes, the position now you are standing is your destination.

95446.instruction: Right now you are facing towards a cupboard and a wooden wall, turn left and move forward, you will find a bed on your right. Move forward towards that bed and turn right, you have an open door in front of you, enter into that door and move forward towards the wall which is beside the commode. Facing towards the open door and you have the commode on your left and this is your final point.

95447.instruction: "Now you are facing towards cupboard, turn towards your left, move forward, you can see a bed towards your right, go near bed and again turn right, you can see a door exit the door, walk inside it, you can see a European WC towards left, beside of it there is a door, go and stand in front of it, your destiny has been arrived."

95507.instruction: You are facing a bed set, turn right. take few steps straight ahead and exit the bedroom,when you exit the bedroom, take step inside the washroom on your right and turn left, take a step inside the hall way facing the picture saying closer and take the entrance on your left  towards the bedroom. Take the entrance to the bedroom straight ahead, which has a chair near the three rectangle windows, stay at the threshold of this bedroom and you are done.

95541.instruction: We are going to start facing a mirror inside a bedroom. Turn to left, and take one step towards the painting at the end of that small hall. Turn left, and pass the wine room to your right. Keep walking straight towards the hallway. We're going to take one more step towards the bench that we can see at the bottom of the stairs. Once you are next to that bench with the two frames on top, you're done.

95556.instruction: You are standing in-front of the open glass door, turn to your right, move forward. Turn slight right, you can see the stair case, move towards the stair case. Turn to your right, now get down the stairs completely, now move forward towards the sofa bench opposite to you. You are facing towards sofa bench opposite to you, which is your final destination.

95557.instruction: Now we are at the entrance of the room, turn right, move straight and take right, get down the steps, at the end of the stairs, we arrived the destination.

95664.instruction: You are standing in a living room.  There will be a fireplace to the right of you.  You are going to head to the left heading towards the burgundy floral chair against the wall.  You will pass the chair and the wood doors on your right.  You are going to see an open arch way in front of you.  You are going to continue on the wood floor thru this arch way passing the orange curtains on the wall on your right.  You will walk thru this small arch way and you will see a dining room table on your right.  To the left of you thru the open arch way you will see a kitchen area.  You are going to walk in between these 2 heading out onto the tiled floor and you will see a double door in the distance on the wall in front of you.  You are going to head towards that door.  You will be near that door now and there will be a shelf on the wall with a floral bouquet on it.  You are going to continue moving forward so the doors will be on your right and you will see some black stools on your left at a counter.  Continue moving forward.  You will see in front of you 2 open arch ways.  You are going to take the 1 on the right where you can see there are stairs going down.  You are going to go down these steps. You are going to continue moving down these steps. And once you have reached almost the bottom of the steps and you will be facing in front of you a large vase like object on the floor you are done.

95713.instruction: You will start by facing a sink and a mirror. Slightly to your right you will see a doorway. Walk towards this doorway. Once you're facing this hallway, to your left you will see 2 open doorways. Take one step towards the second open doorway. Now looking at the large double doors. Walk towards the large double door and continue to walk down the steps. Once you're facing the pool, turn right. Take one step towards the front of the console table or the linen closet. Take another step forward, you will see a doorway to your right. Take one step towards the marbled table then you're done.

95721.instruction: You are in a dinning hall, turn towards your left and walk across the table. Go near the plant at the corner of the room and turn towards your right. In front you can find a glass door, walk through the door and you enter into a corridor, keep moving forwards beside the stairs on your right, in front you can find a section, go through that section, you enter into your living room. Turn towards your left and keep moving forward, beside the kitchen table. In front you can find a coffee maker, go near the coffee maker and  stand there. Turn towards your left, you can find an other room, go through it and you enter into a another dinning room, which has a glass color dinning table over there. Walk beside the glass dinning table and keep moving forward. In front you can find a sofa set, which is cream in color. Turn towards your slight left and walk thought that sofa set. Go near that sofa set and turn towards your left. You can find a staircase, climb up the stairs to the half portion and the you reached your destination.

95722.instruction: You are facing towards the open door, go near the plant, turn right move towards the open door, again move forward then turn left, and move forward then move towards the shelf, then turn left again move forward towards the dining table, again move forward towards the table lamp, then go up the stairs and move forward and stand.

95777.instruction: You're standing in a doorway turn to the right and walk to the right of this table. And take another step forward and walk towards the large archway that's in the middle. And you'll see some tiled floor turn around and walk over the yellow chair that's next to a lamp in front of you. And then walk towards this outside area with a pool table. Take a step to the left of the pool table. And one step past it. And you should be looking at windows and you're done.

95830.instruction: Turn to your right, step between the couch on the right and the coffee table. Turn slightly left and step out that open archway into the hallway. Turn slightly left and walk towards the bottom of the stairs. Walk up the first 2 stairs. Stop. Turn around and change your mind. To the right you see like 3 steps down. Go down those. Then you are going to step forward and end standing in the doorway to the bathroom

95906.instruction: You are facing an open door. Exit the open door and cross the painting which is towards your left. Now you can see, towards your left there is a passage which leads to a room. Enter into the room through the door, and in front of you, you can see there is a white color bed and a black table beside the bed which has a small plant. Go near that black color round table, and this is the end point.

95907.instruction: Now you are standing at the open door. Just step out from the room from the open door and go straight make a slight left turn near to the wall. And go straight near to the open door .From the open door make a slight left turn and go near closed to the bed. Here we reached our destination beside the bed.

96020.instruction: You're standing beside this glass oval table. Step on the stone floor in the direction of the kitchen. Without going in the kitchen, make a` left towards this entry table with the lamp. You will enter a living area. Hop over by the edge of the black coffee table with the potted plant. Take a step towards the fireplace. and stop at the right edge of the fireplace right beside the potted plant and two tall giraffe statues and you're done.

96039.instruction: You will begin facing a large room with a bunch of couches, turn to your right, you will see that there is a opening and you will be able to see some tile flooring, take a step into that room, once you are in this room you will enter a circular corridor, turn to your right, and you will see that there is a hallway, take the hallway it should be next to the stairs, this hallway should bring you into another circular room, there are two doors in front of you, do not take the one you are directly facing, take the one on the left, you should now see a very long hallway, take 5 steps and go to the end of this hallway, you should end up in a bedroom with a bed with antique pink sheets and in front of the bed there will be curtains, take a step towards the curtains to stand directly in front of them, turn around, you will see the bed and next to the bed you will see a closet, take one step and go in the closet, once you are in the closet, you will be standing in the walkway and the bedroom should be behind you, you are done.

96124.instruction: Okay right now you are facing towards the sofa. Turn to your right and walk straight towards the wall in front of you. Now turn to your left and walk straight. Then turn to your left and climb two steps. That is the end point.

96125.instruction: You are facing towards a couch, turn right and walk towards the open entrance, step into it and walk towards the wall, turn left and walk straight in the narrow path, turn left, walk towards the staircase and stand on the first stair. You have reached your destination.

96156.instruction: Right now you are standing in front of the book shelf turn right, you can see the wooden arch exit the room through the wooden arch in the front you can see the open arch walk straight and enter into the open arch to the left you can see the flower pot, turn slight right and walk straight in the front you can see few more arches cross through all the arches in the front till you reach the chairs which are in a row and a sofa on the right side walk behind the sofa and the chairs and go straight in the front you can see the open arch enter into the arch turn left you can see an another open door exit the room through the open door now walk straight in the front you can see another open door, enter into the house through the open door on the left you can see dining table chair and on the right you can see the closed glass door walk in between of them and in the front you can see the cream sofa moves towards it and walks in between of the tea table and the sofa and go near to the two sofas which are present in the front of the fireplace now turn slight left you can see the white table go near it and walk straight at the corner just beside the black pot is the end point.

96157.instruction: You are standing facing towards the wooden shelf with some books arranged on it. Turn right and exit the room. You will see a white arch in front of you. Walk a few steps ahead and enter into the arch. As you enter into the arch you will see two paintings and a white vase on your left. Slightly turn right. You will see a narrow passage in front of you. Keep walking straight till you find a sink on your left. You are now standing beside the sink.  Walk two steps ahead and take left passing through the three chairs behind the sink. Walk through the path between the three chairs on your left and sofa on your right. Walk till the third chair. You will find an arch in front of you. Enter into the arch and turn left. You will see an open brown door beside the round table. Walk a few steps ahead and exit the room. You will find a narrow way in front of you and a window towards your left. Walk a few steps ahead. You will find another open door in front of you. Enter into the room. Walk straight through the path between the brown chairs on your left and glass doors on your right. Keep walking straight till you reach a cream color sofa and a red color chair in the front. Walk a few steps ahead. You will find two cream color chairs and a small round table near the fire place. Walk through the path between the two chairs till you reach a cream color table on your left. You will see a vase in front of you. Walk a few steps ahead and stand near the vase. You have reached your point.

96171.instruction: "Now you are facing the pillar, turn slightly right and walk forward, towards the door, which is on your right side, exit the door and turn right, you can see a closed door, go and stand in front of it, your destiny has been reached."

96172.instruction: Now you are facing towards the opening. Turn slightly right. Move forward to the sofa. You will see an open door. Move forward to the open door. Turn slightly right. Move forward to another open door. Turn right. Move forward to the closed door. You have reached your destination.

96179.instruction: Right now you are facing the corner of the door. Now slightly turn left and exit form the door. You will find steps. Now go up and turn left. You will find stair case. Now go and stand on the second step. Now turn right and get down from the steps. Now slightly turn left and go near the closed door. On the right side you will find narrow opening. Now slightly turn right and go near the sofa. Now slightly turn right. You will find TV. Now go and stand in front of the TV. That will be your final destination.

96180.instruction: You are in the bathroom, facing towards the mirror and the sink, turn slight left, exit the bathroom and move towards the stairs in front of you, turn slight right and climb the three stairs, now turn left and get on the second step from the bottom of the staircase, you are now facing towards the staircase railing. Turn right and get down the stairs, you are now facing towards the wall, turn slight left and move towards the hallway, you are now facing towards the wall, beside the closed door. Turn right, pass through the open entrance and move towards the sofa on the left side, now turn slight right and move towards the television, you are now facing towards the two vases, beside the television, which is your end point.

96332.instruction: Starting off you should see a shower head, you will be standing next to a shower. You are going to turn around so you can step out of the shower and next to the towels hanging up on the right side. Once you are there you can step forward in front of the sinks. Looking straight ahead, you should see a doorway into a bedroom, we're going to walk through that door. Stepping into the bedroom, on the left side you will see a mirror. We are going to walk forward to the left side of the bed by the mirror and the phone on the table with the lamp. And once we are on the left side of this bed you are done.

96404.instruction: Turn left,you can see an open door,go inside the room,stop near to the chair.

96405.instruction: Now we are at the entrance of the washroom, turn left, move straight, there is a chair and we arrived the destination.

96492.instruction: You are standing in font of the wall, and on you right side you can see the television, turn to your left, move towards the chair opposite to you. Now move towards the white mat on the floor, you can see an arche opposite to you, move towards the arche. Now move towards the open entrance on your left side. You are standing in front of an open door, which is your final destination.

96493.instruction: You are in a bedroom near the TV facing towards the wall, take a left turn and go towards the armchair and move forward near the door, and take slightly right turn and go towards the small rug, from there take slightly left turn and go into the corridor, and take slightly left turn and go towards the door near the carpet, this is a door of washroom. This is the endpoint.

96567.instruction: You are standing near a pillar turn on your right and proceed straight ahead towards the two pillars and open door in front of you, once you are standing near the two pillars in the room and you should see their is a statue near the window and the lamp, go towards the right side of the lamp and the stool which has cd's, once you are here, you are done.

96644.instruction: You are standing inside a washroom wall, which has so many pictures, turn left take step on the black rug, turn right, move towards the shell art on the floor straight ahead, once you are their you are done.

96662.instruction: Okay you are in a room facing towards an open door. Turn to your left, in front of you there is a narrow opening. Go straight through the narrow opening passing the sink platform on the left, until you reach the end of the sink platform. Now turn to your right, in front of you there is arch opening and adjacent to it on the right side there is closed door. Go straight near to the closed door. Now you are facing towards the edge of the entrance with the closed door on the left side. Turn to your right, now in front of you there is another open door. Go straight near to that open door, you are facing the edge of the open door. Turn to your right, you are at the entrance of the dining room. Move forward near to the dining table. Now in front of you there is a lamp on the wall in between two glass doors. Go straight near to the lamp. Now turn to your left and move forward. Now you are in front of a glass door and next, and standing next to the table and this is the end point.

96663.instruction: Your standing in a room, facing towards a open door, now turn to your left, you can see an entrance, walk through the entrance, now to the left you have an platform with a sink, to the right you have another platform, walk between them till the end, now slightly turn to your right, you can see a close door, beside the close door there is another entrance to your right, walk to the close door, now slightly turn to your right, to your right you can see an wooden entrance, walk to the wooden entrance, infront of you you can see a dinning table with chairs around it, to the right there is an table, walk between the dinning table and the chairs. Now infront of you there is an close door, now turn to your left, to the right you have another close door, walk to the close door and stand infront of the close door, that's your end point.

96681.instruction: "Okay now, you are facing towards the curtain. Turn around, and move forward, you can see the closed door in front of you. Now slightly turn right, and move forward, you can see the stair case on the right side. Now go down through that stair case, and turn right, and move forward, you can see the open door on the left side. Now go near to that open door, and turn left, you can see the garage door in front of you. Now go near to that garage door, and there are cupboards on the left side. Now, you have reached your destination,"

96682.instruction: Alright ,turn around from the window move forward to the right there is a path which will lead you to the downstairs,by using stairs get down and you will reach to the ground floor there is an entrance to the room an empty room which is completely with some lockers  and there is a space where you can park your car.

96686.instruction: Slightly turn right, and move near to the photo frame on the wall, move forward near to the flower vase in front of you, and from the flower vase, move near to the stove in the kitchen, and take left and move forward near to the sofa, and from the sofa take right and enter into the room, and end near the bench press in the room.

97700.instruction: Right now you're facing towards an open door, move towards the open door. There is a bed in front of you and a closed door beside the bed, move forward and stand beside the bed facing the closed door and it is your end point.

97701.instruction: at present you are beside a stair case in front of a living room, walk straight forward into the living room ,you can see a bed, a table and a chair beside it ,walk straight forward you will see a great out view from the door. you have reached your destination.

97722.instruction: Now you are in abed room, facing towards the bed, exit the bed room, go straight till the which is in front of you, from there turn right, towards your left there are many photo farms on the wall, walk through the walk way, on either side of you there are two room which are open, enter in to the room which is towards left, now your in front of the wall, towards your left there is a table with one chair,this would be your final destination.

97942.instruction: You begin on a staircase, go through the opening on the right, hop over the bed towards the french doors and you're done.

Just before you get to the grass, take a left and walk down that pathway lined with concrete. Once you reach, just above the first step along concrete path, next to the blue hydrometer on the left, as well as the window with the light on, you're done.

98082.instruction: You begin looking at an open window by a spiral shrubbery. And once you are in front of the fireplace with a tan chair on your right and a red chair on your left, you are done.

98167.instruction: Right now you are standing in a corner of a room . Make a slight right turn and move straight. Here we reached our destination in front of the wooden desk.

98168.instruction: Now you are facing towards a wall, turn around and move forward, you can see an open arch in-front of you, enter into it and go near the cream cupboard which is to your left and stand in-front of it, that's your end point.

98524.instruction: You are standing at the entrance of the room facing towards the white color door. Take a about turn and take a slight right. Take few steps towards the plant, which is in front of you. You have reached your destination.

98538.instruction: you start in a wine cellar, turn your body to the left and walk past the ungodly amount of the wine bottles until you are out of the wine cellar. turn your body to the right and walk up the staircase, all the way up until you are at the top of the house. once you are at the top of the stairs turn to the left and walk past the clay vases on the ground. turn your body to the left and you should see a sitting area with a bunch of doors leading outside behind it. take one step to that seating area and you should now be in between the arms of the two closest chairs once you are there you are done.

98559.instruction: Right now you are facing to the couch turn slightly to the right where you will find an another couch on your right and table in front of you move towards the right, here you will find a small table with a lamp on it, now exit the room, you are facing to the wall now, take left and move forward to the pathway where you can see the downstairs move downstairs move forward, go straight where you will find a dining table with a black chair move to the corner where you can find a glass door now you are facing to the glass door now take left and move forward where you will find a window face to the window this is your destination point.

98626.instruction: You are facing towards the washbasin and the wooden racks with cups and glasses on it. Slightly turn left and walk straight in the passage. 100671.instruction: You will start by facing a door. Continue to walk down this hallway towards the arched opening at the end. You will see a kitchen island. Turn right and walk towards the sink. You will see a dining  table just ahead of you. Jump over the chair and coffee table towards the left side of the dining table. Once you're standing in front of the flower decoration and the dining table is on your right then you're done.

100748.instruction: You're standing in front of a table take a step over the table towards the doorway on the left and walk out the doorway. Take a right towards the stairs going up. Turn right again and enter the room you just left and walk towards the white pillar at the end and you're done.

100838.instruction: You are on the stairs facing towards the wall, turn left, move forward towards the window, turn around you can find stairs towards up, climb up the stairs, move little forward, there is a statue at the left side, turn right, you can find an entrance with an open door, enter into it, at the entrance of the room you can find your destination.

100839.instruction: You are standing on the stairs, slightly turn left and climb up the stairs, climb up the stairs completely, after climbing the stairs completely turn right and go one step forward passing through the entrance, here just beside an opened brown door you have reached the destination.

100945.instruction: You begin looking at a tan couch just in front of you. Turn a little bitty bit to the left and move in front of the left armrest of that couch. From there turn left, you should see some open double wooden doors. Step into the threshold of those double wooden doors, and then into the entryway on the right with the wooden border. From there, turn right, you should see a grill, but you're going further right than that, into the next entryway with the microwave and mi- or, microwave and the toaster oven. Continue past the microwave and toaster oven, and through the arched doorway in front of you, and then turn right immediately, moving through the arched entryway, and to the area between the bar stools and the tan couch that you began in front of. Step through that gap between couch and bar stools, and then further through the arched way- or, arched entryway in front of you. The narrow one with the picture to the left of it. As soon as you are through that, next to the circular table with chairs all around it, and the tea set on the right on the kinda greenish consul table with the picture of flowers over it, you are done.

100971.instruction: You begin facing a red carpet, in a red room with red chairs, turn around and you will see a doorway, just take one step into that doorway, once you're standing right between the open doors, you are done.

101022.instruction: You're inside of a massage. Exit the massage room, and in front of you is a door into a pool area. Before you go through the door, take those two steps down and stop. To your left is a small plant and a fire extinguisher. You're done.

101029.instruction: You begin facing a mirror, looking to the archway that's to the left of the mirror, take 4 steps going straight down, keep going towards the open door, once you're in the doorway, you will see a closet, take one step to go into the closet and you're done.

101044.instruction: Right now, you're facing towards the cupboard, slightly turn left and move forward. Now, slightly turn left and move forward, where you will be standing in between the couch and the sink platform. Continue to move forward until you reach an passage on the right. Now, turn right and move forward. Now, turn left and enter into the room, and stand in front of the sink and that is the end point.

101045.instruction: You're facing towards the frame, now slightly turn to you left, and move forward, walk between the sofa and white platform, you can see an open arch, pass through the open arch and in front you can see an another open arch, at your right you can see another open arch and a photo frame, move forward and at your left, you can see an open door, go inside and stop.

101114.instruction: You find yourself at the last step of the staircase while facing the wall and closed the door in front of you. Turn right and head towards the closed door and take an immediate right towards the vase which is present in the narrow walking zone. Enter the narrow walking zone and take a slight right towards the open entrance and go forward near the portrait which is hanging on the wall and take an immediate right which leads you into a bedroom through the open door. Head straight towards the plant in front of you and stop, now you are facing towards the wall which has a window and plant in front of you. This is your final point.

101115.instruction: You are standing on the last step of the stairs, and facing towards the wall, turn slight right, move towards the wall. Turn to your right, walk straight towards the big wooden vase. Turn to your right, move forward. You are standing at the open entrance, move forward. Turn to your right, you can see an open, move towards it. You are standing in front of the open door, move towards the plant opposite to you. You are standing in front of the plant, which is your final destination.

101240.instruction: You're facing a corner of a bathroom turn around and take a step outside and turn right and go towards the bedroom in front of you and turn around again and take a step towards the mirror and turn around again and take a step towards the doorway closest to you on the right and take one step in this closet and you're done.

101277.instruction: Our starting point is in a patio, on your right there's a white table with four chairs, on your left there's a brick wall, and in front of you there are glass doors. 101278.instruction: You're in a living room, look left you'll have a couch on your left head forward keeping the couch on your left. Head forward stand in front of the pastoral painting. Head forward again into the next room that is straight ahead of you. There will be fridges on your right and another island in front of you. Turn left you'll see a large wooden door. Head to the door, turn left, its a bathroom. Turn right you'll see a workout room, enter the workout room and stop when you are next to the rowing machine and the bicep curl.

101395.instruction: You're standing in the passage, facing towards the window and the open entrance. Turn behind and walk into the open entrance. Turn right and walk into the open arch.
