Walk through the passage. Walk into the third open wooden arch which is onto your right. Walk forward towards the couch. Walk into the open door, which has a billiards table. Now walk forward towards the round table onto your left. Stand behind the round table at the corner. This would be your end point.

101396.instruction: Okay right now you are facing towards the wall. Now turn around, you see an open door in front of you with round table. Enter the room and turn to your right and you see arch way in front of you. Enter into that arch way. Turn slightly right again and walk towards the carpet in front of you. Now you are in front of a glass window to your right side. Turn slightly left and you another glass window in front of you. Go and stand in front of it. That is the end point.

101424.instruction: We are looking at a wall. Turn to your left. Taking one step into the hallway. Now turn where you are facing into a bedroom with a yellow and white comforter. Take a step to the foot of the bed. Take one more step in the direction of the window. Now turn and turn and take a step into the closet. You have reached your stopping point.

101448.instruction: Now, you are facing towards the wall and a wash basin in front of it. Turn to your right where you can find an open brown door. Pass through it and move towards your left crossing the gym equipment's and that will be your end point where you are facing the wall and a window in front of you.

101449.instruction: You're facing to a wall, turn right. Walk out of the room. Continue towards the window in front of you. Stop in between the pulley machine and hammer strength machine. It is your destination.

101461.instruction: You will start by facing a wooden dining table with a vase with white flowers on it.You will then turn to the left and the enter the room.You are there when you are standing next to the white next to the grey chair with grey and yellow blanket on it and looking outside to the patio area.

101507.instruction: "Look around you can find a door over there, walk towards the door you can find a ladder near by, go near the ladder.Turn towards your left then you can find stairs over there get down from those stairs. Quiet opposite to the sofa another sofa is presented go near it.

101508.instruction: You are facing towards the closed door turn left you can find a bed at the right, walk straight and exit the room, move little forward and take left, and walk straight you can find stairs towards down, walk down the stairs, turn right and walk down the stairs completely, you can find two rooms in front, enter into the room at the right where you can find sofa, enter into the room you can find a statue of a man on the table at the left side, from there take right you can find another sofa go towards it you can find your destination at the corner of the sofa near the entrance.

101570.instruction: You are facing towards the wooden and glass doors, turn right and move towards the staircase, turn left and move towards the sofa, now turn slight left and move towards the billiards table. 101571.instruction: This is the starting point and you're facing the doors. Turn Right. Walk towards the stairs. Turn left. Walk towards the arm chair. Turn slightly left and walk towards the pillar in front of you. You're standing near the pillar facing the snooker table. This is the end point.

101612.instruction: Okay. You're starting in a living area and a kitchen area. You're looking at a partial wall. You're going to go down the hallway- not all the way. So, you're going to pass the kitchen island, as well as the counter next to the stove with the phone on it, and that archway there, will have a room immediately to your right that you're going to walk into. This is a dining room. You'll see the long dining table. There will be a couple French doors at the far side of the room. You're going to go ahead and walk to the left of the table. Not on the rug, but as close as you can get, and this will be your ending point.

101918.instruction: You're facing towards a closed door. Turn around and enter the bed room. Turn right, you can see the entrance of a room. Walk towards the shelves and stand here is your destination.

102136.instruction: You are facing towards the door, turn to your left turn walk ahead, Then again turn to your right side. 102140.instruction: You begin looking out a window, kind of... More towards the wall just to the left of the window but beggars can't be choosers. Turn completely around and move towards the opening between the two pillars. You will see a stuffed gazelle head staring at you accusingly. Probably wondering why you came back here to this dirty, dirty house. Continue moving forward past the horrifying fireplace to the right with the statuesque depictions of what look like torsos being crushed under the immense weight of the golden top of the thing... I-I don't know, that fireplace is just weird, indescribably weird. Also the reliquary right next to it looks like it was stolen from a church or something, and there's another gazelle head just glaring at you... Why do they have these heads, just mounted on the floor? Who would do that? Why would you do that? Continue to the left side of the burgundy couch. Just stuff yourself on in there, right next to the radiator, as though you're sniffing it. Just sniff the radiator, in that corner. There's also a- a fire extinguisher there, which is good, I guess. So once you're nose-first in the radiator with a little fire extinguisher next to you, you are done. Also there's a portrait of a horse to the left that is looking at you judgmentally.

Slightly turn right and walk through the open door. Now you are standing in the gym room. That will be the end point.

102159.instruction: You are facing towards the wall, turn slightly left and move forward. You are now facing towards the kitchen area. 102161.instruction: You will start by facing a statue. Turn around. Take a step towards the maroon couch. Now turn left and you will see a doorway. Exit this room. 102205.instruction: You are facing the bed, turn around, walk straight. Pass through the rug which is on the floor. You have three rooms in the front. Walk towards the room which is in the centre. 102206.instruction: Now you are facing towards the bed, turn around and move forward through the open entrance and walk into the carpet, now take slightly right turn and stand at the entrance of the toilet is your final destination.

102242.instruction: You will start by standing in the bedroom turn left. Jump over the armchair towards the fireplace. On the left side of the fireplace there's an opening. Continue to step forward and stand in front of the window and you're done.

102270.instruction: You're starting at the base of a staircase, turn around and take a step onto the blue runner rug. Turn right and then go down the stairs. There's a bright light shining through it. This looks like a dining room. Take a step toward the door. Turn left and then take a step to the cardboard box that says "Large." You are done.

102283.instruction: "Okay now, you are facing towards the two red colour chairs. Turn left, and move forward, you can see the portraits hanging in front of you. 102284.instruction: Right now you are facing towards a corner of a door, slightly turn left and move forward towards the portraits and slightly turn right and walk straightly and enter into an open door in front of you and this is your final point where you have a red table with two chairs on your left.

102314.instruction: From your starting point turn back and move forward back of the white sofa, then move in a forward direction towards the dining table. Then turn right through the glass door and enter the room near to the sofa will be your final point.

102315.instruction: You are facing towards a window, turn around and move forward between the couch and the glass door. Turn slightly left and walk towards the white table. 102385.instruction: You will start by facing a stone wall. Turn left stand in between the counter and the stove. Continue to walk towards the two chairs in front of you. You should now be facing the window and behind you is the dining table and you're done.

102506.instruction: Facing the breakfast table, walk around to the right of the table. You should see two open french doors on the right. Take a step outside just on to the mat at the door. 102529.instruction: You are facing towards the cupboards, turn right and exit the room, turn left and move a bit forward, now you are facing towards the wall, turn left and move towards the opened door which is infront of you, to the right, you can find a bed, you can find two opened doors infront of you, enter into the room which is on your left, now you are at the entrance of the room, that would be your end point.

102563.instruction: Okay now you are in a room facing towards small white statue. Turn to your left and move forward in between the dining table on the left and the furnace on the right side. 102564.instruction: You are standing near the table and make around go straight and make a slight left turn. Where you can see two open doors on your left and right side. 102600.instruction: Okay, now you are facing towards the wall of the narrow walk zone. 102601.instruction: You are facing towards the wall. Turn right and enter inside the room. Walk a few steps ahead and turn right. Walk straight and stand on the carpet beside the brown cabinet. You have reached your point.

102686.instruction: Behind the statue go straight then turn right side.Go up stairs and come to the another floor and enter the room in front of window and beside the dressing table.

106716.instruction: Our starting point is in a spa... It appears to be a spa, and we're facing towards a doorway, turn towards the left... On your right there are chairs and some cabinets, and on the left there's an exit way, walk towards it and exit towards a room... It is actually a bathroom, you're now facing a beige wall, turn towards the left and you'll come across a sauna, walk into the sauna, and walk into the heater, and stand in front of the heater, and that's your destination.

106746.instruction: We are in a living room, facing the armchairs. Let's slightly turn to our left and go straight. We're getting close to the painting on the right hand side of the glass door to the outside. On our right, there should be 2 clay pots, and we're going to enter the arching hallway on the right. There should be four art pieces on our right hanging on the wall, and one painting, one thermostat on the left, We can just stop here.

106755.instruction: You are in a reading room, turn towards your right and keep moving forward. Walk beside the table, on your right side and move forward. Now, turn towards your right again and keep moving forward. In front, you can find a green door. Go near that green color door and turn towards your slight left. Go pass through that door and you will enter into your corridor. Turn towards your slight left again and move forward. On you right, you can find an other door, go pass through that door and you will enter into your washroom. Move forward and sand beside a washbasin. You reached your destination.

106756.instruction: You are facing towards the wall which has a portrait attached to it. Slightly turn right and move forward. There is a glass window on your left side. Turn right and move towards the open door. Slightly turn left and exit the room by passing through the open door. Now you are facing towards the staircase. Turn left and walk straightly till you find an open door in front of you. There is an another open door on your right side. Turn right and enter into the room by passing through the open door. Now you are in the washroom facing towards the glass window and the commode. That will be the end point.

106766.instruction: You are facing towards the wall, turn around. move forward and cross the door, now turn right and enter the washroom. This is your end point.

106767.instruction: You are facing towards an open door. Turn around and slightly turn right and walk through the closed door. Now you are facing towards the pillar. Turn right and enter into the open room. Now you are in the washroom facing towards the wall. There is a commode on your right side. That will be the end point.

106810.instruction: Your standing in corridor facing towards a close door, now turn back. You an see an entrance, walk through entrance and enter into the living room. in-front of you you can see a glass table, slightly turn to your right walk to the close door, now slightly turn to your right, you can see a open door, walk to the open door and exit the room. in-front of you you can see another open door, walk to the door and enter into the dinning hall. Now turn to your right you can see another entrance, walk to the entrance, you can see a platform with a sink on your left and you can see a platform on your right, walk between two platforms, in-front of you you can see a microwave oven, walk near to the microwave oven. Stand near to the microwave oven, that's your end point.

106811.instruction: Right now your standing near the closed door. Turn around and go straight in between the arch there you will find a lamp from the lamp make a slight right turn near to the closed door and again make a slight right turn on your right side you can see a large table and chair. You can find a open door. Just walk in between the corridor. While walking you can see another open door just step into the room and make a slight right turn to the arch. Go straight in between the sink platform and kitchen platform. Here we reached our destination in front of the microwave.

106814.instruction: You're now facing the washbasin. Turn left and walk inside the room and walk towards the stairs. Climb up the stairs completely and take left. Now walk towards the sofa set on your left side and turn around. Now move forward, stand near the wooden pillar facing the door. You will reach your destination.

106815.instruction: You are at the entrance of a washroom, turn left and walk towards the staircase, climb the stairs, slightly turn left and walk towards the living room, turn around and take a step ahead, you are now facing towards a glass window with the staircase on your right. You have reached your destination.

106824.instruction: Look around, you're currently in a bathroom. Take one step forward into the hallway. Turn around, and face right. Take one step forward into the pink bedroom, until you're right in front of that white shell on the floor. Turn around, and face left. Take one step forward into the living room. In this living room, you see a large red rug, and two sofas on each side. Hop over all the way to the front of the black statue at the end of this room. Once you're standing in front of this black Greek statue, turn around and face left and take a step forward onto the brown doorway, and now you see the hallway. Right in front of you, is two rugs. Take a step forward so you're at the front of the downward stairs. Take a step down the brown stairs, once you're midway down the brown stairs, you're done.

106842.instruction: Were facing a sauna wall with to clocks on it. Turn around and exit the sauna. Take a right into the first door with the blue beads. This lead into a a pool room. Walk straight with the pool on your right toward the white stairs on your left. When you get to the stairs go up. Then take the next three stairs up ahead of you. You are going to go to the room that is directly ahead of you. As you walk into it you will see a white massage table.  When you are inside the room, walk to the left end of the massage table and in front of the brown chest. Turn around. We are going to exit this room and go into the first room our left. You are going to stay in the threshold. If you look ahead of you there are pink walls and stairs.  You are done.

106848.instruction: You're facing towards a white curtain in front of you, walk a few steps forward, you can see a open door in front of you, walk through the door you can find a narrow passage, walk through the passage, go straight now turn to your right where you can see few chairs in front of you, and now towards your right you can see an oven walk few steps forward and from the re-frigerator turn to your right, you can find an open entrance walk through the entrance, and take right now you can see a table on which a plant and a hat is there and beside that table is your final destination.

106849.instruction: Right now you're facing towards an open door, move towards the door and exit the room. There is a walkway in front of you, move forward in the walkway, until you reach chairs to your right. Now turn right, there are two platforms to your left and a fridge to your right, move forward towards the fridge and cross the fridge. Right now you are facing towards a grill door. Now turn right, there is an open entrance in front of you, move towards the entrance and enter in to the room. Now turn right, there is a walkway in front of you and a portrait on the wall to your left and three portraits on the wall to your right and a table in the walkway, move forward and stand in front of the table and it will be your end point.

106855.instruction: You are facing towards the wooden table and the orange chairs. Slightly turn left and move towards the wall which has two paintings attached to it. Turn right and move towards the open door. Slightly turn left and exit the room by passing through the open door. Now you are standing in front of a potted plant. Turn left and move towards the chair. Slightly turn right and move towards the carpet. Turn right and move towards the dining table. Slightly turn right and walk straightly till you find an open room in front of you. Enter into the open room. Now you are in the kitchen. Now walk straightly till you find a washbasin in front of you. Now you are standing in front of the washbasin facing towards the glass windows. That will be the end point.

106856.instruction: You're facing the red chairs, turn slightly towards your left, go near the plant pot, and turn right, exit the room, and turn left, again you'll find plant pot at the corner, then turn left, go straight, you'll enter the living room, near the white carpet, turn right, to the left, you'll find white chairs, and glass table, go straight along the wall, you'll enter the kitchen, go straight, at the end you'll find wash basin to the left, stop in front of the wash basin, which is your final destination.

106875.instruction: As you're facing the couch in the living room, head towards the couch. You'll see a black chair directly ahead. Head towards the black chair and make the 1st left. When you get to the marble floor, veer to your right into the next opening. You'll find an open room with two double doors, there will be a black mat on the floor. Looks to be a gym. This is your destination.

106876.instruction: Okay right now you are facing towards the glass window near a statue. Turn around and you see a sofa in front of you. Walk straight. Now turn to your left and you see one open door. Exit this room and turn slightly left and you see stairs in front of you. Go towards the stairs. Now you see a open room in front of you. Enter that room. Once you enter the room, turn to your left and walk straight towards the cross symbol to the left side with two statues and stop. That is the end point.

106877.instruction: You are facing towards the window, turn back and move towards the carpet, turn left and move towards the open door, turn slight left and move towards the stairs, again move forward towards the carpet, turn slight left and move towards the statue which is placed in front of the window, this is your end point.

106896.instruction: You will start by standing in the bathroom. Turn right and exit this room. Here you will see a workout area. In front of you there is a large opening. Jump over these workout machines towards the opening. Now you are facing the living area. Take one step behind the white arm chair on your right. Now jump over the armchair and stand in front of the fireplace. Once you're slightly in front of the fireplace then you are done.

107086.instruction: You are facing towards a glass door and standing at the entrance of a bathroom, turn slightly right and move forward into the open entrance which is right in front of you, move forward, there are some portraits on the wall on your left side, take a slight right and move forward. Turn slightly right and you can see stairs on your right side and there is an open entrance right in front of you, pass through it and move forward. Turn to your left and move forward beside the kitchen counter. Move forward towards the white cabinets and the oven. Turn slightly left and enter the open entrance on your left side. You can see a dining table with white coloured chairs. Turn slightly right and walk towards the glass window. Turn slightly left and move forward. You are now standing at a point where you have a white coloured chair on your left and there is a wall on your right side and this is your end point.

107087.instruction: Go straight and enter inside the open door, and take right from the railing, you will be finding one more open door, enter inside and take left, you can see a table with five stools, walk through the table, you will be finding one more open door, come out of the room, you can see a glass dining table with white colour chairs, cross the dining table and stand near the glass window and beside the white chair.

107093.instruction: You are at the door facing slightly right towards the cupboard, take a slight left and enter into the living room, from there take a slight left turn and go straight to the table near the sculpture, from there take left turn and go straight to the door, and in the front you can see a staircase, go straight to the downstairs and go downstairs, from the take a right turn and go straight to the wall. This is the endpoint.

107094.instruction: Now you are facing towards an open door. Turn slightly left. Move forward and enter into the open door. Turn left. Move forward to the brown table with a sculpture on it. Turn left. You will see an open door. Go towards the open door. Move forward. You will see the steps, get down the steps. Move forward to the open door. Turn right. Move forward to the wall. You have reached your destination.

107124.instruction: Now are on the floor mat. On the left you can see the arch move towards the arch, turn to your left and move forward by passing the stairs on your left and on the left there is a entrance move towards it and on the right there is a open door, enter into the room, move towards the table with chairs and on the left you can see the black board move towards it and you can stop.

107125.instruction: You are facing towards the table, turn slightly left and move forward. Turn slightly right and move forward, wherein you are facing towards the kitchen. Turn left and walk straight towards the metal railings. Turn slightly left and move forward, wherein you are facing towards the wall and there are some wall hangings to your right, and metal railings to your left. Move forward, turn slightly right and enter into the open glass door. Move forward, you are now facing towards the glass table and the window. Turn slightly left and stop facing towards the blackboard, and this is your endpoint.

107204.instruction: You are facing the couch, slightly turn right and walk straight by passing through the teapoy. You are facing a wall which has a portrait on it and in the left you have the couch and lamp. This is the end point.

107205.instruction: You are facing towards the vase which is placed on the table, turn slight right and move towards the window which is near the lamp stand, this is your end point.

107238.instruction: You're currently standing at the end of a hallway. Take two steps forward in front of you. Turn around, and face left. Take one step forward to the entrance of this living room. Once you're at the entrance to this living room, and you see a pattern rug, a fireplace and a purple sofa, you're done.

107288.instruction: You are facing towards a white door, slightly turn right, step out of the room through the door, turn left you can see an open entrance, step into it, turn left, get down the stairs till you reach towards an open door, step into it, take a step ahead, turn right and step into the room through the open door. You have reached your destination.

107289.instruction: Right now you are facing towards a door, slightly turn right and exit the room and turn left and enter into an open door in front of you and turn left, you have a stairs, get down the stairs and enter into an open door in front of you and turn right and enter into the shower room and this is your final point.

107296.instruction: You are in a room, Right to you there will be a white lamp, Turn right and come out of the room, You will see some sofa's opposite to you, And take left, And cross the table with two lamps, You will reach near the sofa, And cross the sofa, And go near the single chair with small table, Cross the small sofa aswell, After crossing you will see one more small chair, and turn left you will see steps, Climb up all the steps, After climbing, Turn left and come near a small table and a chair, You can see chess board on the table as well, So, Stand infront of it, Finally, You reached your destination.

107297.instruction: Slightly turn right and go straight there is a sofa left side, turn left and go straight, you will find a table with a sofa, go straight you will find a staircase at the left side reach the top of the staircase, there is a room after reaching top of the staircase with chairs, turn left and go straight you will find your destination between two tables.

107326.instruction: You're standing to the left of a pool table turn around and take a step towards the coffee table in the sitting area. And step over the coffee table and then turn left and you'll see a brown desk step towards it. And you'll see an open wooden door go through it and go up the stairs. All the way to the top. And turn left and you'll see a desk on a rug take a step towards it. Once you're standing at the rug you'll see a table with a chessboard on it and you're done.

107340.instruction: You begin in a fancy room with a red carpet under you and velvet ropes on either side. Go ahead and follow the red carpet, through the doors in front of you, and around the corner. Continue through the next set of doors, and keep going forward following the red carpet, through one last set of doors. You should enter a room with some urns and other pottery on the left, and a table and drapes prominently on the right, and a big ol' chandelier up top. Once you're in that room you are done. All you need to do is go through that third doorway.

107345.instruction: You're facing to the wall. Turn slight right, walk out of the room. Turn right, walk straight towards the opposite wall. Turn left, walk straight in the passage. There is the living area on your right and you have the kitchen area on your left. On your left there is a wall with four photographs and a white colored drawer table, walk towards the table. Turn left, you can see a door on your right, walk to it. Turn right, walk into the room. You can see the sliding door in front of you, walk towards the door. It is your destination.

107346.instruction: You are facing towards a wall, turn right, step out of the washroom, turn right, walk towards the wall, turn left, walk straight in the narrow path till you reach towards a kitchen counter top, slightly turn left, walk towards the four portraits on the wall, turn left, walk towards the white wall, slightly turn right, step into the room through the open glass door and walk towards the closed glass door. You are now facing towards a closed glass door with two portraits on your right, you have reached your destination.

107449.instruction: You will start by facing a bunch of picture frames. Slightly to the left there's an opening. Walk towards this opening and once you're facing a doorway in front of you take a step on the left side where you can see the foot of the stairs. Now you're facing the stairs walk down the staircase on the left. it will lead you to the outside area. Continue to walk out. Once you are on the doorway and facing a bunch of plants then you're done.

107505.instruction: You begin in a green room staring into a corner with a radiator, a lamp, and a rather creepy statue. Do not stare too long into the statues, instead turn completely around and head towards the furnishing with two lamps on top of it, and a portrait hung above it. Turn right, once you reach this furnishing and move through the open door. Unfortunately, moving through that door has taken you into the room across the hall. Absolutely festooned in hunting trophies that make the mantelpiece look like an abomination formed from somebody's nightmares. Look away from the... Creepy fireplace, and the... Animal head that lay across the floor, back towards the hallway that you just crossed. You should see, out of the corner of your eye, some stairs, to the left of the door that you are now looking back through. Move up those stairs. Once you have got most of the way up the first flight of stairs, you're done.

107528.instruction: We're facing towards an empty shelf, turn around... We're now facing towards a bedroom, walk towards the bed that's in front of you, the bed is covered by a yellow and white sheet, and once you're in front of the bed and once you're right on the foot of it, you have reached your destination.

107634.instruction: We are facing a statue on a desk. Turn all the way around so that we are facing out of the room. Go out of the room and ahead of you will be some stairs. Go up the stairs. When you get to the first landing by the window, you want to go up, only taking five steps forward. You are done.

107643.instruction: You're facing towards the window, now turn to you left, you can see an open door, exit the room. You can see an another open door, go inside pass through the dining table, pass the sofas and stop near the round table and two chairs.

107644.instruction: Okay right now you are facing towards the glass window. Turn to your left and walk straight. You see a glass door open to your right side. Exit the house through that door and walk into the open room in front of you and go near the sofa. Go straight and stand near the round table, near the fire furnace. That is the end point.

107677.instruction: pass from the dinning room straight toward the pillar, take right from the pillar, beside the fridge you can see the stares, go straight along the stares, climb the stares and follow the path and go straight, turn around  so you can see the stares and clime the stares, follow the path of the stares, continue with the stare case, turn around and climb the stares again, go the front of the door which is opposite to the stares, and get inside the door, you can see the room with bed inside it, and beside the bed there is a window, go near to the window, and your destinations is arrived.

107678.instruction: We just entered into the living room walk forward to the stairs and go straight near the stairs and again go straight near the stairs and again go straight near the stairs and turn right to the stairs and again turn left to the stairs then go straight to the stairs and just we entered into the another room with two chairs and go straight near the bed.Here we done.

107738.instruction: You are facing towards the wall which has a photo frame mounted to it. Slightly turn left and walk through the open arch. Now walk straightly in the passage till you find a closed wooden door in front of you. Turn left and move towards the open wooden door. That will be the end point.

107739.instruction: Right now you are facing towards a portrait on a wall. Make a slight left turn and move until where you can see a open door in front of you step out the room from the open door and make a slight left turn in front you can see a door stand near the door. Here we reached our destination.

107761.instruction: Move forward and take left to enter into another room, and end after entering into the room.

107762.instruction: Right now you are facing towards a black table, slightly turn left. Move forward straightly until you find an open door on your left and this is your final point where you have a door on your right

107769.instruction: You begin looking at an open wooden door with glass panes. Turn to your left, and move along the right edge of the rug towards the fireplace, and then past the fireplace. You should have a standing mirror on your left, leaning against the wall, and an open door on your right. Rather, an open archway with an open door down it. Move all the way through the open door, and then take a slight right to move onto the rug with the spiral-cut shrubbery on the other side of it. Step to the left of that spiral-cut shrubbery and onto the small circular rug at the top of the spiral stairs. From there, move down the spiral stairs. All the way down them curvy long boys. And once you hit the circular atrium with many doorways connected to it, turn left and take the first doorway on your left side. Inside that doorway you should see a stately wooden room with what looks like a billiards table far, far away. Step forward into the living room that's nearer to you, though, and look slightly to the right. You should see a very fancy brown armchair before the pool room. Go ahead and step behind that fancy armchair. Once you are behind the fancy armchair, and next to the sliding glass door, able to look into the pool room. You're done.

107824.instruction: You are facing towards the cloths. Take a right turn. Now come out of the room. Now take an immediate right turn and walk towards the cupboard. Take a right turn and walk towards the wall. Now take a right turn, walk straight till you see a right side open way. Take a right turn and walk straight till the rack. From rack, take a right turn and enter into the bedroom. Now take a slight left turn and walk towards the bed. Now take a slight left turn and walk towards the exit. Now take a left turn and walk straight towards the wash basin, which is your end point.

107825.instruction: You're facing towards the cloth shelves. Turn right and exit the room. Turn left and walk towards the wall in front you can see two photo frames from there turn right you can see a narrow path walk all the way. On the left side you can see the violin from there turn right and walk straight in front you can see the wooden glass cupboard which has all kinds of dolls from there turn right and move towards the bedroom. From there turn left beside the chair you have another entrance. Walk through it. In front, you can see the mirror and blue mat on the floor walk towards it and stand on the mat. Here is your destination.

107833.instruction: You are standing near an old style sink, turn left and walk towards the back of the chair in front of you and reaching the beige and the glass cabinet in the front, once you are standing near the cabinet which has all the crockery and the pictures on it, turn left and now walk towards the open door next to the crockery shelf and the oven. once you are at the door turn right and exit through the open door in front of you now. As you exit you should see straight ahead their are stairs going up , so go upstairs, once you are near the door which has or glass turn left and carry on with the stairs. Now you should be standing on an old style wood floor beside the stairs. But you should carry straight ahead on the rug in front of you reaching the heater on the floor and the console table on left with the ape figure on it and the door in front of you which is beige in color, once you are at the door , you are done.

107929.instruction: You are now facing the white color marble, from there slightly take a right turn. Walk a few steps forward and stand in front of the way which is to your right side, take a right turn. Walk straight and stand in front of the room, take a left turn, start walking straight and stand in front of the staircases which are to your left side. Take a left turn, start going up the stairs and stand in front of the room which is in front of you. Enter into the room. stand at the entrance, walk straight towards your right side and stand in front of the wall beside the bed, you will find your destination point.

107930.instruction: You are facing towards the spa marble bed, turn slight right, move forward, turn to your right, exit the room. Turn to your left, move forward towards the steps on your left side, passing through the two chairs on your left side. Move forward turn to your left, climb the steps, and walk through the open door. Now you can see few steps opposite to you, move towards it, climb the steps, and move forward. Turn slight right, you can see an entrance opposite to you, move towards the entrance. Enter the room, move towards the bed, now cross the bed, and move forward. You are facing towards the wall, and there is a bed right behind you, which is your final destination.

108096.instruction: We are going to start by being in a room that has a bench and two frames in front of us. We are going to look slightly to the right and proceed to walk to the right side of the door that we see, and this will be your destination.

108163.instruction: Begin facing a pair of garden sheers. Turn right and head to the radiator. Make another right and head out the open door into the hall. Take a left in front of the laundry room and head to the jesus statue. Head right to the end of the pantry and you're done

108175.instruction: You begin facing a dining room, turn around and you will see a staircase, go up the stairs, turn to your left and go up the second set of stairs, in front of you, there is a hallway, go down this hallway, all the way down to the closed double doors, once you're standing right in front of the closed double doors, you are done.

108209.instruction: You are in a closet. Turn to the left and exit toward the foot of the bed. Turn right and exit through the door. Head right in the hallway into another bedroom. Enter the threshold of this new bedroom and stop.

108301.instruction: You are facing towards the wall, turn right and walk straight towards the door in front, and take left you can find a white mat, go near to it and take left where you can find a small room with a rack, enter into it, at the entrance you will find your destination.

108302.instruction: Now, you are facing towards the wall. Move towards your right where you can find an open entrance. Enter through it and move towards an open door which is on right side. Now, turn around and move forward towards right through the white carpet. Now, take left where you can see an open door which is a small empty room. Enter through it and that will be your end point in the point where you step into the room and you can see shelves in front of you.

108333.instruction: You will begin facing a towel and a mirror, turn to your right, you will see a bedroom, with a bed with blue sheets, and a green blanket, take a step towards the bed and turn to the right, you will see that there is an open door and outside of the open door, there is a staircase with a railing, take a step outside of the open door towards the railing, turn to your right, you will see that before the staircase, there is a room immediate to your right, take a step towards that room, take one more step to go in the room, you will see that this room has a white bed, with a fluffy pillow, this room also has a white, fluffy carpet and a very cute little puppy, take a step towards the puppy, now turn to your right, you will see that there is a room which looks like a closet, take one step to go into this room, and to your right, just before the closet, to your right, there will be a bathroom, take one step into the bathroom, you should now be standing in the doorway, with the sink and mirror in front of you, you are done.

108346.instruction: For your start point you will be in a large  open concept room that has a living room area to your right and a dinning area to your left. You will also see four archways you will need to move forward through the second archway to your right. You will now be in a hall turn left pass the four glass double doors until you reach an archway that leads into a kitchen. Move through the archway turning left staying in-between the the kitchen island to your right and the gas stove oven to your left move t continue moving forward until you see a sink and faucet. Turn to right an move forward to the counter, cabinet in front of you. You will need to make a left turn through the archway that leads into the breakfast seating area. Move forward through the archway and you will see a circle breakfast table that's surrounded buy four chairs. Move to the right of that breakfast table and stay in-between the chair that would be on your left and the serving table that has the picture that would be to your right. You should be positioned behind the kitchen table chair and the serving table. Once you are between the chair and the serving table you have reached you end point.

108371.instruction: Starting off in the kitchen with the kitchen island to your left as well as some iron rod barstools beneath it, we're going to turn all the way around, about face, so that now the grey sectional is to your left and the red clock on the wall is before you, we are going to walk down this hallway towards the door on the far end. And as we walk we're going to pass a red clock on the right and a living room on the left, go ahead and keep moving forward. You should be coming across a console table and two pieces of art to your right and a black mirror to your left. Keep going until you stop on the entry mat to the house, and in front of the wooden and glass slated door.

108376.instruction: You begin, like, face first in a curtain. Turn to the right and move towards the right side of the double doors, that you can see leading into a porch. Turn right from there and jump over the pottery below the painting on the right side. Once you're over that pottery you should be at the head of some stairs to the right. Move down those stairs, passing the figurine of a wizard, and moving towards the mom-sized bottle of wine. Once you are at the giant wine, you're going to step past the wine cellar and into the garage. Go ahead into the garage and you're going to move towards the smaller recessed black garage door in the little nook area opposite of where you entered, kind of the far side corner from the black car that's in here, and once you are near the corner with the faucet. Like, the hose faucet, you're done.

108383.instruction: You're facing the wall, turn towards your left, you'll find brown chairs, and table, go till the end, exit the room, and go few steps forward, then turn left, again turn left, you'll find glass table, and cream chairs, from there turn right, go near the brown table, you'll find lamp on the table, go few steps forward, then turn left, again turn left, you'll enter the workout room, go few steps forward, to the left on the wall you'll find one frame, in front of the frame you'll find your destination.

You will see that there are red vases on either side of the doorway. Once you have done that continue forward through another archway you will enter into a bedroom. In front of you, you will see a silver colored arm chair you will need to move to the left of that arm chair and you will need to move between the second arm which will be to your left and the pink bench that is to the foot of the bed.  Move in between the two and make a slight right you will go through the archway that is ahead of you. So you will pass a bed and you will pass  two open doors to the left. Keep moving forward if you look to the left there will be an archway Just stand in front of that door and done. And that would lead into a bathroom.

116354.instruction: Now you are standing on the carpet, move forward from the middle of the sofas now take left and move out of the room and climb up the stairs completely, here you can see a women statue in front of you. Go straight from the open door, now you can see ladder on your right side, turn right and enter into the bedroom go straight and turn left from the bed, in front of the white colour lamp is you end point.

116355.instruction: Now we are in a room, go to left corner of the room, and move out of the room, take right there are stairs climb up the stairs, go straight and take right, go straight and take left, there is a bed, go near to the bed, on the right side of the bed, there is a lamp and we arrived the destination.

116379.instruction: Our starting point is in a wine room, we're facing towards a long wooden table with two candleholders, turn towards the right... Were now facing towards a wooden table with two stools, turn slightly to the right, on your left there are many wine bottles, walk pass the wine bottles, into the arch doorway that's in front of you, continue walking down towards the exit, pass the wine bottles on the right and the wooden table with the stools on the left, continue walking down, exit the wine room, n the left there's a staircase, and on the right there's a huge bottle with some painting on it, walk towards the staircase, walk towards the staircase, turn slightly to the right and walk up the staircase... You're on the top of the stairs, turn towards the left, on your right there's s tool with decorations on top, and walk towards the stool, turn towards the left, in front of you there's another set of the staircase, walk towards the staircase... We're now in a hallway... We're facing towards a brown chair and what appears to be a kitchen area, walk towards the right... We're facing towards a hallway, turn slightly to the right and enter the hallway that's in front of you, on the left there are pictures on the wall and on the right there's a painting and in front of you there's an arch doorway, walk towards the doorway, and that's your destination.

116436.instruction: Okay, now you are in a room with two chairs in front of you. Now turn left and exit the room through the open door, which is in front of you. Now you are standing at the entrance of the room, go straight towards the railing, which is in front of you. Now slightly turn to your left and in front of you there is a staircase, get down the stairs until you reach the second step from the bottom. Now slightly turn to your left and move a bit forward. Now turn left and in front of you there are is a narrow path, walk straight in the narrow path until you reach in front of few stairs and this is the end point.

116437.instruction: In between two chair,move forward and go down the stairs and come to the another floor.Turn right side in front of stairs.

116458.instruction: You are facing towards the closed door, slightly turn to your right and move towards the dining table which is infront of you, turn right and move towards the chair which is infront of you, move a bit forward, to the left you can find a portrait, turn right and move forward towards the opening, stand infront of the stove, that would be your end point.

116459.instruction: You are facing towards closed glass door, slightly turn right and go forward towards the dinning table, turn right and go forward towards the chair, go forward, turn right and go forward pass through the arch, go forward towards the stove, here just beside the stove you have reached the destination.

116484.instruction: We're facing towards an arch way, walk past it, and enter the bedroom that's in front of you... On the left there's a glass door and on the right there's a bed covered with a white sheet and on the foot of the bed there's a bench... Walk towards that bench... Walk past the carpet that's in front of you... Turn slightly to the left... On your right there's a window and next to the window there's a beige curtain... And in front of you there's an archway leading you to a hallway, walk past that hallway... On the left there are pictures and on the right there's one painting, and... That's your destination.

116496.instruction: You are standing on a pink runner rug.  You are going to turn and go thru the wood double doors closest to you and continue straight on the pink runner rug.  Continue on the runner.  And you are going to take it straight all the way down.  And once you enter some wood double doors you are going to stop right in  between that doorway on the pink rug.  You are done.

116546.instruction: We're going to start in a bedroom facing the bed. If you look towards the right of the room you should see an opened door leading to a hallway. Go towards that opened door. Then you should see the railing for the staircase. You're going to head towards the right side... like the right corner of it. Then you're going to walk down this little hallway. You should pass two doors an open bathroom to your left. Then you're make your way towards the left at the end of the hall. You're going to go straight and step into the empty room. There should be nothing in the room...... and if you see on you're right there should be a small rectangular window and then some sliding doors. This will be your finishing point inside of this empty room.

116569.instruction: You are facing some hieroglyphics on the wall. Turn left and take two steps up the stairs and go straight into the room that is the second door on your left. It is right before you get to the radiator in the hall. Go into the dinning room area and when you get to the table turn right and walk straight to the first window as if you are gong to be in the corner... actually you are just going to be on the carpet before the window. You are done.

116578.instruction: You begin looking over a small table with a checkers board on it, or chess board, whichever. Turn around, move towards the TV in the corner of this upstairs area, then turn right. Hard right, nearly completely around, and move down the stairs behind you. Once you're at the bottom of the stairs, well, three steps up from the bottom. Two or three. You're done.

116600.instruction: okay, you are facing a table, slightly turn right and walk straight. Walk towards the television. Turn around, you can see stairs in the front, get down through those stairs. Take a right turn and walk straight, pass through the living area. In the front you have a lamp, walk closer to it. Take a left turn from the pillar and move a step forward. Now to the right you have the railing, to the left you have a pillar and this is the end point.

116601.instruction: Moving further from the area on the upstairs. On the right you will find the TV and the carpet on which chair is placed on very left side there is a way from the stairs to the down and from that stairs,take right there is a living area from you need to again,walk a little then you find the dinning hall and on the left you will find some sofas and chairs on the carpet.

116658.instruction: You will start by standing in between two glass doors. In front of you there is a black and white decor on the wall. Walk towards that wall and on the right side of that, there is a washroom. Walk inside the washroom. Now you have to turn around and go back to where you were standing. Once you're there, in front of you you will see a hallway and staircase on the right side. Walk along the hallway towards the green plant and the wooden decor. On the left side there is a open doorway. Two glass doors. Walk inside the room and you will see that it is a study room. In front of you there is a green plant. Walk towards the green plant. It should be on your right. Turn around and walk towards the left side of the table. You should be standing in between the table and the cupboards on your left. This is where you stop.

116659.instruction: You begin facing a room with a red carpet, take one step forward and then take one last step into the threshold of the door that's to your right, once you're here, you're done.

116674.instruction: You are going to start facing a console table with mirror. Turn to the left, and we are going to be facing a bunch of archways but you are going to take the one that is right next to the bench, the one that has the potted plant. Take one step forward through that archway and you are going to take the first archway to the left. You should be now facing a living room area and a dining room area. Take one step towards the dining room table, and turn to the left. This time you are going to take one step towards the left of the console table that has the two glasses on top, and now, you should see a sliding door that is open that leads to a pool table. Take that opening to go outside. turn right and walk to the right of the pool table. Once you are in front of a couch in the corner and some red flowers, you are done.

116736.instruction: From the place your standing keep moving forward then turn slightly right and move forward. Then turn slightly left and move forward towards the chair, and again move forward then turn slightly right, and move forward towards the stair-case railing. Now turn slightly right and move forward now from the dining table keep moving forward towards the glass window which is in opposite to you. Stand in front of it this will be your final destination point.

116737.instruction: Now, you are beside the big window and a soccer table on your right side. Move forward and take right from the soccer table. Now, take a slight left and pass through the chair. Now, take right and pass through the chairs and sofa. Take right from here and pass through the door on your left side. Move forward and take right through the dining table. Pass through the dining table. Move forward and stand in front of the wash basin. That is your end point.

116766.instruction: Begin facing a dining room. Head through on the right side of the tale into the kitchen. In the kitchen head right down the length of the island. At the end turn into the door on your right.Head to the end of the hallway into the office in front of you. In the office head to the potted plant in the corner and you're done.

116821.instruction: Now your are in front of the white metal racks.Now turn left and come outside of the room.Now go straight and enter the room where you can see a white bed.Go near the bed and then turn left.Now you can see a door open and come outside of the room.Now go straight and take a left where you can see a room with a open white door.Now enter the room and stand in front of the bed which is your final destination.

116822.instruction: You are facing the white stands attached to the wall. Turn left and move straight towards the bed. Once you reach in front of the bed, take a left turn and exit the room. Now walk straightly till you find a room which has a open door to your left. Enter that room. Walk straightly and stand in front of the bed. That is the end point.

116866.instruction: You are facing towards the wall turn to your right, there is door open exit the door and take first left walk on the steps, on first left there is stair case walk till the middle of the steps at the curve, where you will get more steps, on the first step of the turning point is your end point

116867.instruction: Now you are in a kitchen, facing wall. Turn right. Go out of the room. Turn left. Go up the stairs. Turn slightly left. Go up the stairs. Stand on the stairs. You have reached your destination.

116868.instruction: Right now you are facing towards the switches on to your left. Turn slightly right and exit the room. Once you exit the room, turn to your right side and you see a narrow way. Walk through the narrow way then turn to your left and you see a open door in front of you. Enter into the room. Now you have bed to your right and curtains to your left and you see two rooms in front of you. One is to your right and one is to your left. Go straight into the room which is to the left in front of you. Walk near the door which is left side and stop near the door. You reached your destination.

116869.instruction: Right now we are standing in front of the sink facing towards the entrance of the bathroom exit the bathroom through the entrance, take right you can find an open arch enter into the open arch now turn left now you can find and open door enter into the open door it is the bedroom walk straight towards the two open doors in the front enter into the left open door at the entrance of the left open door is the end point.

116883.instruction: Okay, now you are standing at the arch shape open entrance facing towards the wooden wall, turn right and move forward. Now you are standing next to an arch shape open entrance, which is on the left side. Now turn left and go straight, and stand next to the flower vase, which is on the left side. Now slightly turn to your right and walk straight in the corridor until you reach the kitchen area on your left side. Now slightly turn to your left and move forward. Now you are standing next to the table, which is in the middle of the kitchen area. Now move forward and stand behind the couch. Now turn left and walk straight in between the couch, which is on the right side and the bar stools, which are on the left side until you reach in front of a narrow arch shape entrance. Now turn left and go straight through the open door, which is in front of you. Now in front of you there is an open entrance, walk straight through that open entrance. Now keep moving forward by passing the dining table, which is on the left side until you reach backside of the couch. Now slightly turn to your right and move forward. Now you are standing next to an open entrance, which is on the right side. Now keep moving forward and go straight towards the window, which is in front of you. Now you are facing towards the window and standing next to the fire place, which is on the left side and this is the end point.

116884.instruction: Right now you are standing in between the wooden arch. Turn around and take left. Now take a right from the white flower pot with roses. Go straight until you reach the kitchen area. Pass through the white carpet and take a left from the wash basin. There you can see the chairs and sofa with a fireplace on your sides. Pass through the chairs. Enter into the arch and take a left from the dining room. There you can find a door. Step out of that room through the door. Go straight and you can see another door which is entered into the dining room. Enter into that room through that door. Go straight passing through the dining table. There you can find a white sofa and a lamp. Pass through the white sofa and brown chair. Go straight and you will see a chair on your left in front of the fire place. Go straight and stop. That will be your end point beside the table with a flower vase.

116895.instruction: You're facing towards the washroom wall, turn around walk a few steps forward, and from the commode turn to your left, walk a few steps forward and exit the washroom. Go straight, and you can see an open white door in front of you, enter the door, now you're standing beside a bed, go straight and towards your left, you can see an open white door, exit the door and slightly turn to your right, you have an open entrance towards your left side, which leads you into a bedroom, you can see a white bed towards your left, go straight and facing towards the wall is your final destination.

116896.instruction: Okay, now you are in the washroom facing towards the wall, turn left and move forward. Now you are facing towards the washbasin, turn to your left and exit the washroom through the open door, which is in front of you. Now in front of you there is another open door, go straight and exit through that open door. Now you are in the bedroom with a bed in front of you. Now turn left and go straight towards the white door, which is in front of you. Now slightly turn to your left and exit the bedroom through the open entrance, which is in front of you. Now turn right and go straight, and enter the bedroom, which is in front of you. Now you are facing towards the bed, slightly turn to your right and go straight towards the wall. Now you are standing at the end of the bed, which is on the left side and this is the end point.

116926.instruction: You're facing towards the wooden book shelf, turn slight right and move one step forward, turn right you can see a open door walk through that open door, turn slight left and walk straight into the corridor till you reach at the end of the corridor with a window in front of you and a dresser behind it, turn left you can see a open arch walk through the open arch move one step forward on the right you can see an another arch, turn right and move forward you can see a glass door on you're right stand near the glass door and this will be your end point.

116927.instruction: Go straight from the place you are standing and turn right. You will find an open door. Now step out of the door and keep moving forward till you reach the window in front of you. Now turn left and keep moving forward. On the right side you will find narrow opening. Now slightly turn right and go straight near the chair. That will be your final destination.

116963.instruction: "Now you are facing towards the window, turn right and enter inside the wide entrance and towards your left, you can see portrait of person, go and stand in front of it that will be your final destination."

116964.instruction: You are facing towards a fire place in a room, slightly turn right and go forward towards the entrance, go forward towards the portrait on the wall, here just behind the brown wooden chair you have reached the destination.

116969.instruction: You are facing towards a wooden wall, turn back and move towards the opened door, move forward until you see a wash basin on your left and a shower area on your right, that would be your end point.

116970.instruction: You can find yourself facing towards the wall just beside the bed. Turn around and you can find a door just beside the bed. Walk near to the door and enter the washroom and walk near to the shower place. Now you are standing in between the sink and the shower place. This is the endpoint. You have reached the destination.

116991.instruction: You will start by standing at the foot of the bed. Turn left and exit the bedroom. Once you're facing an arched doorway turn left and take a step forward. Now turn right on this hallway. Take a step in front of the piano. Once the piano is on your right and the doors on your left then you're done.

117094.instruction: You begin looking towards a staircase. Go ahead two steps up that staircase and then turn right and move towards the corner, then towards the left side of the shuttered door down the hallway. Once you're there, turn right, you should see a living room with two couches and a coffee table between them. Move towards the near side of that coffee table, and then towards the far corner of the tan couch on the right. Once you are between the tan couch and the window, you are done.

117100.instruction: You begin facing a bedroom, take a step out the main door, take a step forward, towards the hallway that's in front of you and then turn to your right, and take a step into the hallway on you right, you should be standing between a hallway on your left and a bathroom on your right, you are done.

117138.instruction: Now, you are facing towards the fireplace. Turn around and move forward towards the bookshelves. Now, turn right and move towards the open door. Move forward towards the table on your left side and turn right from the table and move towards the open door entrance. Enter through that door and walk straight towards the window and that will be your end point where you are in front of the window.

117139.instruction: Okay, now you are in a room facing towards the wall, turn behind and move towards the second window, which is on the left side. Now turn right and move towards the brown door, which is in front of you. Now slightly turn left and exit the room. Now slightly turn right and in front of you there is a staircase, get down the stairs. Now you are standing on the first step from the top and facing towards the wall, turn behind and slightly turn right and enter the room, which is in front of you. Now slightly turn right and move a bit forward. Now you are standing next to the statue, which is on the left side. Now turn right and move towards the open door, which is on the right side. Now turn right and enter through that open door. Now go straight towards the window, which is in front of you and that is the end point.

117159.instruction: Okay, now you find yourself facing towards the wooden dining table. Turn around and head towards the sofa and take a slight left towards the pool table on your left and take a slight right to go towards the designer chair and head towards a book rack and stop. Now you are in between the pool table and the book rack. This is your final point.

117160.instruction: "Okay now, you are facing towards the table. Turn around, and move forward, you can see the sofa set in front of you. Now slightly turn left, and move forward, you can see the books in front of you, and there is a pool table on the left side. Now, you have reached your destination."

117165.instruction: You are facing a hallway and there is going to be a window to your right.  You are going to turn all the way around and you are going to move forward.  You are going to pass an open wood door on your right.  And then you are going to make a right.  You are going to move forward down this hallway and you are going to go thru the open arched door.  Once thru the open arched door you are going to make a left and you are going to take a step into this room on to the rug in front of you.  You are then going to turn right and you are going to move forward passing a fireplace on your left.  You are going to go thru some open double doors.  Then you are going to make a right.  You are going to see a grill in front of you.  And you are going to take one hop up so on the right of you is going to be an entrance into a room, in front of you is going to be a counter with part of the grill and there is going to be the wood cabinet and on the left of you is going to be a closed wood door and you are done.

117166.instruction: Right now you are facing towards a portrait which is hanged to a wall. Turn around in front you can see a open door. Just exit the room from the open door beside the lamp and move forward in front you can see a open door. Turn to you are right and move forward until where you can see a violin which is hanged to a wall in front of you. From there make a slight right turn and move forward. On you are left side you can see a open door. Turn to you are left and enter into the room. Right now you are facing towards a window. Turn to you are right and exit the room in front you can see a another open door. Just go and stand in front of a table. From the table move forward near to the chair. Turn to you are left in front you can see a closed door, go and stand near the closed door. Here we reached our destination.

117167.instruction: Okay right now you are facing a wall with the picture frames on it. Turn around, you can see an open door beside the table with a lamp. Walk straight towards the door. Then you see a door to your left which is open. Enter into the room to your left which is open. Now you are facing a window in that room. Turn around and enter into the room to your left which is having books, table and chair in that room. Once you enter into the room turn slightly right and go near the books cabinet to the right that is behind the chair. Once you reach behind the chair, you see a glass door in front of you. Walk straight towards the glass door. This is the end point.

117168.instruction: You are looking at a kitchen turn left no, turn right and step on the red carpet under the table and chair, then look on your right side their is a dining room, go towards the right side near the window and stand on the back of the head chair, between the two spiral planters, once you are their you are done.

117244.instruction: You'll start with a  mirror to your right. Looks like an open doorway to your left and far to your left is a  living room. Take a step towards that door and you're going to stop right before you step onto the rug.

117379.instruction: Starting in a dining room. There are two openings. One on the left looks like to a living room. There are some double doors to the right that are opened. Once you are at your third left you can see there is a washer and dryer in this room. Step into this room and you are done.

117383.instruction: Right now you are facing towards a table, slightly turn left and you have an open door in front of you. Exit the room through that door and enter into an open door in front of you and slightly turn left, move forward towards the couch and slightly turn right, you have a iron thing to the corner of the room. Move forward towards that which is beside the couch and this the final point where you have the window on your left.

117384.instruction: You are facing towards the dining table, slightly take left and move forward, you can find an open door, exit the room, and walk straight into the front room, slightly take left and move forward towards the red sofa, there is  a window beside it, move near to it, reach the corner of the room, you can find your destination at the corner of the room, beside the window.

117418.instruction: You are standing in a hall way, take a step towards the threshold of the washroom straight ahead, and then turn immediate right, take a step towards the right closets of the laundry room, you are done.

117440.instruction: Now you are facing towards the door, turn slightly left and move out of the door, now move straight towards the carpet and take little steps, here you can find a frame hanging on the wall on your left side and here you reach your final destination in the middle of the carpet.

117441.instruction: You are standing at the entrance of the bathroom, facing towards the door, turn left and exit the bathroom. Once you are in the middle of the rectangular rug, you're done.

117565.instruction: Turn right from the place you are standing and step out of the door. Now turn right and keep moving forward till you reach the kitchen area. 117566.instruction: Now you are in the laundry room. Turn right and walk straight through the door. Now take right and walk in between the walls. Now go and stand near to the dining table and in front of the entrance which is the endpoint.

117616.instruction: You are standing on the steps facing towards the wall. Slightly turn left and climb the steps. Slightly turn left and walk straight till you reach the arch in front of you. Walk a few steps ahead and stand in front of the fireplace. You have reached your point.

117617.instruction: You are facing towards the wall and you are at the center of the stairs, climb that stairs then go to your left side, walk through that path you will see pots walk straight. the you will see a door, enter into that room , and you will see bed room with white bed and mirror take left near the mirror and there are two chairs and a foot rester, go near to that foot rester

117622.instruction: You are facing towards a teapoy with a potted plant on it, turn right and move towards the opened door which is infront of you, now you are at the entrance of a room, move a bit forward, turn left and move towards the oven which is infront of you, turn left and move forward, where you can find a glass table with six chairs on your right, move a bit forward, where you can find a chair which is in white on your right and white cupboards on your left, that would be your end point.

117623.instruction: You're standing near the staircase. Turn right and walk forward towards the open door. Walk into the open door. Turn left and move forward towards the stove. Again turn left and walk into the open door. Walk forward and stand at the end of the dining table beside the white cupboard. This would be your end point.

117641.instruction: You're in the doorway of a bathroom, turn left and take a step towards the rug. Turn left again and take a step towards the table. And turn left and take a step into this small area. You'll be standing to the left of a door and to the right are some shelves and you're done.

117762.instruction: For your start point you will be in a living room, hop over the coffee table that is in front of you and turn to the right. Stand right at the end table or night table that has the dry looking plant and a lamp on it. Once you are there you are done.

117777.instruction: You are going to start facing a vase and a plate that says not enter in the corner. We are going to turn around. This is a bedroom. You should be facing the bed with the three large windows, and that's it.

117826.instruction: Right now you're facing towards a table which has few white towels on it, move towards the table. Now slightly turn right and you can see a entrance on the right side. Here you're facing towards an opened door and on the left side you can see an arch.
