Exit the room through it and move forward passing through the open entrance right in front of you and you can see another open door right ahead of you. Enter the room, turn slightly left and move forward towards the fireplace. You are now standing near a fireplace facing towards a portrait and this is your destination.

125355.instruction: You're facing towards the window, slightly turn to your left, you can see a mirror, go near the mirror and then turn to your left, you can see stairs, climb up the stairs after climbing the stairs in front, you can see an open door and a statue go inside the room, go near the sofa and turn to your right, you can see a lamp beside the open door, exit the room and again turn right, you can see another open door, exit the room, move straight, you can see an open door beside the stairs, go inside the room, go near the books this is your end point.

125380.instruction: Right now you're facing towards a mirror. Now turn behind and enter in to the room through the open door which is in front of you. There is an arch in front of you, move towards the arch and enter in to the room and stand at the entrance of the room. There is a window and curtain to your right and a lamp to your left and it is your end point

125381.instruction: Now you are standing in the narrow passage facing towards the arch, turn around and enter into the open door and go straight through the narrow path till you find lamp on the table on your left side and curtain on your right side and on the right side of the lamp is your end point on the floor.

125417.instruction: In a living room go straight and enter the another room in front two picture on the wall again turn left side in front of cross of Jesus Christ.

125418.instruction: You are facing towards an open door, enter into the open door, if you turn slightly to your left you can be able to see one more open door, enter inside, take left you will be able to see two statue in front of the window, stand in between the two statues in front of the window and a shield, its your destination.

125419.instruction: You begin in a bathroom looking towards a wall with a painting on it. Turn towards your right and exit the toilet room, and then turn to your right again and exit the entire bathroom into a bedroom. Turn to your right and approach the mirror closet doors, and then turn to the right and exit the bedroom into the hallway. Once you're out there, turn left. You should see a desk with two bar stools tucked under it. Head to the left side of that. That was actually a counter, not a desk, but potato potahto. Continue forward to the left of the small circular table on the end of the black couch, and then turn right and head between the counter and the back of the couch. Continue going forward towards the staircase or the- sorry that is a shuttered door, that you can see in the far distance. Once you are standing in front of the door mat in front of that shuttered door, which says... Metricon... Structure twenty-five years... Quaran- Guarantee. Apologies, the mat is upside-down as you can see. Anyways, once you're standing in front of that shuttered door, with the bright sunlight outside, you're done.

125431.instruction: You begin facing an archway, next to that archway, there is another archway, go through that on the right, you will enter a kitchen, keep going forward, the kitchen island should be to your right, go down the hallway to the right, and go through the first archway on the right, you will see another dining table, take a step towards it and then take a step hopping over it, all the way towards the windows, and then turn to your right, step onto the mat through the open french doors, and then just take one last step onto the tiled flooring outside, you are done.

125504.instruction: You are standing in front of the wide open door. Turn towards your right, there is a single open door. Reach to the door. Now you can see staircase area. Exit the door and reach the staircase area. Now turn right and get down few stairs. Now turn around, now you can see two doors in front of you. Enter the right door. Here you can see a sculpture in front of you and paintings mounted on the left side of the wall and there is a brown sofa in front of you. Go near the sofa. Now turn to your right. Now you can see another wide sofa and a lamp beside the sofa and there is also an open door beside the lamp. Go near the door. Now you are standing in front of the wooden cupboard. Turn to your right. now you can see you're standing in front of the door. Exit the room and here you can see you are standing on a carpet and there are few cartoons in the right side of the room and an idol in the left side of the room, and there is a glass window in front of you. Go near the window. You are facing the window, this is the end point.

125505.instruction: You are in a room facing towards the wall and a mirror. Turn right and walk straightly through the open door and exit the room. Now walk straightly towards another open room in front of you. Turn right and walk down the staircase and stand on third step. Now turn around and walk straightly into the room which has a statue on the table. Slightly turn right and walk towards the couch. Now turn right and walk towards the open door. Now turn right and walk into another room. Now walk straightly towards the window. Now you are standing in front of the window and you have a fire place and a photo frame on your left side. That will be the end point.

125549.instruction: You're looking down an archway into a living room. If you turn around, you'll find you're in a room that is circular. To your left, there is a pathway. Enter that pathway and continue down the corridor. Reaching the end of the corridor, you'll find a kitchen with a large square island and a fireplace further down. Next to the fireplace is a couch. Behind that couch is an island, another island, with three bar stools. Walk between the bar stools and the couch. Down that path, you'll see an archway that leads into a small kitchen table area to eat with a white flower vase on top of it. To the left is an open doorway that leads out. Walk through the doorway and continue straight back into the property. Keep walking straight, keeping the wooden dining table to your left. Keep walking straight through, all the way to the fireplace in the other end of the room, keeping everything furniture-wise your left and the windows and the sliding doors to your right. When you reach the fireplace, you should be standing to the right of the fireplace in the corner. Next to you is a table with a large vase of flowers. Very pretty. You're done.

125556.instruction: We are facing a pool table. turn left and go toward the TV on the wall on our left. Now turn to your right and you will see an open door that leads into a room with a fireplace.  Walk behind the white chairs that are in front of the fireplace and down to the carpet to your left in front of the coffee table and the white chair. Jump over the white chair that has some flowers next to it. Go behind the chair and to the left and you will be in a hallway with a tiled floor. Go left and there will be arches above you. Ahead of you is a kitchen. Walk to the first white cabinet with a marble counter. Take a left in front of the white counter to the end of that kitchen isle. Turn right at the double white sink and go straight to the opening to your left. You will see a round table and chairs ahead of you and to the left is a door going outside. Go out side the door. Straight ahead of you is a window on your left. Ahead of you is another brown mat in front of a door. Walk to the left corner of the brown mat. You are done.

125582.instruction: You begin facing a bunch of wooden doors, turn to your left, you will see a doorway opened up on your right, take a step towards that, you will see a white rug and a opened room to your right, go into that and then just take one more step forward into the room and you're done.

125583.instruction: You are next to a bed.  The bed will be on the left of you and you will see an open doorway to your right where you can see a staircase out beyond the door.  Exit that door.  You are going to walk thru the hallway passing the staircase on your left and a table on your right under a mirror.  Continue forward.  And you are going to go straight across and enter that white open door.  You have now entered a bedroom with a geometric shaped multi colored rug on the floor.   Go towards that rug.  And you are going to go over that rug and stand right in the middle of it.  While standing on the rug to the right of you will be a black book shelf and to the left of you will be the bed.  You are done.

125595.instruction: You're looking at a brown cabinet, to the left are two laundry machines. If you look to the right you'll see an open door across the hallway is an archway, take a step towards this archway. And if you turn to the right you should see a violin at the end of the room, take two steps towards this violin. And once you're in front of the violin and you'll see a piano to the left. Take a step towards this piano. And then take two steps towards the cabinet you see in front of you. And then to the left are two brown open doors, walk through these. And then take a step towards the bathtub you see in front of you. And you should see to your right there's two doors, walk to the one on the left. And then one step into the room on the left, and you'll be a bathroom you'll see a window in front of you and a toilet to the left and you've reached the end.

125624.instruction: For start point you are on a area rug that is toward the end of a pathway move forward onto the rug that is in front of you. You will see a white door move forward

125625.instruction: Turn 180 degrees from the "My Barn My Rules" sign and now with the pool table on your left, to your right you'll see a wooden post directly in front of you and just to the right of that a couch, walk towards the couch that's just to right of that post. Now once you're not quite at the couch or the couch chair yet, take another right and take a step down the brick hallway here so that the chairs are on the left and the window pane doors on the right and you're walking towards the kitchen area. Only go till you're just between the two chairs on the left. Now turn back around 180 degrees and facing the pool table, to the right of the pool table there will be a fireplace in the distance, walk directly towards the fireplace, staying to the right of the beam in front of you and to the left of the table. Once you're close to the fireplace, turn to the right and walk towards the cabinet straight ahead that's grey. Bypassing the coffee table and keeping the couch on your right. Once you're close to the grey cabinet, leaving the coffee table, couches and chairs behind you. Facing the cabinet, you'll have an office desk on the left and a chair behind it with a lamp that's on. Turn to the right and walk, keeping the window pane doors that are now on your left and chairs on your right. Directly in front of you appear to be stairs that are going down and just to the right of that is an entry way into the kitchen that goes underneath the stairs going up. Walk towards that kitchen to the right of the stairway. In the kitchen area you'll see a large dining room table in the middle, stay to the left of that table, keeping the pots and cutlery and plates to the left, dining room table on the right, walk towards the little archway on the kitchen counter top. Once you reach that, turn to the right and keep walking around the dining table, keeping the kitchen counters to your left and the dining room table on your right. Now you should be on the opposite end of the dining room table, facing an oven with a stove on top of it. Turn to the right and you'll be facing the area of which you started with some window pane doors on the left and on the right, stairs going up. Take the stairs going up. At the top of the stairs you'll see a bed with a small chair facing the bed on the left with a small table next to it and then to the right of the bed there is an open door. Stay to the left of the bed and walk between the chair and the foot of the bed. Once you're standing between the chair, the ottoman and the foot of the bed, you're finally finished.

125632.instruction: We're facing towards a bathtub, walk towards it and turn towards the left and walk towards the archway that's in front of you... Turn slightly to the left, take four steps further, turn towards the right, and enter the closet that's in front of you... take a few steps towards the middle of the closet, you'll a dresser on your left and some shirts on your right, and you'll stop in front of a shoe shelf, and that's your destination.

125633.instruction: We start off facing some shelves. Turn around. Hop over the coffee table and on to white tile past the rug. Slightly turn to your left and you'll see an open doorway to the right with a kitchen. Walk though that doorway then turn to your right. Walk into that hallway and on the second door. just past the second door turn left. Take a step on to the left side of the bed towards the restroom door opening. Take a step into the restroom next to the sinks and stop you're done.

125657.instruction: You are facing towards a wall, turn back and move towards the opened door, slightly turn right and move a bit forward, slightly turn right and move forward until you see an opened door on your left, now you are facing towards the wall, slightly turn left and move a bit forward, that would be your end point.

125658.instruction: You are now facing towards a wall, turn around and walk out of the room through the white door opening which is towards your right. And slightly turn towards your right and walk one step forward. And turn right and walk through the corridor and walk near to the wall. And you can find a door opening towards your left. Just enter the door and stand there. This is the final end point and you have reached the destination.

125802.instruction: You are facing towards the snooker table, turn left and move forward. Turn right and move towards the chair which is in front of you. Turn slight left and move towards the fire place. Now you are standing near the fire place, keep moving forward. Turn right and move towards the staircase. You are standing near the railing, turn right and move towards the dinning table. Now turn right you can see a carpet in front of you, move on to the carpet. Now you are facing towards the center table and sofa. The position you are standing is your final destination.

125803.instruction: Now you are in a room, facing towards the snooker table, turn slightly left and walk straight till the wooden wall, from there turn right and walk straight near the chair, go near the wooden table which in front of the sofa,  walk few steps forward, turn right and go straight till the railing, from railing go towards the dinning table, turn right and walk straight near the sofa sets and stand beside the chair which has floral cushion, this would be your final destination.

125838.instruction: You are standing in the kitchen facing towards the kitchen platform which has a sink, take right and walk towards the ovens which are in front of you. Take left and walk towards the arch to your left, take slight left and enter inside the open entrance. Take slight right, you will be facing towards the closed door, now turn left and enter the open room, move forward and exit the room through another open door. You are standing beside the closed stove on your right, now take left and walk towards the white chair, take slight right and move towards the center table, move forward and walk towards the dining table with white color chairs. You are standing beside the chair facing towards the flower vase which is your end point.

125839.instruction: Now, you are facing towards the cupboard. Take left passing through the washbasin. Move forward and take left. On your right, you can find a portrait on the wall and an arch on your right side. Pass through that arch. Now, take left, there you can find a door entrance to the kitchen. Enter into that kitchen. Go straight, you will find another door. Enter through it. Once you are out of that kitchen, take left. You will find a wooden arch. Cross that arch and take slight right towards the fireplace. Cross the table and move forward towards the dining table and that will be your end point near the dining table and glass windows on your left side and then stop.

125911.instruction: "Okay now you are facing towards the wall. Turn around and move forward, you can see an open door on the right side. Now slightly turn right and move forward, you can see the wall in front of you. Now turn left and move forward until, you reach the potted plant in front of you. Now turn left, you can see an open door in front of you. Now enter into that room through that open door and move forward until, you reach the potted plant in front of you, and the the table on the left side. Now, you have reached your destination."

125912.instruction: Turn right from the place you are standing and move a bit forward, to your right you can find an opened door, move towards the opened door and exit the room, slightly turn to your left and move forward, you can find an opened door to your left, enter into the room and stand infront of the potted plant, that would be your end point.

125976.instruction: Now, you are facing towards the stool. Turn slightly right and walk straight in the pathway on the carpets. Now, turn left from the end and you will find a staircase. Take the stairs and go down. Once you reach down, turn slight left towards the stove. Turn left from the stove and move forward towards the cupboards and the oven on your right side. Pass between the cupboards and the chairs. Now, turn left from the chair and move forward towards the lamp. Turn slight right from the lamp. Now, turn around and move forward towards the staircase and that will be your end point at the starting point of the staircase.

125977.instruction: You're facing towards a wooden railing. Walk beside it all the way. Turn left, turn behind and get down the stairs. Walk towards the stove. Turn left and walk beside the dining chairs walk towards the narrow path all the way. Now, you are facing a wooden chair from there turn left and walk straight towards the lamp. From there turn right. On the right side corner, you can see the stairs to get down Stand near the stairs is your destination.

125987.instruction: You're starting in a dining room. There's an open door to your left leading out into a hallway. Exit through that door. Take a step onto the rug in the hallway, passing the stairs on your right. Then take one step to the very top of the stairs. You won't go down them, but you will be looking down them and there is an open door in front of you. You're done.
